attributes.references: Baell & Holloway (2010) J Med Chem; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: percent_activation
attributes.description: Calculated percentage activation of the target relative to controls. Primary activity metric for agonist/activator HTS campaigns. Null for inhibition assays.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1); GLP 21 CFR Part 58; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: percent_inhibition
attributes.description: Calculated percentage inhibition of the target activity relative to positive and negative controls on the same plate. Primary activity metric for inhibitory HTS campaigns. Null for activation assays.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1); GLP 21 CFR Part 58; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: plate_barcode
attributes.description: Unique barcode identifier of the physical assay plate on which the compound was tested. Used for traceability back to the physical plate in the LIMS and for QC investigations.
attributes.references: LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager; GLP 21 CFR Part 58; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: plate_column
attributes.description: Numeric column designation (1–24) of the well on the assay plate. Used for spatial analysis of plate effects and systematic error detection.
attributes.references: ANSI/SBS 1-2004 Microplate Standard; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: plate_row
attributes.description: Row designation (A–P) of the well on the assay plate. Used for spatial analysis of plate effects and edge-effect QC.
attributes.references: ANSI/SBS 1-2004 Microplate Standard; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: quality_flag_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why a data quality flag was applied (e.g., 'edge well effect', 'reagent lot failure', 'instrument malfunction', 'outlier replicate'). Required when data_quality_flag is 'flagged' or 'rejected'.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; 21 CFR Part 11; LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager

attributes.name: raw_signal_value
attributes.description: Unprocessed instrument signal reading from the assay detector (e.g., fluorescence units, luminescence counts, absorbance). Preserved as the primary measurement for audit and reanalysis.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; 21 CFR Part 11; LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager

attributes.name: reagent_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot identifier of the key assay reagent (e.g., enzyme, antibody, cell line passage) used in this assay run. Enables reagent lot correlation analysis for systematic variability investigation.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager; cGMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: replicate_number
attributes.description: Sequential replicate index for this compound-assay combination within the same run (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Enables statistical aggregation across replicates and assessment of intra-assay variability.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: result_classification
attributes.description: Scientific classification of the screening result based on activity thresholds and confirmatory data. Drives hit-to-lead progression decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|inconclusive|toxic|hit|confirmed_hit|false_positive|pan_assay_interference — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH Q6A; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the assay run was executed. Used for temporal trending, reagent lot correlation, and GLP audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the assay instrument reading was captured. Supports intra-day sequencing, instrument log correlation, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: selectivity_score
attributes.description: Quantitative selectivity score measuring the compound's specificity for the primary target versus off-target activities in a selectivity panel. Higher scores indicate greater selectivity. Used in SAR-driven lead optimization.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH S9; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: signal_to_background_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the positive control signal to the background (negative control) signal on the assay plate. A key plate-level QC metric; low S/B ratios indicate assay degradation or reagent failure.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this screening result record. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP 21 CFR Part 58; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: well_position
attributes.description: Alphanumeric well position on the assay plate (e.g., A01, H12, P24) indicating the exact location of the compound in the plate layout. Standard SBS/ANSI plate format.
attributes.references: ANSI/SBS 1-2004 Microplate Standard; LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager

attributes.name: z_prime_factor
attributes.description: Z' factor for the assay plate, a dimensionless statistical metric (range -∞ to 1) measuring assay quality based on signal window and variability. Z' ≥ 0.5 is the accepted threshold for a valid HTS assay plate.
attributes.references: Zhang JH et al. (1999) J Biomol Screen; GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LIMS - LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager

products.name: sar_study
products.description: Master record for Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR) studies conducted to understand how structural modifications to a compound affect its biological activity. Captures study name, lead series identifier, target identifier, SAR hypothesis, key structural features analyzed, number of analogs synthesized, potency range observed, selectivity findings, ADME impact, study status, lead scientist, and ELN notebook reference from IDBS/Dotmatics. Core entity for medicinal chemistry optimization.

attributes.name: sar_study_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the SAR study record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH M10, IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN internal object model

attributes.name: assay_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.assay. Business justification: SAR (Structure-Activity Relationship) studies use specific assays to measure potency and selectivity of synthesized analogs. The study table currently has assay_type as a denormalized STRING attribute

attributes.name: best_compound_id
attributes.description: Reference to the single best-performing compound identified from this SAR study, based on the combination of potency, selectivity, and ADME profile. Candidate for progression to the next discovery stage.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry; ICH M4 CMC

attributes.name: hts_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating High-Throughput Screening (HTS) campaign from which the hit compounds for this SAR study were identified. Provides lineage from HTS to lead optimization.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; LIMS; ICH M4

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: SAR studies are discrete R&D activities requiring dedicated cost tracking via internal orders for financial planning, cost-per-analog analysis, and stage-gate decision support in medicinal chemistry o

attributes.name: lead_series_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead chemical series under investigation in this SAR study. Links to the compound series master record in the compound library.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound library; ICH M4 CMC

attributes.name: molecular_target_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological molecular target (e.g., protein, receptor, enzyme) that the SAR study is designed to modulate. Links to the target identification master record.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; UniProt; ChEMBL target ontology

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: SAR studies generate patentable inventions (novel analogs, structure-activity relationships); patent linkage tracks invention disclosures from medicinal chemistry, supports patent filing decisions, an

attributes.name: primary_sar_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the principal medicinal chemist or scientist responsible for designing and executing this SAR study. Used for accountability, expertise tracking, and publication attribution.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); ICH M4

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent drug discovery project under which this SAR study is conducted. Enables roll-up reporting at the project level.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics project hierarchy; ICH M4

attributes.name: sar_director_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the study director responsible for the overall scientific and regulatory conduct of the SAR study. Required for GLP-compliant studies per 21 CFR Part 58.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 58.33 (GLP Study Director); OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: SAR studies document lead optimization and are included in Module 3.2.S (drug substance chemistry). Real regulatory requirement: structure-activity relationship data supports impurity qualification an

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: SAR studies may involve outsourced analog synthesis or specialized assay services from CRO vendors. Procurement manages vendor qualification, quality agreements, IP protection, and service delivery—co

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SAR study was actually completed and final data locked in the ELN. Compared against target completion date for schedule variance analysis.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: adme_impact_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Absorption Distribution Metabolism Excretion (ADME) Impact Summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of how structural modifications in this SAR study impacted ADME properties including metabolic stability, permeability, solubility, plasma protein binding, and CYP inhibition. Sourced from LIMS and ELN data.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; LIMS (LabWare/SampleManager); ICH M4 CMC; FDA ADME Guidance

attributes.name: analogs_synthesized_count
attributes.description: Total count of chemical analogs synthesized and tested within this SAR study. Key productivity metric for medicinal chemistry resource planning and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registration; ICH M4 CMC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SAR study record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); FDA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) reflecting the completeness and reliability of the experimental data captured in this SAR study, based on assay reproducibility, data completeness, and ELN audit trail integrity. Used for data governance and AI/ML model training quality gates.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance (2018); 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

attributes.name: eln_notebook_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the corresponding study record in the IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN). Provides traceability to the primary research data source.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: glp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SAR study was conducted under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. True = GLP-compliant study; False = non-GLP exploratory research. Relevant for regulatory submission packages.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP); OECD GLP Principles; FDA GLP Guidance

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: Specific disease or medical condition that the compounds in this SAR study are intended to treat or prevent (e.g., Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Rheumatoid Arthritis). More granular than therapeutic area.

attributes.name: key_structural_features
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the key chemical structural features (pharmacophores, functional groups, scaffolds, substituents) analyzed in this SAR study to drive potency, selectivity, or ADME properties.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4 CMC; SAR best practices

attributes.name: mechanism_of_action
attributes.description: Description of the biochemical mechanism by which the compounds in this series exert their pharmacological effect on the target (e.g., competitive inhibition, allosteric modulation, covalent binding).
attributes.references: ICH M4; FDA Pharmacology Review Guidance; ChEMBL MOA ontology

attributes.name: metabolic_stability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead compounds in this SAR study met the predefined metabolic stability criteria (e.g., microsomal half-life threshold). True = criteria met; False = criteria not met.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; LIMS; ICH M4; FDA ADME Guidance

attributes.name: nce_nbe_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Chemical Entity / New Biological Entity (NCE/NBE) Type
attributes.description: Classification of the compound series as a New Chemical Entity (NCE, small molecule) or New Biological Entity (NBE, biologic/large molecule) or hybrid. Determines regulatory pathway and IP strategy.
attributes.references: FDA NCE/NBE Classification; ICH M4; 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA) / Part 601 (BLA)

attributes.name: patent_filing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a patent application has been initiated for compounds or methods arising from this SAR study. True = patent filing in progress or completed; False = no patent action taken.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; USPTO Patent Filing; ICH M4; IP Management Best Practices

attributes.name: permeability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead compounds demonstrated acceptable membrane permeability (e.g., Caco-2 or PAMPA assay thresholds). True = acceptable permeability achieved; False = not achieved.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; LIMS; ICH M4; FDA ADME Guidance

attributes.name: potency_metric_type
attributes.description: Type of biochemical potency measurement used to characterize compound activity in this SAR study (e.g., IC50 for inhibitory concentration, Ki for inhibition constant, EC50 for effective concentration).
attributes.references: IUPAC pharmacology nomenclature; ChEMBL bioactivity standards; ICH M4

attributes.name: potency_range_max_nm
attributes.description: Highest (least potent) IC50 or Ki value observed across all analogs in this SAR study, expressed in nanomolar (nM). Together with the minimum, defines the potency range of the series.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics assay results; ICH M4 Pharmacology; ChEMBL bioactivity standards

attributes.name: potency_range_min_nm
attributes.description: Lowest (most potent) IC50 or Ki value observed across all analogs in this SAR study, expressed in nanomolar (nM). Represents the best-in-series potency achieved.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics assay results; ICH M4 Pharmacology; ChEMBL bioactivity standards

attributes.name: progression_decision
attributes.description: Outcome decision made at the conclusion of the SAR study regarding whether the lead series should progress to the next stage of drug discovery (e.g., lead optimization, candidate selection) or be deprioritized.
attributes.references: ICH M4; ISPE Drug Discovery Stage Gate Model; FDA IND Guidance

attributes.name: sar_hypothesis
attributes.description: Scientific hypothesis describing the proposed relationship between structural features of the compound series and the observed or expected biological activity. Captured from the ELN study plan.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; ICH M4 CMC; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: selectivity_findings
attributes.description: Summary of selectivity data for the lead compounds against off-target proteins or related family members. Describes selectivity ratios, panel screening results, and any observed off-target liabilities.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4 Pharmacology; FDA Pharmacology/Toxicology Guidance

attributes.name: selectivity_ratio
attributes.description: Quantitative ratio of the compound's potency against the primary target versus the most relevant off-target (e.g., 100-fold selective over related kinase). Key metric for candidate progression decisions.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4 Pharmacology; FDA Pharmacology Guidance

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SAR study was formally initiated, corresponding to the first experimental activity recorded in the ELN. Used for timeline tracking and portfolio planning.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: study_name
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the SAR study, typically including the lead series name and therapeutic target (e.g., 'Series-7 EGFR Kinase Inhibitor Optimization'). Used for display and search in ELN and project management tools.

attributes.name: study_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the SAR study at initiation (e.g., SAR-ONC-202401). Used for cross-system referencing in ELN, LIMS, and project tracking systems.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics study numbering convention; ICH M4 eCTD

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: Stage of the drug discovery funnel at which this SAR study is conducted. Aligns with the hit-to-lead and lead optimization progression framework used in medicinal chemistry.
attributes.references: ICH M4; ISPE Drug Discovery Stage Gate Model

attributes.name: study_report_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier or Veeva Vault reference for the formal SAR study report summarizing findings, conclusions, and progression recommendations. Provides traceability to the official scientific record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault QualityDocs / eTMF; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH M4

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SAR study. Drives workflow routing and portfolio reporting. 'terminated' indicates early discontinuation; 'archived' indicates data locked in ELN.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics study lifecycle; ICH M4

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the SAR study is expected to be completed and key findings reported. Used for project milestone tracking and resource scheduling.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4; ISPE Drug Discovery Stage Gate

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Broad disease area or therapeutic category targeted by the SAR study (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Used for portfolio segmentation and resource allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|neuroscience|cardiovascular|infectious_disease|metabolic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WHO ATC Classification; ICH E8; FDA CDER Therapeutic Area Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this SAR study record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); FDA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+

products.name: lead_series
products.description: Master record for chemical lead series progressing through hit-to-lead and lead optimization stages. Captures series name, scaffold/chemotype description, originating HTS campaign, primary target, series status (hit-to-lead, lead optimization, deprioritized, nominated), best-in-class compound identifier, potency benchmark, selectivity profile, ADME profile summary, IP landscape assessment, therapeutic area, program code, and stage-gate progression history with decision rationale. Central entity for tracking medicinal chemistry progression and compound governance decisions from hit confirmation through candidate nomination.

attributes.name: lead_series_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the lead series record. Primary key for the lead_series data product in the discovery domain.
attributes.references: ICH M10, IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics internal entity model

attributes.name: best_in_class_compound_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compound record representing the best-performing compound within this lead series at the current stage, used as the benchmark for potency, selectivity, and ADME profiling comparisons.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry; ICH Q8

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: SAR-to-market traceability: connects lead optimization series to commercial formulation for regulatory CMC narratives, development history documentation, and IP prosecution support. Essential for CMC

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead medicinal chemist or scientist who originated and is responsible for the lead series. Used for accountability, knowledge management, and ELN traceability.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics user registry; GLP (21 CFR Part 58) personnel records

attributes.name: hts_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating High-Throughput Screening (HTS) campaign from which the initial hits in this series were identified. Provides traceability from lead series back to the screening event.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics HTS module; ICH Q8

attributes.name: invention_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.invention_disclosure. Business justification: Lead series generate invention disclosures for novel scaffolds and SAR; disclosure linkage tracks IP capture from medicinal chemistry, supports patent filing decisions, and documents innovation pipeli

attributes.name: licensing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: Lead series may be in-licensed or out-licensed; agreement linkage tracks licensed rights, royalty obligations, milestone payments, territory restrictions, and field-of-use limitations for portfolio ma

attributes.name: molecular_target_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary molecular target (e.g., protein, enzyme, receptor) against which this lead series is designed to act. Central to target-based drug discovery and SAR analysis.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics target registry; ICH Q8; UniProt

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Lead series represent patentable chemical scaffolds; patent family linkage tracks composition-of-matter protection, supports stage gate IP assessments, and enables portfolio prioritization based on IP

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.discovery_project. Business justification: Lead series are chemical series progressing through hit-to-lead and lead optimization stages within discovery projects. The series table currently has program_code as a denormalized STRING attribute.

attributes.name: adme_profile_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Absorption Distribution Metabolism Excretion (ADME) Profile Summary
attributes.description: Summary of the Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, and Excretion (ADME) profile for the lead series, including key in vitro ADME data such as microsomal stability, permeability (Caco-2/PAMPA), plasma protein binding, and CYP inhibition flags.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; ICH M3(R2); GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook ADME module

attributes.name: compound_count
attributes.description: Total number of discrete compounds synthesized and registered within this lead series. Indicates the breadth of SAR exploration and medicinal chemistry effort invested in the series.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry; ICH Q8

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead series record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GLP/21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); ICH Q8

attributes.name: current_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the lead series within the drug discovery pipeline, from hit confirmation through candidate nomination. Distinct from series_status in that it reflects the scientific progression stage rather than the governance lifecycle state.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company discovery stage-gate framework; IDBS E-WorkBook

attributes.name: deprioritization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead series was formally deprioritized or stopped. Null if the series is still active. Used for portfolio analytics and resource reallocation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP

attributes.name: drug_likeness_score
attributes.description: Composite drug-likeness score for the best-in-class compound in the series, typically based on Lipinski Rule of Five parameters or QED (Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness). Ranges from 0 to 1; higher values indicate better drug-likeness.
attributes.references: Lipinski Rule of Five; QED (Bickerton et al.); ICH Q8; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics cheminformatics

attributes.name: eln_notebook_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this lead series to the primary Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) experiment or project in IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics where the originating research data is recorded. Ensures data traceability and GLP audit trail.
attributes.references: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); 21 CFR Part 11; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN

attributes.name: glp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the key studies supporting this lead series have been conducted under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) conditions as required for regulatory submission. True = GLP-compliant studies on record.
attributes.references: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); OECD GLP Principles; FDA GLP regulations

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: Specific disease indication or clinical condition that the lead series is intended to treat or prevent (e.g., 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer', 'Rheumatoid Arthritis'). Aligns with the therapeutic area and drives clinical development planning.
attributes.references: ICD-11 (WHO); MedDRA; company portfolio taxonomy; ICH E8

attributes.name: ip_landscape_assessment
attributes.description: Narrative assessment of the Intellectual Property (IP) landscape for the lead series, including freedom-to-operate (FTO) status, known competitor patents covering the scaffold, and patentability assessment. Classified as confidential due to competitive sensitivity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; ICH Q8; company IP governance policy; USPTO/EPO patent databases

attributes.name: ip_status
attributes.description: Current IP status of the lead series scaffold, indicating whether freedom-to-operate has been established, patents have been filed, or IP encumbrances exist. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: USPTO; EPO; ICH Q8; company IP governance SOP

attributes.name: moa_description
attributes.description: Description of the Mechanism of Action (MOA) for the lead series, explaining how compounds in the series interact with the molecular target to produce the desired pharmacological effect.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; IDBS E-WorkBook pharmacology module

attributes.name: modality
attributes.description: Drug modality classification for the lead series, indicating the type of therapeutic molecule (e.g., small molecule, biologic, peptide). Drives CMC strategy, manufacturing approach, and regulatory pathway selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: small_molecule|biologic|peptide|oligonucleotide|cell_therapy|gene_therapy|antibody_drug_conjugate|radioligand — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q8; FDA CDER/CBER modality classification; EMA guidelines

attributes.name: molecular_weight_da
attributes.description: Molecular weight of the core scaffold or best-in-class compound in Daltons (Da). Key physicochemical property used in drug-likeness assessment (Lipinski Rule of Five: MW ≤ 500 Da for oral drugs).
attributes.references: Lipinski Rule of Five; ICH Q8; IUPAC; Dotmatics cheminformatics

attributes.name: nce_nbe_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Chemical Entity / New Biological Entity (NCE/NBE) Classification
attributes.description: Classification of the lead series as a New Chemical Entity (NCE), New Biological Entity (NBE), or New Molecular Entity (NME). Determines regulatory pathway, IP strategy, and data exclusivity eligibility.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 (NCE); 21 CFR Part 601 (NBE); FDA CDER/CBER classification; ICH Q8

attributes.name: nomination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead series was formally nominated as a development candidate, marking the transition from discovery to preclinical development. Null if the series has not yet been nominated.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

attributes.name: oral_bioavailability_pct
attributes.description: Best-in-class oral bioavailability percentage (%F) for the lead series from preclinical in vivo PK studies. Key ADME metric for assessing drug-likeness and oral dosing feasibility.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; ICH M3(R2); GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: pk_profile_summary
attributes.description: Summary of in vivo Pharmacokinetics (PK) data for the lead series, including key parameters such as oral bioavailability (%F), half-life (t½), clearance (CL), and volume of distribution (Vd) from preclinical species studies.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; ICH M3(R2); GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook PK module

attributes.name: potency_assay_type
attributes.description: Type of biochemical or cellular assay used to determine the potency benchmark value (e.g., IC50, Ki, EC50, Kd). Provides context for interpreting the potency_benchmark_nm value.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook

attributes.name: potency_benchmark_nm
attributes.description: Best-in-class potency value (IC50 or Ki) for the lead series expressed in nanomolar (nM) concentration. Represents the principal quantitative performance metric for the series and is used in stage-gate go/no-go decisions.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook assay data

attributes.name: safety_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any significant safety liabilities (e.g., genotoxicity, hERG inhibition, reactive metabolites, phototoxicity) have been identified for compounds in this lead series. True = known safety liability requiring mitigation.
attributes.references: ICH S2(R1); ICH S7B; ICH M7; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook safety profiling

attributes.name: safety_liability_notes
attributes.description: Narrative description of identified safety liabilities for the lead series, including the nature of the liability, affected compounds, and proposed mitigation strategies. Populated when safety_flag is True.
attributes.references: ICH S2(R1); ICH S7B; ICH M7; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: sar_maturity_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the maturity of the Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR) understanding for the lead series, from early (limited data) to mature (well-defined SAR with predictive models). Used in stage-gate assessments.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; IDBS E-WorkBook SAR module; company medicinal chemistry SOP

attributes.name: scaffold_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the core chemical scaffold or chemotype defining the lead series, including key structural features relevant to Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR) analysis. Captured from ELN records.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH Q8; SAR analysis standards

attributes.name: selectivity_profile_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the selectivity profile for the lead series, describing off-target activity, selectivity ratios against related targets, and any known liabilities identified through selectivity panels (e.g., kinase selectivity panel, GPCR panel).
attributes.references: ICH Q8; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook selectivity data

attributes.name: series_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the lead series within the compound governance system (e.g., ONCO-SER-00042). Used as the business identifier across ELN, LIMS, and medicinal chemistry platforms.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registration standards; ICH Q8

attributes.name: series_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the lead series, typically reflecting the chemotype or scaffold class (e.g., 'Pyrimidine Kinase Inhibitor Series A'). Used in medicinal chemistry reports and stage-gate presentations.

attributes.name: series_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead series was formally initiated following hit confirmation from the originating HTS campaign. Marks the beginning of the hit-to-lead phase and is used for timeline and cycle-time analytics.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

attributes.name: series_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lead series within the drug discovery pipeline. Governs stage-gate decisions and resource allocation. Values: hit_to_lead (active hit confirmation and early profiling), lead_optimization (active medicinal chemistry optimization), deprioritized (paused or stopped), nominated (candidate nominated for development), on_hold (temporarily paused pending decision).
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

attributes.name: smiles_scaffold
attributes.description: Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System (SMILES) string representing the core scaffold structure of the lead series. Enables cheminformatics analysis, substructure searching, and computational chemistry workflows.
attributes.references: IUPAC SMILES notation standard; Dotmatics / IDBS E-WorkBook cheminformatics module

attributes.name: stage_gate_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent stage-gate committee decision was made for this lead series. Used for tracking progression timelines and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP

attributes.name: stage_gate_decision
attributes.description: Most recent stage-gate committee decision for the lead series, indicating whether the series has been approved to progress (go), stopped (no_go), placed on hold, or conditionally approved pending specific criteria.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

attributes.name: stage_gate_rationale
attributes.description: Documented rationale for the most recent stage-gate decision, capturing the scientific, strategic, and risk-based reasoning of the decision committee. Supports audit trail and portfolio governance.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area classification for the lead series, aligning with the company's portfolio strategy (e.g., oncology, immunology, rare disease). Drives resource allocation and stage-gate governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_disease|neuroscience|cardiovascular|infectious_disease|metabolic|respiratory|hematology|ophthalmology — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead series record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); ICH Q8

products.name: compound_synthesis
products.description: Transactional record capturing the synthesis of individual compounds by medicinal chemistry teams. Captures compound identifier, synthesis route identifier, synthetic method, reagents used, reaction conditions (temperature, solvent, catalyst), yield percentage, purity by HPLC/NMR, batch number, synthesis date, synthesizing chemist, ELN experiment reference from IDBS/Dotmatics, and GLP compliance flag. Tracks the manufacturing provenance of discovery compounds.

attributes.name: compound_synthesis_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each compound synthesis record in the discovery domain. Primary key for the compound_synthesis data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete synthesis event with its own lifecycle, reagents, conditions, and outcomes.
attributes.references: ICH Q11 (Development and Manufacture of Drug Substances)

attributes.name: compound_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compound entity that was synthesized in this experiment. Links the synthesis record to the master compound registry (NCE/NBE catalogue).
attributes.references: ICH Q11; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: Synthesis activities consume reagents, labor, and equipment charged to cost centers for project costing, resource planning, and financial reporting. Essential for medicinal chemistry budget management

attributes.name: dmf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.dmf. Business justification: Synthesis routes and manufacturing processes are documented in Drug Master Files (Type II DMF for API). Real business process: CMC teams reference synthesis data when preparing or updating DMFs for re

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Individual synthesis activities are charged to internal orders for cost-per-compound tracking, essential for portfolio economics, make-vs-buy decisions, and CRO cost benchmarking in pharmaceutical dis

attributes.name: invention_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.invention_disclosure. Business justification: Novel synthetic routes and processes are disclosed as inventions; disclosure linkage tracks process IP, supports patent filing for manufacturing methods, and protects CMC innovations.

attributes.name: lead_series_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.lead_series. Business justification: Compound synthesis efforts by medicinal chemistry teams are organized by lead series. Each synthesis produces an analog within a specific chemical series. The synthesis table currently has series_code

attributes.name: molecular_target_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological target (protein, enzyme, receptor, or pathway) against which this compound was synthesized. Links synthesis provenance to target identification and MOA studies in the discovery domain.
attributes.references: ChEMBL target classification; UniProt; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: primary_compound_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the medicinal chemist who performed the synthesis. Supports attribution, GLP accountability, and ELN audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); ICH Q10

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug discovery project under which this synthesis was conducted. Enables project-level portfolio reporting, resource tracking, and compound series management.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics project management

attributes.name: synthesis_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the defined synthetic route used for this synthesis event. A route captures the ordered sequence of chemical transformations from starting materials to target compound.
attributes.references: ICH Q11; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics route registry

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Custom synthesis frequently outsourced to CRO/CMO vendors. Procurement manages vendor qualification, quality agreements, IP protection clauses, and service delivery for outsourced synthesis operations

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the synthesis record received formal electronic approval in the ELN by the supervising scientist. Distinct from record creation; captures the GLP-required second-person review event for data integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); OECD Series on Principles of GLP

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric batch identifier assigned to the synthesized compound lot. Used for inventory tracking, biological testing assignment, and downstream traceability through the discovery pipeline. Aligns with SAP MM batch management.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.68; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA MM module

attributes.name: catalyst
attributes.description: Name and loading of the catalyst or catalytic system used in the reaction (e.g., Pd(PPh3)4, Pd2(dba)3/XPhos, DMAP). Null if the reaction is uncatalysed. Critical for SAR and process chemistry knowledge management.

attributes.name: compound_type
attributes.description: Classification of the synthesized compound by modality. Distinguishes New Chemical Entities (NCE), New Biological Entities (NBE), peptides, oligonucleotides, PROTACs, fragments, and natural product derivatives. Drives downstream development pathway and regulatory strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NCE|NBE|peptide|oligonucleotide|PROTAC|fragment|natural_product_derivative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH M9; FDA CDER Drug Classification; EMA Guideline on the Investigation of Bioequivalence

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this synthesis record was first created in the system (ELN or data lakehouse). Mandatory audit field for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and GLP data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: eln_experiment_ref
attributes.description: Unique experiment identifier from the Electronic Lab Notebook system (IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics) that documents the full experimental procedure, observations, and raw data for this synthesis. Provides traceability back to the authoritative source record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for synthesis failure or cancellation when synthesis_status is 'failed' or 'cancelled'. Captures root cause information (e.g., no reaction observed, product decomposition, purification failure, starting material unavailable) to support process learning and SAR knowledge management.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: glp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this synthesis was conducted in full compliance with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. GLP-compliant syntheses are required for compounds entering formal preclinical safety studies. True = GLP compliant; False = non-GLP (exploratory research).
attributes.references: OECD Principles of GLP; 21 CFR Part 58; OECD Series on Principles of GLP and Compliance Monitoring

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS/CLP hazard classification of the synthesized compound based on its physicochemical and toxicological properties. Governs safe handling, storage, and disposal procedures in the laboratory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_hazardous|flammable|toxic|corrosive|oxidising|highly_toxic|environmental_hazard — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonised System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals); EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008; OSHA HazCom 2012

attributes.name: hplc_purity_percent
attributes.description: Purity of the synthesized compound as determined by High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC), expressed as area percentage. A Critical Quality Attribute (CQA) for compound registration and screening eligibility. Compounds typically require ≥95% purity for HTS submission.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A (Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); USP <621>

attributes.name: molecular_formula
attributes.description: Empirical molecular formula of the synthesized compound (e.g., C18H21N3O2). Derived from structural confirmation data. Used for compound identity verification, registry matching, and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: IUPAC nomenclature; ICH Q6A; Dotmatics / IDBS compound registry

attributes.name: molecular_weight
attributes.description: Calculated molecular weight of the synthesized compound in grams per mole (g/mol), derived from the confirmed chemical structure. Used for stoichiometric calculations, Lipinski rule-of-five assessment, and compound library profiling.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; IUPAC; Dotmatics / IDBS compound registry

attributes.name: nmr_purity_percent
attributes.description: Purity of the synthesized compound as determined by quantitative Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, expressed as percentage. Orthogonal purity assessment to HPLC; used for structural confirmation and identity verification per GLP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); USP <761>

attributes.name: product_mass_mg
attributes.description: Actual mass of isolated compound product in milligrams. Used to determine availability for biological screening, ADME assays, and compound library registration. Directly linked to synthesis scale and yield.
attributes.references: ICH Q11; LIMS (LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager)

attributes.name: purification_method
attributes.description: Method used to purify the crude reaction product to achieve the required purity specification (e.g., column chromatography, preparative HPLC, recrystallisation, trituration). Influences final yield and purity outcomes and informs process development decisions.
attributes.references: ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: reaction_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the synthesis reaction in hours. A Critical Process Parameter (CPP) used in reaction optimization and SAR/process correlation studies.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

attributes.name: reaction_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature at which the synthesis reaction was conducted, expressed in degrees Celsius. A Critical Process Parameter (CPP) that directly influences reaction selectivity, yield, and purity. Captured from ELN experimental conditions.
attributes.references: ICH Q8 (Pharmaceutical Development); ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

attributes.name: reagents_description
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the key reagents and their stoichiometric equivalents used in the synthesis (e.g., 'K2CO3 (2.0 eq), Pd(OAc)2 (5 mol%), SPhos (10 mol%)'). Supports reproducibility and GLP documentation requirements.
attributes.references: GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); 21 CFR Part 58; ICH Q11

attributes.name: registered_in_library
attributes.description: Indicates whether the synthesized compound has been registered in the corporate compound library for HTS and biological screening. True = registered and available for screening; False = not yet registered or failed registration criteria (e.g., purity < 95%).
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry; LIMS (LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager)

attributes.name: smiles_notation
attributes.description: Canonical SMILES (Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System) string representing the two-dimensional chemical structure of the synthesized compound. Machine-readable format used for cheminformatics, SAR analysis, and compound database registration in Dotmatics.
attributes.references: Daylight Chemical Information Systems SMILES specification; ICH Q6A; Dotmatics / IDBS

attributes.name: solvent
attributes.description: Name of the primary solvent or solvent system used in the synthesis reaction (e.g., DMF, THF, DCM, EtOH, water). Influences reaction kinetics, selectivity, and downstream purification strategy. Relevant to ICH Q3C solvent classification for later-stage development.
attributes.references: ICH Q3C (Residual Solvents); ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the synthesized compound to maintain stability and integrity (e.g., room temperature, 2–8°C, −20°C, −80°C, nitrogen atmosphere, desiccator). Derived from compound physicochemical properties and stability data.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A (Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products); LIMS (LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager)

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical storage location of the synthesized compound batch (e.g., freezer ID, rack, position in compound management system). Enables inventory management and sample retrieval for biological testing.
attributes.references: LIMS (LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager); GDP (Good Distribution Practice); ICH Q1A (Stability Testing)

attributes.name: structural_confirmation_method
attributes.description: Analytical technique(s) used to confirm the chemical structure of the synthesized compound (e.g., 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR, LCMS, HRMS, IR, X-ray crystallography). Structural confirmation is mandatory for compound registration and GLP compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1H-NMR|13C-NMR|LCMS|HRMS|IR|X-ray|multiple — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: synthesis_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the synthesis reaction was initiated. Principal business event date for this transaction record. Used for timeline tracking, GLP compliance dating, and SAR trend analysis.
attributes.references: GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); 21 CFR Part 58; ICH Q11

attributes.name: synthesis_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for this synthesis event, typically assigned by the ELN (IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics). Follows site-specific numbering conventions (e.g., MED-SYN-000123). Used for cross-referencing in lab notebooks, SAR databases, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

attributes.name: synthesis_purpose
attributes.description: Scientific purpose for which this compound was synthesized. Classifies the synthesis within the drug discovery workflow (e.g., hit confirmation from HTS, lead optimisation, SAR exploration, ADME probe, tool compound, library synthesis). Enables portfolio analytics and resource allocation reporting.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; FDA Guidance for Industry: Drug Interaction Studies; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: synthesis_scale_mmol
attributes.description: Molar scale of the synthesis reaction expressed in millimoles (mmol). Determines reagent quantities, expected yield mass, and suitability for downstream biological screening (e.g., HTS vs. focused assay).
attributes.references: ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

attributes.name: synthesis_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the synthesis experiment. Tracks progression from planned through execution to completion or failure. Drives workflow routing in the medicinal chemistry pipeline.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: synthetic_method
attributes.description: Name or classification of the synthetic methodology applied (e.g., Suzuki coupling, reductive amination, Buchwald-Hartwig amination, solid-phase synthesis). Enables SAR analysis by correlating method with yield and purity outcomes.
attributes.references: ICH Q11; IUPAC nomenclature; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this synthesis record. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance and data integrity monitoring in GLP environments.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); ICH Q10

attributes.name: yield_percent
attributes.description: Isolated yield of the target compound expressed as a percentage of the theoretical maximum based on the limiting reagent. A primary quantitative outcome metric for synthesis efficiency and SAR optimization. Range: 0.00–100.00.
attributes.references: ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

products.name: adme_profile
products.description: Transactional record capturing ADME (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion) profiling results for compounds under evaluation. Captures compound identifier, assay panel used, solubility value, permeability (Caco-2/PAMPA), plasma protein binding, microsomal stability (human/rat liver microsomes), CYP inhibition profile, P-glycoprotein substrate flag, blood-brain barrier penetration, half-life, clearance rate, bioavailability estimate, assay date, and ADME scientist. Critical for compound progression decisions.

attributes.name: adme_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Absorption Distribution Metabolism Excretion (ADME) Profile ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ADME profiling record in the discovery domain. Primary key for the adme_profile data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — captures a discrete ADME assay event with its own lifecycle and results.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: assay_panel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized ADME assay panel applied during this profiling run, defining the battery of tests performed (e.g., Tier 1 ADME screen, full ADME panel).
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; ICH M10; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: compound_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compound under ADME evaluation, linking to the compound master record in the discovery compound library. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category (compound is the principal resource being profiled).

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ADME scientist responsible for executing and reviewing this profiling run. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category for the responsible scientist.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug discovery project under which this ADME profiling was conducted, enabling project-level aggregation of ADME data for compound progression decisions.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: ADME data is required in Module 4.2.2 (pharmacokinetics) of regulatory submissions. Real regulatory requirement: nonclinical PK/ADME studies must be submitted with traceable study reports. Critical fo

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: ADME profiling frequently outsourced to specialized CRO vendors for permeability, metabolism, protein binding, and PK studies. Vendor qualification, quality agreements, GLP compliance, and data qualit

attributes.name: adme_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite numerical risk score (e.g., 0–100) summarizing overall ADME liability across solubility, permeability, metabolic stability, and DDI risk dimensions. Used for compound ranking and portfolio prioritization in discovery.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; internal compound scoring framework; FDA IND Guidance

attributes.name: assay_concentration_um
attributes.description: Concentration of the compound used in the ADME assay incubation, expressed in micromolar (µM). Required for result interpretation and inter-assay comparability; standard concentrations are typically 1–10 µM.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LabWare LIMS; ICH M10

attributes.name: assay_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the ADME assay panel was executed in the laboratory. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (day-level precision for assay scheduling and trending).

attributes.name: bbb_kp_uu
attributes.description: Unbound brain-to-plasma concentration ratio (Kp,uu,brain), the quantitative measure of CNS penetration accounting for plasma protein binding. Values >0.3 indicate meaningful CNS exposure; used in CNS drug discovery programs.
attributes.references: FDA CNS Drug Development Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

attributes.name: bbb_penetration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the compound demonstrates blood-brain barrier penetration based on in vitro BBB assay (e.g., MDCK-MDR1, hCMEC/D3) or in vivo brain-to-plasma ratio. Critical for CNS-targeted and CNS-safety assessments.
attributes.references: FDA CNS Drug Development Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics; ICH S7A

attributes.name: bioavailability_pct
attributes.description: Estimated oral bioavailability percentage (%F) derived from permeability, solubility, and metabolic stability data using predictive ADME models. Key compound progression criterion for oral drug candidates.
attributes.references: FDA BCS Guidance; ICH M9; EMA BCS-based Biowaiver Guideline

attributes.name: clearance_ml_min_kg
attributes.description: Predicted in vivo hepatic clearance in mL/min/kg, scaled from in vitro microsomal intrinsic clearance using the well-stirred liver model. Used to estimate dose and dosing interval in early drug discovery.
attributes.references: ICH M10; FDA Pharmacokinetics Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ADME profile record was first created in the system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail.

attributes.name: cyp2c9_inhibition_ic50_um
attributes.description: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) for CYP2C9 enzyme inhibition in µM. CYP2C9 metabolizes warfarin and NSAIDs; inhibition is a critical DDI safety signal for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

attributes.name: cyp2d6_inhibition_ic50_um
attributes.description: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) for CYP2D6 enzyme inhibition in µM. CYP2D6 metabolizes ~25% of marketed drugs; inhibition is a major DDI liability assessed by FDA and EMA.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

attributes.name: cyp3a4_inhibition_ic50_um
attributes.description: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) for CYP3A4 enzyme inhibition in µM. CYP3A4 metabolizes ~50% of marketed drugs; inhibition predicts drug-drug interaction (DDI) liability. Key regulatory safety flag.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

attributes.name: cyp_inhibition_flag
attributes.description: Composite boolean flag indicating whether the compound exhibits significant CYP inhibition risk (any CYP isoform IC50 below the regulatory concern threshold, typically <10 µM). Used for rapid compound triage and progression gating.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

attributes.name: efflux_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of basolateral-to-apical (B→A) over apical-to-basolateral (A→B) permeability in Caco-2 assay. Values >2 indicate active efflux transport (e.g., P-gp substrate), impacting oral bioavailability and CNS penetration.
attributes.references: FDA BCS Guidance; ICH M9; EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions

attributes.name: eln_notebook_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this ADME profile to the corresponding experiment entry in the Electronic Lab Notebook (IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics), providing traceability to raw experimental data and GLP documentation.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; 21 CFR Part 11; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN

attributes.name: half_life_h
attributes.description: Predicted or measured plasma half-life of the compound in hours, derived from in vitro microsomal clearance data using allometric scaling or measured directly in in vivo PK studies. Informs dosing frequency predictions.
attributes.references: ICH M10; FDA Pharmacokinetics Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

attributes.name: hlm_clint_ul_min_mg
attributes.description: Intrinsic metabolic clearance measured in human liver microsomes (HLM), expressed as µL/min/mg protein. Used to predict in vivo hepatic clearance and half-life via well-stirred liver model. Critical for dose prediction.
attributes.references: ICH M10; FDA Drug Metabolism Guidance; EMA Guideline on Drug Interactions

attributes.name: lims_sample_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Sample ID
attributes.description: Sample identifier assigned by the LIMS (LabWare or Thermo Fisher SampleManager) for the compound sample used in this ADME assay. Enables traceability from ADME result back to physical sample chain of custody.
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LabWare LIMS; Thermo Fisher SampleManager

attributes.name: metabolic_stability_class
attributes.description: Categorical classification of compound metabolic stability based on microsomal half-life thresholds (e.g., low: t½ <30 min, medium: 30–60 min, high: >60 min). Used in compound progression scoring and SAR triage.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; FDA Drug Metabolism Guidance; internal SAR triage criteria

attributes.name: microsomal_half_life_min
attributes.description: In vitro half-life of the compound in liver microsome incubation (human or rat), expressed in minutes. Derived from substrate depletion kinetics; used to classify metabolic stability as low/medium/high.
attributes.references: ICH M10; FDA Drug Metabolism Guidance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for ADME scientist observations, anomalies, assay deviations, or contextual notes relevant to interpreting the ADME profile results. Supports GLP documentation requirements.

attributes.name: permeability_caco2_nm_s
attributes.description: Apparent permeability coefficient (Papp A→B) measured in Caco-2 cell monolayer assay, expressed in nm/s. Predicts intestinal absorption and oral bioavailability. Key ADME parameter for BCS classification.
attributes.references: FDA BCS Guidance; ICH M9; EMA BCS-based Biowaiver Guideline

attributes.name: permeability_pampa_nm_s
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parallel Artificial Membrane Permeability Assay (PAMPA) Permeability (nm/s)
attributes.description: Passive transcellular permeability measured by PAMPA assay in nm/s. Complements Caco-2 data by isolating passive diffusion component, informing SAR optimization for membrane permeability.

attributes.name: pgp_substrate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the compound is identified as a P-glycoprotein (P-gp / MDR1) efflux transporter substrate based on Caco-2 bidirectional permeability or dedicated P-gp inhibition assay. Impacts CNS penetration and oral bioavailability predictions.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance; EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

attributes.name: plasma_protein_binding_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of compound bound to plasma proteins (albumin, alpha-1-acid glycoprotein) measured by equilibrium dialysis or ultrafiltration. Determines free fraction available for pharmacological activity and clearance.
attributes.references: ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: ppb_method
attributes.description: Analytical method used to determine plasma protein binding percentage. Rapid equilibrium dialysis (RED) is the industry standard; method choice affects result interpretation and cross-study comparability.
attributes.references: ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this ADME profiling run, used in ELN (IDBS/Dotmatics) and LIMS cross-referencing. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the ADME profile record from data entry through scientific review and approval. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|completed|reviewed|approved|invalidated — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]
attributes.references: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl / TrackWise QMS

attributes.name: progression_recommendation
attributes.description: Scientific recommendation for compound progression based on the overall ADME profile assessment. Drives hit-to-lead and lead optimization decisions. Assigned by the ADME scientist upon profile review and approval.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; internal drug discovery stage-gate criteria; FDA IND Guidance 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: rlm_clint_ul_min_mg
attributes.description: Intrinsic metabolic clearance measured in rat liver microsomes (RLM), expressed as µL/min/mg protein. Supports cross-species PK scaling and preclinical-to-clinical translation of metabolic stability data.
attributes.references: ICH S7A; FDA Preclinical Safety Guidance; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: solubility_method
attributes.description: Analytical method used to determine aqueous solubility, distinguishing kinetic from thermodynamic measurements which have different interpretive implications for drug development.

attributes.name: solubility_um
attributes.description: Measured aqueous solubility of the compound in micromolar (µM), typically from kinetic or thermodynamic solubility assay. Critical for assessing oral bioavailability and formulation feasibility. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; FDA Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS)

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Biological species from which the biological matrix (microsomes, plasma, cells) was derived for this ADME assay. Enables cross-species PK comparison and allometric scaling for preclinical-to-clinical translation.
attributes.references: ICH S7A; GLP 21 CFR Part 58; EMA Preclinical Guideline

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this ADME profile record. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: volume_of_distribution_l_kg
attributes.description: Predicted or measured apparent volume of distribution (Vd) in L/kg, reflecting the extent of compound distribution into tissues versus plasma. Informs PK/PD modeling and dose prediction.
attributes.references: ICH M10; FDA Pharmacokinetics Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

products.name: project
products.description: Master record for drug discovery research projects organized around one or more therapeutic targets or disease indications. Captures project name, project code, therapeutic area, disease indication (ICD-10/MeSH reference), primary and secondary target identifiers (supporting multi-target programs), project phase (target identification, target validation, hit identification, hit-to-lead, lead optimization, candidate nomination), project status, start date, projected candidate nomination date, project leader, team members, budget allocation, strategic priority tier, external collaboration references, and portfolio governance decisions. Top-level organizational entity for the discovery domain providing project-centric views of all discovery activities.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the drug discovery research project record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for all downstream joins within the discovery domain.

attributes.name: compound_library_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary compound library or collection used in HTS (High-Throughput Screening) campaigns for this project. Links to the compound management system for screening deck traceability.
attributes.references: ICH Q11; ISPE Drug Discovery; Dotmatics compound registry

attributes.name: fto_analysis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.fto_analysis. Business justification: Discovery projects require FTO clearance at stage gates (target validation, lead optimization, candidate nomination); analysis linkage supports portfolio decisions, risk assessment, and strategic plan

attributes.name: leader_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Project resource planning, performance reviews, succession planning, and portfolio governance require FK to employee. Project leader accountability is critical for stage-gate decisions, budget ownersh

attributes.name: licensing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: Discovery projects often operate under collaboration or in-licensing agreements; linkage tracks licensed rights, diligence obligations, milestone triggers, and royalty terms for financial planning and

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Portfolio lineage tracking: connects research program to marketed medicine for ROI analysis, pipeline reporting, strategic planning. Essential for investment decisions, productivity metrics, and comme

attributes.name: owning_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Discovery projects are owned and managed by specific organizational units for governance, resource allocation, headcount planning, and portfolio management. Essential for matrix reporting and accounta

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Discovery projects generate patent families as key deliverables; family linkage enables portfolio tracking, R&D-to-IP investment analysis, valuation for M&A, and strategic IP planning at program level

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Discovery projects operate under compliance programs (GxP, data integrity, Part 11) that govern execution standards, audit scope, and inspection readiness. Program assignment is required for regulator

attributes.name: project_molecular_target_id
attributes.description: Standardized identifier for the primary biological target (e.g., UniProt accession, HGNC gene symbol) the project is designed to modulate. Central to SAR analysis and MOA documentation in IDBS/Dotmatics ELN.
attributes.references: UniProt; HGNC; ChEMBL target nomenclature; ICH S7A/S7B safety pharmacology

attributes.name: trademark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.trademark. Business justification: Discovery projects plan brand strategy early; trademark linkage tracks naming pipeline, supports trademark clearance searches, coordinates filing with development milestones, and protects future comme

attributes.name: actual_candidate_nomination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the development candidate was formally nominated and the project transitioned to preclinical development. Nullable until nomination occurs. Used for cycle time analytics and portfolio performance measurement.
attributes.references: ICH Q8(R2); 21 CFR 312; ISPE Drug Discovery guidelines

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO ATC classification code assigned to the intended drug product based on its therapeutic target and mechanism. Used for market analysis, competitive intelligence, and regulatory classification.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; EMA product classification; INN guidelines

attributes.name: collaboration_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary external collaboration partner (CRO, academic institution, or partner pharma company) if external_collaboration_flag is true. Classified confidential as it reveals strategic partnership information.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; GDPR Article 28; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: collaboration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the external collaboration arrangement. Determines applicable contractual, IP, and regulatory frameworks governing data sharing and compound rights.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; GDPR Article 28; IP licensing frameworks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the discovery project record was first created in the system of record (IDBS/Dotmatics or portfolio management system). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (MHRA Data Integrity Guidance); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: disease_indication
attributes.description: Specific disease or condition the project aims to treat or prevent (e.g., Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Rheumatoid Arthritis). Free-text aligned to ICD-10 or MeSH terminology for cross-system interoperability.

attributes.name: eln_project_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for this discovery project in the IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics ELN system. Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the authoritative source system for raw experimental data.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); ALCOA+ data integrity principles; IDBS E-WorkBook

attributes.name: external_collaboration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project involves external partners such as CROs, academic institutions, or other pharmaceutical companies. Triggers additional data governance, IP agreement, and confidentiality controls.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; GDPR Article 28 (data processor agreements); 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: glp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project's studies are conducted under GLP regulations as required for regulatory submission. GLP-compliant studies are required for safety data submitted in IND applications.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP); OECD Principles of GLP; EMA GLP guidelines

attributes.name: hts_campaign_count
attributes.description: Number of HTS campaigns executed under this discovery project. Provides a summary indicator of screening activity volume for portfolio reporting and resource utilization analysis.
attributes.references: ISPE Drug Discovery guidelines; ICH Q8(R2)

attributes.name: icd10_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code
attributes.description: Standardized ICD-10 disease classification code for the primary disease indication. Enables cross-domain linkage to clinical, regulatory, and medical affairs data and supports regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: ip_strategy_note
attributes.description: Brief description of the IP strategy for the project, including patentability assessment, freedom-to-operate (FTO) status, and filing intentions. Classified confidential as it contains pre-filing IP strategy.
attributes.references: USPTO; EPO; ICH Q10; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the discovery project record. Required for data lineage tracking, change control auditing, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (MHRA Data Integrity Guidance); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: moa_description
attributes.description: Scientific description of the proposed mechanism by which the drug candidate modulates the target to achieve therapeutic effect. Captured from ELN records in IDBS/Dotmatics. Critical for IND and NDA/BLA submissions.
attributes.references: ICH M4 (eCTD); FDA IND 21 CFR 312.23; EMA scientific guidelines

attributes.name: modality
attributes.description: Type of therapeutic modality being pursued in the project. Determines applicable regulatory pathway (NDA vs BLA), manufacturing approach (CMO vs CDMO), and GLP/GMP requirements. Distinguishes NCE from NBE programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: small_molecule|biologic|antibody|cell_therapy|gene_therapy|oligonucleotide|peptide — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 312 (IND); EMA CHMP guidelines; ICH Q11 (biologics)

attributes.name: phase
