attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: screen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Coded or free-text reason why a subject failed screening and was not enrolled. Populated only when enrollment_status = screen_failed. Used for protocol feasibility analysis and site performance monitoring. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC screen failure CRF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; CDISC CDASH Standard

attributes.name: screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject first presented at the investigational site for screening assessments. Marks the start of the eligibility evaluation period. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: screening_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a subject at the point of screening, prior to eligibility confirmation. Format is site-specific and assigned sequentially by the RTSM system in Medidata Rave. Used to track screen failures and pre-enrollment activity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: stratification_factor_1
attributes.description: Value of the first stratification factor used to balance treatment arm assignments across key prognostic variables (e.g., disease stage, geographic region, biomarker status). Defined in the trial protocol and captured at randomization in RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

attributes.name: stratification_factor_2
attributes.description: Value of the second stratification factor used to balance treatment arm assignments (e.g., prior therapy, performance status, age group). Null if the trial uses fewer than two stratification factors. Captured at randomization in RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

attributes.name: stratification_factor_3
attributes.description: Value of the third stratification factor used to balance treatment arm assignments (e.g., country, mutation status, weight band). Null if the trial uses fewer than three stratification factors. Captured at randomization in RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to a subject upon successful enrollment into the trial. Typically formatted as site-number-sequential-ID (e.g., 001-001). Assigned by Medidata Rave RTSM upon eligibility confirmation and enrollment confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: treatment_arm_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the treatment arm (e.g., active drug, placebo, comparator, dose level) to which the subject was assigned at randomization. Confidential in blinded trials. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM randomization schedule.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: treatment_arm_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the treatment arm assignment (e.g., 'Drug A 100mg QD', 'Placebo', 'Drug B 200mg BID'). Confidential in blinded trials. Complements treatment_arm_code for reporting and analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

attributes.name: unblinding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's treatment assignment was unblinded. Populated only when blinding_status = unblinded. Emergency unblinding events must be documented per GCP. Null for blinded or open-label subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Guideline on Blinding

attributes.name: unblinding_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for the unblinding of the subject's treatment assignment. Emergency unblinding (e.g., for medical management of a Serious Adverse Event) must be documented and reported per GCP and pharmacovigilance requirements. Null for blinded or open-label subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on Blinding

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified in the source system. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject withdrew from the trial or was discontinued. Populated only when enrollment_status = withdrawn. Used for survival analysis (censoring) and dropout rate reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC CDASH Standard

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Coded or free-text reason for subject withdrawal or discontinuation from the trial (e.g., adverse event, consent withdrawal, lost to follow-up, protocol deviation, investigator decision). Null for active or completed subjects. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: adverse_event|consent_withdrawal|lost_to_follow_up|protocol_deviation|investigator_decision|sponsor_decision|death|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9; CDISC CDASH Standard; 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: visit
products.description: Transactional record for each scheduled or unscheduled patient visit within a clinical trial, as captured in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Tracks visit number, visit name per protocol schedule of assessments, planned visit date, actual visit date, visit window compliance, visit type (screening, treatment, follow-up, end-of-study), visit status, and deviations noted. Forms the backbone of the clinical data collection timeline.
products.reference: Visit Record / Schedule of Assessments (Medidata Rave EDC)

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each patient visit record within the clinical trial data product on the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: clinical_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.enrollment. Business justification: Patient visits occur within the context of a specific enrollment. While visit already has participant_id, trial_id, and site_id, linking to enrollment provides the complete enrollment context includin

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the visit took place. Links to the site master record in CTMS (Oracle/Siebel).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the principal investigator or sub-investigator who conducted or supervised this visit. Links to the investigator master record in CTMS (Oracle/Siebel).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Form 1572

attributes.name: patient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) who attended this visit. Links to the subject/patient master record in the EDC (Medidata Rave) and CTMS (Oracle/Siebel).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial protocol version that governs the schedule of assessments for this visit. Links to the protocol master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E8; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: trial_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (trial) under which this visit was conducted. Links to the study master record in CTMS.

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The date on which the visit actually occurred as recorded in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Corresponds to the CDISC CDASH VISDAT field. Null if the visit was missed or cancelled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH VISDAT; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: ae_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more Adverse Events (AEs) were reported at or since the previous visit (True) or not (False). Triggers downstream pharmacovigilance workflows in Argus Safety / Oracle AERS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: arm_name
attributes.description: The name of the treatment arm or study arm to which the subject was assigned at the time of this visit (e.g., 'Drug A 100mg', 'Placebo', 'Drug A + Drug B Combination'). Sourced from CTMS and EDC randomization records.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM v3.3 TA Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9

attributes.name: blinding_status
attributes.description: Indicates the blinding status of the subject and/or investigator at the time of this visit. Unblinded records are restricted to authorized personnel only and are critical for data integrity in double-blind trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Blinding

attributes.name: completion_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of protocol-required assessments and procedures that were completed at this visit (0.00–100.00). Supports partial visit analysis and data completeness reporting for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: conmed_updated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's concomitant medication list was reviewed and updated at this visit (True) or not (False). Supports safety and drug-drug interaction analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH CM Domain; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this visit record was first created in the source EDC system (Medidata Rave). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the visit data was first entered into the EDC system (Medidata Rave) by the site staff. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: data_lock_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the visit record was locked in the EDC (Medidata Rave), preventing further data entry or modification without an authorized unlock. Null if the record has not yet been locked.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC

attributes.name: day_from_reference
attributes.description: The study day number calculated from the subject's reference date (typically first dose date or randomization date) to the actual visit date. Corresponds to the CDISC VISITDY variable. Negative values indicate pre-dose visits.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM v3.3 VISITDY; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the protocol deviation severity at this visit: major (could affect subject safety or data integrity), minor (unlikely to affect safety or data integrity), or administrative (procedural/documentation only).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations (2023); EMA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the protocol deviation(s) noted at this visit, as recorded by the site in the EDC or CTMS. Null when deviation_flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more protocol deviations were recorded for this visit (True) or not (False). A True value triggers linkage to the protocol deviation register in the CTMS or eTMF (Veeva Vault).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: early_termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason the subject discontinued the study at or before this visit, if applicable. Null for non-termination visits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: adverse_event|withdrawal_of_consent|lost_to_follow_up|protocol_violation|sponsor_decision|death|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH DS Domain; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E9

attributes.name: edc_visit_oid
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Visit Object Identifier (OID)
attributes.description: The unique object identifier (OID) assigned to this visit record within the Medidata Rave EDC system. Used for traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the source EDC system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC ODM v1.3; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: epoch
attributes.description: The trial epoch during which this visit occurred, as defined in the CDISC SDTM Trial Design model (e.g., Screening, Run-In, Treatment, Follow-Up, Post-Study). Supports epoch-level analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM v3.3 TE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: informed_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's current informed consent form (ICF) was verified as valid and current at the time of this visit (True) or not (False). Critical for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the visit was scheduled to occur per the protocol Schedule of Assessments and the subject's randomization or enrollment anchor date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH VISDAT; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: query_open_count
attributes.description: The number of data queries (discrepancies) currently open against this visit record in the EDC (Medidata Rave). A non-zero value indicates outstanding data cleaning actions required before database lock.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC Data Management

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: The unique randomization number assigned to the subject at the time of randomization, as recorded in the Interactive Response Technology (IRT) system. Confidential as it may reveal treatment assignment in blinded trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC CDASH RNDM

attributes.name: sae_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) were reported at this visit (True) or not (False). SAEs require expedited reporting to health authorities per ICH E2A and 21 CFR Part 312.32.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) has been completed for this visit by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or monitor (True) or not (False). Critical for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.3; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this visit record was last modified in the source EDC system (Medidata Rave) or during Silver Layer processing. Supports audit trail and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: visit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the visit as defined in the protocol Schedule of Assessments (e.g., 'Screening', 'Cycle 1 Day 1', 'Week 12 Follow-Up', 'End of Study'). Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC visit folder name.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: visit_number
attributes.description: Sequential numeric identifier for the visit as defined in the protocol Schedule of Assessments (SoA). Unscheduled visits may carry a non-integer or supplemental numbering convention captured separately.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the visit record indicating whether the visit was completed, missed, partially completed, cancelled, or rescheduled. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC and CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visit according to its role in the trial timeline. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: screening|baseline|treatment|follow_up|end_of_study|unscheduled|early_termination — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: window_lower_day
attributes.description: The number of days before the planned visit date that defines the lower boundary of the acceptable visit window per the protocol. Used to assess visit window compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: window_upper_day
attributes.description: The number of days after the planned visit date that defines the upper boundary of the acceptable visit window per the protocol. Used to assess visit window compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: within_window_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual visit date fell within the protocol-defined visit window (True) or outside it (False). Derived at ingestion from planned_date, actual_date, window_lower_day, and window_upper_day; stored for analytical efficiency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: crf_form
products.description: Master record for each Case Report Form (CRF) design used in a trial, representing the electronic data capture instrument definition in Medidata Rave. Captures form name, form OID, associated visit, data domain (SDTM domain mapping), version, validation rules, completion requirements, and approval status. Distinct from CRF data (captured in subject_observation) — this is the instrument definition, not the collected data.

attributes.name: crf_form_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CRF form definition record in the Medidata Rave electronic data capture system. Primary key for the crf_form data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: CRF form design approval requires qualified clinical data manager or medical reviewer signature. Current text field 'approved_by' should be FK to employee for qualification verification and electronic

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific trial protocol version under which this CRF form definition was created and approved. Ensures form-to-protocol traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: trial_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial for which this CRF form definition was designed. Links the instrument definition to its parent study in the CTMS.

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled visit with which this CRF form is associated in the study schedule of events. Null for common forms appearing across all visits.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM TV Domain

attributes.name: annotation_text
attributes.description: Annotated CRF text describing the SDTM variable mappings, derivation rules, and coding instructions associated with each field on this form. Used by data management and programming teams for SDTM dataset creation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle approval state of the CRF form definition. 'draft' indicates design in progress; 'under_review' indicates pending sponsor/CRO review; 'approved' indicates GCP-compliant sign-off; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'retired' indicates no longer in use.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CRF form definition received formal GCP-compliant approval. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: cdash_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Acquisition Standards Harmonization (CDASH) Domain
attributes.description: CDISC CDASH domain code indicating the data collection standard this form adheres to (e.g., 'AE', 'VS', 'CM'). Ensures harmonized data collection aligned with CDASH implementation guides.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH Implementation Guide v2.0; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: completion_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for site staff on how to complete this CRF form, including definitions, coding conventions, and data source guidance. Embedded in the EDC and printed CRF booklet.

attributes.name: completion_requirement
attributes.description: Specifies whether completion of this CRF form is mandatory for all subjects, optional, or conditional on specific criteria (e.g., only if a prior form field triggers it). Drives data completeness monitoring and query generation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CRF form definition record was first created in the system. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_entry_mode
attributes.description: Specifies the data entry mode configured for this CRF form in Medidata Rave. 'single' requires one entry; 'double' requires independent dual entry for critical data; 'auto' is populated programmatically from device or lab feeds.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; Medidata Rave Configuration Guide

attributes.name: edit_check_count
attributes.description: Total number of programmed edit checks (validation rules) configured for this CRF form in Medidata Rave. Provides a measure of form complexity and data quality control coverage.
attributes.references: CDISC Edit Check Specification; Medidata Rave Study Design

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Case Report Form (CRF) Effective End Date
attributes.description: Date on which this CRF form version was retired or superseded. Null for currently active versions. Supports version lifecycle management and historical data traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Case Report Form (CRF) Effective Start Date
attributes.description: Date from which this CRF form version is active and available for data entry at investigational sites. Supports version management and ensures sites use the correct form version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; Medidata Rave Study Design

attributes.name: field_count
attributes.description: Total number of data fields (questions/items) defined on this CRF form. Used for form complexity assessment, site burden estimation, and data management planning.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Study Design Specification

attributes.name: form_label
attributes.description: Short display label for the CRF form used in the EDC user interface and printed CRF booklets. May differ from form_name for brevity in UI contexts.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Study Design

attributes.name: form_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the CRF form as displayed in Medidata Rave and study documentation. Examples: 'Adverse Event Form', 'Vital Signs', 'Concomitant Medications'.

attributes.name: form_oid
attributes.description: Unique Object Identifier (OID) for the CRF form as defined in Medidata Rave and conforming to CDISC ODM standards. Used for cross-system referencing and SDTM mapping. Example: 'AE_FORM_V2'.
attributes.references: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: form_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence order of this form within its associated visit or study schedule of events. Determines the display order in the EDC and printed CRF booklet.
attributes.references: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; Medidata Rave Study Design

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CRF form by its data collection pattern in Medidata Rave. 'scheduled' forms appear at predefined visits; 'unscheduled' are event-driven; 'common' appear across all visits; 'log' forms capture repeating events (e.g., AE log); 'repeating' forms allow multiple instances per visit.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave Study Design Specification; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the CRF form definition, following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', '3.0.1'). Tracks design changes over the trial lifecycle and supports audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CRF form contains blinded data (e.g., treatment assignment, randomization code) that must be restricted from unblinded personnel during the trial. Supports GCP-compliant blinding controls.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_repeating
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CRF form allows multiple instances per subject per visit (e.g., an Adverse Event log form where each AE is a separate instance). Drives EDC configuration in Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; Medidata Rave Study Design Specification

attributes.name: is_sdv_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) is required for data entered on this CRF form. Critical forms (e.g., primary endpoints, safety data) typically require 100% SDV; others may be risk-based.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: is_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an electronic signature (e-signature) is required on this CRF form by the investigator or site staff upon completion, as mandated by 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: itt_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CRF form contributes data to the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population definition. ITT-relevant forms are critical for primary efficacy analysis and regulatory review.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on ITT Principle

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CRF form definition record was last modified. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, change control, and GCP compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: primary_endpoint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CRF form captures data for the trial's primary efficacy or safety endpoint (e.g., ORR, PFS, OS). Primary endpoint forms receive heightened monitoring, SDV, and data review scrutiny.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: rave_form_draft_version
attributes.description: The internal Medidata Rave draft version number for this CRF form, distinct from the business version. Tracks incremental design changes within the Rave study build environment prior to promotion to production.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave Study Design Specification; 21 CFR Part 11; CSV Validation

attributes.name: rave_study_name
attributes.description: The study name as configured in Medidata Rave EDC system, used to identify the parent study context for this CRF form. Supports cross-referencing between the data lakehouse and the source EDC system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave Study Design Specification; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether data collected on this CRF form is included in regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/MAA/IND). Drives SDTM dataset inclusion and eCTD packaging requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH M4E; eCTD Specification

attributes.name: safety_form_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CRF form is designated as a safety-critical form (e.g., Adverse Event, Serious Adverse Event, SUSAR reporting). Safety forms trigger expedited review workflows and pharmacovigilance data feeds.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: Two-letter CDISC SDTM domain code to which this CRF form maps for regulatory submission (e.g., 'AE' for Adverse Events, 'VS' for Vital Signs, 'CM' for Concomitant Medications, 'LB' for Laboratory). Drives SDTM dataset generation for NDA/BLA/MAA submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdv_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of data points on this CRF form subject to Source Data Verification (SDV) under the risk-based monitoring plan. Ranges from 0.00 (no SDV) to 100.00 (full SDV). Supports risk-based monitoring strategy.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: source_system_form_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this CRF form record in the source EDC system (Medidata Rave). Enables lineage tracing from the Silver Layer back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: validation_rule_set
attributes.business_glossary_term: Case Report Form (CRF) Validation Rule Set
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the edit check / validation rule set applied to this CRF form in Medidata Rave. References the programmed edit checks that enforce data quality, range checks, and cross-form consistency rules.
attributes.references: CDISC Edit Check Specification; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: visit_oid
attributes.description: CDISC ODM-compliant OID of the study visit to which this form is assigned, as defined in Medidata Rave. Supports cross-system visit-form linkage without requiring a resolved FK at this stage.
attributes.references: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; Medidata Rave Study Design

products.name: subject_observation
products.description: Core transactional table capturing all clinical data collected per subject per visit per CRF form in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Stores data point value, unit, SDTM variable mapping, collection date, data entry date, query status, source data verification (SDV) status, and audit trail reference. Represents the atomic unit of clinical trial data — the foundation for efficacy and safety endpoint derivation (ORR, PFS, OS, QoL) and CDISC SDTM/ADaM dataset generation.
products.reference: EDC Data Record (Medidata Rave / CDISC SDTM)

attributes.name: subject_observation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each subject observation record in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Represents the atomic unit of clinical trial data collected per subject per visit per Case Report Form (CRF) field.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.enrollment. Business justification: Clinical observations are collected for enrolled subjects. Linking subject_observation to enrollment provides treatment arm context and enables filtering observations by analysis population (ITT, mITT

attributes.name: crf_form_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CRF form definition from which this observation originates. Identifies the instrument (e.g., Vital Signs, Lab Results, Adverse Events) used to collect the data point.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: entered_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Data entry requires documented employee identity for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail and GxP compliance. Current text field 'entered_by' should be FK to employee for training verification and electronic si

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the observation was collected. Supports site-level data quality monitoring, SDV tracking, and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: patient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enrolled trial subject (patient) from whom this observation was collected. Enables subject-level data aggregation for ITT, PP, and safety analyses.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.protocol. Business justification: Clinical observations are collected according to protocol-defined data collection standards and edit checks. Linking subject_observation to protocol enables verification that observations were collect

attributes.name: trial_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial (study) under which this observation was collected. Links the observation to the parent trial protocol, phase, and regulatory submission context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which this observation was collected. Supports visit-level data alignment and protocol deviation detection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: analysis_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the analysis population(s) to which this observation contributes: Intent-to-Treat (ITT), Per Protocol (PP), Safety population, or excluded. Drives statistical analysis dataset (ADaM) construction and primary/secondary endpoint derivation.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM IG; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; EMA Guideline on Missing Data

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this observation to its complete audit trail record in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Enables traceability of all data changes, user actions, and timestamps per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 1.45; EMA Reflection Paper on Expectations for Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the observation was collected from the subject at the investigational site. Corresponds to SDTM --DTC variable. Critical for visit window compliance, protocol deviation assessment, and time-to-event endpoint calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG (--DTC); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the observation was collected, including time zone offset. Required for time-sensitive measurements (e.g., PK sampling, ECG) and for accurate SDTM --STDTC derivation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG (--STDTC); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: crf_field_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific CRF field (data point) within the form from which this observation was collected (e.g., SYSBP, WEIGHT, AESTDTC). Corresponds to the EDC field label in Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH IG; CDISC SDTM IG; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: data_lock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this observation record has been locked in the EDC system as part of the database lock process, preventing further modifications. Locked records are used for final statistical analysis and regulatory submission datasets.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Database Lock

attributes.name: edc_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by the EDC system (Medidata Rave) for this observation. Used for source system traceability, audit trail reconciliation, and data migration validation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave Data Model

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the data was first entered into the EDC system (Medidata Rave) by the site user. Used for data entry timeliness monitoring, audit trail compliance, and GCP inspection readiness per ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave Audit Trail

attributes.name: is_baseline
attributes.description: Indicates whether this observation represents the baseline measurement for the subject, used as the reference value for change-from-baseline calculations in efficacy endpoint derivation (e.g., tumor size at baseline for ORR). Corresponds to SDTM ABLFL flag in ADaM datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM IG (ABLFL); ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on Efficacy Endpoints

attributes.name: is_unscheduled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this observation was collected during an unscheduled visit (not defined in the protocol schedule of assessments). Unscheduled observations may be excluded from primary efficacy analyses per the statistical analysis plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; Protocol Schedule of Assessments

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent modification to this observation record in the EDC system. Supports audit trail tracking, data change monitoring, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave Audit Trail

attributes.name: normal_range_high
attributes.description: The upper bound of the reference (normal) range for this observation type as defined by the central laboratory or clinical standard. Used for out-of-range flagging, safety signal detection, and SDTM STNRHI derivation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG (STNRHI); ICH E3 Clinical Study Report; FDA Safety Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: normal_range_low
attributes.description: The lower bound of the reference (normal) range for this observation type as defined by the central laboratory or clinical standard. Used for out-of-range flagging, safety signal detection, and SDTM STNRLO derivation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG (STNRLO); ICH E3 Clinical Study Report; FDA Safety Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: numeric_value
attributes.description: The numeric representation of the observation value after unit standardization, corresponding to the SDTM STRESN variable. Used for quantitative analyses, endpoint derivation (ORR, PFS, OS), and statistical modeling in ADaM datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG (STRESN); CDISC ADaM IG; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: observation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the observation record within the EDC system lifecycle. Drives data cleaning workflows, lock readiness assessment, and database lock milestones. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entered|verified|locked|queried|resolved|deleted — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave Workflow

attributes.name: out_of_range_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the numeric observation value falls outside the defined normal reference range (low or high). Triggers safety review workflows, potential AE/SAE reporting, and DSMB notification processes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E3; FDA Safety Reporting Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this observation is associated with a protocol deviation (e.g., collected outside the visit window, wrong procedure performed). Flagged observations may be excluded from Per Protocol (PP) analysis populations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: query_status
attributes.description: Status of any data query (discrepancy) raised against this observation in the EDC system. Open queries must be resolved prior to database lock. Supports data cleaning metrics and site performance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: query_text
attributes.description: The text of the most recent data query raised against this observation, describing the discrepancy or clarification required from the site. Supports data management review and site communication workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: raw_value
attributes.description: The verbatim data value as entered by the site user in the EDC system (Medidata Rave), prior to any derivation or standardization. Stored as STRING to accommodate all data types (numeric, text, coded). Represents the source data for SDV and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM ORRES variable convention

attributes.name: reason_for_change
attributes.description: The documented reason provided by the site user when modifying a previously entered observation value in the EDC system. Mandatory per 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP requirements for any post-entry data correction. Stored as the most recent change reason.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9.3; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM domain code to which this observation maps (e.g., VS for Vital Signs, LB for Laboratory, AE for Adverse Events, EX for Exposure). Critical for SDTM dataset generation and regulatory submission packages (NDA/BLA/MAA).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdtm_variable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Variable Name
attributes.description: The specific CDISC SDTM variable name to which this CRF field maps (e.g., VSSTRESN, LBORRES, AEDECOD). Enables automated SDTM dataset generation and submission-ready data transformation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdv_date
attributes.description: The date on which Source Data Verification (SDV) was completed for this observation. Used for monitoring visit planning, SDV coverage reporting, and GCP audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of Source Data Verification (SDV) for this observation, indicating whether the EDC-entered value has been verified against the original source document (e.g., medical record, lab report) by the CRA or site monitor. Critical for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: standard_unit
attributes.description: The standardized unit of measure after conversion to the study-defined reference unit (SDTM STRESU). Enables cross-site and cross-study comparability for endpoint derivation and pooled analyses.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG (STRESU); UCUM; ICH E9

attributes.name: toxicity_grade
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Toxicity Grade
attributes.description: The NCI CTCAE toxicity grade assigned to this observation when it represents an adverse finding (Grade 1=Mild, Grade 2=Moderate, Grade 3=Severe, Grade 4=Life-threatening, Grade 5=Death). Critical for safety endpoint reporting, dose modification decisions, and regulatory safety narratives.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE v5.0; ICH E3; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; CDISC SDTM AE Domain

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the observation value as collected (e.g., mmHg, mg/dL, kg, beats/min). Corresponds to SDTM ORRESU variable. Required for clinical interpretation and cross-site data harmonization.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG (ORRESU); UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or monitor who performed Source Data Verification (SDV) for this observation. Supports GCP compliance documentation and monitoring visit reports.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

products.name: trial_adverse_event
products.description: Transactional record for each Adverse Event (AE) reported by a subject during a clinical trial, as captured in the EDC and CTMS.
