attributes.description: The name of the qualified quality unit personnel who approved the final disposition decision. Must be an authorized individual per the quality management system (QMS).

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final disposition decision was made by the quality unit. Marks the completion of batch review and approval process.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: The final quality decision on the batch. Release indicates approval for distribution; Reject indicates failure to meet specifications; Rework indicates batch will be reprocessed; Destroy indicates batch will be disposed of. This is the authoritative disposition outcome.

attributes.name: disposition_rationale
attributes.description: The documented justification for the disposition decision. For rejections, includes the specific quality failures or deviations. For releases, confirms all specifications and cGMP requirements were met. Required for regulatory compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental monitoring results (viable and non-viable particulates, temperature, humidity) were within acceptable limits throughout the manufacturing process. Critical for sterile and aseptic manufacturing per cGMP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.42 - Design and Construction Features

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the batch should not be used or distributed. Calculated based on manufacture date plus approved shelf life from stability studies. Required on all drug product labels per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: formulation_version
attributes.description: The version number of the product formulation used for this batch. Tracks changes to the formula, process parameters, or specifications. Critical for change control and regulatory submissions (CMC section).
attributes.references: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: The GMP classification under which this batch was manufactured. cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) is required for commercial and late-stage clinical batches. GMP applies to earlier development batches. Non-GMP may apply to research-only materials.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the batch manufacturing was completed. Used for regulatory labeling, shelf-life calculations, and expiry date determination. Distinct from manufacturing_end_timestamp which includes time precision.

attributes.name: manufacturing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when manufacturing operations for this batch were completed. Marks the end of the production cycle before quality testing and release. Used to calculate cycle time and production efficiency.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

attributes.name: manufacturing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when manufacturing operations for this batch commenced. Marks the beginning of the batch production cycle. Critical for batch genealogy and process timeline documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

attributes.name: pat_monitoring_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools were used for real-time monitoring and control of critical quality attributes (CQA) during this batch. PAT enables continuous quality verification per FDA PAT guidance.
attributes.references: FDA PAT Guidance - Process Analytical Technology

attributes.name: qbd_design_space_compliance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality by Design (QbD) Design Space Compliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether all critical process parameters (CPP) remained within the approved QbD design space during manufacturing. True indicates full compliance; False indicates deviation requiring investigation. Applicable for products developed under QbD principles per ICH Q8.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the material reconciliation process comparing input materials consumed against output product and documented waste. Discrepancies require investigation per cGMP. Reconciled indicates all materials are accounted for within acceptable limits.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this batch record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance. Distinct from manufacturing_start_timestamp which reflects the physical production start.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this batch record was last modified in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance. Updated whenever any field in the batch record is changed.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) under which this batch was manufactured. Links the batch to the approved regulatory dossier and ensures manufacturing is conducted per approved CMC specifications.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 - Applications for FDA Approval to Market a New Drug

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: The date by which the batch must be re-examined to ensure it still meets quality specifications. Primarily applicable to drug substances (API) and intermediates. If testing confirms specifications are met, the material may continue to be used.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

attributes.name: sterility_assurance_level
attributes.description: The probability of a single viable microorganism being present on a product unit after sterilization. Expressed as SAL-10^-N (e.g., SAL-10^-6 means one in a million probability). Required for sterile products. Not applicable for non-sterile products.
attributes.references: ISO 11137 - Sterilization of Health Care Products

attributes.name: sterilization_method
attributes.description: The sterilization method applied to this batch, if applicable. Required for sterile drug products and certain medical devices. Not applicable for non-sterile products. Method must be validated per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.113 - Control of Microbiological Contamination

attributes.name: theoretical_yield_quantity
attributes.description: The expected quantity of product that should be produced based on the master batch record formula and input materials, assuming 100% efficiency with no losses. Used as the baseline for yield percentage calculation.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: The ratio of actual yield to theoretical yield expressed as a percentage. Calculated as (actual_yield_quantity / theoretical_yield_quantity) * 100. Deviations from expected yield ranges trigger investigations per cGMP.

products.name: master_batch_record
products.description: The approved master batch record (MBR) template defining the standard manufacturing instructions, formulation, process steps, critical process parameters (CPPs) with target values and acceptance criteria, critical quality attributes (CQAs), in-process control specifications, equipment requirements, and expected yields for a specific product and batch size. Represents the recipe or master formula from which individual batch records are generated. Tracks version number, approval status, effective date, superseded date, product code, dosage form, batch size range, and regulatory approval linkage. Serves as the SSOT for all parameter specifications — parameter names, types, target values, control limits (upper/lower), specification limits, and acceptance criteria. Actual measured values during execution are recorded in process_parameter_result, not here. Managed in Veeva Vault QualityDocs or MasterControl.
products.reference: Master Batch Record / Master Formula Record (21 CFR 211.186)

attributes.name: master_batch_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the master batch record. Primary key. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: MBRs define manufacturing processes for specific brands. Links technical manufacturing documentation to commercial product lifecycle management, launch planning, and regulatory submission tracking. Es

attributes.name: drug_master_file_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.drug_master_file. Business justification: MBRs for API or proprietary excipient manufacturing must link to holder's DMF for regulatory submissions, supply chain qualification, change control coordination, and ensuring manufacturing process al

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug product (DP) or drug substance (DS) that this master batch record defines manufacturing instructions for.

attributes.name: drug_substance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_substance. Business justification: MBRs define API/drug substance used in formulation. Critical for API sourcing strategy, DMF linkage, regulatory submissions (CTD Module 3), and ensuring correct active ingredient specification. Suppor

attributes.name: gxp_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.gxp_obligation. Business justification: MBRs are designed to satisfy specific GXP obligations (21 CFR 211.186, EU GMP Chapter 4). Essential for regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/MAA), change control, and demonstrating compliance-by-design. Ph

attributes.name: mbr_author_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: MBR authorship must be tracked for change control accountability, document lifecycle management, regulatory inspection readiness, and technical transfer. GMP requires documented authorship for all con

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: MBRs define manufacturing processes that must reference covering process/formulation patents for technology transfer documentation, licensing agreement compliance, regulatory filings, and IP strategy

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing site or facility where this master batch record is used. Supports multi-site operations and Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) / Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) oversight.

attributes.name: superseded_by_mbr_master_batch_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Master Batch Record (MBR) ID
attributes.description: Reference to the newer master batch record that supersedes this version, enabling version lineage tracking.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of this master batch record: pending, approved, or rejected by quality assurance and regulatory affairs.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the quality assurance (QA) manager or authorized person who approved this master batch record.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this master batch record was formally approved by quality assurance.

attributes.name: batch_size_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum allowable batch size that can be manufactured using this master batch record, supporting scale flexibility.

attributes.name: batch_size_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum allowable batch size that can be manufactured using this master batch record, supporting scale flexibility.

attributes.name: batch_size_standard
attributes.description: The standard or nominal batch size for which this master batch record is designed, expressed in the unit of measure defined in batch_size_uom.

attributes.name: batch_size_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for batch size: kilograms (kg), liters (L), units, tablets, vials, or doses.

attributes.name: cgmp_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this master batch record is compliant with current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) regulations per 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this master batch record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_location
attributes.description: The storage location or URI of the full master batch record document in the document management system (Veeva Vault QualityDocs or MasterControl).

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The finished dosage form (FDF) of the product: tablet, capsule, injection, suspension, solution, cream, ointment, or powder. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|injection|suspension|solution|cream|ointment|powder — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this master batch record becomes effective and can be used for manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: equipment_requirements
attributes.description: Description of the equipment required for executing this master batch record, including specific equipment types, models, or identifiers.

attributes.name: expected_yield_percentage
attributes.description: The expected theoretical yield for this batch as a percentage, used to calculate acceptable yield ranges and detect deviations.

attributes.name: formulation_details
attributes.description: Detailed formulation information including active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and excipient quantities, ratios, and specifications. Business-confidential intellectual property.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.50 (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls - CMC)

attributes.name: in_process_control_specifications
attributes.description: Summary of in-process control specifications and acceptance criteria that must be met during batch execution, including critical quality attributes (CQAs).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this master batch record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the master batch record: draft, under review, approved, active (in use), superseded (replaced by newer version), obsolete, or retired. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|active|superseded|obsolete|retired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: manufacturing_process_type
attributes.description: The type of manufacturing process covered by this master batch record: API synthesis, formulation, fill-finish, packaging, blending, granulation, coating, or lyophilization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: api_synthesis|formulation|fill_finish|packaging|blending|granulation|coating|lyophilization — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: mbr_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for this master batch record, used across manufacturing, quality, and regulatory systems.

attributes.name: mbr_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the master batch record, typically including product name and dosage form.

attributes.name: minimum_yield_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable yield percentage below which a batch is considered out of specification (OOS) and requires investigation.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this master batch record.

attributes.name: pat_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) is implemented for real-time monitoring and control of critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

attributes.name: process_description
attributes.description: High-level description of the manufacturing process steps covered by this master batch record, including key operations and sequence.

attributes.name: qbd_approach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this master batch record was developed using Quality by Design (QbD) principles per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory approval document (NDA, BLA, MAA, or ANDA number) under which this master batch record is authorized for commercial manufacturing.

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: The periodic review cycle in months for this master batch record, ensuring ongoing compliance and relevance per quality management system (QMS) requirements.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The strength or potency of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the finished dosage form, e.g., '500mg', '10mg/mL'.

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: The date on which this master batch record was superseded by a newer version and is no longer used for new batches.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of this master batch record, incremented with each revision. Format: major.minor (e.g., 1.0, 2.1).

products.name: site
products.description: Master data for physical manufacturing facilities including owned sites and CMO/CDMO contract sites. Captures site name, site code, address, country, site type (API manufacturing, formulation, fill-finish, packaging, combination), GMP certification status, regulatory approval status (FDA, EMA, PMDA registered), site capacity, site owner (internal vs CMO/CDMO), ERP plant code, and operational status. Serves as the SSOT for manufacturing location master data within the manufacturing domain.
products.reference: GMP Manufacturing Site / FDA Establishment Registration

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing site. Primary key for the manufacturing site master data entity.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Manufacturing sites have operating budgets for utilities, maintenance, overhead, and capital expenditures requiring linkage for budget planning, variance analysis, and site-level financial performance

attributes.name: cmo_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: When site is operated by contract manufacturing organization (ownership_type = CMO/CDMO), links to vendor master for quality agreements, audit scheduling, regulatory oversight, and performance managem

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Manufacturing sites are capitalized fixed assets requiring depreciation tracking, capital planning, insurance valuation, and regulatory asset documentation for GMP compliance and financial reporting.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturing site became operational and began commercial production. Used for calculating site age, depreciation schedules, and historical performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Management, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the manufacturing site including street number and name. Required for regulatory establishment registration and inspection scheduling.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207 (Establishment Registration), EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building number, suite, floor, or industrial park name.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the site capacity metric. Varies by site type: API sites typically use kg or metric tons, formulation sites use million units or batches, fill-finish sites use thousand vials or liters.
attributes.references: ICH Q10, SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: capacity_units_per_year
attributes.description: Annual production capacity of the site measured in units appropriate to the site type (e.g., kilograms of API, millions of tablets, thousands of vials). Used for capacity planning, supply chain optimization, and network strategy.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the manufacturing site is located. Used for regulatory reporting and supply chain logistics planning.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207 (Establishment Registration), GDP Good Distribution Practice

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturing site ceased operations or was decommissioned. Null for active sites. Used for historical record keeping and regulatory reporting of discontinued manufacturing locations.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the manufacturing site is located. Critical for determining applicable regulatory authority jurisdiction (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, etc.).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, 21 CFR Part 207, EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the manufacturing site record was first created in the master data system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ema_authorization_number
attributes.description: EMA manufacturing authorization number or EudraGMP identifier for sites manufacturing medicinal products for the European market. Required for GMP compliance verification.

attributes.name: ema_authorization_status
attributes.description: Current status of the EMA manufacturing authorization indicating whether the site is actively authorized to manufacture for EU markets, authorization has expired, application is pending, authorization is not required, or has been suspended.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for the manufacturing site used for regulatory correspondence, quality notifications, and business communications.

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_program
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has an active environmental monitoring program for tracking viable and non-viable particulates, temperature, humidity, and other environmental conditions in classified manufacturing areas. Required for sterile and aseptic manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.42, EU GMP Annex 1, ISO 14644

attributes.name: erp_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code or equivalent ERP system identifier for the manufacturing site. Links site master data to production planning (PP), materials management (MM), quality management (QM), and warehouse management (WM) modules.

attributes.name: fda_registration_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date when the current FDA establishment registration expires. FDA registrations must be renewed annually between October 1 and December 31.

attributes.name: fda_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Number
attributes.description: FDA establishment registration number assigned to the site. Required for all facilities manufacturing drugs for the US market per 21 CFR Part 207. Must be renewed annually.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207 (Establishment Registration and Drug Listing)

attributes.name: fda_registration_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Status
attributes.description: Current status of the FDA establishment registration indicating whether the site is actively registered, registration has expired, renewal is pending, registration is not required, or registration has been suspended.

attributes.name: gmp_certification_status
attributes.description: Overall current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) certification status of the site indicating compliance with pharmaceutical quality standards. Certified means site has passed recent GMP inspection, expired means certification has lapsed, pending means inspection scheduled, not certified means site has not been inspected or failed inspection, conditional means certification granted with specific conditions or CAPA requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, ICH Q7, PIC/S GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: iso_9001_certification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001 Certification Date
attributes.description: Date when the site received ISO 9001 certification. ISO 9001 certificates are typically valid for three years with annual surveillance audits.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site holds ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. While not required for pharmaceutical manufacturing, ISO 9001 certification demonstrates commitment to quality management best practices.

attributes.name: last_gmp_inspection_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Inspection Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent GMP inspection conducted by any regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, etc.). Used to track inspection frequency and predict next inspection window.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211, ICH Q10, PIC/S GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the manufacturing site record was last updated in the master data system. Critical for change tracking and data governance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: mes_site_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the site in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Used to link batch records, equipment data, and process parameters to the physical manufacturing location.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Manufacturing Operations Management, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_gmp_inspection_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Inspection Due Date
attributes.description: Expected or scheduled date for the next GMP inspection. Typically inspections occur every 2-3 years for routine surveillance or more frequently for sites with compliance issues or new product approvals.
attributes.references: FDA Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) Guidelines, PIC/S GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the manufacturing site indicating whether the facility is actively producing, temporarily offline, permanently closed, being built, in validation phase, or suspended due to regulatory or quality issues.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) Guidelines

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site is owned and operated internally by the company, operated by a Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO), a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), or a joint venture partnership.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA Guidance on Contract Manufacturing

attributes.name: pat_capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has Process Analytical Technology (PAT) capabilities for real-time monitoring and control of critical process parameters (CPP) and critical quality attributes (CQA) during manufacturing. PAT enables continuous process verification and improved process understanding.
attributes.references: FDA PAT Guidance, ICH Q8/Q9/Q10, 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the manufacturing site. Used for regulatory authority communications, audit scheduling, and emergency contact.

attributes.name: pics_membership_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S) Membership Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site is located in a PIC/S member country, enabling mutual recognition of GMP inspections across participating regulatory authorities. Member status facilitates international regulatory acceptance.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the manufacturing site address. Used for logistics, shipping, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDP Good Distribution Practice, 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: qbd_implementation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the level of Quality by Design (QbD) principles implementation at the site. QbD is a systematic approach to pharmaceutical development that begins with predefined objectives and emphasizes product and process understanding based on sound science and quality risk management.
attributes.references: ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development, ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management, ICH Q10

attributes.name: quality_management_system
attributes.description: Primary Quality Management System platform deployed at the site for managing deviations, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), change control, and document management. Critical for compliance and audit readiness.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the manufacturing site used across enterprise systems and regulatory submissions. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by corporate master data management.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Official legal or business name of the manufacturing facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207 (Establishment Registration), EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary manufacturing capability of the site. API manufacturing produces active pharmaceutical ingredients (drug substance), formulation creates drug product, fill-finish performs sterile filling operations, packaging performs secondary packaging, combination sites perform multiple operations, and analytical testing sites perform quality control testing.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, 21 CFR Part 210

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division where the site is located. Required for regulatory jurisdiction determination and tax compliance.

products.name: line
products.description: Master data for individual production lines, suites, or manufacturing units within a site. Captures line code, line name, line type (granulation, blending, compression, coating, filling, lyophilization, packaging), associated site, capacity (units/hour or kg/batch), equipment train composition, cleanroom classification, validated status, current operational status (available, in-use, under maintenance, decommissioned), and qualification expiry date. Enables production scheduling and capacity planning at the line level.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing line. Primary key.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Production lines have dedicated budgets for maintenance, validation campaigns, and operating costs tracked separately from site-level budgets for line-level financial performance and capacity planning

attributes.name: responsible_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing site where this line is located. Links to the site master data for facility-level context.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation for the manufacturing line. Continuous manufacturing represents advanced Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and Quality by Design (QbD) implementations.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Continuous Manufacturing, ICH Q8 QbD

attributes.name: capacity_kg_per_batch
attributes.description: Maximum batch size capacity in kilograms for bulk processing lines such as granulation, blending, or Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) synthesis. Null for unit-based lines.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: capacity_units_per_hour
attributes.description: Rated production capacity of the line expressed as units per hour. For solid dosage forms, this represents tablets or capsules per hour; for liquids, vials or bottles per hour.

attributes.name: changeover_time_hours
attributes.description: Average time in hours required to perform a product changeover on this manufacturing line, including cleaning, setup, and line clearance activities per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.

attributes.name: cleaning_validation_status
attributes.description: Current status of cleaning validation for the manufacturing line. Critical for preventing cross-contamination and ensuring compliance with Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) per 21 CFR Part 211.

attributes.name: cleanroom_classification
attributes.description: ISO 14644 or European Union (EU) Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Annex 1 cleanroom classification for the manufacturing line environment. Critical for sterile and aseptic manufacturing operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISO-5|ISO-6|ISO-7|ISO-8|Grade-A|Grade-B|Grade-C|Grade-D|non-classified — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 14644 Cleanroom Standards, EU GMP Annex 1

attributes.name: cmo_cdmo_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) or Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) Name
attributes.description: Name of the Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) or Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) operating this line, if applicable. Null for internally operated lines.

attributes.name: cmo_cdmo_operated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) or Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) Operated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this manufacturing line is operated by a Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) or Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) rather than owned and operated internally.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturing line was commissioned and became operational. Used for asset lifecycle management and depreciation tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which manufacturing costs for this line are allocated. Links to the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) financial module for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacturing line record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturing line was decommissioned and taken out of service. Null for active lines.

attributes.name: dosage_form_type
attributes.description: Type of Finished Dosage Form (FDF) produced on this manufacturing line. Aligns with regulatory submissions and product master data. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|injectable|lyophilized-vial|suspension|solution|cream|ointment|patch|inhaler — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing line requires environmental monitoring for viable and non-viable particulates per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Annex 1 for sterile manufacturing.

attributes.name: equipment_train_composition
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of major equipment units that comprise the manufacturing line, such as 'Mixer-Granulator-Dryer-Mill' or 'Filling Machine-Capper-Labeler'. Supports equipment traceability and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome classification from the most recent regulatory inspection. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) uses classifications such as No Action Indicated (NAI), Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), and Official Action Indicated (OAI).

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance activity performed on the manufacturing line. Supports equipment reliability and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacturing line record was last updated. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the manufacturing line, used in production scheduling, batch records, and Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Typically alphanumeric and unique within a site.

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the manufacturing line, such as 'Tablet Compression Line 3' or 'Sterile Fill-Finish Suite A'.

products.name: process_parameter
products.description: Defines and records Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) and non-critical process parameters for manufacturing processes, including both the specification (target values, control limits, specification limits) from the master batch record and the actual measured values recorded during batch execution from MES, PAT instruments, or manual entry. Captures parameter name, type (CPP vs non-critical), process step, target value, control/specification limits, unit of measure, measurement frequency, PAT indicator, and per-batch actual measurements with timestamps, instrument IDs, and pass/fail status. Supports QbD principles, process validation, CPV trending, and regulatory inspection readiness per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10.

attributes.name: data_integrity_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash or checksum of the parameter measurement record to ensure data integrity and detect unauthorized modifications. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The system or application from which this parameter data originated (e.g., SAP PP, MES, LIMS, PAT instrument software). Required for data lineage and audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this parameter specification version was superseded or retired. Null for currently active specifications. Supports historical batch record interpretation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this parameter specification version became effective. Used to determine which specification applies to historical batch records and supports regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: investigation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parameter measurement requires formal investigation due to exceeding control or specification limits. True triggers Quality Assurance (QA) review and potential Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this process parameter record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: The lower boundary of the normal operating range for this parameter. Values below this trigger investigation but may not require batch rejection. Used for statistical process control and continuous process verification.

attributes.name: lower_specification_limit
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable value for this parameter as defined in regulatory filings and approved specifications. Values below this limit may result in batch rejection or deviation investigation per Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP).

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency or timing for measuring this parameter during batch execution. Defines sampling plan and monitoring requirements per the approved batch record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|per_batch|hourly|per_shift|daily|on_demand|at_process_step — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The method by which this parameter is measured or recorded. Indicates whether data is captured through Process Analytical Technology (PAT), manual operator entry, or laboratory testing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manual_entry|automated_sensor|pat_instrument|laboratory_analysis|inline_measurement|atline_measurement|offline_measurement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this parameter measurement was recorded. Critical for establishing batch record chronology and supporting 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the parameter within the manufacturing process. Used for cross-referencing with Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Process Analytical Technology (PAT) instruments.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the process parameter (e.g., Mixing Temperature, Compression Force, pH Level, Dissolution Rate).

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parameter based on its impact on product quality. Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) have direct impact on Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs) and require stringent control per Quality by Design (QbD) principles.

attributes.name: parameter_version
attributes.description: Version number of the parameter specification. Incremented when control limits, specification limits, or other parameter attributes are changed through the change control process. Supports regulatory change history requirements.

attributes.name: pat_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parameter is monitored using Process Analytical Technology (PAT) instruments for real-time or near-real-time measurement and control. True if PAT is implemented for this parameter.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether deviations or out-of-specification results for this parameter must be reported to regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA, etc.) as part of annual product reviews or post-approval change protocols.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The intended setpoint or target value for this parameter as defined in the master batch record or process development documentation. Represents the optimal operating point.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The measurement unit for this parameter (e.g., degrees Celsius, bar, pH units, RPM, minutes, mg/mL). Must be consistent with International System of Units (SI) or industry-standard pharmaceutical units.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: The upper boundary of the normal operating range for this parameter. Values above this trigger investigation but may not require batch rejection. Used for statistical process control and continuous process verification.

attributes.name: upper_specification_limit
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable value for this parameter as defined in regulatory filings and approved specifications. Values above this limit may result in batch rejection or deviation investigation per Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this parameter measurement was reviewed and verified by Quality Assurance (QA) or supervisory personnel. Part of the batch record review and release process.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) or supervisory personnel who reviewed and verified this parameter measurement. Required for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) batch record review.

products.name: process_parameter_result
products.description: Actual measured values of critical process parameters (CPPs), non-critical process parameters, and in-process control (IPC) results recorded during batch manufacturing execution. Captured from MES, PAT instruments, SCADA systems, or manual entry in the electronic batch record. Captures batch reference, process step, parameter name, parameter type (CPP, non-critical, IPC), measured value, unit of measure, measurement timestamp, measurement method, instrument ID, operator ID, pass/fail evaluation against specification limits defined in the master batch record, deviation flag, and PAT indicator. This entity is the sole SSOT for all in-process parameter measurements — parameter specifications (targets, control limits, acceptance criteria) are owned by master_batch_record while this entity owns all actuals. Provides the complete CPP/CQA data trail for each batch, supporting QbD principles, process validation (Stage 2/3), continued process verification (CPV) trending, statistical process control, and regulatory inspection readiness per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 and 21 CFR 211.188.
products.reference: In-Process Control Result / CPP Measurement (21 CFR 211.192)

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Human-readable batch number or lot number for traceability and regulatory reporting. Denormalized for query performance.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or observations recorded by the operator or system regarding the measurement, including any contextual notes or anomalies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this process parameter result record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: System or source from which the measurement data originated: MES (Manufacturing Execution System), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System), Manual Entry, PAT System, ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook).

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measurement triggered a process deviation or Out of Specification (OOS) event requiring investigation and CAPA.

attributes.name: evaluation_result
attributes.description: Result of comparing the measured value against specification limits: Pass (within limits), Fail (out of specification), Warning (approaching limits), Not Evaluated (no limits defined).

attributes.name: instrument_code
attributes.description: Human-readable code or tag number of the instrument or equipment (e.g., TMP-101, PRS-205). Denormalized for traceability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this process parameter result record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower acceptable limit for the parameter as defined in the master batch record or process specification. Used for pass/fail evaluation.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Actual measured value of the process parameter as recorded during batch execution. This is the primary result field.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Method by which the parameter was measured: Manual (operator entry), Automated (MES/SCADA), PAT (real-time analyzer), Laboratory (offline test).

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the parameter measurement was taken or recorded. Critical for batch chronology and process validation.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the operator or technician who recorded the measurement. Denormalized for audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: parameter_type

attributes.references: ICH Q8 (QbD), ICH Q9, ICH Q10

attributes.name: pat_indicator

attributes.name: record_status

attributes.name: sampling_point
attributes.description: Physical location or sampling point within the process equipment where the measurement was taken (e.g., Inlet, Outlet, Mid-Point, Probe Location).

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target or setpoint value for the parameter as defined in the master batch record. Used for comparison and deviation detection.

attributes.name: test_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the validated test method or Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) used for the measurement (e.g., SOP-QC-1234, USP Method 621).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measured value (e.g., Celsius, bar, pH units, RPM, L/min, %RH). Critical for interpretation and compliance.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper acceptable limit for the parameter as defined in the master batch record or process specification. Used for pass/fail evaluation.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the measurement verification by a supervisor or quality assurance: Pending (awaiting review), Verified (approved), Rejected (invalid), Under Review (investigation in progress).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the measurement was verified or approved by a supervisor or quality assurance personnel.

products.name: manufacturing_deviation
products.description: Records unplanned departures from approved manufacturing procedures, specifications, or batch records during production. Captures deviation number, batch reference, deviation type (process, equipment, material, environmental, documentation), description, severity (critical, major, minor), detection date, detection phase (in-process, packaging, QC testing), root cause category, immediate containment actions, impact assessment, CAPA reference, closure date, and regulatory reportability flag. Integrates with MasterControl/TrackWise QMS. Distinct from quality CAPA records owned by the quality domain.

attributes.name: deviation_category

attributes.name: deviation_type

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when formal investigation of the deviation was initiated.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the deviation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: manufacturing_area

attributes.name: manufacturing_deviation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the deviation: open (newly identified), under_investigation (root cause analysis in progress), pending_capa (awaiting corrective action), closed (investigation and actions complete), cancelled (determined not to be a deviation).

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: Estimated or known date when the deviation actually occurred, which may differ from detection date.

Aligned with SAP PP BOM and master batch record formulation. Supports MRP calculations, material traceability, and procurement.

products.name: process_validation
products.description: Records of process validation studies conducted to demonstrate that a manufacturing process consistently produces a product meeting its predetermined specifications and quality attributes, per FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011) and ICH Q8/Q10. Covers all validation types including process validation (Stages 1-3), cleaning validation (dirty hold time, clean hold time, swab/rinse recovery), and computer system validation (CSV/CSA for MES, SCADA, LIMS). Captures validation protocol number, product, process step or system, validation stage (Stage 1 prospective, Stage 2 process qualification, Stage 3 continued process verification), validation type (process, cleaning, computerized system, analytical method transfer), number of validation batches or runs, acceptance criteria, validation outcome (pass/fail/conditional), approval date, revalidation triggers, and next periodic review date. Supports lifecycle approach to validation per ICH Q12.

attributes.references: ICH Q8, ICH Q6A, FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)

attributes.name: batch_size_max
attributes.description: Maximum batch size validated in the study, expressed in the unit of measure appropriate for the product. Defines the upper bound of the validated batch size range.

attributes.name: batch_size_min
attributes.description: Minimum batch size validated in the study, expressed in the unit of measure appropriate for the product (kg for API, number of units for finished dosage form). Defines the lower bound of the validated batch size range.

attributes.name: batch_size_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the batch size (e.g., kg for bulk API, units/tablets/capsules for solid oral dosage forms, vials/syringes for injectables). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|L|mL|units|tablets|capsules|vials|syringes — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Reference to the change control record that authorized this validation or revalidation activity. Links validation to the change management process per ICH Q10.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or observations related to the validation study. May include summary of key findings, lessons learned, or special considerations.

attributes.name: cpp_monitored
attributes.description: List of Critical Process Parameters (CPP) monitored during the validation study. CPPs are process parameters whose variability has an impact on a CQA and therefore should be monitored or controlled to ensure the process produces the desired quality. Examples include temperature, pressure, mixing time, pH, flow rate.

attributes.name: cqa_monitored
attributes.description: List of Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) monitored during the validation study. CQAs are physical, chemical, biological, or microbiological properties that should be within an appropriate limit, range, or distribution to ensure the desired product quality. Examples include assay, impurities, dissolution, content uniformity, sterility, endotoxin.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this validation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: design_space_defined
attributes.description: Indicates whether a design space was defined as part of the validation. Design space is the multidimensional combination and interaction of input variables and process parameters that have been demonstrated to provide assurance of quality per ICH Q8. True if design space was established through QbD approach.

attributes.name: deviation_count
attributes.description: Number of deviations from the validation protocol that occurred during execution. Deviations must be documented, investigated, and assessed for impact on validation outcome per cGMP requirements.

attributes.name: execution_end_date
attributes.description: Date when validation execution was completed (last validation batch or run completed and all testing finished).

attributes.name: execution_start_date
attributes.description: Date when validation execution began (first validation batch or run initiated).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this validation record was last modified. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the validation. Per ICH Q10 and continued process verification principles, validations must be periodically reviewed to ensure the process remains in a state of control. Typically reviewed annually or based on risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH Q10, ICH Q12, FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)

attributes.name: number_of_runs
attributes.description: Number of validation batches or runs executed as part of the validation study. Typically minimum 3 consecutive successful batches for process validation per FDA guidance. May vary based on validation type and risk assessment.
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q7

attributes.name: oos_count
attributes.description: Number of Out of Specification (OOS) results encountered during validation execution. OOS results require investigation per FDA OOS guidance and may impact validation outcome.

attributes.name: pat_implementation
attributes.description: Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools were implemented as part of the validation. PAT is a system for designing, analyzing, and controlling manufacturing through timely measurements of critical quality and performance attributes with the goal of ensuring final product quality. True if PAT tools (e.g., NIR, Raman, in-line sensors) were used.

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: Specific manufacturing process step or unit operation being validated (e.g., API synthesis, granulation, blending, compression, coating, fill-finish, lyophilization, sterilization, packaging). For cleaning validation, this is the equipment or system being cleaned. For CSV, this is the computerized system being validated.
attributes.references: ICH Q8, FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)

attributes.name: protocol_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the validation protocol was approved by Quality Assurance and authorized for execution. Represents the start of the validation lifecycle.

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: Unique protocol number assigned to the validation study. Serves as the externally-known business identifier for this validation activity.

attributes.name: qa_approver
attributes.description: Name of the Quality Assurance representative who reviewed and approved the validation protocol and report. QA approval is required per cGMP regulations.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory filing (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD section) where this validation data is or will be submitted. Validation data is typically included in Module 3 (Quality) of the Common Technical Document (CTD).

attributes.name: report_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the validation report was reviewed and approved by Quality Assurance. This is the official validation completion date and triggers the validated state for the process.

attributes.name: revalidation_trigger
attributes.description: Event or condition that triggered the need for revalidation. Examples include: process changes, equipment changes, facility changes, raw material supplier changes, scale-up or scale-down, transfer to new site, out-of-specification results, quality issues, regulatory inspection findings, or periodic review schedule. Supports change control and lifecycle management per ICH Q12.
attributes.references: ICH Q10, ICH Q12, 21 CFR Part 211.100

attributes.name: validation_approach
attributes.description: Validation approach methodology. Traditional approach uses fixed process parameters and extensive testing. Quality by Design (QbD) approach uses design space and process understanding per ICH Q8. Hybrid combines traditional and QbD elements. Risk-based approach uses ICH Q9 risk management principles to focus validation efforts.
attributes.references: ICH Q8, ICH Q9, ICH Q10

attributes.name: validation_lead
attributes.description: Name of the person responsible for leading the validation study. Typically a validation engineer, process engineer, or quality assurance specialist.

attributes.name: validation_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the validation study. Pass indicates all acceptance criteria were met. Fail indicates one or more acceptance criteria were not met. Conditional indicates validation passed with minor deviations that require corrective action but do not invalidate the study. Inconclusive indicates validation could not be completed or results were ambiguous.
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q10

attributes.name: validation_stage
attributes.description: Stage of process validation per FDA lifecycle approach. Stage 1 (Process Design) establishes commercial manufacturing process based on development knowledge. Stage 2 (Process Qualification) confirms process design is capable of reproducible commercial manufacturing. Stage 3 (Continued Process Verification) provides ongoing assurance that process remains in control. Also includes legacy approaches: prospective (validation before routine production), concurrent (validation during routine production), and retrospective (validation using historical data).
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q10

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the validation study. Draft indicates protocol is being prepared. In Progress indicates validation execution is underway. Under Review indicates validation report is being reviewed by Quality Assurance. Approved indicates validation successfully completed and approved. Rejected indicates validation failed to meet acceptance criteria. Conditional indicates validation passed with minor deviations requiring follow-up. Expired indicates validation has exceeded its periodic review date and requires revalidation. Superseded indicates validation has been replaced by a newer study. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|under_review|approved|rejected|conditional|expired|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: validation_type
attributes.description: Type of validation being performed. Process validation covers manufacturing processes, cleaning validation covers equipment cleaning procedures, computerized system validation covers MES/SCADA/LIMS systems per 21 CFR Part 11, analytical method validation covers laboratory test methods, equipment validation covers production equipment qualification, and sterilization validation covers sterilization cycles.
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q7, 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: environmental_monitoring
products.description: Records of environmental monitoring (EM) results for cleanrooms and controlled manufacturing areas, capturing microbial and particulate data as required under cGMP for sterile and non-sterile manufacturing. Captures monitoring location, cleanroom classification (ISO 5/6/7/8, Grade A/B/C/D), monitoring type (viable air, surface, personnel, non-viable particulate), sample date/time, organism identified, colony forming units (CFU), action limit, alert limit, pass/fail status, and trend flag. Supports contamination control strategy per Annex 1 (EMA) and 21 CFR 211.42.
products.reference: Environmental Monitoring / Contamination Control Strategy (Annex 1 / 21 CFR 211.42)

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the environmental monitoring record. Primary key.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing batch being produced during this environmental monitoring event.

attributes.name: gxp_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.gxp_obligation. Business justification: Environmental monitoring programs are designed to meet specific GXP requirements for sterile/aseptic manufacturing (EU GMP Annex 1, FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance). Essential for contamination contro

attributes.name: manufacturing_deviation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality deviation record if this environmental monitoring result triggered a deviation investigation.

attributes.name: primary_environmental_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory analyst or quality technician who performed the environmental monitoring and analysis.

attributes.name: quality_capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPA record if corrective or preventive actions were initiated based on this environmental monitoring result.

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the environmental monitoring sample, typically generated by the LIMS or MES system.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility where the environmental monitoring was performed.

attributes.name: action_limit
attributes.description: Action limit threshold for the monitoring type and location. Exceeding this limit requires immediate corrective action and deviation investigation.

attributes.name: action_limit_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the action limit was exceeded (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: alert_limit
attributes.description: Alert limit threshold for the monitoring type and location. Exceeding this limit triggers investigation but does not necessarily indicate a deviation.

attributes.name: alert_limit_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the alert limit was exceeded (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: cfu_count
attributes.description: Number of colony forming units (CFU) detected in the sample. For viable air, typically reported as CFU per cubic meter; for surface, CFU per plate or per area.

attributes.name: cfu_per_cubic_meter
attributes.business_glossary_term: Colony Forming Units (CFU) per Cubic Meter
attributes.description: Normalized CFU count per cubic meter of air sampled, calculated for viable air monitoring.

attributes.name: cleanroom_classification_iso
attributes.description: ISO 14644-1 cleanroom classification for the monitored area.

attributes.name: cleanroom_grade_eu
attributes.description: EU GMP Annex 1 cleanroom grade classification for the monitored area.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or observations recorded by the analyst regarding the environmental monitoring event, sample collection, or result.

attributes.name: exposure_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes that a passive settle plate or contact plate was exposed. Null for active air sampling.

attributes.name: incubation_duration_hours
attributes.description: Duration in hours for which the microbial sample was incubated before reading.

attributes.name: incubation_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the microbial sample was incubated.

attributes.name: manufacturing_operation_phase
attributes.description: Phase of manufacturing operation during which the environmental monitoring was performed: at-rest (no activity), operational (normal production), or intervention (during maintenance or setup).

attributes.name: monitoring_location_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the specific location within the cleanroom or controlled area where the sample was taken (e.g., FILL-ROOM-A-LOC-001).

attributes.name: monitoring_location_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the monitoring location (e.g., 'Near filling line conveyor belt, 1 meter from HEPA filter').

attributes.name: monitoring_type
attributes.description: Type of environmental monitoring performed: viable air (microbial air sampling), surface (contact plates or swabs), personnel (gown or glove sampling), non-viable particulate (particle counting), or water (for water systems).

attributes.name: organism_identified
attributes.description: Name of the microorganism identified in the sample (e.g., Staphylococcus epidermidis, Bacillus species). Null if no growth or if identification not performed.

attributes.name: particulate_count_0_5_micron
attributes.description: Number of particles equal to or greater than 0.5 microns detected per cubic meter for non-viable particulate monitoring.

attributes.name: particulate_count_5_0_micron
attributes.description: Number of particles equal to or greater than 5.0 microns detected per cubic meter for non-viable particulate monitoring.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this environmental monitoring record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this environmental monitoring record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Status of the environmental monitoring result: pass (within limits), alert (exceeded alert limit), action (exceeded action limit), or fail (critical excursion).

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the environmental monitoring result was reviewed and approved by quality assurance.

attributes.name: sample_collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the environmental monitoring sample was collected.

attributes.name: sample_volume_liters
attributes.description: Volume of air sampled in liters for viable or non-viable air monitoring. Null for surface or personnel monitoring.

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: Specific method used to collect the environmental sample (e.g., active air sampling with impactor, passive settle plate, contact plate, swab, finger dab, glove print).
attributes.value_regex: active air|passive air|contact plate|swab|finger dab|glove print

attributes.name: trend_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this result is part of an adverse trend requiring investigation (True) or not (False).

products.name: investigational_product_supply
products.description: This association product represents the supply allocation and usage tracking between master batch records (manufacturing specifications for investigational products) and clinical trial investigators. It captures trial-specific supply chain planning, dosing regimens, approved indications, and regulatory traceability requirements per ICH GMP Annex 13. Each record links one master batch record to one investigator with attributes that exist only in the context of this clinical supply relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical clinical operations, a single master batch record (manufacturing specification) is used to produce investigational product that is supplied to multiple investigators across different trials, phases, and sites. Conversely, each investigator typically receives investigational product from multiple master batch records representing different formulations, strengths, or product variants across their portfolio of trials. The business actively manages these supply allocations as distinct operational records with trial-specific attributes.

attributes.description: ICH-defined storage condition for the stability study: 25°C/60%RH (long-term temperate), 30°C/65%RH (long-term subtropical), 30°C/75%RH (intermediate), 40°C/75%RH (accelerated), 5°C (refrigerated), -20°C (frozen), -70°C (ultra-low), photostability chamber, or stress condition (heat, humidity, oxidation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 25C_60RH|30C_65RH|30C_75RH|40C_75RH|5C|minus20C|minus70C|photostability|stress_condition — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Climatic Zones, ICH Q1B Photostability

attributes.name: study_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional study-level observations, deviations from protocol, chamber malfunctions, sample handling issues, or other relevant comments that may impact data interpretation.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2), 21 CFR Part 211.194 Laboratory Records

attributes.name: study_protocol_number
attributes.description: Unique protocol identifier assigned to the stability study per internal numbering convention and regulatory submission requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

attributes.name: study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the stability study was initiated and samples were placed into controlled storage chambers. Marks time zero for all pull-point calculations.

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stability study indicating whether it is planned, actively running, on hold, completed, cancelled, or under quality review.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stability study: registration (for regulatory submission), commitment (post-approval commitment), ongoing (routine monitoring), photostability (ICH Q1B), stress (forced degradation), intermediate, accelerated, or long-term per ICH Q1A. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registration|commitment|ongoing|photostability|stress|intermediate|accelerated|long_term — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2), ICH Q1B Photostability Testing

attributes.name: test_parameters
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of analytical test parameters performed at each time point (e.g., assay, degradation products, dissolution, appearance, pH, viscosity, water content, particulate matter). Defines the analytical scope per study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2), ICH Q6A Specifications, USP General Chapters

products.name: method_validation

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analytical method being validated. Links to the analytical method master data.
