attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rd_capitalization. Business justification: Analytical method validation costs during development are typically capitalized as part of R&D under accounting standards. Essential for method validation cost capitalization, linking validation docum

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or laboratory site where the method validation was performed. Links to site master data.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Analytical method validations are performed to demonstrate that a test method meets the acceptance criteria defined in a specification. One method validation is performed for one specification (1:N re

attributes.name: accuracy_recovery_percent_mean
attributes.description: Mean recovery percentage from accuracy studies, typically expected to be 98-102% for assay methods.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Accuracy

attributes.name: accuracy_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the accuracy assessment. Pass indicates recovery within predefined acceptance criteria across the method range.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Accuracy

attributes.name: api_name
attributes.description: Name of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) that the method is designed to measure or detect.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the validation report and method were formally approved by quality assurance.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: compendial_method_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the method is based on a pharmacopeial (compendial) method from USP, EP, JP, or other official compendia. True if compendial, False if proprietary or in-house developed.
attributes.references: USP General Chapter <1225> Validation of Compendial Procedures

attributes.name: compendial_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacopeial monograph or general chapter if the method is compendial (e.g., USP <621>, EP 2.2.46, JP 17).
attributes.references: USP General Chapter <1225> Validation of Compendial Procedures

attributes.name: intermediate_precision_rsd_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intermediate Precision Relative Standard Deviation (RSD) Percent
attributes.description: Relative standard deviation (RSD) from intermediate precision studies (inter-assay precision, different days, analysts, equipment), typically expected to be ≤ 3% for assay methods.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Precision (Intermediate Precision)

attributes.name: linearity_correlation_coefficient
attributes.description: Correlation coefficient (R) from the linearity study, typically expected to be ≥ 0.999 for assay methods.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Linearity

attributes.name: linearity_range_lower
attributes.description: Lower limit of the concentration range over which linearity was demonstrated.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Linearity

attributes.name: linearity_range_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the linearity range (e.g., mg/mL, µg/mL, percent label claim).
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Linearity

attributes.name: linearity_range_upper
attributes.description: Upper limit of the concentration range over which linearity was demonstrated.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Linearity

attributes.name: linearity_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the linearity assessment. Pass indicates acceptable correlation coefficient and residuals within acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Linearity

attributes.name: lod_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Limit of Detection (LOD) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the limit of detection (e.g., µg/mL, ppm, percent).
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Detection Limit

attributes.name: lod_value
attributes.description: Established limit of detection value for the method - the lowest amount of analyte that can be detected but not necessarily quantitated.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Detection Limit

attributes.name: loq_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Limit of Quantitation (LOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the limit of quantitation (e.g., µg/mL, ppm, percent).
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Quantitation Limit

attributes.name: loq_value
attributes.description: Established limit of quantitation value for the method - the lowest amount of analyte that can be quantitatively determined with suitable precision and accuracy.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Quantitation Limit

attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: Classification of the analytical method by its intended purpose (e.g., assay for potency, identification for substance confirmation, impurity for degradation products).
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: overall_validation_conclusion
attributes.description: Final conclusion of the method validation study. Validated indicates the method is fit for its intended purpose; not validated indicates it failed to meet acceptance criteria; conditionally validated indicates it passed with specific limitations or conditions.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: precision_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the precision assessment. Pass indicates RSD values within predefined acceptance criteria for repeatability and intermediate precision.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Precision

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Name of the drug product (DP) or drug substance (DS) being tested by the validated method.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this method validation is included in a regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA). True if included in regulatory dossier, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ICH M4Q Quality - Common Technical Document

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory submission in which this method validation is included (e.g., IND for Investigational New Drug, NDA for New Drug Application, BLA for Biologics License Application, MAA for Marketing Authorization Application).
attributes.references: ICH M4Q Quality - Common Technical Document

attributes.name: repeatability_rsd_percent
attributes.description: Relative standard deviation (RSD) from repeatability studies (intra-assay precision), typically expected to be ≤ 2% for assay methods.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Precision (Repeatability)

attributes.name: robustness_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the robustness assessment. Pass indicates the method is robust to deliberate variations in parameters such as pH, temperature, flow rate, or mobile phase composition.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Robustness

attributes.name: specificity_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the specificity assessment. Pass indicates the method can unequivocally assess the analyte in the presence of impurities, degradation products, and matrix components.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures - Specificity

attributes.name: technique
attributes.description: Analytical technique or instrumentation used (e.g., HPLC, GC, UV-Vis Spectroscopy, FTIR, Mass Spectrometry, Titration, Dissolution Apparatus).
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: validation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all validation activities were completed and the method was deemed validated.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: validation_protocol_number
attributes.description: Unique protocol number assigned to the method validation study. Business identifier for the validation activity.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: validation_report_number
attributes.description: Unique document number for the final validation report summarizing all validation activities and results.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: validation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the method validation activities commenced.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the method validation activity. Tracks progression from draft through approval or rejection.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: validation_type
attributes.description: Type of validation performed: full validation for new methods, partial for minor modifications, revalidation for significant changes, cross-validation for method transfer, or concurrent validation during routine use.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

products.description: Product quality complaint records from healthcare professionals, patients, distributors, and regulatory agencies regarding marketed pharmaceutical products. products.name: audit_site_inspection
products.description: This association product represents the inspection event between audit and vendor_site. It captures the specific audit activities conducted at each vendor site, including audit outcomes, findings classification, CAPA requirements, and follow-up schedules. Each record links one audit to one vendor site with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific site inspection within a broader audit program.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical supplier quality management, a single audit program can encompass multiple vendor sites (e.g., a CMO with manufacturing facilities in three countries), and each vendor site undergoes multiple audits over time (initial qualification, annual surveillance, for-cause investigations, pre-approval inspections). The business actively manages each audit-site inspection as a distinct quality event with its own findings, CAPA requirements, and follow-up schedules.

attributes.name: analysis_methodology_details

attributes.name: analysis_type

attributes.name: batch_number

attributes.name: closure_date

attributes.name: contributing_factors

attributes.name: corrective_action_required

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_date

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an effectiveness check is required to verify that implemented corrective and preventive actions successfully addressed the root cause.

attributes.name: evidence_collected
attributes.description: Summary of the evidence, data, and documentation collected during the investigation to support the root cause determination.

attributes.name: immediate_cause
attributes.description: The direct or proximate cause that led to the problem or deviation, identified during the investigation.

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential or actual impact of the root cause on product quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and business operations.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date when the root cause analysis was formally initiated.

attributes.name: investigation_team
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the cross-functional team members involved in the root cause analysis (e.g., Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, Regulatory).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the root cause analysis record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Key insights, best practices, and lessons learned from the root cause analysis that can be applied to prevent similar issues in the future.

attributes.name: preventive_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether preventive actions are required to prevent recurrence of similar issues in other areas or processes.

attributes.name: problem_statement
attributes.description: Clear and concise description of the problem or deviation being investigated, defining the scope of the root cause analysis.

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: Specific manufacturing or quality process step where the problem occurred (e.g., blending, compression, filling, testing).

attributes.name: qms_system_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or link to the record in the external QMS system (e.g., MasterControl, TrackWise) where the full root cause analysis documentation is maintained.

attributes.name: rca_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the root cause analysis, typically system-generated and externally referenced in quality documentation.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the root cause analysis findings were reported to regulatory authorities, if applicable.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the findings of the root cause analysis require reporting to regulatory authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA).

attributes.name: risk_assessment_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal risk assessment was conducted as part of the root cause analysis to evaluate impact and likelihood.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk level assigned based on the severity and likelihood of the identified root cause, used to prioritize corrective actions.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: The fundamental underlying cause(s) identified through systematic analysis that, if corrected, will prevent recurrence of the problem.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause (e.g., human error, equipment failure, material defect, process design flaw, environmental factor, procedural inadequacy).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the root cause analysis investigation.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the root cause analysis should be completed, typically driven by regulatory timelines or internal quality SLAs.

attributes.name: parent_root_cause_analysis_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on root_cause_analysis (parent_root_cause_analysis_id)

products.name: sample
products.description: Master reference table for sample. Referenced by sample_id.

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: Primary key for sample

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified person who approved the sample testing results. Must have appropriate training and authority per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing batch or lot from which this sample was drawn. Links sample to production batch for traceability and Certificate of Analysis (CoA) generation.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this sample record in the system. Required for audit trail and accountability under Good Documentation Practice (GDP).

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Reference to a quality deviation record if this sample is associated with a deviation investigation (e.g., Out of Specification result, sampling procedure deviation). Links sample to Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) system.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified personnel who physically collected the sample. Required for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) traceability and accountability.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material, active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), or excipient being sampled. Used for raw material qualification and supplier quality management.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this sample record. Required for audit trail and accountability under Good Documentation Practice (GDP).

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or material being sampled. Enables aggregation of sample results by product for trend analysis and Out of Trend (OOT) detection.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility or site where the sample was collected. Enables multi-site quality trending and site-specific compliance reporting.

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Samples are tested against specifications. Currently sample has test_specification_id (BIGINT) which should link to specification table. Renaming to specification_id for consistency. One sample is tes

attributes.name: stability_study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stability study protocol if this sample is part of a formal stability program. Links sample to long-term, accelerated, or stress stability testing programs.

attributes.name: test_specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the test specification or analytical method that defines the quality control tests to be performed on this sample, including acceptance criteria and test procedures.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sample testing results were reviewed and approved by qualified personnel. Represents the final disposition decision for the sample and associated batch.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chain of custody for the sample has been verified and documented. Critical for regulatory compliance and forensic investigations of Out of Specification (OOS) results.

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sample was physically collected or drawn from the batch, lot, or source material. This is the principal business event timestamp for the sample lifecycle.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, special handling instructions, or contextual information about the sample that may be relevant for testing or investigation.

attributes.name: composite_sample_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample is a composite (pooled from multiple sampling points or containers) or a discrete sample from a single source. Composite sampling is used for homogeneity assessment.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of container used to store and transport the sample. Must be appropriate for the material type and testing requirements to prevent contamination or degradation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sample record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and data integrity (ALCOA+ principles).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the sample is no longer valid for testing due to potential degradation or stability concerns. Calculated based on material stability data and storage conditions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sample record was last modified. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and data integrity (ALCOA+ principles).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for sample testing. Urgent and expedited samples receive accelerated testing to support production schedules or regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sample was formally registered in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) or Quality Management System (QMS) and assigned a sample number.

attributes.name: retain_sample_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample must be retained for the regulatory retention period. Retain samples are stored for future investigation of complaints, adverse events, or regulatory inquiries.

attributes.name: retain_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which the retain sample must be stored. Typically calculated as product expiration date plus one year, or as defined by regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date when the sample or associated material must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications. Applicable to raw materials and reference standards with limited shelf life.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the sample, typically assigned by Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) or Quality Management System (QMS). Used for tracking and referencing across quality documentation.

attributes.name: sample_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of material collected for the sample. Used to ensure sufficient sample volume for all required tests and potential retests.

attributes.name: sample_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the sample quantity (grams, kilograms, milligrams, milliliters, liters, units, tablets, vials). Must align with product specification units.

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sample in the quality testing workflow. Tracks progression from collection through testing to final disposition decision.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sample based on its purpose and stage in the manufacturing lifecycle. Raw material samples are tested upon receipt, in-process samples during manufacturing, finished product samples before release, stability samples for shelf-life studies, reference standards for calibration, and retain samples for future investigation.

attributes.name: sampling_location
attributes.description: Physical location or equipment identifier where the sample was collected (e.g., reactor vessel, blending tank, packaging line, warehouse zone). Critical for environmental monitoring and contamination investigation.

attributes.name: stability_timepoint
attributes.description: Timepoint designation within the stability study protocol (e.g., T0, 3M, 6M, 12M, 24M) indicating when this sample was pulled for testing. Used to track product degradation over time.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the sample to maintain integrity until testing is complete. Critical for stability samples and temperature-sensitive materials.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the sample is stored (e.g., laboratory refrigerator ID, stability chamber number, quarantine area). Enables sample retrieval and chain of custody tracking.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product for which this method is primarily used. Null if method is applicable across multiple products.

attributes.name: accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Percent recovery demonstrating the accuracy of the method, typically from validation studies.

attributes.name: analyte

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Reference to the most recent change control record associated with modifications to this analytical method.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a compendial method from an official pharmacopeia (USP, EP, JP) or a proprietary in-house method.

attributes.name: compendial_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the official pharmacopeia monograph or general chapter if this is a compendial method (e.g., USP <621>, EP 2.2.46).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this analytical method record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this analytical method became or will become effective for use in quality control testing.

attributes.name: equipment_required

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this analytical method is no longer valid for use and must be retired or replaced.

attributes.name: limit_of_quantitation
attributes.description: Lowest concentration of analyte that can be quantitatively determined with suitable precision and accuracy, expressed in the method's unit of measure.

attributes.name: linearity_range_lower

attributes.name: linearity_range_upper
attributes.description: Upper limit of the concentration range over which the method demonstrates linearity.

attributes.name: matrix
attributes.description: The type of sample or material to which this method is applied (e.g., tablet, capsule, injectable solution, raw material, bulk drug substance).

attributes.name: method_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the analytical method that clearly identifies its purpose and technique.

attributes.name: method_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the analytical method, typically following organizational naming conventions (e.g., HPLC-001234, GC-MS-5678).

attributes.name: method_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the analytical method indicating its readiness for use in quality control testing.

attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the analytical method based on the primary testing technique employed.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this analytical method record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: precision_rsd_percent
attributes.description: Relative standard deviation percentage demonstrating the precision of the method, typically from validation studies.

attributes.name: reagent_list
attributes.description: List of reagents, standards, and consumables required to perform this analytical method.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this method has been submitted to regulatory authorities as part of a drug application (NDA, ANDA, BLA, MAA).

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the regulatory submission (NDA, ANDA, BLA, MAA) in which this method was included.

attributes.name: revalidation_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the method must be revalidated to maintain its validated status, typically based on periodic review cycles.

attributes.name: robustness_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the method robustness has been evaluated and verified during validation studies.

attributes.name: run_time_minutes
attributes.description: Typical duration in minutes required to complete one analytical run or sample analysis.

attributes.name: sample_preparation_time_minutes
attributes.description: Typical time in minutes required for sample preparation before analysis.

attributes.name: sop_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Standard Operating Procedure document that provides detailed instructions for executing this method.

attributes.name: specification_limit_lower
attributes.description: Lower acceptance limit for the test result as defined in the product specification or pharmacopeia monograph.

attributes.name: specification_limit_upper
attributes.description: Upper acceptance limit for the test result as defined in the product specification or pharmacopeia monograph.

attributes.name: stability_indicating
attributes.description: Indicates whether the method is stability-indicating, capable of detecting degradation products and changes over time.

attributes.name: technique
attributes.description: Specific analytical technique or instrument platform used (e.g., HPLC, GC-MS, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, Bioburden).

attributes.name: test_category
attributes.description: Category of quality control test that this method supports, aligned with regulatory submission requirements.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which test results are reported (e.g., mg/mL, %, ppm, CFU/g, EU/mL).

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the analytical method validation was completed and approved.

attributes.name: validation_protocol_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the validation protocol document used to validate this analytical method.

attributes.name: validation_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the validation report document that summarizes the validation results for this method.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the method validation process indicating whether the method has been validated per ICH Q2(R1) requirements.

attributes.name: superseded_analytical_method_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on analytical_method (superseded_analytical_method_id)

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Manages end-to-end pharmaceutical supply chain planning and execution including demand forecasting, inventory management, cold-chain logistics, GDP (Good Distribution Practice) compliance, and distribution network management. Covers raw materials, API, excipients, packaging components, and finished goods across manufacturing sites, distribution centers, and third-party logistics providers. Integrates with Kinaxis RapidResponse/Blue Yonder and SAP MM/WM/SD. Tracks SKU, NDC, and lot/batch traceability for both commercial and clinical trial supply chains.
domains.references: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01) / 21 CFR Part 203 / SAP MM

products.name: demand_plan
products.description: Statistical and consensus-based demand forecast for pharmaceutical SKUs across commercial and clinical supply chains. Captures baseline forecast, adjusted forecast, consensus-approved quantities, planning horizon, and demand signals from Kinaxis RapidResponse/Blue Yonder. Tracks forecast version, approval status, planning cycle, and demand classification (commercial, clinical, compassionate use). Serves as the authoritative demand signal for supply planning and inventory positioning.

attributes.name: exclusivity_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Critical for commercial forecasting with regulatory exclusivity co

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.gxp_obligation. Business justification: Demand planning for controlled substances (DEA quotas), biologics (cold chain capacity), and orphan drugs (named patient programs) must comply with specific GxP obligations. Link tracks regulatory con

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product (Drug Product/Drug Substance) associated with this demand plan, enabling cross-SKU product-level demand aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ICH Q10

attributes.name: molecular_target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.molecular_target. Business justification: Strategic demand planning segments forecasts by target class and mechanism of action for competitive intelligence and portfolio planning. Enables target-based market analysis linking therapeutic area

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Demand planning must account for patent expiry dates (LOE events) to forecast generic competition impact on volumes. Critical for commercial forecasting and LOE planning cycles in pharmaceuticals.

attributes.name: planning_department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.department. Business justification: Demand planning is organized by therapeutic area departments for resource allocation, budget tracking, and capacity planning. New attribute needed for organizational hierarchy reporting.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or distribution site for which this demand plan is scoped, supporting multi-site supply network planning.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.discovery_project. Business justification: Integrated business planning (IBP) requires linking demand forecasts to R&D pipeline projects for portfolio-driven capacity planning, launch readiness, and commercial supply network design. Critical f

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this demand plan is generated. Covers both commercial and clinical supply SKUs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: adjusted_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Demand quantity after commercial, medical affairs, or supply chain planner adjustments to the statistical baseline. Reflects market intelligence, launch events, tender wins, or clinical trial enrollment changes applied on top of the baseline.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; APICS S&OP

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the pharmaceutical product. Enables standardized cross-product demand analysis and regulatory reporting alignment.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; EMA Product Classification

attributes.name: baseline_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Statistically generated baseline demand quantity for the SKU in the forecast period, produced by the statistical forecasting engine (Kinaxis/Blue Yonder) using historical sales, shipment, or consumption data without manual override.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU requires cold chain (temperature-controlled) logistics and storage throughout the supply chain. Critical for biologics, vaccines, and temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products. Drives GDP-compliant distribution planning.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); WHO Technical Report Series 961; FDA Guidance on Temperature-Sensitive Products

attributes.name: consensus_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the demand plan was formally approved through the S&OP consensus process. Marks the transition to frozen/authoritative demand signal for supply execution. Compliant with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10; SOX Compliance; APICS S&OP

attributes.name: consensus_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Final consensus-approved demand quantity agreed upon during the S&OP/IBP consensus meeting, representing the authoritative demand signal used for supply planning and inventory positioning. Populated only after plan_status reaches consensus_approved.
attributes.references: APICS S&OP Framework; Kinaxis RapidResponse; ICH Q10

attributes.name: demand_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the demand signal by supply chain purpose: commercial (market sales), clinical (investigational product for trials), compassionate use (expanded access programs), sample (promotional/medical samples), or launch (pre-launch inventory build). Drives planning rules and inventory segmentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; GDP Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: demand_signal_source
attributes.description: Origin of the primary demand signal used to generate or adjust this forecast (e.g., Kinaxis RapidResponse statistical engine, Blue Yonder, SAP APO, manual planner input, CRM pipeline, market research, or tender/contract data). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kinaxis|blue_yonder|sap_apo|manual|crm|market_research|tender — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; SAP S/4HANA PP; APICS

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The trade channel through which the pharmaceutical product reaches the end customer (e.g., wholesale distributor, direct hospital supply, retail pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, government/tender, export). Influences demand pattern and supply routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wholesale|direct|hospital|retail_pharmacy|specialty_pharmacy|government|export|e_commerce — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GDP Guidelines; WHO GDP

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_pct
attributes.description: Measured forecast accuracy for the prior equivalent period, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Calculated as 1 minus the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) for the SKU-period. Used to assess planning reliability and trigger model recalibration.
attributes.references: APICS CPIM; Kinaxis RapidResponse KPI Framework

attributes.name: forecast_bias
attributes.description: Systematic directional error in the forecast for the prior equivalent period, measured as actual minus forecast quantity. Positive bias indicates under-forecasting; negative bias indicates over-forecasting. Used for continuous improvement of demand planning accuracy.
attributes.references: APICS CPIM; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Analytics

attributes.name: forecast_granularity
attributes.description: The time granularity at which the demand forecast quantities are expressed (weekly, monthly, or quarterly buckets). Determines how forecast_period_date is interpreted.

attributes.name: forecast_period_date
attributes.description: The specific time bucket (month, week, or quarter start date) to which the demand quantities in this record apply. Each row represents one SKU-period combination within the planning horizon.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: lot_size_qty
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing lot or batch size quantity for the SKU, used to convert demand quantities into production orders and assess capacity requirements. Expressed in the same UOM as forecast quantities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; ICH Q7; cGMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: FDA National Drug Code (NDC) for the pharmaceutical product/package, used for US market demand planning, regulatory reporting, and supply chain traceability. Format: labeler-product-package (5-4-2).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 207; FDA NDC Directory

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the adjusted forecast deviates from the statistical baseline (e.g., new tender win, product launch, competitor entry, clinical trial enrollment change, market withdrawal). Required when adjusted_forecast_qty differs from baseline_forecast_qty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tender_win|product_launch|competitor_entry|clinical_enrollment|market_withdrawal|promotional_event|regulatory_change — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; APICS S&OP; ICH Q10

attributes.name: plan_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this demand plan record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail start point for the planning record lifecycle.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: plan_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this demand plan record, supporting audit trail requirements and change management tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH Q10.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the demand plan, used for cross-system reference in Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, and SAP S/4HANA. Follows the enterprise demand plan numbering convention.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; SAP S/4HANA MM; Blue Yonder

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand plan record, tracking progression from initial statistical generation through consensus approval and freeze for supply execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|consensus_approved|frozen|superseded — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; APICS S&OP Framework; ICH Q10

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the demand plan, enabling tracking of iterative revisions within a planning cycle (e.g., v1.0, v2.1). Supports version-controlled consensus planning workflows.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the demand planner documenting assumptions, market intelligence, adjustment rationale, or risk factors influencing the forecast. Supports S&OP review and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; APICS S&OP Framework; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: planning_cycle
attributes.description: The cadence of the demand planning cycle in which this plan was generated (e.g., monthly S&OP cycle, quarterly business review, weekly rolling horizon). Determines the review and approval schedule.
attributes.references: APICS S&OP Framework; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the demand planning horizon covered by this plan. Defines the end of the forecast period, typically 12–24 months for pharmaceutical commercial planning.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the demand planning horizon covered by this plan. Defines the start of the forecast period for supply planning and inventory positioning.

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this SKU, calculated from lead time demand plus safety stock. Used in SAP S/4HANA MRP and Kinaxis supply planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/MRP; Kinaxis RapidResponse; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum buffer inventory quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions for this SKU in the planning period. Expressed in the same UOM as forecast quantities. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM or Kinaxis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse; APICS CPIM; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the pharmaceutical SKU in days from the date of manufacture. Critical for demand planning to ensure inventory is consumed within expiry, minimizing write-offs and ensuring patient safety compliance.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; EMA Guideline on Shelf Life

attributes.name: statistical_model_type
attributes.description: The statistical forecasting algorithm applied to generate the baseline forecast (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, Croston, moving average, machine learning ensemble). Sourced from Kinaxis RapidResponse or Blue Yonder model configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exponential_smoothing|arima|croston|moving_average|holt_winters|ml_ensemble — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this pharmaceutical SKU. Used in conjunction with minimum storage temperature to define the acceptable temperature range for GDP-compliant cold chain management.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines; ICH Q1A Stability; WHO Technical Report Series 961; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this pharmaceutical SKU. Used for cold chain planning, GDP compliance, and distribution network configuration (e.g., -80°C for mRNA vaccines, 2–8°C for biologics).
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines; ICH Q1A Stability; WHO Technical Report Series 961; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: supply_chain_tier
attributes.description: Identifies the supply chain tier to which this demand plan applies: Drug Substance (DS/API), Drug Product (DP/FDF), Finished Goods (packaged product), or Packaging Components. Enables multi-tier demand disaggregation from finished goods back to API and raw materials.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP S/4HANA PP/MM; cGMP 21 CFR Parts 210-211

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area classification of the pharmaceutical product (e.g., oncology, immunology, rare diseases, cardiovascular, neurology). Used for demand segmentation and portfolio-level planning analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neurology|infectious_disease|metabolic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATC Classification (WHO); ICH E8; FDA Therapeutic Classification

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which demand quantities (baseline, adjusted, consensus) are expressed. Common pharmaceutical UOMs include EA (each), CS (case), BT (bottle), VL (vial), KG (kilogram), L (litre), TAB (tablet), CAP (capsule). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA UOM configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|BT|VL|KG|L|TAB|CAP|VIAL|SYRINGE — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GS1 Standards; ISO 80000

products.name: plan
products.description: Constrained and unconstrained supply plan for drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and finished dosage form (FDF) across manufacturing sites and CMOs/CDMOs. Captures planned production quantities, planned receipt dates, supply source, planning horizon, capacity constraints, and plan version. Integrates with Kinaxis RapidResponse/Blue Yonder and SAP PP. Tracks plan status (draft, approved, frozen) and supply type (make, buy, transfer).

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.cro_cmo_engagement. Business justification: CMO engagement agreements govern external manufacturing supply plans. Links supply planning to contracted manufacturing scope, technology transfer status, and quality agreements for outsourced pharmac

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.discovery_project. attributes.name: source_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating site for transfer supply type plans. Identifies the site from which material will be transferred to the receiving/destination site. Relevant for inter-site and inter-company supply transfers.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving site or distribution center for transfer supply type plans. Identifies where the material will be received after inter-site transfer or CMO/CDMO delivery.
