attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Supply plans execute against contracted supply agreements with CMOs/vendors. Links planning commitments to contractual terms, pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities for pharmaceutical suppl

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external supplier, CMO, or CDMO responsible for supplying material under a buy supply type plan. Links to the vendor master record in SAP MM. Applicable when supply_type is 'buy'.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master / GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply plan was formally approved by the authorized supply chain planner or manager. Part of the electronic audit trail required under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH Q10.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Standard or planned batch size for the manufacturing run, expressed in the quantity UOM. Critical for GMP compliance, batch record generation, and capacity utilization calculations. Aligns with the validated batch size in the manufacturing process.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 / ICH Q7 / SAP PP

attributes.name: capacity_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply plan record is constrained by manufacturing capacity limitations (True) or represents an unconstrained theoretical plan (False). Distinguishes constrained from unconstrained plan scenarios.

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of available manufacturing capacity consumed by this supply plan at the designated manufacturing site. Used for capacity management, bottleneck identification, and CMO contract utilization tracking.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse / SAP PP Capacity Planning

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned material requires cold-chain storage and transportation (True) to maintain product integrity. Triggers cold-chain logistics requirements in GDP-compliant distribution planning.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines / WHO Technical Report Series / 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply plan record was first created in the source planning system (Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, or SAP PP). Part of the audit trail for plan lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 / ICH Q10 / SAP PP

attributes.name: gdp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply plan has been reviewed and confirmed as compliant with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements for the planned distribution lanes and storage conditions.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01 / WHO GDP / 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply plan record was most recently modified in the source planning system. Supports change tracking, plan versioning, and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total planned lead time in calendar days from production start (or purchase order placement) to material availability at the destination site. Includes manufacturing, QC release, and logistics transit time. Used for MRP scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP MM MRP / Kinaxis RapidResponse / GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmaceutical material covered by this supply plan: Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP), Finished Dosage Form (FDF), Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), excipient, or packaging component. Aligns with CMC categorization.
attributes.references: ICH Q11 / ICH Q8 / 21 CFR Part 210-211

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: National Drug Code assigned by the FDA uniquely identifying the drug product, labeler, and package size. Required for US commercial supply planning and distribution. Applicable to FDF and DP material types.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply planners to document assumptions, constraints, risk factors, or exceptions associated with this supply plan record. Supports S&OP decision documentation and audit trail.

attributes.name: number_of_batches
attributes.description: Total number of manufacturing batches planned within the planning horizon for this supply plan record. Used for capacity loading, CMO scheduling, and GMP batch record planning.
attributes.references: SAP PP / Kinaxis RapidResponse / 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the supply plan, sourced from Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, or SAP PP (e.g., SP-2024-00123). Used for cross-system traceability and communication with CMOs/CDMOs.
attributes.references: SAP PP / Kinaxis RapidResponse / Blue Yonder

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supply plan. Draft indicates work-in-progress; approved indicates sign-off by supply chain leadership; frozen indicates locked for execution; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; cancelled indicates plan is void.
attributes.references: SAP PP / Kinaxis RapidResponse / ICH Q10

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply plan indicating whether it reflects capacity and material constraints (constrained) or theoretical demand without constraints (unconstrained). Consensus plan represents the agreed S&OP output. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: constrained|unconstrained|consensus|rough_cut|master — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse / Blue Yonder / ISPE GAMP

attributes.name: planned_production_qty
attributes.description: Total planned production or procurement quantity for the material within the planning horizon, expressed in the base unit of measure (e.g., kg for DS/API, units for FDF/DP). Core quantitative output of the supply plan.
attributes.references: SAP PP Planned Order / Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: planned_production_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled start date for the manufacturing or procurement activity. Used for capacity planning, CMO scheduling, and lead time management. Derived from planned receipt date minus production lead time.
attributes.references: SAP PP Planned Order / Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the planned quantity is expected to be received at the destination site or made available in inventory. Used for inventory availability calculations and demand fulfillment scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP PP / SAP MM MRP / Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: planning_cycle
attributes.description: Identifier for the S&OP or supply planning cycle in which this plan was generated (e.g., '2024-Q3-Cycle2', 'Monthly-2024-09'). Enables tracking of plan evolution across planning cycles and version comparison.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the latest date for which planned production or receipt quantities are captured. Typically 12–36 months for pharmaceutical supply planning.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse / Blue Yonder / SAP PP

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the earliest date for which planned production or receipt quantities are captured. Typically aligned with the S&OP cycle.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse / Blue Yonder / SAP PP

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the planned production quantity (e.g., kg for drug substance, units/vials/tablets for finished dosage forms). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|L|mL|units|vials|tablets|capsules|batches — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM UOM / ISO 80000 / ICH Q11

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order is triggered for the material at the destination site. Used in SAP MM MRP reorder point planning to ensure continuous supply availability.

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Planned safety stock quantity for the material at the destination site, expressed in the quantity UOM. Represents the buffer inventory maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Configured in SAP MM MRP.
attributes.references: SAP MM MRP / Kinaxis RapidResponse / GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: scenario
attributes.description: Scenario classification for the supply plan, supporting what-if analysis and risk planning. Base is the primary plan; optimistic and pessimistic reflect demand upside/downside; risk_adjusted incorporates supply risk mitigations.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Remaining shelf life in calendar days for the planned material at the time of planned receipt. Critical for pharmaceutical supply planning to ensure product reaches patients with adequate remaining shelf life per GDP and customer requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 / ICH Q1A / GDP Guidelines / SAP MM

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific saleable or transferable unit of the drug product or FDF. Used for commercial inventory management and distribution planning. Aligns with SAP MM material number.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage temperature condition for the planned material (e.g., ambient 15-25°C, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -20°C, ultra-frozen -80°C). Drives cold-chain logistics and warehouse configuration requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A / GDP Guidelines / USP <1079> / 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: supply_chain_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply plan pertains to the commercial supply chain or the clinical trial supply chain. Clinical supply plans are subject to IND/CTA requirements and GCP; commercial plans are subject to GMP and GDP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 / ICH E6 GCP / GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: supply_type
attributes.description: Indicates the sourcing strategy for the planned supply: make (internal manufacturing), buy (external procurement from CMO/CDMO), or transfer (inter-site or inter-company stock transfer). Drives MRP logic in SAP PP and Kinaxis.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the supply plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports plan versioning and comparison between constrained and unconstrained scenarios across planning cycles.

products.name: inventory_lot
products.description: Lot/batch-level inventory record for raw materials (APIs, excipients), packaging components, drug substance, drug product, and finished goods held at manufacturing sites, distribution centers, and 3PL locations. Captures lot number, NDC, SKU, material number, quantity on hand, quantity reserved, quantity available, storage location, storage condition (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), expiry date, retest date, lot status (unrestricted, quality hold, quarantine, rejected, released), and GDP compliance flags. SSOT for lot-level inventory traceability.

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each lot/batch-level inventory record in the pharmaceutical supply chain. Primary key for the inventory_lot data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; 21 CFR Part 211.192

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: Inventory valuation, expiry management, and revenue recognition in pharma require brand-level aggregation. Enables commercial finance to track inventory by brand for gross-to-net calculations, sample

attributes.name: compound_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.compound. Business justification: Pharmaceutical lot genealogy requires tracing manufactured inventory back to discovery compound for regulatory compliance (21 CFR Part 11), recall management, and CMC documentation. Critical for IND/N

attributes.name: disposition_authority_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Lot disposition decisions require documented QA release authority position for GMP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness. Position-based rather than individual for role continuity.

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: Inventory lots represent physical stock of specific drug products (formulation+strength+dosage form). Essential for batch traceability, GDP compliance, recall execution, and regulatory lot disposition

attributes.name: exclusivity_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: Lots manufactured under exclusivity periods must be tracked for regulatory compliance and commercial analytics. Required for exclusivity-linked inventory management and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Every inventory lot must reference its material master for specifications, regulatory data, storage requirements, quality parameters. Material_number is denormalized identifier; FK enforces referentia

attributes.name: packaging_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Business justification: Lots are manufactured in specific packaging configurations. Required for serialization hierarchy (GTIN/NDC mapping), regulatory compliance reporting, and distribution channel planning where package si

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Lots of patented products must track which patent covers them for regulatory compliance, serialization, and patent linkage requirements (Orange Book). Required for anti-counterfeiting and regulatory t

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Inventory lots are held at plants requiring plant master data for GDP authorization, GMP status, capacity management, regulatory inspections. Plant_code is denormalized identifier; FK enforces referen

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.storage_location. Business justification: Lots are stored at specific storage locations requiring master data for GDP compliance, capacity management, temperature zones, DEA authorization. Storage_location_code is denormalized identifier; FK

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved supplier, CMO, or CDMO that manufactured or supplied this lot. Links to the vendor master for supplier qualification status, approved supplier list (ASL), and GDP compliance records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (Vendor Master); ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.84

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record in the Quality Management System (QMS) if this lot is subject to an active quality investigation or deviation. Links to MasterControl or TrackWise QMS.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q10; MasterControl/TrackWise; FDA

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued by the manufacturer or supplier for this lot, confirming that the lot meets all specified quality attributes and release criteria. Required for GMP compliance and regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.84; EU GMP Chapter 6; ICH Q7; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: cold_chain_break_date
attributes.description: Date on which a cold chain break or temperature excursion was first detected for this lot. Populated only when temperature_excursion_flag is True. Used to initiate quality impact assessment and determine lot disposition.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines; USP <1079>; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit_cost valuation (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency inventory valuation reporting across global manufacturing and distribution sites.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: days_until_expiry
attributes.description: Number of days remaining until the lot's expiry date, calculated at the time of data extraction. Used for near-expiry inventory alerts, FEFO prioritization, and supply chain risk management. Negative values indicate expired lots.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule classification (I through V) for this lot, if applicable. Determines the level of security, storage, and record-keeping requirements. Null for non-controlled substances.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; Controlled Substances Act; DEA

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the lot is no longer suitable for use, as determined by stability studies and approved shelf-life specifications. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, GDP compliance, and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to SAP batch expiry date (VFDAT field).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Chapter 4; ICH Q1A; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: is_clinical_supply
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this lot is designated for use in clinical trials (investigational product supply) rather than commercial distribution. Clinical supply lots are subject to additional regulatory controls under GCP and IND/CTA requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6 (GCP); FDA

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this lot contains a DEA-scheduled controlled substance requiring additional security, storage, and regulatory reporting obligations under the Controlled Substances Act.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; Controlled Substances Act; DEA

attributes.name: is_gdp_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this lot's storage and handling at the current location is confirmed compliant with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, including temperature monitoring, security, and documentation standards.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 957; PIC/S

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory movement (goods receipt, goods issue, transfer posting, or stock transfer) recorded for this lot in SAP. Used for slow-moving inventory analysis and supply chain performance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned alphanumeric identifier for the production lot or batch. Enables full lot/batch traceability from raw material receipt through finished goods distribution. Corresponds to SAP batch number (CHARG field). Required for GMP compliance and recall management.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA QM/WM Module

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current quality and disposition status of the lot in the inventory management system. Drives whether the lot is available for use, shipment, or must be held pending quality review. Maps to SAP batch status (unrestricted-use, quality inspection, blocked). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unrestricted|quality_hold|quarantine|rejected|released|destroyed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Chapter 4; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ICH Q7

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lot was manufactured or the production process was initiated. Used for shelf-life calculation, lot traceability, and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to SAP batch manufacturing date (HSDAT field).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Chapter 4; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA PP/QM Module

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material held in this lot. Distinguishes between Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), excipient, packaging component, drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and finished dosage form (FDF/finished good). Drives storage, handling, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: API|excipient|packaging_component|drug_substance|drug_product|finished_good — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q7; ICH Q11; 21 CFR Part 210; EU GMP

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code in 5-4-2 format uniquely identifying the drug product, including labeler, product, and package codes. Applicable to finished drug products and drug substances registered with the FDA. Null for raw materials and packaging components.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; 21 CFR Part 207; FDA

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number associated with the procurement of this lot from an external supplier. Enables financial reconciliation, goods receipt matching, and procurement traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Net quantity of the lot available for new allocations, calculated as quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved minus quantity_on_quality_hold. Represents the actionable inventory for supply planning and order fulfillment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Total physical quantity of the lot currently in stock at the storage location, expressed in the base unit of measure. Represents the gross inventory position before reservations. Sourced from SAP inventory management (MARD/MCHB tables).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; ICH Q7

attributes.name: quantity_on_quality_hold
attributes.description: Quantity of the lot currently blocked due to quality inspection, Out-of-Specification (OOS) investigation, or quality hold pending Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) resolution. Not available for use or shipment.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; MasterControl/TrackWise

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity of the lot that has been reserved for specific production orders, sales orders, or clinical trial supply requests but not yet physically consumed or shipped. Reduces available quantity for new allocations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason this lot has been placed in quarantine or quality hold status. Documents the triggering event (e.g., OOS result, customer complaint, supplier deviation, temperature excursion) for CAPA and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Chapter 6; MasterControl/TrackWise

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lot was received at the current storage location via goods receipt (GR) posting in SAP. Marks the start of the lot's residency at the site and triggers incoming quality inspection workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (MIGO GR); GDP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.84

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory lot record was first created in the source system (SAP) or the data lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inventory lot record in the source system or data lakehouse. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lot was formally released by Quality Assurance (QA) for use in manufacturing, clinical supply, or commercial distribution following successful completion of all required quality control testing and review.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Chapter 6; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the lot must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications before further use or distribution. Applicable primarily to APIs, drug substances, and excipients with defined retest periods per ICH Q7 and approved specifications.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 Section 11.6; ICH Q1A; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Chapter 4

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing site, distribution center, or third-party logistics (3PL) location where this lot is physically held. Enables multi-site inventory visibility and GDP compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GDP Guidelines; PIC/S; EU GMP Chapter 3

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Internal Stock Keeping Unit code used for commercial inventory management and order fulfillment. Represents a specific sellable configuration of a drug product (strength, pack size, dosage form). Links to commercial product catalog.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Module; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage temperature condition for this lot as specified in the product's approved labeling and storage requirements. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and GDP compliance. Values: ambient (15–25°C), refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (-20°C), controlled_room_temp (20–25°C), ultra_low (-60 to -80°C).
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; USP <1079>; GDP Guidelines; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: supplier_lot_number
attributes.description: Original lot or batch number assigned by the external supplier, Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO), or Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). Enables traceability back to the supplier's manufacturing records and Certificate of Analysis (CoA).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.84; EU GMP Chapter 5; ICH Q7; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this lot has experienced a documented temperature excursion during storage or transit that may impact product quality and requires quality impact assessment per GDP and cold-chain management procedures.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines; USP <1079>; ICH Q1A; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard or moving average cost per unit of measure for this lot as recorded in SAP. Used for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and financial reporting. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS IAS 2; SOX; GAAP

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all quantity fields on this lot record (e.g., KG for bulk API, ML for liquid drug substance, EA for finished unit packs, TAB for tablets). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure (MEINS field). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|G|MG|L|ML|EA|BT|VL|TAB|CAP — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 80000; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: SAP inventory valuation method applied to this lot for financial costing purposes. Determines how the lot's value is calculated in the general ledger (standard price, moving average price, or actual cost). Relevant for COGS reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS IAS 2; SOX

products.name: warehouse_receipt
products.description: Record of physical receipt of materials at a pharmaceutical manufacturing site, warehouse, or distribution center against a purchase order or inbound delivery. Captures GR document number, posting date, material, lot number, received quantity, storage location, vendor, CoA reference, GDP compliance check status, temperature excursion flag, and quarantine status. Aligns with SAP MM goods receipt (MIGO). Triggers quality inspection and lot creation in LIMS.

attributes.name: warehouse_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the warehouse receipt record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Goods Receipt (MIGO)

attributes.name: distribution_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: Warehouse receipts occur at specific distribution network nodes (plants, warehouses). The plant_code (STRING) should be replaced with distribution_network_id FK to distribution_network.distribution_ne

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The name or employee ID of the qualified person who performed the physical receiving inspection and verified the shipment against the purchase order, delivery note, and CoA. Required for GMP audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_incident. Business justification: Receipt discrepancies (GDP documentation gaps, temperature excursions on arrival, COA/COC missing) trigger compliance incidents requiring investigation per GxP. Link tracks incident from receipt event

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Warehouse receipts create or update inventory lot records upon material receipt. The batch_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Material attri

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Goods receipt must validate against material master specifications (storage conditions, quality inspection requirements, batch management rules). Critical for GDP compliance, COA verification, and qua

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Goods receipts occur at specific plants requiring plant master data for GMP certification status, FDA establishment identifier, capacity validation. Essential for receipt authorization, quality inspec

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) who delivered the materials. Corresponds to the SAP vendor/business partner master record. Used for vendor performance tracking, GDP compliance, and approved supplier list (ASL) validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Vendor Master; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GDP

attributes.name: actual_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the physical materials arrived at the receiving dock or facility. Distinct from the SAP posting date; captures the real-world event time for GDP compliance, cold-chain monitoring, and traceability. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDP – Good Distribution Practice; 21 CFR Part 211.68; ICH Q10

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The carrier's bill of lading number for the inbound shipment. Provides the legal transport document reference linking the receipt to the logistics carrier record. Used for freight claims, GDP transport documentation, and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the logistics carrier or third-party logistics provider (3PL) responsible for transporting the materials to the receiving site. Used for GDP carrier qualification tracking and freight performance management.

attributes.name: clinical_supply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material is designated for clinical trial supply (investigational product) rather than commercial supply. True = clinical trial supply subject to IND/GCP requirements; False = commercial supply. Determines applicable regulatory framework and handling procedures.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 – IND; GCP; ICH E6

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: The document reference number or identifier for the vendor's Certificate of Analysis (CoA) accompanying the shipment. The CoA confirms the material meets specification. Required for GMP compliance and regulatory traceability. Stored in Veeva Vault or LIMS document management.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.84; ICH Q7; GMP; GDP

attributes.name: coc_reference
attributes.description: The document reference number for the vendor's Certificate of Compliance (CoC), confirming the material was manufactured in accordance with GMP and applicable regulatory requirements. Distinct from the CoA which covers analytical test results.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.84; ICH Q7; GMP; GDP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse receipt record was first created in the source system or data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The vendor's delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the shipment. Used for physical receipt verification, discrepancy identification, and document archiving per GMP requirements.

attributes.name: gdp_compliance_status
attributes.description: The GDP compliance check status for this receipt, confirming that the material was transported and received in accordance with Good Distribution Practice guidelines. 'compliant' = all GDP checks passed; 'non_compliant' = one or more GDP deviations identified; 'pending_review' = GDP review in progress.
attributes.references: GDP – EU Guidelines 2013/C 68/01; WHO GDP; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP Material Document number generated upon posting the goods receipt in SAP S/4HANA MIGO (transaction MIGO/MB01). Serves as the primary business identifier linking this receipt to the source ERP transaction. Format follows SAP material document numbering (e.g., 5000012345).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Document (MIGO); 21 CFR Part 211.68; GDP

attributes.name: gr_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year associated with the SAP GR material document number. Required because SAP material document numbers are unique only within a fiscal year. Combined with gr_document_number to form the unique SAP key.

attributes.name: inbound_delivery_number
attributes.description: SAP inbound delivery document number (transaction VL31N/VL32N) associated with this goods receipt, if applicable. Used when the receipt is triggered by an advance shipping notice (ASN) from the vendor. May be null for direct PO-based receipts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM/EWM – Inbound Delivery; GDP

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The SAP Quality Management (QM) inspection lot number automatically created upon goods receipt posting for materials subject to quality inspection. Links the warehouse receipt to the quality inspection process in SAP QM and LIMS. Null if no inspection is required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Inspection Lot; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GMP

attributes.name: po_line_item
attributes.description: The specific line item number within the purchase order against which this goods receipt is posted. A single PO may have multiple line items for different materials or delivery schedules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchase Order Item

attributes.name: po_quantity
attributes.description: The ordered quantity as specified in the purchase order line item. Used to calculate receipt variance (received vs. ordered) and to identify over/under deliveries requiring vendor notification or tolerance check.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchase Order Quantity

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date of the goods receipt in SAP, determining the fiscal period in which the inventory and accounting entries are recorded. This is the principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO Posting Date; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP purchase order number against which this goods receipt is posted. Links the physical receipt to the procurement commitment. Used for three-way matching (PO, GR, invoice) in accounts payable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchase Order; 21 CFR Part 211.84

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material has been placed in quarantine status pending quality inspection or investigation. True = material is quarantined and not available for use; False = material is not in quarantine. Triggers quality inspection workflow in LIMS and QMS.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.84; ICH Q7; GMP; GDP

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the warehouse receipt. 'posted' = GR document successfully posted in SAP; 'reversed' = GR has been reversed/cancelled; 'blocked' = receipt blocked pending resolution; 'under_inspection' = quality inspection in progress; 'released' = inspection complete and stock released for use.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Stock Status; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GDP

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material physically received and counted at the receiving dock, expressed in the base unit of measure. Used for inventory posting, three-way matching, and discrepancy reporting against the PO quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO Quantity; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GDP

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The SAP stock type assigned to the received material upon posting. 'unrestricted' = available for use/sale; 'quality_inspection' = held pending QC inspection (default for GMP materials); 'blocked' = blocked stock due to quality issue or hold; 'returns' = returned goods stock.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Stock Type; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GMP

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: The required storage condition for the received material, determining the appropriate storage area and cold-chain handling requirements. 'ambient' = room temperature; 'refrigerated' = 2–8°C; 'frozen' = -20°C or below; 'controlled_room_temp' = 15–25°C; 'controlled_substance' = DEA-regulated controlled substance requiring secure storage.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A – Stability Testing; USP <659>; GDP; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The SAP storage location code within the plant where the received material is physically placed. Determines the specific area (e.g., quarantine area, cold storage, controlled substance vault, general warehouse) for inventory tracking and GDP compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM – Storage Location; 21 CFR Part 211.68; GDP

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion was detected during transport or at the time of receipt. True = temperature excursion occurred (requires investigation and potential rejection); False = no temperature excursion detected. Critical for cold-chain materials (biologics, vaccines, temperature-sensitive APIs).
attributes.references: GDP – Cold Chain Management; ICH Q1A; 21 CFR Part 211.68; WHO TRS 961

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the received quantity (e.g., KG = kilograms, G = grams, L = litres, ML = millilitres, EA = each, BT = bottle, DR = drum, BAG = bag, BOX = box). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure in the material master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|G|L|ML|EA|BT|DR|BAG|BOX — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse receipt record was last modified in the source system or data platform. Tracks changes to status, inspection results, or corrections. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: goods_issue
products.description: Record of material consumption or outbound movement from inventory including issuance to production orders, clinical trial supply kits, sample distribution, destruction, quality testing, or customer delivery. Captures GI document number, posting date, material, lot number, issued quantity, movement type (production consumption, sales delivery, sample, scrap, transfer posting), cost center or order reference, and issuing storage location. Aligns with SAP MM goods issue (MIGO). Reduces inventory on hand and triggers cost accounting entries. Supports GMP batch record material consumption documentation.

attributes.name: goods_issue_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the goods issue record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the system-generated identifier for each material outbound movement or consumption event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – MIGO Transaction

attributes.name: delivery_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.delivery_order. Business justification: Goods issue documents are created as part of delivery order fulfillment. The delivery_document_number (STRING) should be replaced with a proper FK to delivery_order.delivery_order_id. This establishes

attributes.name: distribution_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: Goods issue transactions occur at specific distribution network nodes. The plant_code (STRING) should be replaced with distribution_network_id FK to distribution_network.distribution_network_id. This

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP user ID (USNAM in MKPF) of the person who posted the goods issue document. Required for GMP audit trail, 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance, and accountability tracking. Supports investigation of posting errors and unauthorized material movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – USNAM; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Goods issue transactions consume inventory from specific lots. The batch_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Material identifiers and descrip

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Material issuance requires material master data for valuation, specifications, handling instructions, controlled substance schedules. Essential for inventory accounting, GMP compliance, and movement t

attributes.name: receiving_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Material issuances to receiving plants require plant master data for GMP status, capacity, regulatory authorization. Receiving_plant is denormalized code; FK enables plant qualification verification a

attributes.name: clinical_trial_number
attributes.description: The clinical trial protocol number (IND/CTA reference) associated with the goods issue when material is issued as investigational product (IP) for clinical trial supply. Links the material consumption to the specific clinical study for GCP compliance, IND/CTA regulatory reporting, and clinical supply chain reconciliation. Populated only for clinical supply goods issues.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 (IND Regulations); ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; Medidata Rave; Oracle CTMS

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issued material requires cold-chain temperature-controlled handling and transportation (e.g., 2-8°C refrigerated, -20°C frozen, -80°C ultra-cold for biologics and mRNA products). When True, GDP cold-chain documentation including temperature monitoring records must accompany the shipment.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 (Cold Chain); 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The SAP cost center (KOSTL) to which the material consumption cost is charged. Used for internal cost allocation, R&D expense tracking, manufacturing overhead assignment, and financial reporting. Applicable for goods issues not associated with a production or sales order (e.g., quality testing samples, R&D consumption, administrative use).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – KOSTL; SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls); IFRS/US GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the goods issue document was first created and posted in SAP (CPUDT + CPUTM in MKPF). Provides the precise audit timestamp for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and GMP batch record documentation. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – CPUDT/CPUTM; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 11; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the material cost amount (WAERS in SAP). Represents the local currency of the issuing plant. Required for multi-currency financial consolidation and cross-border supply chain cost reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI – WAERS; IFRS/US GAAP

attributes.name: destruction_certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate of destruction document number issued by a licensed waste disposal or pharmaceutical destruction contractor when materials are scrapped or destroyed (movement type 551/552). Required for GMP compliance, DEA controlled substance destruction reporting, and environmental regulatory compliance. Populated only for destruction goods issues.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 1317 (Disposal of Controlled Substances); EU GMP Chapter 5; DEA Regulations; EPA RCRA

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date the goods issue document was physically created or the actual date of the material movement (BLDAT in SAP). May differ from posting_date when backdated postings occur. Used for audit trail and GMP documentation compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – BLDAT; 21 CFR Part 211.68; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: gi_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP material document number assigned to the goods issue posting (e.g., 4900012345). This is the primary business identifier referenced in GMP batch records, cost accounting entries, and supply chain traceability. Corresponds to MBLNR in SAP MSEG/MKPF tables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO; 21 CFR Part 211.188 (Batch Production Records); ICH Q7

attributes.name: gi_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the goods issue material document was posted in SAP (MJAHR). Required in combination with gi_document_number to uniquely identify a material document in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – MKPF Table; SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: gi_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods issue document. 'posted' indicates the GI is active and inventory has been reduced; 'reversed' indicates a reversal document has been posted (movement type 262/552/602); 'blocked' indicates the document is on quality hold; 'cancelled' indicates the document was voided prior to posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO; 21 CFR Part 211.192 (Investigation of Discrepancies)

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issued material is a DEA-scheduled controlled substance requiring additional regulatory documentation, DEA Form 222 or CSOS electronic ordering, and controlled substance inventory reconciliation. When True, the goods issue must comply with DEA 21 CFR Part 1304 record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1304 (Records and Reports); DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: is_gmp_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods issue is subject to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation and traceability requirements. True for materials used in GMP-regulated manufacturing, clinical trial supply, or quality testing. False for non-GMP materials such as office supplies, maintenance items, or non-regulated consumables. Drives GMP batch record inclusion and regulatory audit scope.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210/211; EU GMP Guidelines; ICH Q7; PIC/S Guide to GMP

attributes.name: issued_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material issued in the base unit of measure (ERFMG in SAP MSEG). Represents the actual amount consumed, shipped, scrapped, or transferred. Drives inventory reduction, cost accounting entries, and GMP batch record material consumption documentation. Must reconcile with production order component requirements or delivery quantities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ERFMG; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7 Section 6; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: issuing_storage_location
attributes.description: The SAP storage location (LGORT) from which the material is physically withdrawn. Identifies the specific warehouse area, cold-chain storage zone, quarantine area, or dispensing room within the plant. Critical for GMP material flow documentation, cold-chain compliance, and GDP storage condition traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM – LGORT; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 1; GDP Guidelines; PIC/S Guide

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the goods issue record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Tracks subsequent changes such as reversal postings, status updates, or data corrections. Required for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail completeness per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); EU GMP Annex 11; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: material_cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost value of the goods issue calculated as issued_quantity multiplied by the material valuation price at time of posting (DMBTR in SAP MSEG in local currency). Represents the COGS or cost allocation amount posted to the consuming cost center or production order. Critical for financial reporting, profitability analysis, and manufacturing cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – DMBTR; IFRS/US GAAP COGS Recognition; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code that classifies the nature of the goods issue (BWART in MSEG). Drives inventory valuation, account determination, and GMP documentation requirements. Key values: 261=Goods issue to production order (consumption), 551=Scrapping/destruction, 601=Goods issue for delivery/customer shipment, 311=Transfer posting within plant. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 261|262|551|552|601|602|311|312|901|902 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Movement Type Configuration; 21 CFR Part 211.188; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: movement_type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the SAP movement type (e.g., 'Goods Issue to Production Order', 'Goods Issue for Delivery', 'Scrapping', 'Sample Withdrawal', 'Transfer Posting'). Supports business reporting and GMP batch record documentation without requiring SAP configuration knowledge.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – T156T Table; 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: order_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the consuming or receiving order associated with the goods issue. For production consumption (movement type 261), this is the SAP production order number (AUFNR). For clinical supply, this is the clinical trial supply order number. For customer delivery, this is the SAP sales order number (VBELN). Central to GMP batch record traceability and cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/SD – AUFNR/VBELN; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order type associated with the goods issue. Determines the business process context: production_order/process_order for manufacturing consumption, sales_order for commercial customer delivery, clinical_supply_order for investigational product distribution to trial sites, transfer_order for inter-plant movements, destruction_order for controlled substance or expired material disposal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/SD/MM; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7; GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting and inventory posting date of the goods issue (BUDAT in SAP). Determines the period in which inventory reduction and cost accounting entries are recorded. Critical for period-end closing, GMP batch record dating, and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI – BUDAT; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7 Section 6

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: The SAP profit center (PRCTR) associated with the goods issue for management accounting and P&L reporting. Enables attribution of material costs to specific business units, therapeutic areas, or product lines. Supports segment reporting and profitability analysis per IFRS 8.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA – PRCTR; IFRS 8 (Operating Segments); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: The SAP reason code (GRUND) providing additional classification for the goods issue movement, particularly for scrapping, destruction, or non-standard consumption. Examples include: expired material destruction, quality rejection scrap, clinical trial sample, regulatory submission sample, stability testing sample. Supports GMP deviation tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – GRUND; 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Chapter 5; ICH Q7

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location
attributes.description: For intra-plant transfer postings (movement type 311), the destination storage location within the same plant. Tracks material movement between warehouse zones, e.g., from quarantine to released stock, from bulk storage to dispensing area, or from cold-chain to ambient staging.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM – UMLGO; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 1; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External or cross-system reference document number associated with the goods issue (XBLNR in SAP). May reference a purchase order, clinical trial supply request, destruction certificate, quality disposition document, or regulatory sample request. Enables cross-system traceability between SAP and CTMS, LIMS, or QMS systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – XBLNR; 21 CFR Part 211.188; Veeva Vault QualityDocs; MasterControl

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP material document number of the reversal posting (STBLG) if this goods issue has been reversed. A reversal restores inventory and reverses cost accounting entries. Populated only when gi_status = 'reversed'. Required for GMP audit trail and financial period correction documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – STBLG; 21 CFR Part 211.68 (Audit Trail); EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special stock indicator (SOBKZ) identifying whether the issued material belongs to a special stock category. Key values: E=Sales order stock (customer-specific), Q=Project stock, K=Consignment stock at customer, W=Vendor consignment stock. Empty value indicates standard own stock. Critical for clinical trial supply (project stock) and consignment management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – SOBKZ; 21 CFR Part 211.150; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Type at Time of Issue
attributes.description: The quality/availability stock type from which the material was issued (INSMK in SAP). Indicates whether material was issued from unrestricted (released) stock, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, or restricted-use stock. Critical for GMP compliance — goods issues from quality inspection or blocked stock require QA authorization and deviation documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – INSMK; 21 CFR Part 211.84 (Testing and Approval); EU GMP Chapter 4; ICH Q7

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the issued quantity (ERFME in SAP MSEG). Standard pharmaceutical units include KG (kilograms) for APIs and bulk materials, ML/L for liquids, EA (each) for finished units, TAB/CAP for solid dosage forms, VIAL/AMP for injectables. Aligns with SAP UoM configuration and GMP batch record documentation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|G|MG|L|ML|EA|BT|BX|PAL|TAB|CAP|VIAL|AMP — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ERFME; ISO 80000-1 (Quantities and Units); 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The inventory valuation method applied to the goods issue for cost accounting purposes (BWTAR in SAP). Determines how the material consumption cost is calculated: standard cost (standard price from material master), moving average price (MAP), or actual cost. Impacts COGS calculation and financial reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IM Valuation; IFRS/US GAAP Inventory Valuation; SOX Section 404

products.name: stock_transfer_order
products.description: Inter-site or inter-plant stock transfer order for pharmaceutical materials between manufacturing sites, distribution centers, and 3PL locations. Captures transfer order number, sending plant/storage location, receiving plant/storage location, material, lot number, transfer quantity, transfer type (one-step, two-step), GDP compliance requirements, cold-chain requirements, and transfer status. Aligns with SAP MM/WM stock transfer order management.

attributes.name: stock_transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the stock transfer order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: STOs plan inter-site transfers of specific drug products for supply network optimization. Product-level link needed for capacity planning, cold chain requirement determination, and controlled substanc

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Stock transfer orders move specific inventory lots between locations. The batch_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Material attributes, expi

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Stock transfers require material master for handling instructions, storage conditions, cold chain requirements, DEA schedules. Critical for GDP-compliant transfers, serialization verification, and rec

attributes.name: receiving_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Stock transfers to receiving plants require plant master data for GMP certification, capacity, DEA registration. Receiving_plant_code is denormalized; FK ensures receiving plant qualification, capacit

attributes.name: requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Inter-site transfers require documented requestor for GDP compliance, inventory accountability, and approval workflow traceability. New attribute needed for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: sending_distribution_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: Stock transfer orders move materials between distribution network nodes. The sending_plant_code (STRING) should be replaced with sending_distribution_network_id FK to distribution_network.distribution

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for cancellation of the stock transfer order. Populated only when transfer_status is 'cancelled'. Supports root cause analysis and supply chain performance improvement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice)

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the qualified logistics carrier or 3PL provider responsible for transporting the pharmaceutical materials between locations. Must be a GDP-qualified carrier for pharmaceutical shipments.
attributes.references: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011; EU Guidelines 2013/C 68/01

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmaceutical material requires cold-chain handling during transport (e.g., refrigerated 2-8°C or frozen -20°C/-80°C conditions). Triggers cold-chain logistics protocols, temperature monitoring requirements, and qualified carrier selection.
attributes.references: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011; WHO Technical Report Series 961 Annex 9; EU GMP Annex 15

attributes.name: controlled_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material being transferred is a DEA-scheduled controlled substance. When true, additional regulatory controls apply including DEA Form 222 or CSOS electronic ordering, chain of custody documentation, and secure transport requirements.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1301-1321; DEA Form 222

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) schedule classification for controlled substances (I through V). Null for non-controlled materials. Determines the level of regulatory control and documentation required for the transfer.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

attributes.name: delivery_document_number
attributes.description: SAP outbound delivery document number (transaction VL10) created from the stock transfer order for goods issue processing. Links the STO to the physical shipment execution in SAP WM/SD.
attributes.references: SAP SD/WM Outbound Delivery; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: gdp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock transfer order has been executed in full compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, including qualified carrier use, temperature monitoring, chain of custody documentation, and deviation management.
attributes.references: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — EU Guidelines 2013/C 68/01; PIC/S PE 011; WHO TRS 957 Annex 5

attributes.name: goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which goods issue was posted at the sending plant, marking the departure of materials from the source location. Triggers inventory reduction at the sending plant and initiates in-transit stock.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Issue; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which goods receipt was posted at the receiving plant, confirming arrival and acceptance of the transferred materials. Triggers inventory increase at the receiving plant and closes the in-transit stock.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: issued_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material for which goods issue (GI) has been posted at the sending plant. May differ from transfer_quantity in cases of partial goods issue. Corresponds to SAP movement type 351/641 posted quantity.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Issue; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock transfer order record was last modified in the source system. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP MM Change Documents; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records)

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP inventory management movement type code used for the stock transfer. Key values: 301 (one-step plant-to-plant), 303/305 (two-step transfer order), 351 (goods issue for STO), 641/647 (goods issue with delivery). Determines accounting and inventory impact.
attributes.references: SAP MM Movement Types; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the stock transfer order. Critical transfers may relate to patient safety supply continuity, clinical trial supply, or shortage situations. Drives scheduling and resource allocation in supply chain planning.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse Supply Chain Planning; Blue Yonder Supply Chain

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason code explaining why the stock transfer was initiated. Examples include demand replenishment, safety stock replenishment, inter-company transfer, clinical trial supply, product recall, quality hold relocation, or returns processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: demand_replenishment|safety_stock|inter_company|clinical_supply|recall|quality_relocation|returns|balance_stock — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material for which goods receipt (GR) has been posted at the receiving plant. May differ from issued_quantity due to transit losses, damage, or rejection. Corresponds to SAP movement type 101/105 posted quantity.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location
attributes.description: SAP storage location code within the receiving plant where the materials will be placed upon goods receipt. Identifies the specific warehouse area, cold-room, quarantine zone, or controlled substance vault at the destination site.
attributes.references: SAP WM Storage Location; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the receiving plant requires the materials to arrive. Used for supply chain planning, scheduling goods issue, and measuring on-time delivery performance. Corresponds to the SAP STO delivery date field.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; Kinaxis RapidResponse Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: sending_storage_location
attributes.description: SAP storage location code within the sending plant from which the materials are issued. Identifies the specific warehouse area, cold-room, quarantine zone, or controlled substance vault at the source site.
attributes.references: SAP WM Storage Location; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: shipping_condition
attributes.description: Shipping service level or condition required for the transfer. Determines carrier selection, transit time expectations, and special handling requirements. Corresponds to SAP SD shipping condition configuration.
attributes.references: SAP SD Shipping Condition; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: sto_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock transfer order was created in the source system (SAP MM). Represents the business event timestamp of order initiation. Used for lead time analysis and supply chain performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: sto_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business document number assigned by SAP MM for the inter-plant or inter-site stock transfer order. Corresponds to the SAP Purchase Order number used for STO processing (document type UB or NB).
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: SAP stock type of the material at the sending location prior to transfer. Indicates whether the material is in unrestricted use, quality inspection (QI) stock, blocked stock, or restricted-use stock. Impacts GDP compliance and release status.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Types; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Chapter 3

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage and transport temperature condition for the pharmaceutical material. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and carrier qualification. Values: ambient (15-25°C), refrigerated (2-8°C), frozen (-20°C), deep_frozen (-80°C), controlled_room_temp (20-25°C).
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices; GDP PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: supply_chain_type
attributes.description: Distinguishes whether the stock transfer is part of the commercial supply chain or the clinical trial supply chain. Clinical trial transfers require additional traceability and compliance controls per GCP and IND/CTA requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); ICH E6 GCP; GDP (Good Distribution Practice)

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number or waybill number for the shipment associated with this stock transfer order. Enables real-time shipment visibility and chain of custody documentation for GDP compliance.
attributes.references: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011; SAP MM/WM Shipment Tracking

attributes.name: transfer_category
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the transfer based on the sending and receiving location types: plant-to-plant, distribution center to plant, plant to distribution center, DC-to-DC, or involving a third-party logistics (3PL) provider. Supports network-level supply chain analytics.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the pharmaceutical material ordered for transfer in the base unit of measure. Represents the planned transfer quantity as specified in the STO line item.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice)

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock transfer order. Tracks progression from creation through goods issue, in-transit, goods receipt, and closure or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|goods_issued|in_transit|partially_received|received|cancelled|blocked — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transfer is a one-step transfer (goods issue and receipt posted simultaneously) or a two-step transfer (goods issue posted at sending plant, goods receipt posted separately at receiving plant). Aligns with SAP MM movement types 301/303/305.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the transfer quantity. Standard SAP UoM codes used in pharmaceutical supply chain (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, G=Gram, MG=Milligram, L=Liter, ML=Milliliter, BT=Bottle, BX=Box, CS=Case, PAL=Pallet).
