attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution network node record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: dea_registration_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number authorizing the node to handle Schedule I–V controlled substances. Required for US-based nodes handling controlled pharmaceutical products. Null for non-US nodes or nodes not handling controlled substances.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; DEA 21 CFR Part 1304

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution network node is scheduled to cease operations or be decommissioned. Null for currently active nodes with no planned end date. Used for network transition planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Kinaxis RapidResponse; GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01)

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this distribution network node became or is scheduled to become operationally active in the supply network. Used for time-phased network planning and historical network topology analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Kinaxis RapidResponse; GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01)

attributes.name: gdp_authorization_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) Authorization Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the GDP wholesale distribution authorization expires. Supply planning systems must alert when expiry is approaching to prevent distribution through unauthorized nodes.

attributes.name: gdp_authorization_number
attributes.description: Official GDP wholesale distribution authorization number issued by the competent regulatory authority (e.g., MHRA, national competent authority). Required for regulatory traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: gdp_authorization_status
attributes.description: Current GDP authorization status of the node as required by EU GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01) and equivalent national regulations. Authorized nodes are eligible to handle medicinal products. Expired or suspended nodes must be excluded from active distribution lanes.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); MHRA GDP Guidelines; WHO Technical Report Series No. 957

attributes.name: handling_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days required for internal processing activities at the node (receiving, quality inspection, pick/pack, dispatch preparation). Added to lead times in supply planning calculations.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; SAP S/4HANA WM; Blue Yonder

attributes.name: hazmat_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node is certified to store and handle hazardous materials including cytotoxic compounds, flammable solvents, and other regulated substances. Relevant for oncology API and certain excipient handling.
attributes.references: IATA DGR; IMDG Code; 49 CFR (US DOT Hazmat); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: inbound_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days required for inbound shipments to arrive at this node from its upstream supply source. Used as a planning parameter in Kinaxis RapidResponse and SAP APO/IBP for replenishment scheduling.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; SAP APO/IBP

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution network node record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the distribution node in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for geospatial network optimization, transportation routing, and distance-based lead time calculations.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the distribution node in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for geospatial network optimization, transportation routing, and distance-based lead time calculations.

attributes.name: multi_temperature_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node can simultaneously handle multiple temperature zones (e.g., both ambient and refrigerated storage). Enables assignment of mixed-temperature product portfolios to a single node in supply network planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier classification of the node within the distribution network topology. Tier 1 = primary manufacturing/central DC; Tier 2 = regional DC; Tier 3 = local/last-mile node. Drives network optimization and replenishment hierarchy in supply planning.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; SAP APO/IBP

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this distribution network node across supply chain planning systems (Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, SAP APO/IBP). Used as the business key for cross-system integration and network lane definitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the distribution network node (e.g., 'Frankfurt Regional DC', 'Chicago 3PL Hub', 'Singapore Manufacturing Site'). Used in supply chain planning dashboards and network topology reports.

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the distribution network node. Inactive or suspended nodes are excluded from supply planning runs. Nodes under qualification are pending GDP or regulatory authorization review.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); 21 CFR Part 211; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the network node by its functional role in the pharmaceutical supply chain. Drives planning logic, GDP compliance requirements, and lane eligibility in Kinaxis RapidResponse and SAP APO/IBP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_site|distribution_center|3pl_node|wholesaler|direct_to_pharmacy|clinical_depot|hospital_pharmacy|specialty_pharmacy — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); SAP S/4HANA MM; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing operational notes, special handling instructions, or qualifications relevant to this distribution network node. Examples include specific GDP deviation history, special import/export restrictions, or infrastructure constraints.

attributes.name: operator_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity operating the distribution node. Distinguishes between internally operated sites and third-party operators such as 3PL (Third-Party Logistics), CMO (Contract Manufacturing Organization), CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization), or wholesalers.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); SAP S/4HANA MM; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: outbound_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days required for outbound shipments to depart this node and reach the next downstream node or customer. Used for delivery commitment and supply planning in Kinaxis RapidResponse.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; SAP APO/IBP

attributes.name: pallet_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of standard pallets (EUR/ISO pallet) the node can accommodate simultaneously. Used for operational capacity planning and inbound/outbound throughput modeling in supply network planning tools.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; Kinaxis RapidResponse; ISO 6780 (Flat Pallets)

attributes.name: quarantine_zone_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node has a dedicated physical quarantine zone for holding materials pending quality release, investigation, or returns processing. Required for GDP-compliant nodes handling pharmaceutical products.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); 21 CFR Part 211.84; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Internal geographic region classification for the node (e.g., 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'North America', 'LATAM'). Used for regional supply planning segmentation in Kinaxis RapidResponse and Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; SAP APO/IBP

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP plant code assigned to this distribution network node in SAP S/4HANA MM/WM/PP modules. Used for cross-system integration between supply planning tools (Kinaxis, Blue Yonder) and SAP ERP for inventory and production order management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SAP S/4HANA WM; SAP APO/IBP

attributes.name: sap_storage_location_code
attributes.description: SAP storage location code within the plant, representing the primary storage location for this node in SAP S/4HANA WM. Used for inventory posting, goods receipt, and goods issue transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: serialization_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node is equipped to scan, verify, and process serialized pharmaceutical packaging as required by DSCSA (US) and EU FMD (Falsified Medicines Directive) track-and-trace regulations.
attributes.references: DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act); EU FMD Directive 2011/62/EU; 21 CFR Part 203

attributes.name: storage_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Total physical storage capacity of the node measured in cubic meters. Used for capacity planning, network optimization, and inventory allocation decisions in Kinaxis RapidResponse and SAP WM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Primary temperature storage zone capability of the node. Defines the cold-chain handling classification: ambient (15–25°C), CRT (Controlled Room Temperature, 15–30°C), refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (-20°C), or ultra-low temperature (-80°C). Critical for product-to-node assignment in supply planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); USP <1079>; GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); WHO TRS 961

attributes.name: warehouse_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct storage zones configured within the node (e.g., quarantine zone, approved stock zone, returns zone, controlled substance vault). Reflects the physical warehouse layout complexity in SAP WM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM; GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); 21 CFR Part 211.68

products.name: clinical_supply_order
products.description: Supply order for investigational medicinal products (IMPs), comparators, and ancillary supplies destined for clinical trial sites. Captures IMP material code, protocol number, study site, randomization kit number, ordered quantity, blinding requirements, expiry date, cold-chain requirements, import/export permit references, and order status. Distinct from commercial sales orders due to IND/CTA regulatory requirements, blinding, and randomization constraints.

attributes.name: clinical_supply_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical supply order record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: compound_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.compound. Business justification: Clinical trials order specific investigational compounds identified in IND/CTA applications. Essential for clinical supply chain management linking discovery assets to trial execution, regulatory subm

attributes.name: debarment_check_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.debarment_check. Link tracks compliance with FDA/EMA screening requirements, s

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Clinical supply costs (IMP manufacturing, packaging, distribution) are charged to clinical trial internal orders for R&D cost accounting. Required for trial budget tracking, capitalization decisions,

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Clinical supply orders are fulfilled from specific inventory lots of investigational products. The lot_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Ma

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) master record being ordered. Captures the IMP material code as defined in the clinical supply catalogue and aligned with the IND/CTA filing.
attributes.references: EU Directive 2001/20/EC; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q10

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site that will receive the clinical supply shipment. Identifies the physical location (hospital, clinic, research centre) conducting the trial.

attributes.name: msl_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to medical.msl_profile. Business justification: MSLs coordinate clinical supply for investigator-initiated trials and named patient programs, providing therapeutic area expertise and investigator relationship management. Business process: MSL revie

attributes.name: named_patient_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to medical.named_patient_request. Business justification: Named patient requests directly trigger clinical supply orders for compassionate use programs. Core pharmaceutical regulatory pathway linking medical access programs to supply fulfillment. Business pr

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Clinical supply for investigational products links to patent families covering the compound/formulation being tested. Required for IP protection tracking during clinical development and trial material

attributes.name: patient_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.patient_enrollment. Business justification: Supply orders must verify enrollment status (active, consented) before shipping investigational product. Links order to specific trial enrollment context (site, protocol version, treatment arm) requir

attributes.name: requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Clinical supply orders require documented requestor from clinical operations for IRT reconciliation, protocol compliance, and regulatory audit trail. New attribute needed for GCP traceability.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.territory. Business justification: Investigator-initiated trials and expanded access programs often align with commercial territories for field coordination. Links clinical supply distribution to territory-based medical science liaison

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinical supply was confirmed as received at the investigational site. Compared against required_delivery_date to assess supply chain performance and site readiness.

attributes.name: approved_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of IMP or ancillary supply formally approved for fulfilment after clinical supply review. May differ from ordered_quantity due to stock availability, protocol amendments, or QP release constraints.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Parts 210/211

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Specifies the blinding methodology applied to this supply order as defined in the clinical protocol. Determines labelling, packaging, and handling requirements for the IMP to maintain trial integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for cancellation when order_status is 'Cancelled'. Captures business justification for audit trail and supply planning analysis (e.g., protocol amendment, site closure, stock recall).
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply order requires cold-chain logistics (True) due to temperature-sensitive IMP storage and transport conditions. Triggers cold-chain packaging, monitoring, and carrier selection in the distribution workflow.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 Annex 9; 21 CFR Parts 210/211

attributes.name: courier_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party logistics (3PL) provider or courier responsible for transporting the clinical supply from the depot to the investigational site. Used for GDP audit trail and shipment tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this clinical supply order record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; ICH Q10

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the investigational site receiving the supply is located. Drives import permit requirements, customs clearance, and cold-chain logistics planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01; EU Regulation 536/2014

attributes.name: dispensing_unit
attributes.description: Description of the dispensing unit configuration for the IMP as packaged for clinical trial use (e.g., 'Blinded kit of 28 tablets', '1 vial 10mg/mL'). Supports site pharmacist dispensing and accountability records.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Parts 210/211; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: export_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the export permit or authorisation issued by the originating country's regulatory authority for the shipment of IMP across international borders for clinical trial purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; EU Regulation 536/2014; GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: import_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the import permit issued by the relevant national regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA member state, PMDA) authorising the importation of the IMP into the destination country for clinical trial use.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; EU Regulation 536/2014; PMDA Clinical Trial Notification; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: ind_cta_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigational New Drug (IND) / Clinical Trial Authorisation (CTA) Number
attributes.description: The regulatory filing reference number (IND number in the US per 21 CFR Part 312, or CTA number in the EU per Regulation 536/2014) under which this clinical supply order is authorised. Required for import/export permit applications and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); EU Regulation 536/2014 (CTA); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: irt_system_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or transaction ID from the Interactive Response Technology (IRT) / Interactive Web Response System (IWRS) that triggered or confirmed this supply order. Links the supply event to the randomization and drug management system.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply order is subject to blinding requirements (True) or is open-label (False). Used as a quick filter for blinding compliance checks and supply handling procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this clinical supply order record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for change control audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; ICH Q10

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the clinical supply order was formally placed or submitted by the clinical supply team. This is the principal business event date for the order.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP MM Purchase Order Date

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable order reference number assigned by the clinical supply management system (e.g., Kinaxis RapidResponse or SAP MM) to uniquely identify this supply order across systems and with third-party logistics providers.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP MM Purchase Order Number convention

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the clinical supply order, tracking progression from initial creation through fulfilment or cancellation. Drives supply chain workflow in Kinaxis RapidResponse / SAP MM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Draft|Submitted|Approved|In Preparation|Shipped|Delivered|Cancelled|On Hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP MM Order Status; GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply order by the nature of the material being ordered. IMP = investigational medicinal product; Comparator = approved reference drug; Placebo = matching placebo; Ancillary = non-IMP study supplies; Open-Label Extension = OLE phase supply; Rescue Medication = emergency/rescue supply.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of IMP or ancillary supply units requested in this order, expressed in the unit of measure defined on the IMP material master (e.g., vials, tablets, kits).
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Parts 210/211; ICH Q10

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the clinical supply order indicating the urgency of fulfilment. Emergency orders may be triggered by unplanned site demand, protocol deviations, or patient safety requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH Q10; GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the clinical trial protocol for which this supply order is raised. Links the order to the governing IND/CTA and study design. Corresponds to the protocol number registered in the CTMS (Oracle Clinical / Siebel CTMS).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); EMA CTA Regulation (EU) 536/2014

attributes.name: qp_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Qualified Person (QP) formally certified and released the IMP batch for clinical use. Required for EU GMP Annex 13 compliance and batch disposition records.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; EU Directive 2001/20/EC; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: qualified_person_release
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP batch included in this order has been certified and released by a Qualified Person (QP) as required by EU GMP Annex 13 and Directive 2001/20/EC before dispatch to the clinical site.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; EU Directive 2001/20/EC; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the ordered quantity is expressed, aligned with the IMP material master in SAP MM. Ensures unambiguous interpretation of quantity across manufacturing, QC, and site dispensing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Vial|Tablet|Capsule|Kit|Syringe|Ampoule|Bottle|Sachet|Patch|Unit — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP MM Unit of Measure; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: randomization_kit_number
attributes.description: The unique kit number assigned by the Interactive Response Technology (IRT) or randomization system to the blinded supply kit. Links the physical supply to the randomization schedule and subject assignment. Critical for blinded trial integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the clinical supply must arrive at the investigational site to support the trial schedule. Used for supply chain planning and lead-time management in Kinaxis RapidResponse.

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinical supply was physically dispatched from the originating depot or manufacturing site. Used for GDP compliance, transit time tracking, and delivery performance monitoring.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of IMP or ancillary supply physically dispatched from the manufacturing site or depot. May differ from approved_quantity due to last-minute stock adjustments or partial shipments.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Parts 210/211

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country from which the clinical supply is dispatched. Used for import/export compliance, customs documentation, and GDP route planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum permissible storage and transport temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP in this order, as specified in the IMP dossier and CoA. Used to configure cold-chain monitoring thresholds and excursion alerts.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum permissible storage and transport temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP in this order, as specified in the IMP dossier and CoA. Used to configure cold-chain monitoring thresholds.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9

attributes.name: supply_depot_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the clinical supply depot, distribution centre, or CMO/CDMO warehouse from which this order is fulfilled. Used for inventory allocation, GDP compliance, and 3PL coordination.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (EU) 2013/C 343/01; SAP WM Storage Location; ICH Q10

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The courier or logistics provider's shipment tracking reference number, enabling real-time monitoring of the clinical supply in transit. Supports GDP compliance and cold-chain excursion investigation.

products.name: product_recall

Captures recall number, recall class (Class I, II, III per FDA), affected NDC, affected lot numbers, recall scope (market, distribution level), recall reason, regulatory agency notification date, press release date, customer notification status, quantity recovered, and recall closure date. Supports lot traceability and regulatory reporting obligations under 21 CFR Part 7.

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the pharmaceutical product recall event record. Primary key for the product_recall data product in the supply domain.

Link tracks remediation of recall-triggering deficiencies, supports regulatory submissions (reca

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: Recalls during exclusivity periods have heightened commercial impact and may affect exclusivity status. Required for recall impact assessment on market exclusivity and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: managing_department_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to medical.medical_advisory_board. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to medical.medical_publication. Business justification: Product recalls may require publication of safety data, corrections, or retractions in scientific literature. Regulatory requirement for transparent post-marketing safety communication. Business proce

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product record for the pharmaceutical product subject to the recall. Links to the product master data entity for product name, formulation, and therapeutic area details.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Master Data

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Recalls may trigger patent-related investigations if formulation defects relate to claimed inventions. Required for quality-IP cross-functional review and potential patent validity assessments post-re

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.patient. Business justification: When recalled lots were dispensed to trial participants, pharmacovigilance must identify affected patients for safety follow-up per FDA/EMA requirements. Enables patient-level recall effectiveness che

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacovigilance.pv_product.
