attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_inspection. Business justification: Recalls are frequently triggered by FDA/EMA inspection findings (Form 483, Warning Letters). Direct link enables traceability from inspection observation to recall initiation, supports regulatory resp

attributes.name: responsible_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Recalls require documented responsible person for regulatory traceability, CAPA ownership, and health authority reporting. New attribute needed; removes denormalized responsible_person text field.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing site where the affected lots were produced. Enables traceability back to the production facility for root cause investigation and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: affected_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3-letter country codes (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU) identifying the countries or markets where the recalled product was distributed and where recall actions must be executed.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; 21 CFR Part 7; EMA Recall Guidance

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recalled product requires cold-chain handling (temperature-controlled logistics) during the recovery and return process. Critical for biologics, vaccines, and temperature-sensitive drug products.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines; WHO Cold Chain Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the product recall record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which direct customers (wholesalers, distributors, hospitals, pharmacies) were formally notified of the recall via recall notification letters or electronic communications.

attributes.name: customer_notification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer notification process indicating whether recall notification letters have been sent to all affected customers in the distribution chain.

attributes.name: distribution_level
attributes.description: The level in the distribution chain to which the recall extends. Consumer: product reached end patients/consumers; Retail: product at retail pharmacy level; Wholesale: product at wholesale distributor level; Hospital: product at hospital/clinic level; User: product at healthcare professional level.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.3(k); FDA Recall Depth Definitions

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_level
attributes.description: FDA-defined effectiveness check level indicating the depth and percentage of consignees to be audited to verify recall notification receipt and product return. Level A: 100% of consignees; Level B: some percentage; Level C: 10% of consignees; Level D: 2% of consignees; Not Required: for certain recall types.
attributes.value_regex: Level A|Level B|Level C|Level D|Not Required
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.42(b); FDA Recall Effectiveness Check Guidance

attributes.name: expiration_date_range
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expiration Date Range of Affected Lots
attributes.description: The expiration date range (e.g., '2024-01 to 2025-06') covering all affected lot numbers included in the recall. Assists customers and distributors in identifying recalled product on shelves and in inventory.

attributes.name: gdp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recall execution is being conducted in compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) guidelines, including proper documentation, chain of custody, and temperature-controlled handling of recovered product where applicable.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines; PIC/S

attributes.name: health_hazard_assessment
attributes.description: Summary of the health hazard evaluation conducted by the company's medical and regulatory teams to assess the risk to patients from the defective product. Supports recall classification and regulatory submission under 21 CFR Part 7.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.41; FDA Health Hazard Evaluation

attributes.name: initiating_agency
attributes.description: The regulatory authority or company entity that initiated or mandated the recall. Identifies whether the recall was company-initiated (voluntary) or directed by a specific regulatory body such as FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or NMPA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|NMPA|WHO|Company — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; EMA Recall Guidance; MHRA Recall Guidance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the product recall record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and enables change tracking for regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The National Drug Code (NDC) of the affected drug product in the standard 5-4-2 format. Uniquely identifies the labeler, product, and package configuration of the recalled pharmaceutical product as registered with the FDA.

attributes.name: press_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company issued a public press release or public notification regarding the recall. Required for Class I and certain Class II recalls to inform consumers and healthcare professionals.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; FDA Press Release Requirements

attributes.name: product_disposition
attributes.description: The approved method for disposing of recovered recalled product. Options include destruction, return to manufacturer, reprocessing, relabeling (where permitted), or quarantine pending further evaluation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; 21 CFR Part 211.204; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_distributed
attributes.description: Total quantity of the affected product that was distributed to the market prior to the recall initiation, expressed in the standard unit of measure (e.g., units, bottles, vials). Used to calculate recall effectiveness and track recovery progress.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.53; FDA Recall Effectiveness Checks

attributes.name: quantity_recovered
attributes.description: Total quantity of the recalled product that has been physically returned, destroyed, or otherwise accounted for as of the last update. Used to calculate recall effectiveness percentage and support regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.53; FDA Recall Effectiveness Checks

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to quantity_distributed and quantity_recovered fields (e.g., EA=Each, BT=Bottle, VL=Vial, AMP=Ampoule, PKG=Package, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|BT|VL|AMP|PKG|KG|L — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recall_class
attributes.description: FDA-defined classification indicating the severity of the health hazard associated with the recalled product. Class I: serious adverse health consequences or death; Class II: temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences; Class III: unlikely to cause adverse health consequences.

attributes.name: recall_closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recall was formally closed or terminated by the regulatory authority or the company after all recall activities, effectiveness checks, and documentation requirements were completed.

attributes.name: recall_effectiveness_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of distributed product that has been successfully recovered or accounted for, calculated as (quantity_recovered / quantity_distributed) * 100. Key metric for FDA recall effectiveness checks and regulatory reporting under 21 CFR Part 7.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.53; FDA Recall Effectiveness Guidance

attributes.name: recall_initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recall was formally initiated by the company or ordered by the regulatory authority. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the recall lifecycle.

attributes.name: recall_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, regulatory correspondence summaries, or contextual information relevant to the recall event that is not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned recall identification number issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA recall number) or internally assigned by the company for voluntary recalls. Serves as the primary business identifier for tracking and referencing the recall event across regulatory submissions and communications.

attributes.name: recall_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the root cause or reason for the recall (e.g., contamination, labeling error, sub-potency, sterility failure, foreign particulate). Aligns with FDA recall reason taxonomy for regulatory reporting and trend analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Contamination|Labeling Error|Sub-Potency|Super-Potency|Sterility Failure|Foreign Particulate|Stability Failure|Packaging Defect|Microbial Contamination|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; FDA Recall Reason Codes

attributes.name: recall_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific defect, violation, or safety concern that triggered the recall. Provides the full technical and regulatory context beyond the recall reason code, including root cause findings from CAPA investigations.

attributes.name: recall_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the recall indicating whether the recall covers the entire national market, specific regions, international markets, or is limited to a specific manufacturing or distribution site.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; EMA Recall Guidance; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recall event. Pending: recall initiated but not yet active; Active: recall in progress with field corrections underway; Monitoring: recall effectiveness checks ongoing; Terminated: FDA has terminated the recall; Closed: all recall activities completed and documented.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.55; FDA Recall Status Definitions

attributes.name: recall_strategy
attributes.description: Description of the recall strategy approved by the regulatory authority or company, including the depth of recall, communication methods, effectiveness check methodology, and disposition instructions for recovered product.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.42; FDA Recall Strategy Guidance

attributes.name: recall_type
attributes.description: Categorization of the recall initiation type. Voluntary recalls are company-initiated; Mandatory recalls are ordered by a regulatory authority; Market Withdrawal involves minor violations not subject to legal action; Stock Recovery involves products not yet distributed to the market.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company formally notified the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA) of the recall initiation. Critical compliance milestone tracked under 21 CFR Part 7 and equivalent international regulations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7.46; EMA Recall Notification Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory submission (e.g., NDA, BLA, MAA) associated with the recalled product. Links the recall event to the product's regulatory dossier for compliance tracking in RIMS.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; 21 CFR Part 601; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code identifying the specific commercial packaging configuration of the recalled product as used in SAP MM/WM and supply chain systems. Enables traceability at the packaging level across distribution channels.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse

products.name: serialization_record
products.description: Unit-level and case-level serialization record for pharmaceutical finished goods compliant with DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act) and EU FMD (Falsified Medicines Directive) requirements. Captures serial number, GTIN, NDC, lot number, expiry date, aggregation hierarchy (unit→case→pallet), commissioning event, decommissioning event, verification status, and trading partner transaction history. Enables end-to-end track-and-trace across the pharmaceutical supply chain.

attributes.name: serialization_record_id
attributes.description: Primary key for serialization_record

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Serialized units must trace to manufacturing batch. DSCSA and EU FMD regulations mandate linking serial numbers to batch records for product authentication, verification, and targeted recall execution

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: Serialization compliance (DSCSA, FMD) is brand-specific; commercial teams use serialization data for product authentication, counterfeit prevention, and market-specific regulatory reporting. Links tra

attributes.name: business_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trading partner (manufacturer, wholesaler, distributor, pharmacy) that currently holds legal ownership of the serialized unit. Updated at each DSCSA transaction event (Transfer of Ownership). Core to DSCSA chain-of-custody tracking.
attributes.references: DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203) Section 582(b); GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01)

attributes.name: commissioned_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Serialization commissioning events require documented operator for regulatory compliance, DSCSA traceability, and falsified medicines directive audit trail. New attribute needed.

attributes.name: commissioning_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Serialization commissioning occurs at plants; plant master data provides GMP certification, FDA establishment identifier, regulatory market authorization. Distinct from manufacturing_site_id (manufact

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical finished goods product master record. Links the serialized unit to the product's regulatory approvals, storage conditions, and supply chain attributes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203)

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_incident. Business justification: Serialization violations (missing serial numbers, verification failures, EPCIS event gaps) are compliance incidents under DSCSA/FMD requiring investigation and regulatory reporting. Link enables incid

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Serialization records track individual serialized units that belong to specific inventory lots. The lot_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. N

attributes.name: named_patient_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to medical.named_patient_request. Business justification: Track-and-trace regulatory requirement: serialization records verify product authenticity for named patient programs, especially for controlled distribution and compassionate use. Business process: Se

attributes.name: packaging_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Business justification: Serialization occurs at specific packaging levels (bottle, carton, case, pallet). Packaging configuration defines GTIN structure, aggregation hierarchy, and regulatory serialization requirements (DSCS

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Serialized units of patented products must link to covering patents for anti-counterfeiting, regulatory compliance (Orange Book linkage), and track-and-trace requirements in pharmaceuticals.

attributes.name: patient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.patient. Business justification: Clinical supply serialization systems track which specific serialized unit (GTIN/serial) was dispensed to which patient. Required for accountability, returns reconciliation, regulatory inspections, an

attributes.name: primary_serialization_commissioning_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or packaging site where the serial number was commissioned. Used for GDP compliance, site-level traceability, and regulatory reporting to FDA/EMA.
attributes.references: DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01)

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recall event record when recall_flag is TRUE. Links the serialized unit to the specific recall notification, recall class, and remediation actions. Populated only when the unit is subject to an active recall.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7 (Recalls); FDA Recall Guidance; EU GMP Chapter 8

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location (warehouse, distribution center, pharmacy, hospital) where the serialized unit is currently held. Used for inventory visibility, GDP compliance, and cold-chain monitoring.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01); DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); SAP WM Module

attributes.name: treatment_exposure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.treatment_exposure. Business justification: Links serialized investigational product units to documented treatment administration events in eCRF. Enables verification that lot/serial numbers recorded in exposure logs match dispensed units, crit

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this serialized unit requires cold-chain storage and transportation (e.g., 2-8°C refrigerated or -20°C frozen). Drives cold-chain logistics routing, temperature monitoring requirements, and GDP compliance checks.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01); WHO Technical Report Series No. 961; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: commissioning_event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the serial number was commissioned (activated and associated with a physical product unit) at the manufacturing or packaging site. Marks the start of the serialized unit's lifecycle. Required for DSCSA and EU FMD event reporting.
attributes.references: DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; GS1 EPCIS Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this serialization record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Represents the audit trail creation timestamp for the Silver Layer record, distinct from the commissioning event timestamp.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: decommissioning_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for decommissioning the serialized unit. Required for EU FMD decommissioning event reporting to the European Medicines Verification System (EMVS). Supports pharmacovigilance and recall management workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recall|destruction|sample|theft|damage|dispensed|exported|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161 Article 40; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203)

attributes.name: decommissioning_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the serialized unit was decommissioned (removed from the active supply chain). Populated when serialization_status transitions to 'decommissioned' or 'destroyed'. Required for EU FMD and DSCSA event reporting.
attributes.references: EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); GS1 EPCIS Standard

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical dosage form of the product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution). Used for supply chain classification, storage condition assignment, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|injection|solution|cream|patch|inhaler|suspension — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Dosage Form Codes; EMA Product Information; ICH M5

attributes.name: epcis_event_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Product Code Information Services (EPCIS) Event ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the most recent GS1 EPCIS event associated with this serialized unit. Links to the EPCIS event repository for full event history (ObjectEvent, AggregationEvent, TransactionEvent). Used for DSCSA and EU FMD interoperability.
attributes.references: GS1 EPCIS Standard v1.2/2.0; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161

attributes.name: gdp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current handling and storage of this serialized unit is compliant with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements. Set to FALSE if a GDP deviation has been recorded for this unit (e.g., temperature excursion, unauthorized handling).
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01); WHO Technical Report Series No. 957; MHRA GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit GS1 Global Trade Item Number identifying the pharmaceutical product at the trade item level. Encoded in the 2D DataMatrix barcode on the package. Used for product identification in DSCSA transaction data and EU FMD verification.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this serialization record was most recently updated in the enterprise data platform. Tracks the latest status change, verification event, or ownership transfer recorded against this serialized unit.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: last_verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent verification event performed against the medicines verification system (NMVS/EMVS). Used to track verification frequency and identify units that have not been recently verified.
attributes.references: EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203)

attributes.name: market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the intended market for which this serialized unit was packaged and labeled. Determines applicable serialization regulations (e.g., EU FMD for EU markets, DSCSA for USA, SFDA for China).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); NMPA Serialization Requirements

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Quantity and unit of the pharmaceutical product contained in the individual saleable unit (e.g., '30 tablets', '10 mL vial', '1 pre-filled syringe'). Used for dispensing verification and supply chain planning.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Requirements (21 CFR Part 201); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: Level of the packaging hierarchy this serialization record represents. 'unit' is the individual saleable unit (SGTIN); 'bundle' is a multi-pack; 'case' is a shipping case (SSCC); 'pallet' is a pallet-level aggregation (SSCC). Drives aggregation hierarchy logic.
attributes.references: GS1 SGTIN/SSCC Standards; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161

attributes.name: parent_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the immediate parent container in the aggregation hierarchy (e.g., the case serial number for a unit, or the pallet serial number for a case). Enables reconstruction of the full unit→case→pallet aggregation tree for DSCSA and EU FMD compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 SSCC Standard; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial or brand name of the pharmaceutical product associated with this serialized unit. Included for operational readability and reporting without requiring a join to the product master.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Requirements (21 CFR Part 201); EMA Product Information

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this serialized unit is subject to an active product recall. Set to TRUE when the unit's lot number is included in a recall notification. Enables rapid identification and quarantine of affected units across the supply chain.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7 (Recalls); FDA Recall Guidance; EU GMP Chapter 8; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203)

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: Regulatory market authorization code or product registration number applicable to the market country. Links the serialized unit to the specific marketing authorization (NDA/BLA/MAA) under which it was released for that market.
attributes.references: FDA NDA/BLA (21 CFR Part 314/601); EMA MAA; ICH CTD

attributes.name: saleable_return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this serialized unit has been returned from the market and assessed as eligible for re-entry into the saleable supply chain. Requires verification against the NMVS/EMVS and GDP assessment before re-release.
attributes.references: DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203) Section 582(g); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161 Article 13; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric serial number assigned to an individual saleable unit or case during commissioning. Conforms to GS1 SGTIN or SSCC encoding standards. Required for DSCSA unit-level traceability and EU FMD verification at point of dispense.
attributes.references: DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; GS1 SGTIN Standard

attributes.name: serialization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the serialized unit within the track-and-trace system. 'commissioned' = activated at manufacturing; 'active' = in supply chain; 'shipped' = dispatched to trading partner; 'returned' = returned from market; 'decommissioned' = intentionally removed; 'destroyed' = physically destroyed.
attributes.references: DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; GS1 EPCIS Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating serialization system or track-and-trace platform (e.g., SAP Advanced Track and Trace for Pharmaceuticals, Tracelink, Serialized Inventory Management System) that generated this record. Used for data lineage and system reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); SAP S/4HANA ATTP Module

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the serialized unit as specified in the product's approved labeling and stability data. Drives warehouse zone assignment, cold-chain logistics, and GDP compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; GDP Guidelines (2013/C 343/01); 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: supply_chain_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the serialized unit belongs to the commercial supply chain or the clinical trial supply chain. Clinical trial units require additional IND/CTA traceability. Compassionate use units require special regulatory tracking.
attributes.references: DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203); ICH E6 GCP; 21 CFR Part 312 (IND)

attributes.name: transaction_statement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid DSCSA Transaction Statement has been received and verified for this serialized unit from the upstream trading partner. Required under DSCSA Section 582 for each change of ownership in the pharmaceutical supply chain.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent verification check of the serialized unit against the national or European medicines verification system (NMVS/EMVS). 'verified' = authentication passed; 'failed' = authentication failed (potential falsification); 'pending' = verification in progress; 'not_verified' = not yet checked.
attributes.references: EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161 Article 11; DSCSA (21 CFR Part 203) Section 582

products.name: service_agreement
products.description: Commercial supply agreement with CMOs, CDMOs, and 3PLs governing contracted manufacturing or logistics services for pharmaceutical products. Captures agreement number, counterparty, agreement type (manufacturing, packaging, distribution, storage), contracted volumes, minimum order quantities, lead times, quality agreement reference, GDP compliance obligations, force majeure clauses, and agreement status. Distinct from procurement purchase orders — represents the strategic framework governing the supply relationship.

attributes.name: service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for service_agreement

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee (typically Supply Chain Director or Category Manager) who owns and is accountable for this supply agreement. Used for escalation routing and contract renewal workflows.

attributes.name: primary_service_business_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external organisation (CMO, CDMO, or 3PL) that is the contracting counterparty for this supply agreement. Links to the supplier/vendor master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; ICH Q10 Section 7 (Outsourced Activities)

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Supply agreements with vendors/CMOs must align with compliance programs (GDP, GMP, quality agreements). Link tracks which agreements fall under specific compliance oversight (audit schedules, quality

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific manufacturing or logistics facility of the counterparty where contracted services are performed. Critical for regulatory site authorisation tracking and GDP compliance audits.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Database; SAP S/4HANA MM Plant

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable agreement reference number assigned at contract execution (e.g., MSA-2024-CMO-0042). Used for cross-referencing with counterparty documents, SAP MM outline agreements, and legal records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supply agreement. Drives operational eligibility: only 'active' agreements may be used to generate purchase orders or release batches against contracted volumes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Status; ICH Q10

attributes.name: agreement_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the supply agreement as stated in the contract document (e.g., 'Commercial Manufacturing Services Agreement for Drug Substance API-X'). Supports search and reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply service covered by the agreement. Distinguishes manufacturing (API/DS/DP), packaging (primary/secondary), distribution (3PL/GDP), storage (cold-chain/ambient), testing (QC/analytical), and fill-finish operations.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP S/4HANA MM; GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01)

attributes.name: agreement_version
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier of the agreement document (e.g., v1.0, v2.3-AMEND). Tracks amendments and renegotiations over the agreement lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months
attributes.description: Contractually agreed frequency (in months) at which the company has the right to audit the counterparty's facility for GMP/GDP compliance (e.g., 12 = annual audit). Supports quality oversight scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Section 7; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Annex 16; MasterControl/TrackWise

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement automatically renews at expiry unless notice of termination is provided within the renewal_notice_days window. True = auto-renews; False = requires affirmative renewal action.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement covers products requiring cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport). True = cold-chain infrastructure and monitoring are contractual obligations.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9; ICH Q1A Stability

attributes.name: contracted_annual_volume
attributes.description: Total contracted volume of product or service units per agreement year (e.g., batches, kg of API, units of FDF). Represents the committed or target volume used for capacity planning and take-or-pay calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: contracted_unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed price per unit of measure (volume_uom) for the contracted service or product under this agreement. Used for COGS calculation, budget planning, and purchase order valuation in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Pricing; ICH Q10; SOX

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the external service provider: Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO), Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO), Third-Party Logistics provider (3PL), Contract Research Organisation (CRO), distributor, or warehouse operator.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply agreement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and SOX.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; SOX; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which contracted prices and financial obligations are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and FX exposure management.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the supply agreement expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended evergreen agreements. Triggers renewal workflow when within the renewal_notice_days threshold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; ICH Q10

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the supply agreement becomes legally binding and operationally effective. Used to determine whether the agreement is in scope for a given planning horizon.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; ICH Q10

attributes.name: expedite_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Contractually agreed expedited or rush lead time in calendar days available at a premium cost. Used in supply planning exception scenarios and shortage mitigation.

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a force majeure clause that excuses performance obligations under extraordinary circumstances (e.g., pandemic, natural disaster, regulatory action). True = force majeure clause is present.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP S/4HANA MM; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: gdp_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is contractually obligated to comply with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) guidelines for storage and distribution of pharmaceutical products. True = GDP compliance is a contractual requirement.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 957; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable regulatory and legal framework for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR; EMA Regulations

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent GMP/GDP compliance audit conducted at the counterparty's facility under this agreement. Used to determine next audit due date and assess supplier qualification status.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GDP Guidelines; MasterControl/TrackWise

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this supply agreement record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; SOX; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: minimum_order_qty
attributes.description: Minimum quantity per purchase order or manufacturing run that the counterparty will accept under this agreement. Expressed in volume_uom. Used in supply planning to avoid sub-MOQ orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement MOQ; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: price_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Description of the contractual price escalation mechanism (e.g., 'Annual CPI adjustment capped at 3%', 'Fixed for 2 years then renegotiated'). Supports financial forecasting and contract renewal planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX; ICH Q10

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Free-text description of the pharmaceutical products, APIs, excipients, or packaging components covered by this agreement (e.g., 'Drug Substance API-X and Drug Product FDF-Y in 10mg and 20mg strengths'). Supports scope management and audit.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; SAP S/4HANA MM; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: quality_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier of the associated Quality Agreement (QA) that governs GMP responsibilities, batch release criteria, and quality obligations between the parties. Distinct from the commercial supply agreement.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Section 7; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; EMA GMP Annex 16; Veeva Vault QualityDocs

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to the effective_end_date by which either party must provide written notice of intent to renew or terminate. Drives automated renewal alerts in supply planning systems.

attributes.name: standard_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Contractually agreed standard lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to delivery or batch release. Used as the primary lead time parameter in supply planning and demand-supply balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Contractually specified storage condition for products handled under this agreement: ambient (15–25°C), refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (-20°C), ultra-frozen (-80°C), or controlled room temperature (CRT, 20–25°C). Drives cold-chain infrastructure requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; USP <1079>; EU GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: supply_chain_segment
attributes.description: Identifies whether the agreement governs commercial supply, clinical trial supply, or both. Clinical supply agreements are subject to additional GCP and IND/CTA regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH Q10

attributes.name: take_or_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a take-or-pay clause obligating the company to purchase or pay for a minimum contracted volume regardless of actual demand. True = take-or-pay applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ICH Q10 Section 7

attributes.name: take_or_pay_min_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of contracted_annual_volume that must be purchased or paid for under the take-or-pay clause (e.g., 80.00 = 80%). Null if take_or_pay_flag is False.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; Kinaxis RapidResponse

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the agreement was terminated, if applicable. Null for active or expired agreements. Distinct from effective_end_date which is the planned expiry; this captures early or for-cause termination.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of written notice required by either party to terminate the agreement for convenience (excluding termination for cause). Drives supply continuity risk assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; ICH Q10

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason category for agreement termination. Populated only when agreement_status is 'terminated'. Supports supplier relationship analytics and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: for_cause|for_convenience|mutual_agreement|regulatory_action|counterparty_insolvency — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to contracted_annual_volume and minimum_order_qty fields (e.g., KG for API, BATCH for manufacturing runs, UNIT for finished dosage forms). Aligned with SAP UOM configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|BATCH|UNIT|VIAL|TABLET|CAPSULE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: lot_traceability
products.description: End-to-end lot/batch traceability record linking raw material lots through drug substance, drug product, and finished goods lots across the pharmaceutical supply chain. Captures parent lot, child lot, material, transformation type (manufacturing, packaging, repackaging), site, transformation date, quantity in, quantity out, yield, and traceability chain status. Supports regulatory recall traceability, pharmacovigilance investigations, and GMP batch record linkage. Critical for 21 CFR Part 211 and EU GMP Annex 11 compliance.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each lot/batch traceability linkage record in the pharmaceutical supply chain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Lot traceability tracks material genealogy. Must link child lots to the batch record that produced them for full chain of custody, regulatory compliance, and recall effectiveness in pharmaceutical sup

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: Traceability chains track genealogy of specific drug products through manufacturing transformations (bulk→finished, repackaging). Essential for recall scope determination, deviation impact assessment,

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Child Masterdata Material Master Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Traceability chains require material master linkage for genealogy, transformation rules, yield calculations. Child_material_code and child_material_description are denormalized; FK ensures referential

attributes.name: operator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Manufacturing transformations require documented operator for batch record traceability, GMP compliance, and deviation investigation. New attribute needed for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: parent_inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: lot_traceability tracks parent-child lot genealogy. The parent_lot_number (STRING) should be replaced with parent_inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. This enables proper referential

attributes.name: pv_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacovigilance.pv_product. Business justification: Batch genealogy investigations for quality complaints and adverse events require linking manufacturing lot lineage to PV product master. Supports root cause analysis when AEs cluster by batch, enables

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or packaging site where the transformation was performed. Links to the site master for GDP compliance, regulatory site registration, and supply chain network analysis.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.42; EU GMP Chapter 3; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: child_lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number of the output/produced material resulting from the transformation step. Represents the downstream node in the traceability chain (e.g., drug product lot, finished goods lot). Aligns with SAP MM batch number of the output material.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7 Section 6

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: The Certificate of Analysis (CoA) document number associated with the child lot, confirming that the lot meets all quality specifications. Issued by the QC laboratory (LIMS) and referenced in regulatory submissions and customer/partner documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.194; EU GMP Chapter 6; ICH Q7 Section 11

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot requires cold-chain handling and storage conditions (e.g., 2–8°C refrigerated, -20°C frozen, -80°C ultra-cold). Drives GDP-compliant logistics routing, carrier selection, and temperature monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series 961; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this traceability record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11 for electronic records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 11; ISO 8601

attributes.name: deviation_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of any GMP deviation, OOS (Out of Specification), or OOT (Out of Trend) investigation associated with this lot or transformation step. Links to the Quality Management System (MasterControl/TrackWise) for CAPA tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q10; EU GMP Chapter 8

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date assigned to the child lot, beyond which the material must not be used or distributed. Determined by stability studies and shelf-life specifications. Critical for GDP compliance, inventory management, and recall scope determination.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Chapter 5; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: gdp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transformation and handling of this lot was performed in compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) guidelines. FALSE triggers a quality investigation. Required for EU distribution authorization and WHO prequalification.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO TRS 957; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this traceability record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 11; ISO 8601

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The official date of manufacture assigned to the child lot, as recorded on the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and batch record. Used for shelf-life calculation, regulatory reporting, and lot genealogy.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Chapter 5; ICH Q7

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the child lot material type within the pharmaceutical supply chain hierarchy. Drives traceability chain logic, regulatory reporting scope, and GDP compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|api|excipient|packaging_component|drug_substance|drug_product|finished_goods|clinical_supply — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.80; EU GMP Chapter 5

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned National Drug Code (NDC) for the child lot material, in the standard 5-4-2 format. Applicable to commercial finished goods. Used for regulatory traceability, serialization compliance, and distribution tracking under DSCSA.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; 21 CFR Part 207; DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act)

attributes.name: process_order_number
attributes.description: SAP PP process order number or manufacturing work order number that authorized and tracked the transformation operation. Provides the operational link between the traceability record and the ERP production execution.
attributes.references: SAP PP Process Order; 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: qp_release_status
attributes.description: The Qualified Person (QP) or Authorized Person (AP) release status of the child lot. 'released' indicates the lot has been certified by a QP for distribution per EU GMP Annex 16. 'rejected' indicates the lot failed QP review. Required for EU market distribution and clinical supply.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 16; 21 CFR Part 211.192; EMA Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_in
attributes.description: The quantity of the parent lot material consumed or input into the transformation step. Expressed in the unit of measure defined by quantity_uom. Used for yield calculation and GMP batch record reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7 Section 6; EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: quantity_out
attributes.description: The quantity of the child lot material produced or output from the transformation step. Expressed in the unit of measure defined by quantity_uom. Used for yield calculation and GMP batch record reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7 Section 6; EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to both quantity_in and quantity_out fields (e.g., kg for API, units for finished tablets, vials for injectables). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|mg|L|mL|units|tablets|vials|bottles|capsules — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure; ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lot is subject to an active product recall. Set to TRUE when a recall action is initiated by the company or regulatory authority. Enables rapid identification of affected lots across the traceability chain for recall scope determination.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7 Subpart C; EU GMP Chapter 8; FDA Recall Guidance

attributes.name: recall_reference_number
attributes.description: The regulatory or internal recall reference number associated with this lot when recall_flag is TRUE. Links the traceability record to the formal recall action for scope tracking, regulatory reporting, and pharmacovigilance investigation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7 Subpart C; EU GMP Chapter 8; FDA Recall Database

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: The date by which the child lot material (typically API or drug substance) must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications before use. Applicable to materials with retest periods rather than expiry dates per ICH Q7.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 Section 11; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Chapter 5

attributes.name: serialization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot requires unit-level serialization per DSCSA (US), FMD (EU Falsified Medicines Directive), or other track-and-trace regulations. Drives serialization system integration and aggregation hierarchy management.
attributes.references: DSCSA 2013; EU FMD Delegated Regulation 2016/161; 21 CFR Part 203

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The internal Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code for the child lot material as defined in the ERP/WMS system. Used for inventory management, demand planning integration with Kinaxis/Blue Yonder, and commercial distribution tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: The required storage condition for the child lot material as specified in the product dossier and CoA. Drives warehouse slotting, GDP compliance, and cold-chain logistics planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|refrigerated|frozen|ultra_cold|controlled_room_temp|protect_from_light|controlled_substance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GDP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.142; WHO TRS 961

attributes.name: supply_chain_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this traceability record belongs to the commercial supply chain, the clinical trial supply chain, or spans both. Clinical supply chain records require additional IND/CTA traceability and blinding controls.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q7

attributes.name: theoretical_yield
attributes.description: The maximum expected quantity of output material based on the bill of materials and batch formula, expressed in quantity_uom. Used to calculate actual vs. theoretical yield variance for GMP batch record review and OOS/OOT investigations.

attributes.name: traceability_chain_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the lot genealogy hierarchy, where level 1 represents the raw material/API input and higher levels represent downstream transformation steps (e.g., level 2 = drug substance, level 3 = drug product, level 4 = finished goods). Enables hierarchical traceability chain traversal for recall scope and genealogy reporting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7

attributes.name: traceability_chain_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this traceability linkage record. 'active' indicates a valid, in-use chain link; 'recalled' flags lots subject to a market recall; 'under_investigation' indicates a pharmacovigilance or quality investigation is open; 'invalidated' marks records superseded by corrections.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q10

attributes.name: traceability_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this traceability linkage record. Used in regulatory submissions, recall investigations, and GMP batch record cross-references. Typically sourced from SAP MM/WM or MES batch record systems.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7

attributes.name: transformation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the manufacturing, packaging, or supply chain transformation operation was performed, converting the parent lot into the child lot. Principal business event date for this traceability record.

attributes.name: transformation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the manufacturing or supply chain operation that converted the parent lot into the child lot. Drives traceability chain logic and GMP batch record linkage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing|packaging|repackaging|blending|filling|labelling|sampling|testing|transfer — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7

attributes.name: yield_pct
attributes.description: The process yield expressed as a percentage, calculated as (quantity_out / quantity_in) × 100. Stored as a business-critical GMP metric for batch record review, deviation investigation, and process performance trending. Out-of-specification yield triggers CAPA.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q7 Section 6; EU GMP Chapter 4

products.name: fulfillment_event
products.description: Unified event log capturing all supply chain milestones, exceptions, and deviations across the pharmaceutical distribution network. Includes shipment milestones (departed, in-transit, arrived, delivered), temperature and environmental excursions during cold-chain storage/transit (biologics, vaccines, APIs), GDP deviations (documentation gaps, unauthorized access, pest control), supply disruptions, allocation changes, and ATP exceptions. Captures event type, event timestamp, affected material, lot, shipment or storage location reference, temperature/humidity readings, monitoring device ID, excursion severity (minor, major, critical), GDP guideline reference, CAPA reference, regulatory reportability flag, event source system, and resolution status. Supports GDP compliance per EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01, WHO GDP guidelines, and cold-chain integrity assurance. SSOT for all supply chain event and exception tracking.

attributes.name: fulfillment_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fulfillment_event

attributes.name: reported_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Supply chain excursions require documented reporter for CAPA assignment, deviation management, and regulatory reportability assessment. New attribute needed; removes denormalized reported_by text fiel

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical shipment record associated with this event. Links the event to the specific shipment leg, delivery document, or transport order in the distribution network.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; SAP S/4HANA WM/SD Module

attributes.name: stock_transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stock transfer order associated with this event, linking to the supply.stock_transfer_order product for intra-company or inter-site material movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage or transit location where the supply chain event occurred. Covers manufacturing sites, distribution centers, third-party logistics (3PL) warehouses, customs facilities, and clinical trial depots.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: affected_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of pharmaceutical material directly affected by this supply chain event (e.g., quantity of product in a temperature-excursed shipment, quantity subject to a supply disruption, quantity reallocated in an allocation change event).
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: The CAPA identifier from the Quality Management System (MasterControl or TrackWise) linked to this supply chain event. Populated when a formal CAPA has been initiated in response to a GDP deviation, temperature excursion, or supply disruption.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Annex 15; MasterControl/TrackWise QMS

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the carrier, courier, or third-party logistics (3PL) provider responsible for the shipment at the time of this event. Relevant for GDP qualification tracking and carrier performance management.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines; PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment event record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GDP Guidelines. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: deviation_reference
attributes.description: The formal quality deviation or non-conformance report number from the QMS (MasterControl/TrackWise) associated with this event. Distinct from CAPA reference — a deviation may exist without a CAPA if the risk is low.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP Part I; MasterControl/TrackWise QMS

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the supply chain event, providing operational context, observed conditions, and initial assessment. Captured by the logistics operator, quality team, or automated monitoring system at the time of event detection.

attributes.name: event_location_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the location where the event occurred, including site name, warehouse zone, or transit leg description. Complements the location ID for operational reporting and GDP deviation documentation.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the fulfillment event, used for cross-system referencing and communication with logistics partners, CROs, and CMOs. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD/WM or Kinaxis RapidResponse.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: event_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated or captured this supply chain event. Enables data lineage tracing and source system reconciliation across SAP S/4HANA, Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, IoT monitoring devices, courier portals, LIMS, and MES platforms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_S4HANA|Kinaxis_RapidResponse|Blue_Yonder|manual_entry|IoT_sensor|courier_portal|LIMS|MES — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; GAMP 5

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fulfillment event record, tracking whether the event is newly identified, under active investigation, resolved with corrective action, formally closed, or escalated to regulatory or senior management.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q10; MasterControl/TrackWise QMS

attributes.name: event_subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the event type. Examples: for shipment_milestone — departed, in_transit, arrived, delivered, customs_hold; for temperature_excursion — cold_chain_breach, freeze_event, heat_event; for gdp_deviation — documentation_gap, unauthorized_access, pest_control, vehicle_hygiene. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: departed|in_transit|arrived|delivered|customs_hold|cold_chain_breach|freeze_event|heat_event|documentation_gap|unauthorized_access|pest_control|vehicle_hygiene — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the supply chain event occurred in the real world (e.g., when a shipment departed, when a temperature excursion was detected, when a GDP deviation was identified). Distinct from record audit timestamps. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 211; WHO GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the nature of the supply chain event. Shipment milestones cover departed/in-transit/arrived/delivered states; temperature excursions cover cold-chain breaches; GDP deviations cover documentation gaps, unauthorized access, pest control; supply disruptions cover material shortages; allocation changes cover demand reallocation; ATP exceptions cover available-to-promise failures.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines; ICH Q10

attributes.name: excursion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration in minutes of a temperature or humidity excursion event, from first breach detection to return within acceptable limits. Used for mean kinetic temperature (MKT) calculations and product impact assessments. Null for non-excursion events.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; USP <1079>; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: excursion_severity
attributes.description: The severity classification of a temperature, humidity, or GDP excursion event. Minor excursions may be within product stability limits; major excursions require quality investigation; critical excursions may necessitate product quarantine, destruction, or regulatory reporting. Null for non-excursion events.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines; ICH Q10; MasterControl/TrackWise

attributes.name: gdp_guideline_reference
attributes.description: The specific GDP guideline clause or section number that is relevant to this event or deviation. Examples: EU GDP 2013/C 343/01 Chapter 6.3 (Temperature Control), WHO GDP TRS 957 Annex 5 Section 8. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and deviation documentation.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines TRS 957 Annex 5; PIC/S PE 011

attributes.name: humidity_reading_pct
attributes.description: The relative humidity percentage recorded at the time of the event. Relevant for moisture-sensitive pharmaceutical products and storage condition compliance monitoring. Null for non-environmental events.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q1A; USP <1079>

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment event record was most recently modified. Tracks status changes, resolution updates, and CAPA linkages. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing lot or batch number of the pharmaceutical material affected by this event. Critical for GMP traceability, recall management, and GDP compliance. Aligns with SAP batch management and LIMS batch records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number or equivalent ERP identifier for the pharmaceutical material affected by this event. Covers APIs, excipients, packaging components, drug substances, and finished drug products.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ICH Q7; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: monitoring_device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the temperature/humidity monitoring device (data logger, IoT sensor, or continuous monitoring system) that captured the environmental reading associated with this event. Supports device calibration traceability and GDP audit trails.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO GDP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 11; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The U.S. National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product, dosage form, and package size affected by this event. Used for regulatory traceability and DSCSA compliance for finished pharmaceutical products.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207; FDA NDC Directory; DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act)

attributes.name: product_quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected pharmaceutical material has been placed in quarantine status as a result of this event. When True, the material is blocked from further distribution pending quality investigation and disposition decision.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 211.84; ICH Q10; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the affected quantity field. Standard pharmaceutical units include each (EA), kilograms (KG), litres (L), millilitres (mL), grams (g), milligrams (mg), vials, bottles, cartons, and pallets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|mL|g|mg|vials|bottles|cartons|pallets — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ICH Q7

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority to which this event must be reported, if regulatory_reportable is True. Applicable for events involving product quality failures, GDP deviations, or controlled substance discrepancies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|NMPA|WHO|DEA|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.81; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q10

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply chain event requires regulatory reporting to health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA). True for events such as critical GDP deviations, product recalls, or significant cold-chain failures affecting product quality and patient safety.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.81; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; EMA/INS/GMP/79766/2011; MHRA GDP Guidance

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the actions taken to resolve this supply chain event, including corrective measures, product disposition decisions, and process improvements implemented. Populated when event_status transitions to resolved or closed.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q10; MasterControl/TrackWise QMS

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the supply chain event was formally resolved and closed in the QMS or supply chain system. Used to calculate event resolution cycle time for GDP KPI reporting.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific commercial or clinical product variant affected by this event, including pack size and configuration. Used for inventory management and commercial distribution tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: source_system_event_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this event in the originating source system (e.g., SAP delivery document number, Kinaxis event ID, IoT platform alert ID). Supports cross-system traceability and deduplication during ETL processing.

attributes.name: storage_condition_required
attributes.description: The required storage condition for the affected pharmaceutical material as per product specification and regulatory labelling. Used to assess the impact of excursion events against the product's approved storage requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; USP <659>; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: supply_chain_segment
attributes.description: Identifies whether this event pertains to the commercial supply chain, clinical trial supply chain, product returns/reverse logistics, or sample distribution. Enables segregated reporting and compliance tracking across supply chain segments.

products.name: drug_dispensation
products.description: This association product represents the dispensation event between inventory_lot and patient in clinical trials. It captures the operational record of investigational product or commercial drug being dispensed from a specific lot to a specific trial participant. Each record links one inventory_lot to one patient with attributes that exist only in the context of this dispensation transaction, including dispense date, quantity, location, status, and return information for GDP compliance and clinical trial accountability.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical clinical trials, drug dispensation represents a true operational many-to-many relationship. A single inventory lot is dispensed to multiple patients over the course of a trial (one lot serves many participants across visits), and a single patient receives drug from multiple lots throughout their trial participation (across visits, cycles, or dose adjustments). The dispensation event is actively managed by clinical supply teams and site pharmacists as a distinct business process with its own lifecycle, attributes, and regulatory requirements.

products.name: distribution_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual service agreement between a distribution network node and a payer account. It captures the operational service level commitments, delivery parameters, and cold-chain capabilities that govern how pharmaceutical products flow from specific distribution nodes to specific payer organizations. Each record links one distribution_network node to one payer_account with service-level attributes that exist only in the context of this distribution relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical supply chain operations, a single distribution network node (e.g., a regional distribution center in Frankfurt) serves multiple payer accounts (commercial insurers, PBMs, specialty pharmacies) with potentially different service level agreements, delivery lead times, and cold-chain requirements for each payer. Conversely, a single payer account (e.g., a national PBM like Express Scripts) receives pharmaceutical products from multiple distribution nodes across different geographic regions to ensure supply redundancy, optimize delivery speed, and source products with different temperature requirements. The business actively manages these distribution service agreements as operational contracts with specific service levels, carriers, and capabilities per node-payer pair.

products.name: contract_fulfillment_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational allocation and fulfillment tracking between inventory lots and payer contracts in pharmaceutical supply chain operations. It captures the business process of allocating specific inventory lots (with their lot numbers, expiry dates, and quality status) to fulfill contracted obligations with payers, PBMs, and GPOs. Each record links one inventory lot to one payer contract with allocation quantities, fulfillment priorities, and contract period tracking that exist only in the context of this lot-to-contract allocation relationship. Critical for gross-to-net revenue management, rebate accrual calculations tied to actual shipped inventory, and GDP-compliant lot traceability to contracted entities.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical supply chain operations, a single inventory lot (batch) can be allocated across multiple payer contracts during shortage scenarios, multi-contract fulfillment strategies, or when optimizing expiry date management across contracted entities. Conversely, a single payer contract is fulfilled by multiple inventory lots over time due to replenishment cycles, batch production schedules, and the need to maintain continuous supply. The business actively manages these lot-to-contract allocations with specific quantities, fulfillment priorities, and contract period tracking.

domains.name: pharmacovigilance
domains.description: Owns all post-market safety surveillance and adverse event management. Collects, processes, and reports individual case safety reports (ICSR), serious adverse events (SAE), suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSAR), periodic safety update reports (PSUR), risk management plans (RMP), and signal detection records. Integrates with Argus Safety/Oracle AERS. Supports mandatory regulatory reporting to FDA, EMA, and other health authorities per PV regulations.

products.name: icsr
products.description: Individual Case Safety Report — the primary transactional record in pharmacovigilance. Captures all adverse event/adverse drug reaction reports from healthcare professionals, patients, literature, clinical trials, and spontaneous sources. Stores case identifiers (worldwide unique case ID), report type (spontaneous, literature, clinical trial, solicited, SAE), source channel, seriousness criteria, listedness assessment, causality assessment, narrative, regulatory clock start date, case processing status, and submission compliance. For literature-sourced cases, stores publication reference (PMID/DOI). For clinical trial cases, stores reconciliation status with EDC, dechallenge/rechallenge results, and site details. Includes version history tracking (initial, follow-up, nullification) with full audit trail per ICH E2B and 21 CFR Part 314. Includes de-identified patient demographics (age, sex, weight, medical history) per GDPR/HIPAA. Includes intake triage, minimum criteria validation, duplicate assessment outcome, and case assignment. SSOT for all individual safety cases. Supports regional requirements for FDA (MedWatch), EMA (EudraVigilance), PMDA (J-ICSR), NMPA, and TGA reporting. SLA-critical: 7-day and 15-day regulatory reporting deadlines.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.compound. Business justification: ICSRs for investigational products in clinical trials must reference the specific discovery compound for IND safety reporting, causality assessment, and DSUR preparation. FDA and EMA require traceabil

attributes.name: manufacturing_batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Pharmacovigilance ICSRs should link to manufacturing batch records for product quality complaints and batch-related adverse events. This enables integrated safety and quality investigation and support

attributes.name: manufacturing_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Manufacturing site identification required for GMP deviation investigations, site-specific signal detection, and quality-safety interface. Links safety events to production locations for batch-related

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hcp.hcp_master. Business justification: ICSRs require linking to reporting HCP for follow-up queries, credential verification, specialty-based causality assessment, and regulatory submission completeness per ICH E2B requirements. Role prefi

attributes.name: patent_id
