attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ingredient specification becomes effective in the formulation. Used for change control and version management.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System - Change Management

attributes.name: ingredient_function
attributes.description: Specific functional role of the ingredient in the formulation such as binder, filler, disintegrant, lubricant, coating agent, or flavoring agent. Critical for Quality by Design (QbD) and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Inactive Ingredient Database; ICH Q8

attributes.name: ingredient_name
attributes.description: Common or trade name of the ingredient as used in manufacturing documentation and internal systems.

attributes.name: ingredient_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of ingredients within the formulation, used for manufacturing instructions and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: ingredient_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ingredient role in the formulation: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), excipient, solvent, preservative, stabilizer, or colorant.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A Specifications - Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this formulation ingredient record was last updated. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and change control.

attributes.name: overage_justification
attributes.description: Business and scientific rationale for the overage percentage, including stability data, manufacturing loss studies, or regulatory requirements. Required for regulatory submissions and quality documentation.

attributes.name: overage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of additional ingredient added beyond the theoretical quantity to compensate for manufacturing losses, degradation, or potency variations. Critical for API stability and shelf-life management.
attributes.references: ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development; ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: quantity_per_batch
attributes.description: Total amount of the ingredient required for a standard manufacturing batch. Used for batch record generation, material planning, and manufacturing execution.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice; ICH Q7

attributes.name: quantity_per_unit_dose
attributes.description: Amount of the ingredient present in a single unit dose (e.g., one tablet, one capsule, one vial). Used for labeling, regulatory submissions, and quality control.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 201 - Labeling; ICH M4 Quality

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the ingredient for use in pharmaceutical manufacturing: approved for use, pending review, restricted use, or obsolete.

attributes.name: retest_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after which the ingredient must be retested to confirm it still meets specifications before use in manufacturing. Part of stability and quality management programs.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.166

attributes.name: specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the detailed quality specification document or standard operating procedure (SOP) governing acceptance criteria for this ingredient.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the ingredient such as temperature range, humidity control, light protection, or inert atmosphere. Critical for maintaining ingredient quality and stability.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; USP General Notices

products.name: packaging_configuration
products.description: Master record for the packaging configuration of a drug product, defining primary container (vial, blister, bottle), secondary packaging (carton, wallet), and tertiary/shipper packaging. Captures container closure system (CCS) specifications, pack size, fill volume, headspace, cold-chain requirements (2-8°C, -20°C, -80°C), and serialization/aggregation hierarchy for track-and-trace compliance (DSCSA, EU FMD). Referenced by supply chain, manufacturing, and commercial domains for SKU definition.

attributes.name: packaging_configuration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the packaging configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug product (finished dosage form) that this packaging configuration applies to.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria for New Drug Substances and New Drug Products

attributes.name: packaging_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Packaging operations site assignment for capacity planning, serialization compliance (plant-level aggregation), secondary packaging operations, distribution planning. Required for Track & Trace regula

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Packaging and device components (especially combination products) have distinct patent protection. Critical for product differentiation, IP strategy, and device-related regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Packaging fill volume UOM for fill specifications (target fill volume), stability (headspace calculations), regulatory filings (container-closure system). Normalizes implicit ml unit in fill_volume_ml

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Packaging materials (containers, closures, labels) are procured from specialized vendors. Critical for supplier qualification, quality agreements, change control notifications, and regulatory complian

attributes.name: aggregation_hierarchy
attributes.description: Description of the parent-child aggregation structure for serialized units (e.g., unit > case > pallet) used in track-and-trace systems.

attributes.name: child_resistant_packaging
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging meets child-resistant standards to prevent accidental ingestion by children.
attributes.references: 16 CFR Part 1700 - Poison Prevention Packaging Act; ISO 8317

attributes.name: closure_type
attributes.description: Type of closure used to seal the primary container, ensuring product integrity and preventing contamination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rubber_stopper|screw_cap|flip_off_cap|child_resistant_cap|tamper_evident_seal|heat_seal|crimp_seal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USP <1207> Package Integrity Evaluation; 21 CFR Part 211.94 - Drug product containers and closures

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging configuration requires temperature-controlled cold chain storage and distribution.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; WHO Technical Report Series on Temperature Control; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: configuration_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the packaging configuration used across manufacturing, supply chain, and commercial systems.
attributes.references: ISO 11239 - Health informatics - Identification of medicinal products - Pharmaceutical dose forms, units of presentation and routes of administration

attributes.name: configuration_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the packaging configuration, typically including container type, pack size, and market designation.

attributes.name: configuration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the packaging configuration based on its intended use and distribution channel.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312 - Investigational New Drug Application; 21 CFR Part 314 - Applications for FDA Approval to Market a New Drug

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging configuration record was first created in the master data system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this packaging configuration was discontinued and is no longer manufactured or distributed.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 314.81 - Other postmarketing reports

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this packaging configuration becomes active and available for manufacturing and distribution.

attributes.name: fill_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of drug product filled into the primary container, measured in milliliters. Critical for dosing accuracy and overfill calculations.
attributes.references: USP <698> Deliverable Volume; ICH Q6A - Specifications

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-14) used for supply chain identification and track-and-trace serialization.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; DSCSA - Drug Supply Chain Security Act; EU FMD - Falsified Medicines Directive

attributes.name: headspace_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of air or inert gas in the primary container above the drug product, important for stability and oxidation control.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1207> Package Integrity

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this packaging configuration record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the packaging configuration indicating its availability for manufacturing and distribution.

attributes.name: light_protection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging must protect the drug product from light exposure to prevent photodegradation.

attributes.name: market_authorization_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the primary market or regulatory jurisdiction for which this packaging configuration is authorized.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH M4 - Common Technical Document

attributes.name: moisture_protection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging must provide moisture barrier protection to prevent hygroscopic degradation.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1136> Packaging and Storage Requirements

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code uniquely identifying this specific packaging configuration in the US market. Format: labeler-product-package.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207 - Registration of Producers of Drugs and Listing of Drugs in Commercial Distribution; FDA NDC Directory

attributes.name: nominal_fill_volume_ml
attributes.description: Labeled or declared fill volume on the packaging, which may differ from actual fill volume due to overfill requirements.
attributes.references: USP <698> Deliverable Volume; 21 CFR Part 201 - Labeling

attributes.name: package_insert_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the package insert or patient information leaflet included with this packaging configuration.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 201 - Labeling; EMA QRD Template - Quality Review of Documents

attributes.name: primary_container_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the primary container, critical for stability and compatibility with the drug substance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: glass_type_i|glass_type_ii|glass_type_iii|plastic_hdpe|plastic_ldpe|plastic_pet|plastic_pp|aluminum|laminate — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USP <661> Containers - Plastics; USP <660> Containers - Glass; ICH Q1A - Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

attributes.name: primary_container_type
attributes.description: Type of primary container that is in direct contact with the drug product, part of the container closure system (CCS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vial|ampoule|blister|bottle|syringe|cartridge|pen|inhaler|sachet|tube|pouch — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 11239 - Pharmaceutical dose forms; USP <1207> Package Integrity Evaluation

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the packaging configuration received regulatory approval for commercial distribution.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 - NDA Approval; EMA Marketing Authorization Procedures

attributes.name: retest_period_months
attributes.description: Period in months after which the drug product must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; ICH Q6A - Specifications

attributes.name: secondary_packaging_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the secondary packaging, selected for protection, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: secondary_packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of secondary packaging that contains one or more primary containers, providing additional protection and labeling space. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: carton|wallet|box|tray|shrink_wrap|bundle|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 11239 - Pharmaceutical dose forms; GDP Guidelines - Good Distribution Practice

attributes.name: serialization_level
attributes.description: Level at which unique serialization is applied for track-and-trace compliance (unit, pack, case, or pallet level).
attributes.references: DSCSA - Drug Supply Chain Security Act (US); EU FMD 2011/62/EU; GS1 EPCIS

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life duration in months from date of manufacture, based on stability study data.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; ICH Q1E - Evaluation of Stability Data

attributes.name: storage_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of storage conditions including temperature range, humidity, light protection, and orientation requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.142 - Warehousing procedures

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain product stability and efficacy.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain product stability and efficacy.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices

attributes.name: tamper_evident_feature
attributes.description: Type of tamper-evident feature incorporated into the packaging to ensure product integrity and patient safety.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.132 - Tamper-evident packaging requirements; ISO 8317 - Child-resistant packaging

attributes.name: tertiary_packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of tertiary or shipper packaging used for bulk distribution and logistics, containing multiple secondary packs.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines - Good Distribution Practice; ISO 11239

attributes.name: units_per_primary_pack
attributes.description: Number of individual dosage units (tablets, capsules, vials) contained in the primary packaging.

attributes.name: units_per_secondary_pack
attributes.description: Number of primary containers included in one secondary package unit.

attributes.name: units_per_tertiary_pack
attributes.description: Number of secondary packages contained in one tertiary shipper or case for distribution.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines; Supply Chain Packaging Standards

products.name: sku
products.description: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) master record representing the commercially sellable unit of a drug product at a specific strength, dosage form, and packaging configuration. Captures GTIN/EAN barcode, SAP material number, trade name, market (country/region), launch date, discontinuation date, commercial status (active, discontinued, withdrawn), and channel designation (retail, hospital, specialty pharmacy). Serves as the SSOT for commercial product identity referenced by supply chain, commercial, and finance domains. NDC codes for US-market SKUs are managed via regulatory_identifier.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU record. Primary key for the SKU master data product.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: SKUs are market-specific (country-level) for pricing, reimbursement, distribution, regulatory compliance. Replaces denormalized market_country_code with FK to country master for market access analytic

attributes.name: mah_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: SKU-level Marketing Authorization Holder tracking for market-specific regulatory compliance, product liability, pharmacovigilance case processing. Each market/SKU may have different MAH (local affilia

attributes.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.ndc_code. Business justification: SKUs in US market must link to NDC for billing (pharmacy claims, 340B), reimbursement (Medicare Part D), serialization (DSCSA compliance). Replaces denormalized ndc_code with FK to NDC master for pric

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent drug product (DP) or finished dosage form (FDF) that this SKU represents at a specific packaging and market configuration.

attributes.name: packaging_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Business justification: SKU is the commercially sellable unit with specific packaging. The packaging details (package_size, package_type, storage_condition, cold_chain_required, shelf_life_months) on sku should reference the

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary manufacturing site or CMO/CDMO facility responsible for producing this SKU. Used for supply chain planning, quality investigations, and regulatory inspections.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: sku has therapeutic_area as a STRING attribute that should reference the therapeutic_area master table for standardized classification.

attributes.name: trademark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.trademark. Business justification: Each market SKU is sold under trademark protection. Essential for commercial operations, brand enforcement, market-specific trademark registration tracking, and anti-counterfeiting programs.

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the active ingredient. Used for therapeutic classification and pharmacoepidemiological research.

attributes.name: commercial_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU in the market. Active indicates commercially available; discontinued indicates no longer manufactured but may have remaining inventory; withdrawn indicates removed from market for safety or regulatory reasons.
attributes.references: ICH E2D - Post-Approval Safety Data Management

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule classification (I-V) for SKUs containing controlled substances. Non-controlled if not a controlled substance. Determines regulatory handling and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the list price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Aligns with the market country.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SKU was discontinued or withdrawn from the market. Null if the SKU is still active. Used for supply chain planning and pharmacovigilance reporting.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary distribution channel or customer segment for this SKU (e.g., retail pharmacy, hospital, specialty pharmacy). Impacts pricing, contracting, and supply chain routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|hospital|specialty_pharmacy|mail_order|clinic|government|veterinary — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form in which the drug product is presented (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, cream). Aligns with FDA dosage form terminology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|solution|suspension|injection|cream|ointment|patch|inhaler|suppository|powder|gel|emulsion|aerosol|implant|film|lozenge|spray — 18 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or United States Adopted Name (USAN) for the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in this SKU.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14) barcode identifier for the SKU. Used for supply chain tracking, point-of-sale scanning, and serialization compliance.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU record is currently active in the system. False if the record has been logically deleted or archived. Used for data filtering and reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the SKU master record. Used for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SKU was first made commercially available in the specified market. Used for lifecycle tracking and patent exclusivity calculations.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Manufacturer's suggested retail price or wholesale acquisition cost (WAC) for the SKU in the local currency. Used for pricing strategy, contracting, and financial planning.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA material master number uniquely identifying this SKU in the ERP system. Serves as the primary business identifier for procurement, manufacturing, and sales operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the SKU master record. Required for audit trail and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures

attributes.name: prescription_status
attributes.description: Regulatory classification indicating whether the SKU requires a prescription (Rx), is available over-the-counter (OTC), or has restricted access. Varies by market jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FDA - Prescription Drug Marketing Act, EMA - Legal Status for Supply

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SKU by regulatory and commercial category (e.g., branded innovator drug, generic, biosimilar, vaccine, OTC). Impacts regulatory pathway, pricing, and market access strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: branded|generic|biosimilar|vaccine|otc|medical_device_combination|orphan_drug — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA - Drug Categories, EMA - Product Classification

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Market-specific regulatory approval or authorization number (e.g., NDA number in US, MA number in EU, approval number in Japan). Links the SKU to its regulatory dossier.

attributes.name: reimbursement_code
attributes.description: Market-specific reimbursement or pricing code used by payers and health authorities (e.g., HCPCS code in US, PZN in Germany). Enables claims processing and market access.
attributes.references: CMS - HCPCS Coding, National Reimbursement Authorities

attributes.name: rems_program
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the FDA-mandated REMS program if applicable. Null if no REMS required. REMS programs impose additional safety requirements for high-risk products.
attributes.references: FDA - Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: Method by which the drug product is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical). Critical for prescribing and dispensing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|intravenous|intramuscular|subcutaneous|topical|transdermal|inhalation|rectal|ophthalmic|otic|nasal|sublingual|buccal — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: serialization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is subject to serialization and track-and-trace requirements under DSCSA (US), FMD (EU), or other regional regulations. True if unique serial numbers must be applied at unit level.
attributes.references: FDA DSCSA - Drug Supply Chain Security Act, EU FMD - Falsified Medicines Directive

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Potency or concentration of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the finished dosage form, including unit of measure (e.g., 500mg, 10mg/mL, 0.5%).
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Commercial brand name or trade name under which the SKU is marketed and sold. May differ by market or therapeutic indication.

products.name: product_ndc_code
products.description: National Drug Code (NDC) registry record for each FDA-listed drug product. Captures the 10-digit NDC number (labeler, product, package segments), FDA listing status, listing date, application number linkage (NDA/ANDA/BLA), proprietary name, non-proprietary name, and DEA schedule. Serves as the authoritative NDC-to-product mapping for regulatory compliance, dispensing, and reimbursement.

attributes.name: product_ndc_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NDC registry record. Primary key for the product NDC code entity.

attributes.name: inn_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: NDC codes map to INN for drug classification, interoperability (HL7, FHIR), data exchange (FDA SPL). Replaces denormalized inn_name with FK to INN registry for standardized substance identification, t

attributes.name: labeler_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: NDC labeler code must map to legal entity for FDA establishment registration, labeling compliance, product listing. Replaces denormalized labeler_name with FK for regulatory reporting (FDA SPL submiss

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the master product entity in the product domain. Links the NDC record to the internal product catalog.

attributes.name: packaging_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Business justification: NDC codes are assigned to specific packaging configurations in the FDA listing system. The package_description, package_quantity, and package_unit on product_ndc_code should reference the packaging_co

attributes.name: active_ingredient
attributes.description: The substance or substances in the drug product responsible for the therapeutic effect. May list multiple active ingredients for combination products.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207; ICH Q6A

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned application number for the drug product. Prefix indicates application type: NDA (New Drug Application), ANDA (Abbreviated New Drug Application for generics), or BLA (Biologics License Application).
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; 21 CFR Parts 314 and 601

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: The type of FDA regulatory application under which the drug product is approved: NDA (New Drug Application for new molecular entities), ANDA (Abbreviated New Drug Application for generics), BLA (Biologics License Application), or OTC (Over-The-Counter, no application required).
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Standards; 21 CFR Parts 314 and 601

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code that categorizes the drug according to the organ or system on which it acts and its therapeutic, pharmacological, and chemical properties.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NDC registry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification if the drug product contains a controlled substance. CI (Schedule I) through CV (Schedule V) indicate increasing levels of accepted medical use and decreasing abuse potential. Unscheduled indicates no controlled substance.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form of the drug product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream, patch). Describes how the drug is administered.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: labeler_code
attributes.description: The first segment of the NDC identifying the labeler (manufacturer, repackager, or distributor). Assigned by FDA to the firm that manufactures, repacks, or distributes the drug product.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NDC registry record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: listing_date
attributes.description: The date the drug product was first listed with the FDA National Drug Code Directory. Required for all marketed drug products.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: listing_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the FDA listing expires or was terminated. Null for active listings. Populated when a product is discontinued or delisted.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the NDC listing with FDA. Active indicates the product is currently marketed; inactive indicates listing is no longer active; discontinued indicates the product has been permanently removed from the market.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: marketing_end_date
attributes.description: The date the drug product was withdrawn from the market or discontinued. Null for products still being marketed.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: marketing_start_date
attributes.description: The date the drug product was first commercially marketed in the United States. This is the date the product became available for sale.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: ndc_number
attributes.description: The 10-digit or 11-digit FDA National Drug Code in standard format with hyphens separating labeler code, product code, and package code segments. This is the authoritative FDA-assigned identifier for the drug product.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: non_proprietary_name
attributes.description: The established or generic name of the drug product, typically the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) name. May be the INN (International Nonproprietary Name) or USAN (United States Adopted Name).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; WHO INN; USAN Council

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: The third segment of the NDC identifying the package size and type for the drug product.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The second segment of the NDC identifying the specific strength, dosage form, and formulation of the drug product for a particular firm.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The regulatory classification of the drug product indicating whether it is a prescription drug, over-the-counter (OTC) drug, biologic, vaccine, or plasma derivative.
attributes.value_regex: human prescription drug|human otc drug|human prescription drug|biologics|vaccine|plasma derivative
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: proprietary_name
attributes.description: The trademarked brand name under which the drug product is marketed. Also known as the trade name or brand name.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: reimbursement_code
attributes.description: The code used for insurance reimbursement and billing purposes, often the 11-digit NDC format required by CMS and payers.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, subcutaneous, intramuscular).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: rx_otc_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug product requires a prescription (Rx) or is available over-the-counter (OTC) without a prescription.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The concentration or potency of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the drug product, including unit of measure (e.g., 500mg, 10mg/mL, 0.5%).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: therapeutic_equivalence_code
attributes.description: The FDA Orange Book therapeutic equivalence code indicating whether the drug product is therapeutically equivalent to other pharmaceutically equivalent products. Codes starting with A are considered therapeutically equivalent; codes starting with B are not.

attributes.name: usan_name
attributes.description: The United States Adopted Name for the active pharmaceutical ingredient. This is the official generic name used in the United States, often aligned with the INN.

products.name: lifecycle
products.description: Tracks the lifecycle stage and status transitions of a medicinal product from discovery through post-market, including pipeline stage (discovery, preclinical, Phase I/II/III, NDA/BLA submission, approved, launched, LOE, discontinued). Captures stage entry date, exit date, milestone events, responsible team, and lifecycle gate criteria. Provides the authoritative product lifecycle timeline referenced by portfolio planning and regulatory domains.
products.reference: ICH M4 / FDA Drug Development Lifecycle

attributes.name: lifecycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product lifecycle record. Primary key for tracking lifecycle stage transitions of a medicinal product from discovery through post-market discontinuation.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Product lifecycle stage transitions (discovery→development→launch→maturity) drive budget allocation and reforecasting in pharmaceutical portfolio management. This link enables tracking budget consumpt

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the medicinal product (Drug Product, Drug Substance, Finished Dosage Form, or SKU) whose lifecycle is being tracked. Links to the authoritative product master catalog.

attributes.name: program_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Program manager accountability for milestone tracking, gate reviews, resource allocation, and cross-functional coordination. Currently stored as plain text; FK enables portfolio reporting, workload an

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_risk_register. Business justification: Lifecycle stages (development, launch, post-market surveillance, discontinuation) have distinct compliance risk profiles (trial fraud in development, promotional compliance at launch, pharmacovigilanc

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: product_lifecycle has therapeutic_area as a STRING attribute that should reference the therapeutic_area master table for standardized classification.

attributes.name: actual_launch_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the product was commercially launched in the primary market. Null for products not yet launched. Used to calculate time-to-market and compare against target launch date.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, notes, or commentary regarding the lifecycle stage transition, gate review outcomes, or strategic considerations. Supports audit trail and knowledge management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was formally discontinued from development or withdrawn from the market. Null for active products. Used for portfolio attrition analysis and lessons learned.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Shortages Database; EMA Withdrawal Procedures; Internal Portfolio Management Standards

attributes.name: discontinuation_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for product discontinuation or development termination. Critical for portfolio risk analysis and strategic decision-making on future investments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety_concerns|efficacy_failure|commercial_viability|strategic_portfolio_decision|manufacturing_issues|regulatory_rejection|competitive_landscape — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E2F Development Safety Update Report; Internal Portfolio Review Standards

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory exclusivity periods (e.g., data exclusivity, market exclusivity, orphan exclusivity) expire. May differ from patent expiry and provides additional market protection.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; 21 CFR 314.108; EMA Regulatory Exclusivity Guidelines

attributes.name: gate_criteria_met
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether all predefined gate criteria for the current lifecycle stage have been successfully met. Used in stage-gate governance processes to authorize progression to next stage.
attributes.references: Internal Stage-Gate Governance Framework; Portfolio Management Standards

attributes.name: gate_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision outcome from the gate review committee. 'Go' authorizes progression, 'conditional_go' requires specific actions, 'hold' pauses development, 'kill' terminates the program, 'recycle' returns to previous stage for additional work.
attributes.references: Internal Stage-Gate Governance Framework; Portfolio Management Standards

attributes.name: gate_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal gate review was conducted to assess readiness for stage transition. Part of the governance process ensuring disciplined portfolio management.

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: Specific disease, condition, or medical indication that the product is being developed or marketed to treat. May evolve as new indications are pursued through lifecycle management strategies.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; EMA European Public Assessment Reports; INN WHO Drug Information

attributes.name: investment_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative investment amount (in USD) spent on the product from inception through the current lifecycle stage. Includes R&D costs, clinical trial expenses, regulatory submission costs, and manufacturing setup. Used for ROI analysis and portfolio valuation.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Reporting Standards; R&D Capitalization Policy per ASC 730

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lifecycle record is the current active record for the product. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis of lifecycle transitions.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status within the lifecycle stage. Distinguishes between active progression, temporary holds, suspensions due to safety or regulatory issues, terminations, and completion of stage milestones.
attributes.references: ICH E8 General Considerations for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Clinical Holds

attributes.name: milestone_date
attributes.description: Date when the milestone event occurred. May differ from stage_entry_date if there is administrative lag between milestone achievement and formal stage transition recording.
attributes.references: ICH M4 Common Technical Document; Internal Portfolio Management Standards

attributes.name: milestone_event
attributes.description: Description of the key milestone event that triggered the current lifecycle stage transition (e.g., 'IND Submission Accepted', 'Phase III Primary Endpoint Met', 'FDA Approval Granted', 'Commercial Launch Completed'). Provides business context for stage changes.
attributes.references: ICH M4 Common Technical Document; FDA Guidance on Milestone Reporting

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this lifecycle record. Required for audit trail and accountability per 21 CFR Part 11 and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle record was last modified. Tracks data currency and supports change control processes required for GxP compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: next_planned_stage
attributes.description: The anticipated next lifecycle stage based on current development plans. Used for forward-looking portfolio planning and resource forecasting. May be null for discontinued or terminated products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discovery|preclinical|phase_i|phase_ii|phase_iii|nda_bla_submission|maa_submission|approved|launched|loe|discontinued — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: patent_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the primary patent protection expires, marking the beginning of loss of exclusivity (LOE) period. Critical for lifecycle management planning and generic competition forecasting.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; EMA Patent Register; WIPO Patent Database

attributes.name: previous_stage
attributes.description: The immediately preceding lifecycle stage before the current stage. Enables tracking of stage transitions and identification of products that have been moved backward (e.g., from Phase III back to Phase II due to protocol amendments). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discovery|preclinical|phase_i|phase_ii|phase_iii|nda_bla_submission|maa_submission|approved|launched|loe|discontinued — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: probability_of_success
attributes.description: Estimated probability (as percentage, 0.00 to 100.00) that the product will successfully progress through all remaining lifecycle stages to commercial launch. Based on historical success rates, clinical data, and competitive landscape. Used in risk-adjusted portfolio valuation (rNPV).
attributes.references: BIO Industry Analysis; Internal Portfolio Risk Assessment Framework

attributes.name: projected_peak_sales
attributes.description: Forecasted annual peak sales revenue (in USD) for the product at market maturity. Used for portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and commercial planning. Updated as market intelligence and clinical data evolve.
attributes.references: Internal Commercial Forecasting Standards; Market Access Planning Framework

attributes.name: regulatory_pathway
attributes.description: Regulatory approval pathway or designation assigned by health authorities (FDA, EMA, PMDA). Influences development timelines, data requirements, and commercial strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|fast_track|breakthrough|priority_review|accelerated_approval|orphan_drug|biosimilar|generic_505b2 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Fast Track, Breakthrough Therapy, Accelerated Approval Guidance; EMA PRIME Scheme; Orphan Drug Act

attributes.name: responsible_team
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the functional team or business unit responsible for managing the product during the current lifecycle stage (e.g., 'Discovery Biology', 'Clinical Development Oncology', 'Regulatory Affairs', 'Commercial Launch Team').

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the medicinal product in its development and commercial lifecycle. Tracks progression from early research through regulatory approval, market launch, loss of exclusivity (LOE), and eventual discontinuation. Critical for portfolio planning and resource allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discovery|preclinical|phase_i|phase_ii|phase_iii|nda_bla_submission|maa_submission|approved|launched|loe|discontinued — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH M4 Common Technical Document; FDA IND/NDA Process; EMA Marketing Authorization Procedures

attributes.name: stage_entry_date
attributes.description: Date when the product entered the current lifecycle stage. Used to calculate time-in-stage metrics and track development velocity against portfolio benchmarks.
attributes.references: ICH M4 Common Technical Document; Internal Portfolio Management Standards

attributes.name: stage_exit_date
attributes.description: Date when the product exited or is expected to exit the current lifecycle stage. Nullable for products still in active stage. Critical for forecasting and resource planning.
attributes.references: ICH M4 Common Technical Document; Internal Portfolio Management Standards

attributes.name: strategic_priority
attributes.description: Strategic importance ranking assigned by portfolio management based on alignment with corporate strategy, unmet medical need, commercial potential, and competitive positioning.

attributes.name: target_launch_date
attributes.description: Planned or forecasted commercial launch date for the product. Updated as development progresses and regulatory timelines become clearer. Critical for commercial planning and supply chain readiness.
attributes.references: Internal Portfolio Planning Standards; Commercial Launch Readiness Framework

products.name: regulatory_identifier
products.description: Unified catalog of regulatory product identifiers and listing codes assigned by health authorities across all jurisdictions. Captures NDA, ANDA, BLA, MAA, JNDA, EMA product numbers, PMDA approval numbers, NMPA registration numbers, and National Drug Codes (NDC — 10-digit labeler-product-package segments with FDA listing status, listing date, application number linkage, proprietary/non-proprietary names, and DEA schedule). Records identifier type, issuing authority, application number, approval date, approval status, jurisdiction, and listing metadata. Serves as the single source of truth for cross-jurisdiction regulatory identity, product listing, and dispensing/reimbursement code mapping for each drug product.

attributes.name: regulatory_identifier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory identifier record. Primary key.

attributes.name: country_id

attributes.name: mah_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Regulatory approvals (NDA, BLA, MAA) granted to specific legal entities (Marketing Authorization Holder). Critical for regulatory compliance, pharmacovigilance (ICSR case processing), regulatory intel

attributes.name: packaging_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: The regulatory application number associated with this identifier (e.g., IND number, NDA number, BLA number). Links the identifier to the original regulatory submission.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current regulatory approval status of the product under this identifier (e.g., Approved, Pending, Withdrawn, Suspended, Expired, Rejected).

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code assigned to the product for therapeutic categorization.

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.value_regex: Schedule I|Schedule II|Schedule III|Schedule IV|Schedule V|Non-Controlled

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The finished dosage form of the product as registered with the regulatory authority (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, suspension).
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiration_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: fast_track_designation

attributes.name: identifier_number
