attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency, PMDA - Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (Japan), NMPA - National Medical Products Administration (China)

attributes.name: identifier_type
attributes.description: The type or category of regulatory identifier (e.g., NDA for New Drug Application, ANDA for Abbreviated New Drug Application, BLA for Biologics License Application, MAA for Marketing Authorization Application, NDC for National Drug Code). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NDA|ANDA|BLA|MAA|JNDA|PMDA Approval Number|NMPA Registration Number|NDC|EMA Product Number|Other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency, PMDA - Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (Japan), NMPA - National Medical Products Administration (China)

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory health authority or governing body that issued this identifier (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA, WHO). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|NMPA|WHO|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency, MHRA - Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (UK), PMDA - Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (Japan), NMPA - National Medical Products Administration (China), WHO - World Health Organization

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this regulatory identifier record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: listing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product was officially listed with the regulatory authority under this identifier. Particularly relevant for NDC listings with FDA.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: The current listing status of the product with the regulatory authority (e.g., Active, Inactive, Discontinued). Indicates whether the product is currently marketed.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration

attributes.name: marketing_category
attributes.description: The marketing category or classification of the product as defined by the regulatory authority (e.g., NDA, ANDA, BLA, OTC Monograph).
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration

attributes.name: ndc_labeler_code
attributes.description: The labeler segment of the 10-digit NDC code, identifying the manufacturer or distributor. Applicable for US FDA NDC identifiers.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration (NDC)

attributes.name: ndc_package_code
attributes.description: The package segment of the 10-digit NDC code, identifying the package size and type. Applicable for US FDA NDC identifiers.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration (NDC)

attributes.name: ndc_product_code
attributes.description: The product segment of the 10-digit NDC code, identifying the specific strength, dosage form, and formulation. Applicable for US FDA NDC identifiers.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration (NDC)

attributes.name: non_proprietary_name
attributes.description: The generic or non-proprietary name of the product (e.g., INN - International Nonproprietary Name, USAN - United States Adopted Name) as registered with the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: WHO - World Health Organization (INN), USAN Council

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product has been granted orphan drug designation by the regulatory authority for treatment of rare diseases.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration (Orphan Drug Act), EMA - European Medicines Agency

attributes.name: priority_review_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product has been granted priority review designation by the regulatory authority to shorten the review timeline.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration

attributes.name: proprietary_name
attributes.description: The brand or trade name of the product as registered with the regulatory authority under this identifier.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency

attributes.name: rems_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy is required by the regulatory authority to ensure the benefits of the product outweigh its risks.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration (REMS)

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory approval or listing was last renewed with the health authority.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The route by which the product is administered as registered with the regulatory authority (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, topical).
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The strength or potency of the active pharmaceutical ingredient in the product as registered with the regulatory authority (e.g., 500mg, 10mg/mL).
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency

attributes.name: usan
attributes.description: The United States Adopted Name for the active pharmaceutical ingredient, assigned by the USAN Council.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product was withdrawn from the market or the regulatory identifier was revoked by the health authority.
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: The reason for withdrawal of the product or revocation of the regulatory identifier (e.g., safety concerns, commercial decision, regulatory non-compliance).
attributes.references: FDA - U.S. Food and Drug Administration, EMA - European Medicines Agency

products.name: indication
products.description: Association record linking a medicinal product to its approved or investigational therapeutic indications, capturing indication name, MedDRA preferred term, ICD-10 code, approval status by jurisdiction, approval date, patient population (adult, pediatric, geriatric), line of therapy, and label claim text. Tracks both approved and pipeline indications to support regulatory, medical affairs, and commercial strategies.

attributes.name: indication_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product-indication association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approval_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Indications approved per country/jurisdiction for labeling (country-specific claims), reimbursement (HTA submissions), medical affairs (country-specific medical information). Replaces denormalized app

attributes.name: atc_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: Indication-level ATC classification for therapeutic categorization, reimbursement coding (HTA submissions), pharmacoepidemiology studies, formulary management. Replaces denormalized atc_code string wi

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the medicinal product (Drug Product (DP), Drug Substance (DS), or Finished Dosage Form (FDF)) associated with this indication.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: product_indication has therapeutic_area as a STRING attribute that should reference the therapeutic_area master table for standardized classification.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority granted marketing authorization for this product-indication combination. Null for investigational or non-approved indications.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book, EMA Public Assessment Reports

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the product for this specific indication. Approved indicates marketing authorization granted; investigational indicates clinical trial phase; withdrawn indicates voluntary or regulatory removal; pending indicates under review; rejected indicates application denied; suspended indicates temporary hold.
attributes.references: FDA Approval Process, EMA Authorization Procedures

attributes.name: biomarker_requirement
attributes.description: Description of any required biomarker, genetic marker, or diagnostic test result that must be present for the patient to be eligible for this indication. Examples include specific gene mutations, protein expression levels, or companion diagnostic test results. Null if no biomarker requirement exists.
attributes.references: FDA Companion Diagnostics Guidance, EMA Personalized Medicine Guidelines

attributes.name: black_box_warning_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the product label contains a boxed warning (black box warning) for this indication, highlighting serious or life-threatening risks. True indicates boxed warning present; False indicates no boxed warning.

attributes.name: breakthrough_designation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this product-indication combination has received breakthrough therapy designation from FDA, indicating preliminary clinical evidence of substantial improvement over existing therapies for serious conditions. True indicates breakthrough designation granted; False indicates not designated.
attributes.references: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation, 21 CFR 312 Subpart E

attributes.name: clinical_trial_identifier
attributes.description: Primary clinical trial registry identifier for the pivotal study that supported approval of this product-indication combination. Format examples: NCT########, EUCTR####-######-##, ISRCTN########. Null for indications not yet in clinical trials or approved without trial data.
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov, EU Clinical Trials Register, WHO ICTRP

attributes.name: combination_partners
attributes.description: List or description of other drugs, biologics, or therapeutic modalities that are approved or recommended for use in combination with this product for this indication. Null if monotherapy or combination_therapy_flag is False.
attributes.references: FDA Prescribing Information, Clinical Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: combination_therapy_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this indication requires or recommends the product be used in combination with other therapeutic agents. True indicates combination therapy; False indicates monotherapy or therapy-agnostic indication.
attributes.references: FDA Combination Product Guidance, Clinical Trial Protocols

attributes.name: contraindication_summary
attributes.description: Summary of absolute contraindications or patient populations for whom this product-indication is not recommended or is prohibited due to safety concerns. Includes conditions, co-medications, or patient characteristics that preclude use.
attributes.references: FDA Prescribing Information Section 4, EMA SmPC Section 4.3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product-indication association record was first created in the master data system. Immutable audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR Article 5, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: disease_severity
attributes.description: The severity classification of the disease or condition for which this indication applies. Mild indicates minor symptoms; moderate indicates significant symptoms; severe indicates major impact on function; critical indicates immediate life risk; life_threatening indicates high mortality risk; not_applicable for preventive indications.
attributes.references: Clinical Trial Protocol Standards, Disease-Specific Severity Scales

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this product-indication association record became active and valid for operational use. Represents the start of the records validity period in the master data system.

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which regulatory market exclusivity protections expire for this product-indication combination. Exclusivity types include new chemical entity exclusivity, orphan drug exclusivity, pediatric exclusivity, or biologics exclusivity. Null if no exclusivity applies or has already expired.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book, FDA Purple Book, EMA Exclusivity Provisions

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this product-indication association record is no longer valid or active. Null indicates the record is currently active with no planned expiration. Used for temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: icd_10_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code
attributes.description: ICD-10 diagnosis code representing the disease or condition for which the product is indicated.

attributes.name: icd_10_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Description
attributes.description: Full text description of the ICD-10 code representing the disease or condition.

attributes.name: indication_name
attributes.description: The common or clinical name of the therapeutic indication or disease state that the product is approved or being investigated to treat.

attributes.name: indication_type
attributes.description: The therapeutic purpose or clinical use category of the product for this indication. Treatment is active disease management; prevention is disease avoidance; diagnosis is disease detection; prophylaxis is pre-exposure prevention; palliation is symptom relief; risk_reduction is lowering disease probability.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Guidelines, ICH M4 Common Technical Document

attributes.name: label_claim_text
attributes.description: The exact verbatim text from the approved product label or package insert describing the indication, including any limitations, patient population specifics, or conditional use statements. This is the regulatory-approved language for marketing and prescribing.
attributes.references: FDA Prescribing Information, EMA Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product-indication association record was most recently updated or modified. Updated with each change for audit trail and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR Article 5, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: line_of_therapy
attributes.description: The treatment sequence position in the therapeutic regimen for which this product is indicated. First-line is initial treatment; second/third/fourth-line are subsequent treatments after prior therapy failure; adjuvant is post-surgery; neoadjuvant is pre-surgery; maintenance is long-term disease control; salvage is rescue therapy; palliative is symptom management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: first_line|second_line|third_line|fourth_line_plus|adjuvant|neoadjuvant|maintenance|salvage|palliative — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCCN Guidelines, ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code
attributes.description: Eight-digit MedDRA Preferred Term code representing the standardized medical terminology for the indication.

attributes.name: meddra_pt_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Name
attributes.description: The MedDRA Preferred Term name corresponding to the MedDRA PT code for standardized indication classification.

attributes.name: orphan_designation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this product-indication combination has received orphan drug designation for a rare disease (typically affecting fewer than 200,000 patients in the US or fewer than 5 in 10,000 in the EU). True indicates orphan designation granted; False indicates not designated.
attributes.references: FDA Orphan Drug Act, EMA Orphan Regulation (EC) No 141/2000

attributes.name: patent_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the primary patent protection expires for this product-indication combination, after which generic or biosimilar competition may enter the market. Represents the latest expiring patent covering the indication. Null if no patent protection or already expired.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book, USPTO Patent Database, EPO Patent Register

attributes.name: patient_population
attributes.description: The age-based patient population segment for which this indication is approved or being studied. Adult typically 18-64 years; pediatric under 18 years; geriatric 65+ years; neonatal under 1 month; adolescent 12-17 years; all_ages indicates no age restriction.
attributes.references: ICH E11 Pediatric Guidelines, FDA Geriatric Guidance

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this product-indication association record in the master data system. Active indicates currently valid; inactive indicates no longer in use; pending indicates awaiting approval; superseded indicates replaced by newer record; withdrawn indicates removed from use.

attributes.name: rems_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether FDA requires a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy program for this product-indication to ensure benefits outweigh risks. REMS may include medication guides, communication plans, or restricted distribution. True indicates REMS required; False indicates no REMS.

products.name: labeling
products.description: Master record for the approved product label (prescribing information / SmPC / package insert) for each drug product by jurisdiction. Captures label version, effective date, label type (USPI, SmPC, PIL), regulatory approval reference, black box warning flag, REMS requirement flag, controlled substance schedule, and key label sections (indications, dosing, contraindications, warnings). Supports pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, and regulatory compliance.
products.reference: FDA Prescribing Information / EMA SmPC / 21 CFR 201

attributes.name: labeling_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product labeling record. Primary key for the product labeling entity.

attributes.name: compliance_capa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_capa. Business justification: Labeling deficiencies identified in FDA inspections (missing warnings, outdated safety information) trigger compliance CAPAs requiring label updates. Business links CAPA to specific label version to d

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Product labels country-specific for regulatory compliance (country-specific labeling requirements), language requirements, safety updates (country-specific label changes). Replaces denormalized jurisd

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug product for which this label applies. Links to the master product catalog.

attributes.name: inspection_observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection_observation. Business justification: Inspection observations frequently cite specific labeling deficiencies (Form 483: 'Product labeling lacks required pregnancy warning per 21 CFR 201.57'). Business links observation to exact label vers

attributes.name: label_id
attributes.description: Unique document identifier or reference number for the label file stored in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault document ID).
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM, Internal Document Management Standard

attributes.name: mah_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Product labels approved for specific legal entities (MAH) per jurisdiction. Required for regulatory compliance (label changes, safety updates), pharmacovigilance (labeling assessment for ICSRs), regul

attributes.name: orange_book_listing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.orange_book_listing. Business justification: FDA-approved labeling must align with Orange Book patent listings for Paragraph IV defense, generic competition monitoring, and regulatory compliance. Critical for patent-label consistency.

attributes.name: packaging_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Business justification: Product labeling is specific to a packaging configuration (different pack sizes may have different labels, especially for dosing instructions and NDC codes). The ndc_code on product_labeling should re

attributes.name: policy_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy_document. Business justification: Labeling review/approval workflows reference governing SOPs and policies. Pharmaceutical operations track which policy version (e.g., 'Labeling Review SOP v3.2') governed each label approval to demons

attributes.name: adverse_reactions_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Adverse Reactions section from the label, summarizing the most common and serious adverse events observed in clinical trials and post-marketing surveillance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority officially approved this label version.

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code for the drug product, used for international drug utilization research and statistics.

attributes.name: black_box_warning_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the label contains a black box warning (boxed warning) highlighting serious or life-threatening risks. True if present, False otherwise.

attributes.name: clinical_pharmacology_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Clinical Pharmacology section from the label, describing the mechanism of action (MOA), pharmacokinetics (PK), and pharmacodynamics (PD) of the drug product.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 201.57, EMA SmPC Section 5.1 and 5.2

attributes.name: contraindications_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Contraindications section from the label, listing situations where the drug product should not be used due to risk of harm.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance classification schedule if the drug product is a controlled substance. Schedule I through V indicate increasing levels of medical use and decreasing abuse potential. Not Controlled if the product is not a controlled substance.
attributes.value_regex: Schedule I|Schedule II|Schedule III|Schedule IV|Schedule V|Not Controlled

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product labeling record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dosage_administration_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Dosage and Administration section from the label, providing instructions on how to prescribe, prepare, and administer the drug product.

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form of the finished drug product as it is administered (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream). Follows FDA or EMA standard terms for dosage forms.
attributes.references: FDA Dosage Form Terminology, EMA EDQM Standard Terms

attributes.name: drug_interactions_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Drug Interactions section from the label, describing known interactions with other drugs, foods, or substances that may affect efficacy or safety.

attributes.name: ectd_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Sequence Number
attributes.description: The eCTD sequence number associated with the regulatory submission that included this label version. Used for tracking regulatory submission history.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this label version becomes effective and must be used for all product distribution and prescribing information.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Guidance, EMA QRD Template

attributes.name: established_name
attributes.description: The non-proprietary or generic name of the drug product, typically the International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or United States Adopted Name (USAN).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 299, WHO INN Programme, USAN Council

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this label version is superseded or no longer valid. Null if the label is currently active with no planned replacement.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Guidance, EMA QRD Template

attributes.name: indications_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Indications and Usage section from the label, describing the approved therapeutic uses and patient populations for the drug product.

attributes.name: label_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the label is written (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish, ja for Japanese).

attributes.name: label_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the label. Draft = under development, Submitted = filed with regulatory authority, Approved = authorized but not yet effective, Active = currently in use, Superseded = replaced by newer version, Withdrawn = removed from use.

attributes.name: label_type
attributes.description: Type of product label document. USPI = US Prescribing Information, SmPC = Summary of Product Characteristics (EU), PIL = Patient Information Leaflet, IFU = Instructions for Use.

attributes.name: label_version
attributes.description: Version number of the product label following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented with each regulatory update or revision.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Guidance, EMA QRD Template

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product labeling record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: pregnancy_category
attributes.description: Legacy FDA pregnancy category (A, B, C, D, X) for products approved before the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLR). Not Applicable for products approved after PLLR implementation.

attributes.name: proprietary_name
attributes.description: The brand or trade name under which the drug product is marketed. This is the commercial name used in labeling and promotion.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Official approval or authorization number issued by the regulatory authority for this label. Examples: NDA number (FDA), MAA number (EMA), PMDA approval number.

attributes.name: rems_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) program is required for this product as mandated by FDA. True if REMS is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug product is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, topical, inhalation). Follows FDA or EMA standard terms.
attributes.references: FDA Route of Administration Terminology, EMA EDQM Standard Terms

attributes.name: rx_otc_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product requires a prescription (Rx), is available over-the-counter (OTC), or is behind-the-counter (BTC) requiring pharmacist consultation.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The amount of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) per dosage unit, expressed with unit of measure (e.g., 500 mg, 10 mg/mL, 5%).

attributes.name: use_in_specific_populations_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Use in Specific Populations section from the label, providing information on use in pregnancy, lactation, pediatric, geriatric, and patients with renal or hepatic impairment.

attributes.name: warnings_precautions_text
attributes.description: Full text of the Warnings and Precautions section from the label, describing serious adverse reactions, potential safety hazards, and steps to prevent or manage them.

products.name: product_change_control
products.description: Transactional record capturing post-approval changes and variations to drug product registrations, including Type IA/IB/II variations (EMA), Prior Approval Supplements (PAS), Changes Being Effected (CBE-30/CBE-0), Annual Reports (FDA), and PMDA partial change applications. Captures change description, change category (CMC, labeling, safety, manufacturing site), affected markets, submission numbers, implementation date, health authority notification/approval status, and impact assessment on product quality, safety, and efficacy. Bridges regulatory affairs and quality change management workflows.
products.reference: FDA PAS/CBE/AR / EMA Variation Regulation (EC) No 1234/2008

attributes.name: product_change_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product change control record. Primary key.

attributes.name: comparability_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the comparability protocol used to assess whether the change maintains product comparability and does not adversely affect quality, safety, or efficacy.
attributes.references: ICH Q5E Comparability of Biotechnological/Biological Products, FDA Comparability Protocols Guidance

attributes.name: compliance_capa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_capa. Business justification: Product changes frequently implement regulatory commitments from inspection responses or warning letters. Business tracks which compliance CAPA (e.g., 'WL-2023-001 CAPA: Update manufacturing process')

attributes.name: inspection_response_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection_response. Business justification: Inspection responses commit to specific product changes (process improvements, specification tightening, equipment upgrades). Business tracks which change control implements which inspection commitmen

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product affected by this change control. Links to the master product catalog.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing site affected by or implementing this change. Relevant for manufacturing site changes, process modifications, or equipment updates.
attributes.references: GMP Guidelines, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: affected_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic markets or regulatory jurisdictions affected by this change (e.g., USA, EU, JPN, CHN). Supports multi-market change coordination and regulatory strategy.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the health authority officially approved the change. Null if pending approval or if approval is not required for the change type.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality assurance or regulatory affairs authority who approved the change control for implementation. Required for GMP compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, 21 CFR 211.22

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Business category of the change indicating the affected area. CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls), manufacturing site, labeling, safety update, specification change, packaging, stability protocol, process parameter, analytical method, or excipient modification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMC|Manufacturing Site|Labeling|Safety|Specification|Packaging|Stability|Process|Analytical Method|Excipient — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q12 Technical and Regulatory Considerations for Pharmaceutical Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the change control record, typically assigned by the Quality Management System (QMS) or Regulatory Information Management System (RIMS). Format: CC-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the proposed or implemented change, including rationale, scope, and technical details. Captures the business justification and scientific basis for the modification.

attributes.name: change_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the change control record within the regulatory and quality management workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Draft|Submitted|Under Review|Approved|Rejected|Implemented|Withdrawn|Closed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory change according to the applicable regulatory framework. Type IA/IB/II for EMA variations, PAS (Prior Approval Supplement), CBE (Changes Being Effected) for FDA, or Partial Change Application for PMDA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Type IA|Type IB|Type II|PAS|CBE-30|CBE-0|Annual Report|Partial Change Application|Major Variation|Minor Variation — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EMA Variation Regulation 1234/2008, FDA 21 CFR 314.70, PMDA Notification 0401022

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the change control record was formally closed after successful implementation and verification. Marks the completion of the change lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change control record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for regulatory compliance and data lineage.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting documentation stored in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault), including change control forms, technical reports, validation protocols, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GMP Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: ectd_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Sequence Number
attributes.description: eCTD sequence number assigned to the regulatory submission package for this change. Four-digit sequence number used for electronic submission tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the change becomes legally effective and binding for regulatory compliance purposes. May differ from implementation date based on regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: efficacy_impact_level
attributes.description: Assessed level of impact on product efficacy and therapeutic performance. High or Critical levels may require additional clinical data or bioequivalence studies.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials, ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management

attributes.name: health_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory health authority to which this change was submitted. FDA (US), EMA (EU), MHRA (UK), PMDA (Japan), NMPA (China), Health Canada, TGA (Australia), Swissmedic (Switzerland), ANVISA (Brazil), COFEPRIS (Mexico). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|NMPA|Health Canada|TGA|Swissmedic|ANVISA|COFEPRIS — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Comprehensive assessment of the changes impact on product quality, safety, efficacy, manufacturing process, supply chain, and regulatory compliance. Documents risk analysis and mitigation strategies.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Date when the approved change was or will be implemented in commercial manufacturing, distribution, or labeling. Critical for supply chain and manufacturing execution planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or department who initiated the change control request. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change control record was last modified. Supports audit trail, version control, and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory notification to the health authority is required for this change type. True if notification is mandatory, False if the change can be implemented without prior notification.

attributes.name: prior_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior approval from the health authority is required before implementing the change. True for PAS (Prior Approval Supplement) or Type II variations, False for CBE or Type IA/IB.

attributes.name: quality_impact_level
attributes.description: Assessed level of impact on product quality attributes (CQA - Critical Quality Attributes). Drives the rigor of validation and testing requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development, ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management

attributes.name: regulatory_commitment
attributes.description: Description of any commitments made to the health authority as part of the change approval, such as post-approval studies, annual reports, or specific monitoring activities.

attributes.name: safety_impact_level
attributes.description: Assessed level of impact on patient safety and product safety profile. High or Critical levels trigger additional pharmacovigilance and risk management activities.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management, ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management

attributes.name: stability_study_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether additional stability studies are required to support the change. True if new stability data must be generated to demonstrate product shelf-life is maintained.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the change control was officially submitted to the health authority for review and approval.

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Official regulatory submission identifier assigned by the health authority (e.g., FDA supplement number, EMA variation number, PMDA application number). May be null if not yet submitted.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 314, EMA Variation Regulation, PMDA Guidelines

attributes.name: validation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether process validation, analytical method validation, or computer system validation (CSV) is required to support this change. True if validation activities are mandatory.
attributes.references: FDA Process Validation Guidance, ICH Q2 Analytical Validation, 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: combination_product
products.description: Master record for combination products that combine a drug with a device, biologic, or another drug (e.g., auto-injectors, prefilled syringes, inhalers, transdermal patches, drug-eluting stents). Captures combination type (drug-device, drug-biologic, drug-drug-device), constituent parts with their respective regulatory classifications, primary mode of action (PMOA), lead center designation (CDER/CDRH/CBER), combination product agreement number, device constituent specifications (design history file reference, human factors study status), and cross-labeling requirements. Supports 21 CFR Part 4 compliance, regulatory strategy, and CMC documentation.
products.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 3 Combination Products / CDER/CDRH Jurisdiction

attributes.name: combination_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the combination product record. Primary key.

attributes.name: atc_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: Combination products classified by primary ATC (drug constituent) for regulatory categorization, market analysis, reimbursement. Replaces denormalized atc_code with FK to ATC master for combination pr

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: combination_product has drug_constituent_name, drug_constituent_classification, drug_constituent_strength, dosage_form, and route_of_administration that describe the drug component. This FK links the

attributes.name: mah_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Combination products require MAH tracking for regulatory submissions (lead center determination, cross-labeling), post-market surveillance (device/drug adverse events), GMP compliance (drug/device man

attributes.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.ndc_code. Business justification: Combination products assigned NDC for US market authorization (FDA product listing), distribution (supply chain), reimbursement (billing codes). Replaces denormalized ndc_code with FK to NDC master fo

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Drug-device combinations require integrated IP strategy across multiple patent families (drug, device, method). Essential for regulatory planning, commercial strategy, and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary manufacturing facility responsible for final assembly and release of the combination product.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: combination_product has therapeutic_area as a STRING attribute that should reference the therapeutic_area master table for standardized classification.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Unique agreement number issued by FDA Office of Combination Products documenting the regulatory pathway and lead center assignment.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the FDA approved the combination product for marketing in the United States.

attributes.name: biologic_constituent_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory status of the biologic constituent under BLA (Biologics License Application) or biosimilar pathway.

attributes.name: biologic_constituent_name
attributes.description: Name of the biological product component if the combination product includes a biologic (e.g., monoclonal antibody, vaccine antigen, cell therapy).

attributes.name: cmc_documentation_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chemistry Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) Documentation Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the CMC section of regulatory submissions documenting manufacturing processes, specifications, and controls for both drug and device constituents.

attributes.name: combination_product_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code assigned to the combination product for internal tracking and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: combination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the combination product based on constituent components (e.g., drug-device for auto-injectors, drug-biologic for antibody-drug conjugates).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the combination product record was first created in the master data system.

attributes.name: cross_labeling_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the combination product requires coordinated labeling across drug and device constituents to ensure consistent safety and efficacy information.

attributes.name: device_constituent_classification
attributes.description: FDA device classification and regulatory pathway for the device constituent (510k=premarket notification, PMA=premarket approval, De Novo=novel device classification).

attributes.name: device_constituent_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the device component of the combination product (e.g., auto-injector, prefilled syringe, transdermal patch delivery system, drug-eluting stent).

attributes.name: device_design_history_file_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the Design History File documenting the device constituent design, development, and verification activities per Quality System Regulation (QSR).

attributes.name: drug_constituent_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory status of the drug constituent (NDA=New Drug Application, ANDA=Abbreviated New Drug Application, BLA=Biologics License Application, IND=Investigational New Drug).

attributes.name: drug_constituent_name
attributes.description: Name of the drug substance or drug product component of the combination product, including Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) identification.

attributes.name: drug_constituent_strength
attributes.description: Quantitative composition of the drug constituent expressed with unit of measure (e.g., 50 mg, 0.3 mL of 1 mg/mL solution).

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current GMP compliance status for the combination product manufacturing operations based on FDA inspection outcomes.

attributes.name: human_factors_study_status
attributes.description: Status of human factors engineering and usability validation studies required for the device constituent to demonstrate safe and effective use by intended users.

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: FDA-approved indication statement describing the disease or condition the combination product is intended to treat, prevent, or diagnose.

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: WHO International Nonproprietary Name for the active pharmaceutical ingredient in the drug constituent.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the combination product record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: lead_center
attributes.description: FDA center assigned primary jurisdiction for premarket review and regulation (CDER=Center for Drug Evaluation and Research, CDRH=Center for Devices and Radiological Health, CBER=Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research).

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the combination product lifecycle from development through post-market surveillance.

attributes.name: primary_mode_of_action
attributes.description: The single mode of action that provides the most important therapeutic action of the combination product, used to determine lead center assignment.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial or proprietary name of the combination product as it appears on labeling and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: qbd_approach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the combination product was developed using Quality by Design principles with defined design space and control strategy.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned submission number for the combination product application (NDA, BLA, PMA, or 510k number).

attributes.name: rems_requirement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Requirement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the combination product is subject to a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy to ensure benefits outweigh risks.

attributes.name: rld_assignment_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Request for Lead Center Designation (RLD) Assignment Date
attributes.description: Date when the FDA assigned the lead center designation for this combination product following RLD submission.

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the combination product in months from date of manufacture, based on stability studies.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the combination product to maintain stability and efficacy (e.g., refrigerated 2-8°C, room temperature, protect from light).

attributes.name: usan_name
attributes.description: United States Adopted Name for the active pharmaceutical ingredient in the drug constituent.

products.name: therapeutic_area
products.description: Reference master for therapeutic areas (oncology, immunology, rare diseases, neuroscience, etc.) used to classify products, trials, and research programs

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the therapeutic area. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.gxp_obligation. Business justification: Certain GxP obligations are therapeutic-area-specific (pediatric investigation plan requirements for pediatric TAs, REMS programs for oncology, orphan drug annual reporting for rare diseases). Busines

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: Therapeutic areas are profit centers for P&L reporting (franchise-level financials), commercial performance tracking, segment reporting. Enables TA-level revenue/margin analysis, portfolio profitabili

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Therapeutic areas managed by specific organizational units (business units, franchises, therapeutic area heads) for portfolio management, resource allocation, budget planning, strategic decision-makin

attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this therapeutic area are typically eligible for accelerated approval based on surrogate or intermediate clinical endpoints.
attributes.references: FDA Accelerated Approval; 21 CFR 314 Subpart H; 21 CFR 601 Subpart E

attributes.name: area_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the therapeutic area (e.g., ONCO, IMMUNO, RARE). Used as business identifier across systems.

attributes.name: area_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the therapeutic area, including scope, disease categories, and clinical focus.

attributes.name: area_name
attributes.description: Full name of the therapeutic area (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Neuroscience, Cardiovascular).

attributes.name: atc_level_1_code
attributes.description: WHO ATC classification level 1 anatomical main group code (single letter: A-V). Maps therapeutic area to international classification standard.

attributes.name: atc_level_1_name
attributes.description: WHO ATC classification level 1 anatomical main group name (e.g., Alimentary Tract and Metabolism, Blood and Blood Forming Organs, Cardiovascular System).
attributes.references: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology - ATC Classification

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this therapeutic area are typically eligible for breakthrough therapy designation due to serious or life-threatening conditions with unmet medical need.
attributes.references: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation; EMA PRIME Scheme

attributes.name: business_unit_owner
attributes.description: Name of the business unit or division responsible for strategy, portfolio management, and commercial execution for this therapeutic area.

attributes.name: clinical_trial_complexity_level
attributes.description: Assessment of clinical trial design and execution complexity for this therapeutic area based on endpoint selection, patient recruitment challenges, and trial duration.

attributes.name: commercial_priority_level
attributes.description: Strategic priority level for commercial investment and market development in this therapeutic area.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_potential
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this therapeutic area have potential for abuse or dependence requiring Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) scheduling consideration.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this therapeutic area record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disease_category
attributes.description: Primary disease category or pathology focus within the therapeutic area (e.g., Solid Tumors, Hematologic Malignancies, Autoimmune Disorders, Genetic Disorders).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this therapeutic area classification became effective in the master data system.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this therapeutic area classification expires or is superseded. Null for currently active classifications.

attributes.name: fast_track_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this therapeutic area are typically eligible for fast track designation to facilitate development and expedite review of drugs for serious conditions with unmet medical need.
attributes.references: FDA Fast Track Designation; 21 CFR 312 Subpart E

attributes.name: global_market_size_usd_millions
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Market Size in United States Dollars (USD) Millions
