Captures administrable dose form, route of administration, unit of presentation, and reference to constituent active ingredients. Bridges drug_product (manufactured form) to clinical usage.

attributes.name: pharmaceutical_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmaceutical product record. Primary key for the administrable pharmaceutical product entity per IDMP ISO 11616 standard.

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufactured drug product from which this administrable pharmaceutical product is derived. Links to the manufactured form before administration preparation.

attributes.name: inn_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: Pharmaceutical products use INN for ingredient identification, prescribing systems (e-prescribing), clinical decision support. Replaces denormalized inn_name with FK to INN registry for standardized n

attributes.name: manufacturing_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Pharmaceutical product (administrable dose form) manufactured at specific plants for batch release, distribution planning, regulatory site registration. Complements manufacturing_site_id with masterda

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: For biosimilar products, reference to the originator biological product that this pharmaceutical product is biosimilar to. Used for regulatory and interchangeability assessment.
attributes.references: FDA Purple Book - Biosimilar and Interchangeable Products

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary manufacturing site responsible for producing this pharmaceutical product. Critical for supply chain traceability and quality investigations.

attributes.name: specified_substance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) or drug substance contained in this administrable pharmaceutical product. Links to the molecular entity responsible for therapeutic effect.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Pharmaceutical product concentration UOM for dosing (dose calculations), administration (infusion rates), labeling (concentration declaration). Replaces denormalized concentration_unit with FK to UOM

attributes.name: administrable_dose_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dose form of the product after any necessary preparation steps and as administered to the patient (e.g., solution for injection, powder for oral suspension, inhalation aerosol). Distinct from manufactured dose form.
attributes.references: ISO 11239 - IDMP Dose Forms, EMA SPOR RMS

attributes.name: administration_device
attributes.description: The medical device or delivery system used to administer the pharmaceutical product (e.g., pre-filled syringe, auto-injector, nebulizer, infusion pump, metered-dose inhaler). Relevant for combination products.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pharmaceutical product received regulatory approval from the health authority. Marks the beginning of the products commercial lifecycle.
attributes.references: FDA Approved Drug Products, EMA Medicines Database

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code indicating the therapeutic and pharmacological properties of the pharmaceutical product. Used for drug utilization studies and formulary management.

attributes.name: black_box_warning_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmaceutical product labeling includes a boxed warning (black box warning) for serious or life-threatening risks. The most serious FDA warning for prescription drugs.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 201.57 - Specific Requirements on Content and Format of Labeling

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmaceutical product requires cold chain (refrigerated or frozen) storage and distribution. Critical for logistics planning and temperature monitoring.
attributes.references: WHO Technical Report Series on Temperature-Sensitive Pharmaceutical Products

attributes.name: concentration_value
attributes.description: The numeric concentration of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the administrable product. Used in conjunction with concentration unit for precise dosing.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification if the pharmaceutical product contains a controlled substance. Determines regulatory requirements for prescribing, dispensing, and record-keeping.
attributes.value_regex: Schedule I|Schedule II|Schedule III|Schedule IV|Schedule V|Not Controlled
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 1308 - DEA Schedules of Controlled Substances

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pharmaceutical product record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

attributes.name: dosing_instructions
attributes.description: Standard dosing instructions for the administrable pharmaceutical product, including recommended dose, frequency, and duration. Derived from approved prescribing information.
attributes.references: FDA Prescribing Information Format, EMA SmPC

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_status
attributes.description: The current GMP compliance status of the pharmaceutical product and its manufacturing operations. Indicates whether the product meets current Good Manufacturing Practice requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, EU GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: indication_summary
attributes.description: A concise summary of the approved therapeutic indications for which this pharmaceutical product may be administered. Derived from approved product labeling.
attributes.references: FDA Approved Drug Products, EMA Product Information

attributes.name: interchangeability_status
attributes.description: For biological products, indicates whether the product has been designated as interchangeable with the reference product, allowing automatic substitution at the pharmacy level without prescriber intervention.
attributes.references: FDA Biosimilar and Interchangeable Products Guidance

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmaceutical product record is currently active in the system. Used for soft deletion and historical record management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pharmaceutical product record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the pharmaceutical product in the regulatory and commercial context. Indicates whether the product is actively marketed or has been withdrawn.

attributes.name: marketing_authorization_holder
attributes.description: The legal entity that holds the marketing authorization for the pharmaceutical product and is responsible for its quality, safety, and efficacy. Also known as the license holder or applicant.
attributes.references: EMA Guideline on Good Pharmacovigilance Practices, 21 CFR 314.80

attributes.name: pharmacopoeial_standard
attributes.description: The pharmacopoeial monograph or standard that the pharmaceutical product complies with (e.g., USP, EP, JP, BP). Defines quality specifications and test methods.

attributes.name: phpid_code
attributes.description: ISO 11616 compliant PhPID code uniquely identifying the administrable pharmaceutical product at the international level. Used for regulatory submissions and global product identification.

attributes.name: preparation_instructions
attributes.description: Instructions for preparing the pharmaceutical product for administration, including reconstitution, dilution, or mixing requirements. Critical for products requiring preparation before administration.

attributes.name: preservative_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the administrable pharmaceutical product is formulated without preservatives. Critical for products intended for intrathecal, intraocular, or neonatal use.
attributes.references: USP General Chapter <51> - Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The full name of the administrable pharmaceutical product as it would be described in clinical and regulatory contexts. Includes strength and administrable dose form.
attributes.references: ICH M8 - Electronic Common Technical Document

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: The regulatory approval number assigned by the health authority for this pharmaceutical product (e.g., NDA number, BLA number, MAA number). Links to the regulatory submission and approval documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book, FDA Purple Book, EMA Product Register

attributes.name: rems_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy is required by FDA for this pharmaceutical product due to serious safety concerns. Impacts distribution and prescribing requirements.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the pharmaceutical product is administered to the patient (e.g., intravenous, oral, subcutaneous, intramuscular, topical, inhalation). Critical for clinical usage and safety.
attributes.references: ISO 11239 - IDMP Routes of Administration, FDA CDER Data Standards Manual

attributes.name: shelf_life_after_preparation_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Shelf Life After Preparation in Hours
attributes.description: The maximum time in hours that the pharmaceutical product remains stable and safe for administration after preparation (reconstitution, dilution, or opening). Critical for hospital pharmacy and clinical administration.

attributes.name: sterility_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates the sterility requirement for the administrable pharmaceutical product. Sterile products are required for parenteral, ophthalmic, and certain other routes of administration.
attributes.references: USP General Chapter <71> - Sterility Tests, EU GMP Annex 1

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: The required storage conditions for the administrable pharmaceutical product to maintain stability and efficacy (e.g., store at 2-8°C, protect from light, store at controlled room temperature). Critical for supply chain and pharmacy operations.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

attributes.name: target_patient_population
attributes.description: Description of the intended patient population for this administrable pharmaceutical product, including age groups, disease stage, and any specific patient characteristics (e.g., adult patients with metastatic disease, pediatric patients 2 years and older).
attributes.references: ICH E11 - Clinical Investigation of Medicinal Products in the Pediatric Population

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The primary therapeutic area or disease category that this pharmaceutical product is indicated for (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Cardiovascular, Neurology, Rare Diseases).
attributes.references: ICH M1 - MedDRA Therapeutic Area Classification

attributes.name: total_volume_ml
attributes.description: The total volume of the administrable pharmaceutical product in milliliters, applicable to liquid dose forms. Used for dose calculation and administration instructions.
attributes.references: USP General Chapter <1> - Units of Measurement

attributes.name: unit_of_presentation
attributes.description: The discrete unit in which the pharmaceutical product is presented for administration (e.g., vial, syringe, tablet, capsule, ampoule, inhaler). Represents the smallest administrable unit.

attributes.name: parent_pharmaceutical_product_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on pharmaceutical_product (parent_pharmaceutical_product_id)

products.name: specified_substance
products.description: IDMP ISO 11238 entity representing a substance with a specified level of detail including strength, reference strength, and substance role (active, excipient). Links formulation_ingredient to the global substance reference and enables precise regulatory substance identification per IDMP requirements.

attributes.name: specified_substance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specified substance record. Primary key for this entity representing an IDMP ISO 11238 substance with specified detail level.
attributes.references: ISO 11238 - Identification of Medicinal Products (IDMP) Substance

attributes.name: formulation_ingredient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulation ingredient that this specified substance represents. Links to the ingredient within a specific formulation context.

attributes.name: primary_specified_drug_substance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the global substance master record. Links this specified substance to the authoritative substance definition in the substance registry.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Specified substance strength UOM for substance specifications (IDMP), regulatory data exchange (substance strength representation). Replaces denormalized strength_unit with FK to UOM master for standa

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: The change control or deviation number associated with the creation or modification of this specified substance record. Links to the formal change management process.

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for concentration. Common units include mg/mL, g/L, % w/v, % w/w, molarity (M), or other pharmacopoeial concentration units.

attributes.name: concentration_value
attributes.description: The concentration of the substance in solution or suspension formulations. Represents the amount of substance per unit volume or weight of formulation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this specified substance record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record creation tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this specified substance definition becomes effective and valid for use in formulations and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this specified substance definition is no longer valid or has been superseded by a newer version. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: grade
attributes.description: The quality grade or compendial standard of the substance. Examples include USP, EP, JP, BP, or in-house specification grade. Indicates the purity and quality standard applied.
attributes.references: ISO 11238 - IDMP Substance, USP, EP, JP

attributes.name: idmp_substance_code
attributes.description: The globally unique IDMP substance identifier assigned per ISO 11238 standards. Used for international regulatory submissions and substance harmonization across health authorities.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this specified substance record is currently active and available for use in formulations. True indicates active, False indicates inactive or archived.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this specified substance record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the specified substance record. Indicates whether the record is actively used, inactive, obsolete, or under review for changes.

attributes.name: manufacturer_substance_code
attributes.description: The manufacturer-specific internal code or catalog number for this specified substance. Used for procurement, quality control, and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: molecular_formula
attributes.description: The chemical molecular formula of the specified substance. Represents the elemental composition including any salt, solvate, or hydrate components.

attributes.name: molecular_weight
attributes.description: The molecular weight of the specified substance in Daltons or g/mol. Includes the weight of any salt, solvate, or hydrate components.

attributes.name: optical_activity
attributes.description: The stereochemical configuration or optical activity of the substance. Indicates whether the substance is a specific enantiomer, racemate, or other stereoisomeric form (e.g., R, S, (+), (-), racemic).

attributes.name: polymorphic_form
attributes.description: The specific polymorphic or crystalline form of the substance. Polymorphism can significantly impact solubility, stability, and bioavailability. Examples include Form I, Form II, amorphous.

attributes.name: purity_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum purity percentage of the specified substance as defined in the specification. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 98.5 for 98.5% purity).

attributes.name: reference_strength_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the reference strength value. Typically represents the base or active moiety unit when different from the administered substance unit.

attributes.name: reference_strength_value
attributes.description: The numeric quantity expressed as reference strength. Used when the active moiety differs from the administered form (e.g., salt vs base). Enables standardized strength comparison across different salt forms.
attributes.references: ISO 11238 - IDMP Substance, FDA Guidance on Strength

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: The current regulatory status of the specified substance in the context of its use in medicinal products. Indicates whether the substance is approved for commercial use, under investigation, or withdrawn.

attributes.name: salt_form
attributes.description: The specific salt form of the substance if applicable. Examples include hydrochloride, sodium, sulfate, mesylate. Critical for bioavailability and stability considerations.

attributes.name: solvate_type
attributes.description: The type of solvate if the substance exists as a solvate. Common examples include hydrate, ethanolate, or other solvent inclusion compounds.

attributes.name: specification_level
attributes.description: The level of detail at which the substance is specified. Indicates whether the substance is defined at molecular, salt, solvate, hydrate, polymorphic form, or mixture level per IDMP hierarchy.

attributes.name: specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the quality specification document that defines the acceptance criteria for this specified substance. Links to internal specification documents or compendial monographs.

attributes.name: stoichiometry
attributes.description: The stoichiometric ratio of components in the specified substance. Relevant for salts, solvates, hydrates, and co-crystals (e.g., 1:1, 2:1, monohydrate, hemihydrate).

attributes.name: strength_value
attributes.description: The numeric quantity of the substance expressed as strength. Represents the amount of active moiety or substance per unit dose or per unit of measure.

attributes.name: substance_code
attributes.description: The standardized code identifying the substance. May be an UNII code, CAS number, or other globally recognized substance identifier used for regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: substance_name
attributes.description: The official name of the substance at the specified level. May be INN, USAN, chemical name, or other standardized nomenclature depending on regulatory context.
attributes.references: ISO 11238 - IDMP Substance, WHO INN, USAN

attributes.name: substance_role
attributes.description: The functional role of the substance within the formulation. Indicates whether the substance is an active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), excipient, or other functional component per IDMP requirements.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of this specified substance definition. Incremented when specification details change, enabling change control and traceability.

attributes.name: parent_specified_substance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on specified_substance (parent_specified_substance_id)

products.name: prescription
products.description: This association product represents the prescription event between a medicinal product and a patient. It captures the commercial/post-market relationship where a specific medicinal product is prescribed to a specific patient, including prescriber information, dosage instructions, therapy timeline, adherence tracking, and discontinuation details. Each record represents one prescription instance linking one medicinal product to one patient with attributes that exist only in the context of this prescribing relationship. Distinct from clinical trial exposure (protocol-driven) and represents real-world evidence for patient support programs, adherence monitoring, and pharmacovigilance.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical commercial operations, patients routinely receive multiple medicinal products simultaneously (polypharmacy for chronic conditions, combination therapies) or sequentially (treatment switches, dose escalations), and each medicinal product is prescribed to thousands of patients across diverse indications and patient populations. Patient support programs, specialty pharmacies, and real-world evidence teams actively manage prescription-level records as operational entities, tracking adherence metrics, refill patterns, discontinuation reasons, and therapy outcomes for each patient-product combination. This is distinct from clinical trial exposure (which is protocol-mandated) and represents the post-market commercial relationship where prescription records are created, monitored, and analyzed as core business data.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this prescription record. Primary key for the prescription association.

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare provider who wrote this prescription. Used for prescriber network analysis and pharmacovigilance follow-up.

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the medicinal product that was prescribed

attributes.name: patient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the patient who received the prescription

attributes.name: adherence_score
attributes.description: Calculated adherence metric for this prescription (e.g., proportion of days covered, medication possession ratio). Used for patient support program interventions and real-world evidence studies.
attributes.references: PDC (Proportion of Days Covered) or MPR (Medication Possession Ratio)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prescription record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discontinuation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why this prescription was discontinued or stopped. Critical for pharmacovigilance signal detection and real-world effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: dosage_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text or structured dosage instructions specific to this prescription (e.g., '10mg twice daily with food'). Varies by patient based on indication, weight, comorbidities.

attributes.name: prescription_date
attributes.description: The date when the prescription was written by the prescribing physician. Critical for therapy timeline tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: prescription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this prescription. Used for patient support program workflow management and adherence intervention triggering.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether payer prior authorization was required for this prescription. Used for market access analytics and patient support program design.

attributes.name: refill_count
attributes.description: Number of refills dispensed for this prescription. Used for adherence monitoring and patient support program engagement tracking.

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prescription was dispensed through a specialty pharmacy channel. Relevant for high-cost biologics, oncology products, and products requiring special handling.

attributes.name: therapy_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the patient stopped taking the medicinal product. Used to calculate treatment duration and time-to-discontinuation for real-world evidence studies.

attributes.name: therapy_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the patient actually started taking the medicinal product. May differ from prescription_date due to prior authorization delays or patient decision timing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prescription record was last updated. Used for change data capture and incremental data pipeline processing.

products.name: formulary_listing
products.description: This association product represents the formulary listing relationship between drug_product and payer_account. It captures the specific terms under which a payer covers a drug product on their formulary, including tier placement, authorization requirements, rebate agreements, and coverage dates. Each record links one drug_product to one payer_account with attributes that exist only in the context of this payer-product coverage relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, each drug product is listed on multiple payer formularies (commercial plans, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, regional health plans), and each payer account maintains formularies covering hundreds to thousands of drug products. Market access teams actively manage these formulary listings as operational business entities, negotiating tier placement, rebate terms, and access restrictions for each drug-payer combination. The formulary listing is a recognized business concept with its own lifecycle, managed through P&T committee reviews, contract negotiations, and ongoing monitoring.

attributes.name: formulary_listing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this formulary listing record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the drug product that is listed on the payer's formulary

attributes.name: payer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the payer account whose formulary includes this drug product

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this formulary listing became or will become effective. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this formulary listing expires or was removed, if applicable. Supports tracking of historical formulary positions.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: Current status of the drug product on the payer's formulary. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: The tier placement assigned by the payer for this drug product on their formulary, determining patient cost-sharing and access restrictions. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) committee review of this drug product's formulary status.

attributes.name: listing_source
attributes.description: The source or mechanism through which this drug product was added to the payer's formulary.

attributes.name: medical_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the payer's medical policy or coverage criteria document that governs this drug product's coverage.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next P&T committee review of this drug product's formulary status.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer requires prior authorization for coverage of this drug product. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: quantity_limit
attributes.description: Any quantity limits or dispensing restrictions imposed by the payer for this drug product (e.g., '30 tablets per 30 days').

attributes.name: rebate_percentage
attributes.description: The negotiated rebate percentage that the manufacturer provides to the payer for this drug product. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer mandates step therapy (fail-first) protocols before covering this drug product.

products.name: approved_vendor
products.description: This association product represents the qualification and approval relationship between an excipient and a vendor authorized to supply it. It captures vendor-specific qualification status, audit history, compliance verification, and supply agreement terms that exist only in the context of this specific excipient-vendor pairing. Each record represents one approved source for one excipient.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical manufacturing, excipients are routinely multi-sourced from multiple qualified vendors to ensure supply continuity, manage risk, and meet regulatory requirements for alternative sources. Each excipient-vendor pairing requires independent qualification activities including site audits, sample testing, quality agreement execution, and ongoing compliance monitoring. The approved vendor list is an operational business entity actively managed by procurement and quality teams, with vendor-specific and material-specific attributes including qualification status, audit dates, pricing terms, lead times, and risk classifications.

attributes.name: approved_vendor_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the approved_vendor association

attributes.name: excipient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the excipient master record being sourced

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the qualified vendor authorized to supply this excipient

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor approval is currently active and available for procurement. Inactive approvals represent historical qualifications that are no longer valid.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor was approved to supply this specific excipient following successful qualification activities including site audit, sample testing, and quality agreement execution.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_status
attributes.description: GMP compliance status specific to this vendor's manufacturing site for this excipient. A vendor may have different compliance statuses for different materials manufactured at different sites.

attributes.name: inactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor approval was inactivated, if applicable. Inactivation may occur due to vendor disqualification, quality issues, business decisions, or vendor exit.

attributes.name: inactivation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for inactivating this vendor approval (e.g., Quality Issues, Vendor Exit, Cost, Strategic Sourcing Decision, Regulatory Non-Compliance).

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent on-site or remote audit conducted specifically for this vendor's capability to supply this excipient. Audit scope is material-specific and site-specific.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from purchase order issuance to material receipt for this excipient from this vendor. Lead time varies by vendor and material.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by this vendor for this excipient, typically expressed in kilograms or the standard unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next audit of this vendor for this excipient. Audit frequency is risk-based and may vary by material criticality and vendor performance history.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the preferred source for this excipient based on quality, cost, reliability, and strategic relationship. Multiple vendors may be qualified but only one is typically preferred.

attributes.name: price_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of this specific vendor for this specific excipient. Status is excipient-vendor specific and may differ from the vendor's overall qualification status.

attributes.name: quality_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Document control number or reference identifier for the Quality Agreement governing the supply of this excipient from this vendor. Each excipient-vendor combination typically has a specific quality agreement.

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Risk classification for this specific excipient-vendor combination based on material criticality, vendor performance, supply continuity, regulatory compliance, and alternative source availability.

attributes.name: standard_unit_price
attributes.description: Current standard unit price for this excipient from this vendor in the agreed currency. Price is vendor-specific and material-specific.

attributes.name: supplier_qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the excipient supplier based on quality audits, performance history, and GMP compliance. Determines procurement eligibility. [Moved from excipient: Qualification status is vendor-specific and excipient-specific, not a property of the excipient itself. The same excipient may have different qualification statuses with different vendors. This attribute belongs in the approved_vendor association as qualification_status.]

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for ordering and pricing this excipient from this vendor (e.g., KG, MT, LB).

products.name: product_payer_contract
products.description: This association product represents the commercial contract between a medicinal product and a payer account. It captures the negotiated terms, rebate agreements, formulary placement, and performance metrics that govern market access and reimbursement. Each record links one medicinal product to one payer account with contract-specific attributes including pricing terms, formulary tier, effective dates, and contract status. This is the operational SSOT for pharmaceutical market access contracting.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical commercial operations, each medicinal product is contracted with multiple payers (commercial insurers, Medicare Part D plans, Medicaid programs, PBMs, GPOs) simultaneously, and each payer maintains active contracts for hundreds to thousands of products in their formulary. The payer contract is a recognized operational entity managed by market access teams, with contract-specific attributes including rebate terms, formulary tier placement, utilization targets, and outcomes metrics that belong to neither the product nor the payer alone.

attributes.name: product_payer_contract_id
attributes.description: Primary key for product_payer_contract

attributes.name: contract_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal market access manager or account director responsible for managing this payer contract relationship.

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the medicinal product covered under this payer contract

attributes.name: payer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the payer organization that is party to this contract

attributes.name: payer_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this payer contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: base_rebate_pct
attributes.description: The baseline rebate percentage negotiated with this payer for this medicinal product, expressed as a percentage of WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost). Identified in detection phase as relationship data. Subject to confidentiality restrictions.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: External contract reference number or identifier used in legal documents and commercial systems. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this payer contract. Identified in detection phase as relationship data. Drives eligibility for claims adjudication and rebate processing.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commercial arrangement governing this payer relationship. Identified in detection phase as relationship data. Determines rebate structure, performance metrics, and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payer contract record was first created in the market access system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payer contract expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended or evergreen contract.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payer contract becomes effective and pricing/formulary terms take effect. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: The formulary tier placement negotiated for this medicinal product on this payers formulary. Identified in detection phase as relationship data. Drives patient out-of-pocket cost and utilization.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payer contract was last reviewed or renegotiated by the market access team.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next contract review or renegotiation cycle with this payer for this medicinal product.

attributes.name: outcomes_metric

products.name: kol_product_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the operational engagement relationship between a Key Opinion Leader and a medicinal product. It captures the specific role, engagement history, indication focus, and compliance-relevant data for each KOL-product pairing. Each record links one medical_kol_profile to one medicinal_product with attributes that exist only in the context of this therapeutic area engagement, advisory relationship, or clinical trial leadership role.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical medical affairs operations, Key Opinion Leaders engage with multiple medicinal products across their therapeutic expertise areas (e.g., an oncology KOL may serve on advisory boards for multiple cancer drugs), and each medicinal product has relationships with multiple KOLs for advisory boards, speaker bureaus, clinical trial leadership, and publication planning. The business actively manages these engagements as distinct operational entities with specific roles, engagement histories, indication focuses, and compliance-tracked transfer-of-value data.

attributes.name: kol_product_engagement_id

attributes.name: medical_kol_profile_id

attributes.name: advisory_role

attributes.name: clinical_trial_role

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: relationship_type

products.name: contract_pricing
products.description: This association product represents the commercial pricing contract between a medicinal product and an institutional contract account (GPO, IDN, hospital system, specialty pharmacy). It captures negotiated pricing terms, rebate structures, volume commitments, and contract periods that exist only in the context of this specific product-account relationship. Each record links one medicinal product to one contract account with pricing and terms that are unique to that combination. Supports contract pricing administration, rebate management, and institutional account management business processes.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical commercial operations, institutional contract accounts (GPOs, IDNs, hospital systems, specialty pharmacies) negotiate pricing agreements for multiple medicinal products, and each medicinal product has separate pricing contracts with multiple institutional accounts. The relationship represents a real operational business process: contract pricing administration and rebate management. Commercial teams actively create, negotiate, approve, and manage these contract pricing agreements as distinct business entities with product-account-specific terms.

attributes.name: contract_pricing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this contract pricing agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the institutional contract account that negotiated this pricing agreement

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the medicinal product covered under this contract pricing agreement

attributes.name: annual_volume_commitment
attributes.description: The total annual volume (in units) that the contract account has committed to purchase for this medicinal product. Used for rebate tier calculation and contract performance tracking.

attributes.name: contract_price
attributes.description: The negotiated unit price for this medicinal product under this contract account. This price is specific to the product-account combination and represents the contracted rate that overrides standard list pricing.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External contract reference number or agreement identifier used by the contract account or GPO. Used for contract reconciliation and customer communications.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this contract pricing agreement. Only Active contracts are used for pricing calculations in order processing and rebate accrual.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of commercial contract under which this pricing agreement was established. Different contract types have different negotiation processes, approval workflows, and rebate structures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this contract pricing agreement becomes effective. Pricing and rebate terms apply to purchases on or after this date.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this contract pricing agreement expires. After this date, standard pricing applies unless the contract is renewed. Supports contract renewal workflow and pricing administration.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: The formulary placement status of this medicinal product within the contract account's formulary. Preferred status typically corresponds to more favorable pricing and higher utilization.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity required for this medicinal product under this contract to qualify for the contracted pricing. Used in order validation and contract compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: rebate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rebate applicable to purchases of this medicinal product by this contract account. Rebates are typically paid quarterly or annually based on volume achievement.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: volume_tier
attributes.description: The volume commitment tier that this contract account has committed to for this medicinal product. Higher tiers typically correspond to larger volume commitments and more favorable pricing or rebate terms.

products.name: supply_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the supply relationship between a Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) and a manufacturing/packaging plant. It captures the multi-sourcing strategy for each SKU across the pharmaceutical manufacturing network, including primary and secondary supply designations, allocation percentages, lead times, and supply priority. Each record links one SKU to one plant with attributes that exist only in the context of this supply relationship. Critical for supply chain planning, available-to-promise (ATP) calculations, demand allocation during capacity constraints, and supply continuity management during plant shutdowns or regulatory events.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical supply chain operations, SKUs are routinely sourced from multiple manufacturing and packaging plants to ensure supply continuity, balance capacity utilization, and comply with regulatory requirements for multi-site approval. Each plant can produce multiple SKUs across different therapeutic areas and dosage forms. The business actively manages these supply allocations with plant-specific data including allocation percentages, primary/secondary designations, lead times, supply priority rankings, and regulatory approval status for each plant-SKU combination.

attributes.name: supply_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supply allocation record. Primary key for the association product.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the manufacturing or packaging plant providing supply. Part of the composite business key (sku_id, plant_id, effective_start_date).

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Stock Keeping Unit being supplied. Part of the composite business key (sku_id, plant_id, effective_start_date).

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total SKU demand allocated to this plant in the supply network. Used for demand planning and ATP calculations. Sum of allocation percentages across all plants for a given SKU should equal 100% for active allocations. Null if allocation is based on absolute capacity rather than percentage.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the maximum capacity metric (e.g., bottles, cartons, pallets, dosage units). Should align with SKU packaging configuration.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing cost per unit for producing this SKU at this plant. Varies by plant due to labor costs, efficiency, scale, and local regulations. Used for supply network optimization and make-vs-buy decisions. Null if cost is managed at aggregate level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supply allocation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost per unit (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF). Required when cost_per_unit is populated.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply allocation ceases to be effective. Null for currently active allocations. Used to track supply network changes due to plant shutdowns, capacity reallocation, regulatory events, or strategic manufacturing network optimization.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply allocation becomes effective. Part of the composite business key enabling temporal tracking of supply network changes. Used for supply continuity planning and historical analysis of manufacturing network evolution.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply allocation record is currently active in the system. False if the record has been logically deleted or superseded. Used for filtering current supply network configuration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the supply allocation record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to product availability for this SKU from this specific plant. Varies by plant due to manufacturing batch cycles, packaging capacity, and logistics. Used for ATP calculations, order promising, and supply planning. Different from SKU-level lead time as it captures plant-specific manufacturing and logistics characteristics.

attributes.name: maximum_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum production or packaging capacity for this SKU at this plant, expressed in SKU units (e.g., bottles, cartons). Used for capacity planning, demand allocation, and ATP calculations. Null if capacity is managed at aggregate plant level rather than SKU level.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity for this SKU from this plant, driven by batch size constraints, packaging line minimums, or economic order quantities. Null if no minimum applies. Used in supply planning and order consolidation logic.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the supply allocation record. Required for audit compliance and change management.

attributes.name: primary_supply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plant is designated as the primary supply source for this SKU. True for primary plant, false for secondary/backup plants. Only one plant should be marked as primary for a given SKU at any point in time. Used for supply chain routing and prioritization decisions.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Regulatory approval status for manufacturing this SKU at this plant for the target market. Approved indicates regulatory authority has approved this plant-SKU combination. Pending indicates approval in process. Critical for ensuring only approved plants supply to regulated markets.

attributes.name: supply_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this plant in the supply network for this SKU. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest priority). Used during supply allocation decisions when demand exceeds capacity or when plants experience disruptions. Enables cascading supply logic in ATP and order promising systems.

attributes.name: supply_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this supply allocation. Active indicates currently supplying, Planned indicates future supply source, Suspended indicates temporary disruption (e.g., plant maintenance, regulatory hold), Discontinued indicates permanently ended. Used for supply availability checks and network planning.

products.name: drug_product_assay_specification
products.description: This association product represents the quality control testing specification between a drug product and an assay. It captures the regulatory and operational requirements for testing each drug product using specific assays. Each record links one drug product to one assay with attributes that define the testing protocol, acceptance criteria, and regulatory commitments that exist only in the context of this specific product-assay combination.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical quality control operations, a single drug product requires multiple assays for comprehensive testing (potency, purity, dissolution, stability, impurities, content uniformity), and a single validated assay is reused across multiple drug products (platform assays, compendial methods like USP dissolution). The business actively manages these specifications as regulatory commitments with product-specific acceptance criteria, testing frequencies, and validation protocols that cannot reside on either the assay or drug product alone.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Product Assay Specification - Drug Product Assay Specification Id

attributes.name: assay_purpose
attributes.description: The regulatory and operational purpose for which this assay is applied to this drug product. Determines when and how the assay is executed in the product lifecycle.

attributes.name: compendial_method_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assay is a pharmacopeial method (USP, EP, JP) applied to this product, which may have different validation and change control requirements than proprietary methods.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this specification record.

attributes.name: lower_specification_limit
attributes.description: Numeric lower bound of the acceptance range for computational validation and trending. Null if specification is qualitative or one-sided.

attributes.name: out_of_specification_procedure
attributes.description: Reference to the OOS investigation procedure or escalation path specific to this product-assay combination, which may vary by product criticality or regulatory risk.

attributes.name: regulatory_commitment
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory submission, approval letter, or commitment document that mandates this assay for this product (e.g., NDA 123456 Section 3.2.P.5.1, BLA approval letter dated 2022-03-15).

attributes.name: reportable_to_regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from this assay for this product must be included in annual reports, stability reports, or other regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The number of units or replicates required for this assay when testing this product, as defined in the validation protocol or regulatory commitment.

attributes.name: specification_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this specification became effective for batch release or stability testing. Critical for traceability when specifications change over product lifecycle.

attributes.name: specification_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this specification was superseded or retired. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: specification_limit
attributes.description: The acceptance criteria or specification range for this assay when applied to this drug product (e.g., 95.0-105.0% of label claim, NMT 2.0% RSD). Product-specific and may differ from assay platform defaults.

attributes.name: specification_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this specification record, enabling change control and audit trail when acceptance criteria or testing frequency are revised.

attributes.name: test_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which this assay must be performed on this drug product, driven by regulatory commitments, stability protocols, or risk-based testing strategies.

attributes.name: upper_specification_limit
attributes.description: Numeric upper bound of the acceptance range for computational validation and trending. Null if specification is qualitative or one-sided.

attributes.name: validation_protocol_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier for the validation protocol or report that qualifies this assay for use with this specific drug product.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: The current validation state of this assay specifically for this drug product. An assay may be validated for one product but require transfer or revalidation for another.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that created this specification record.

products.name: informed_consent
products.description: Unified consent lifecycle management covering clinical informed consent (ICF), re-consent events, consent withdrawals, and all data privacy authorizations. Clinical consent: ICF version, consent/withdrawal dates, consenting investigator, witness, method (paper, eConsent), language, sub-study consent flags (genetic, biomarker, future use). Privacy consent: GDPR Article 6/9 lawful basis, HIPAA authorization, consent purpose (data processing, research, marketing, data sharing), data subject rights requests (access, erasure, portability, rectification), request/fulfillment dates, jurisdiction (EU, US, UK, JP), consent channel (web, paper, verbal). Captures consent category (clinical_icf, re-consent, withdrawal, privacy_gdpr, privacy_hipaa, data_sharing), LAR/caregiver reference for pediatric populations, and full audit trail. Single source of truth for ALL consent types — clinical and privacy. Mandatory for GCP compliance, regulatory inspection readiness, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and data subject rights fulfillment.

products.name: clinical_observation
products.description: Consolidated clinical findings and measurements collected from participants across all observation categories. Covers laboratory results (LOINC-coded tests, specimen type, toxicity grade), vital signs (blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, weight, BMI, respiratory rate, SpO2), biomarker/genomic results (CDx, TMB, PD-L1, MSI, PGx panels, gene mutations), and clinical endpoint assessments (RECIST 1.1, iRECIST, DAS28, ECOG PS, Karnofsky). Captures measurement category, test/assessment name, coding (LOINC, assay type), specimen type, collection date/time, visit name, result value, result unit, reference range, out-of-range flag, toxicity grade (CTCAE), result interpretation, assessor, assessment method, laboratory/assay identifier, and delta-from-prior flag. Aligned with OMOP CDM measurement table and CDISC findings-class domains (LB, VS, MB, TR). Sourced from EDC (Medidata Rave), LIMS (LabWare), central labs, and molecular diagnostics vendors.

products.name: diagnosis

products.name: patient_enrollment2
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a patient and a patient support program (PSP). It captures the complete lifecycle of a patient's participation in a specific support program, including enrollment dates, eligibility verification, benefit tracking, and disenrollment. Each record links one patient to one support program with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific enrollment relationship. This is the operational record that enables tracking of copay assistance utilization, adherence monitoring participation, and program-specific patient outcomes.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical patient services operations, patients routinely enroll in multiple patient support programs simultaneously (e.g., copay assistance for one brand, adherence monitoring for another, nurse educator support for a third therapeutic area). Conversely, each support program serves thousands of patients concurrently. The enrollment relationship is a recognized operational business entity with its own lifecycle, managed actively by patient services teams, hub vendors, and specialty pharmacies.

products.name: registry_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment of a medicinal product in a patient registry for post-marketing surveillance, safety monitoring, or regulatory commitment fulfillment. It captures product-specific enrollment data including enrollment dates, treatment context, and outcome tracking. Each record links one medicinal product to one registry with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific product-registry enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical operations, medicinal products are enrolled in multiple patient registries simultaneously (e.g., a checkpoint inhibitor may be tracked in an oncology disease registry, a pregnancy exposure registry, and a REMS-mandated safety registry). Conversely, each registry monitors multiple medicinal products within its therapeutic scope (e.g., a rare disease registry tracks all approved therapies for that condition). Registry enrollment is an operational business process managed by pharmacovigilance and regulatory affairs teams, with specific enrollment dates, data collection protocols, and outcome tracking for each product-registry combination.

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: urban_rural_classification

products.name: sales_rep

attributes.name: sales_rep_id

attributes.name: budget_id

attributes.name: business_unit

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Veeva CRM

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country in which the sales representative operates (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, Sunshine Act applicability, and multi-country field force reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: first_name

attributes.name: gcp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sales representative holds a current Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification. Required for MSLs and reps supporting clinical trial site engagement or investigator-initiated study discussions. Sourced from the Learning Management System (LMS).

attributes.name: hcp_engagement_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the sales representative's HCP engagement level based on the complexity and strategic importance of their account portfolio. attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Official date on which the sales representative was hired by the organization, as recorded in the HR system of record (SAP S/4HANA). Used for tenure calculations, vesting schedules, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: job_title

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name of the sales representative as recorded in the HR system of record. Used for display, reporting, and identity verification.

attributes.name: product_certification_status

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: sample_authorization_status

attributes.name: state_province_code

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id

products.name: promo_material
products.description: Master catalog, content lifecycle, and MLR approval workflow for all promotional materials managed in Veeva PromoMats. Captures material ID, title, material type (detail aid, leave-behind, patient brochure, digital asset, journal ad, video), brand, indication, distribution channel, and current approval status. products.name: commercial_formulary_position
products.description: This association product represents the formulary placement contract between a pharmaceutical brand and a payer account. It captures the negotiated coverage terms, restrictions, and rebate arrangements that govern how the payer will cover the brand for its members. Each record links one brand to one payer account with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific formulary placement relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, each brand must secure formulary placement with multiple payers to ensure patient access across different health plans, and each payer maintains formularies covering hundreds of brands across therapeutic areas. The formulary position is an actively managed business entity where market access teams negotiate tier placement, utilization management restrictions, and rebate terms with each payer for each brand. This relationship has substantial relationship-specific data including tier, restrictions, rebates, and coverage dates that belong to neither the brand nor the payer alone.

products.name: brand_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the supply contract between a pharmaceutical brand and its approved vendors. It captures the qualification status, approved material categories, risk assessment, and spend allocation for each brand-vendor relationship. Each record links one brand to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this supply relationship, enabling supply chain risk management, multi-sourcing strategy, and procurement planning at the brand level.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical operations, brands require materials from multiple vendors across different categories (API suppliers, excipient suppliers, packaging vendors, CMOs), and vendors supply materials for multiple brands in their portfolio. Procurement teams actively manage brand-vendor supply agreements as operational entities, tracking qualification status, approved material categories, risk tier, and spend allocation for each brand-vendor pair. This is a core supply chain management process, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: medical_advisory_board_membership
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between Key Opinion Leaders and Medical Advisory Boards. It captures the formal appointment, participation terms, compensation arrangements, and engagement metrics for each KOL serving on each advisory board. Each record links one KOL to one advisory board with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific membership relationship, including role designation, tenure dates, honorarium details, meeting attendance tracking, and compliance documentation.. Existence Justification: Advisory board membership is a formally managed business relationship in pharmaceutical medical affairs. A single KOL can serve on multiple advisory boards simultaneously (e.g., an oncology KOL may sit on boards for different therapeutic indications or development programs), and each advisory board has multiple KOL members by design (typical member counts range from 8-15 experts). Medical affairs teams actively create, manage, and track these memberships with formal contracts, honoraria, meeting attendance, and compliance documentation.

products.name: congress_attendance
products.description: This association product represents the attendance event between MSL profiles and congress events. It captures the operational record of MSL deployment to medical and scientific congresses, including attendance logistics, engagement activities, and post-congress outcomes. Each record links one MSL to one congress with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific attendance instance.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical medical affairs operations, MSLs are deployed to multiple congresses throughout the year based on therapeutic area alignment, strategic importance, and territory coverage. Each congress hosts multiple MSLs from the same organization performing different roles (presenters, booth staff, attendees). Congress attendance is an actively managed operational process involving planning, approval workflows, budget allocation, logistics coordination, and post-event reporting. The business explicitly tracks attendance as a distinct entity with its own lifecycle and attributes.
