attributes.name: review_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the types of materials, studies, or activities that fall within the committee's review authority, such as investigator-initiated trials (IIT), investigator-sponsored studies (ISS), publications, medical information responses, or real-world evidence (RWE) studies.

attributes.name: secretary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the committee secretary for administrative communications and meeting coordination.

attributes.name: secretary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual serving as the secretary of the review committee, responsible for maintaining meeting minutes and administrative support.

attributes.name: standard_review_turnaround_days
attributes.description: Target number of business days for the committee to complete a standard review and provide a decision or recommendation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the review committee in its lifecycle. Active committees are fully operational, inactive committees are temporarily not meeting, suspended committees have paused operations, dissolved committees have been permanently closed, and pending formation committees are being established.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area of focus for the review committee, aligned with the organization's core business processes.

attributes.name: total_member_count
attributes.description: Current total number of active members serving on the review committee.

attributes.name: veeva_medcomms_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the committee is integrated with Veeva MedComms system for managing medical communications, publication planning, and scientific content.

attributes.name: voting_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of affirmative votes required for a motion or decision to pass within the committee, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 66.67 for two-thirds majority).

attributes.name: parent_review_committee_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on review_committee (parent_review_committee_id)

domains.name: market
domains.description: Coordinates market access, pricing, reimbursement, and payer relations. Manages formulary positioning, health technology assessment (HTA) submissions, value dossiers, contracting with payers, pharmacy benefit managers (PBM), and group purchasing organizations (GPO). Tracks reimbursement policies, coverage decisions, patient access programs, copay assistance, and gross-to-net revenue management. Owns RWE and RWD assets used for payer negotiations.
domains.references: AMCP Format / ISPOR Guidelines / HTA Body Requirements

products.name: access_strategy
products.description: Master record defining the market access strategy for a pharmaceutical product in a given geography or payer segment. Captures overarching access objectives, value proposition, target formulary tier, reimbursement pathway, HTA strategy, launch sequencing plan, identified access barriers with severity and remediation actions, key access milestones with planned and actual dates, and milestone status tracking. Serves as the strategic anchor for all downstream access activities including HTA submissions, payer contracting, patient support programs, and systematic access gap management.

attributes.name: access_strategy_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the market access strategy record. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Access strategies require budget allocation for HTA submissions, RWE studies, patient support programs, and payer engagement activities. Market access teams must track spend against approved budgets f

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Access strategies are country-specific, requiring regulatory authority names, HTA body details, reimbursement frameworks, and market access tier classifications for strategic planning and submission p

attributes.name: exclusivity_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: Access strategies depend on regulatory exclusivity (orphan, pediatric, data) to determine market entry barriers, competitive landscape, and reimbursement positioning. Exclusivity periods directly info

attributes.name: indication_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific therapeutic indication or disease area for which this access strategy applies, enabling indication-level access differentiation.

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hcp.hcp_master. Business justification: Access strategies target specific KOL physicians for advocacy, advisory boards, and peer influence. Market access teams identify and engage key physicians to support formulary positioning and HTA subm

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product (drug product or biologic) for which this market access strategy is defined.

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Access strategies must reference patent protection to align launch timing with exclusivity windows, inform pricing negotiations, and plan LOE transitions. Market access teams require patent expiry dat

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Market access strategies must operate within compliance programs governing promotional activities, transparency reporting (Sunshine Act/EFPIA), and anti-kickback rules. Compliance oversight is mandato

attributes.name: access_barrier_severity
attributes.description: Overall severity rating of the identified access barriers for this strategy: low (minor hurdles), medium (manageable barriers), high (significant barriers requiring targeted remediation), or critical (barriers that may prevent market access).

attributes.name: access_barrier_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the primary identified access barriers for this product in the target geography and payer segment (e.g., lack of comparative clinical evidence, high ICER, step therapy requirements, prior authorization burden). Confidential strategic content.

attributes.name: access_objective
attributes.description: Overarching strategic access objective statement for this product in the target geography and payer segment (e.g., 'Achieve preferred formulary tier 1 placement in 80% of commercial plans within 12 months of launch'). Confidential strategic business information.

attributes.name: actual_launch_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the product was commercially launched in the specified geography and payer segment. Compared against planned_launch_date to measure launch execution performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Health Cloud

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this market access strategy was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from under_review to approved lifecycle status.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault QualityDocs; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the senior leader (e.g., VP Market Access, Chief Commercial Officer) who formally approved this access strategy.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault QualityDocs; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX

attributes.name: copay_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a copay assistance or copay card program is included in this access strategy to reduce patient out-of-pocket costs and improve commercial insurance access.
attributes.references: CMS Anti-Kickback Statute Safe Harbors; OIG Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market access strategy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 and SOX requirements.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this market access strategy becomes operative and binding for downstream access activities including HTA submissions, payer contracting, and patient support programs.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this market access strategy expires or is superseded. Nullable for open-ended strategies. Used to manage strategy lifecycle and trigger renewal workflows.

attributes.name: gross_to_net_target_pct
attributes.description: Target gross-to-net revenue reduction percentage for this access strategy, representing the expected aggregate discount, rebate, and allowance burden relative to gross list price. Critical for P&L planning and net revenue forecasting. Confidential financial data.

attributes.name: heor_study_plan
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Study Plan
attributes.description: Summary of the Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) study plan, including cost-effectiveness models, budget impact analyses, and quality-of-life studies planned to support payer value dossiers and HTA submissions. Confidential strategic content.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; NICE Methods Guide; EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282

attributes.name: hta_body_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary HTA body responsible for evaluating this product in the target geography (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, PBAC, CADTH, AIFA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NICE|G-BA|HAS|PBAC|CADTH|AIFA|SMC|NCPE|TLV|ZIN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; ISPOR HTA Compendium

attributes.name: hta_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the HTA review by the primary HTA body: pending (under review), positive (recommended), positive_with_restriction (recommended with clinical/population restrictions), negative (not recommended), withdrawn (submission withdrawn), or not_applicable.
attributes.references: NICE Technology Appraisal; G-BA AMNOG; EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282

attributes.name: hta_strategy
attributes.description: Description of the Health Technology Assessment (HTA) strategy including target HTA bodies (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, PBAC), submission sequencing, evidence package approach, and comparator selection rationale. Confidential strategic content.
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; NICE STA Process; G-BA AMNOG; HAS; PBAC

attributes.name: hta_submission_actual_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Technology Assessment (HTA) Submission Actual Date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the HTA dossier was submitted to the primary HTA body. Compared against hta_submission_planned_date to track submission timeliness.
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; NICE STA Process; G-BA AMNOG

attributes.name: hta_submission_planned_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Technology Assessment (HTA) Submission Planned Date
attributes.description: Planned date for submission of the HTA dossier or value dossier to the primary HTA body. Used for launch sequencing and access readiness milestone tracking.
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; NICE STA Process; G-BA AMNOG

attributes.name: icer_threshold_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio (ICER) Willingness-to-Pay Threshold Amount
attributes.description: Payer or HTA body willingness-to-pay threshold per quality-adjusted life year (QALY) or other health outcome unit in the target geography. Used to assess pricing headroom and value-based pricing strategy. Confidential strategic financial data.
attributes.references: NICE Methods Guide; ICER Value Assessment Framework; EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282

attributes.name: icer_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the ICER willingness-to-pay threshold applicable in the target geography (e.g., GBP for NICE, EUR for G-BA/HAS, USD for ICER US).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NICE Methods Guide; ICER Value Assessment Framework

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the access strategy document: draft (being authored), under_review (in approval workflow), approved (signed off), active (being executed), on_hold (paused), superseded (replaced by a newer version), or retired (no longer applicable). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|active|on_hold|superseded|retired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: list_price_amount
attributes.description: Gross list price (WAC — Wholesale Acquisition Cost in the US, or equivalent list price in other geographies) for the product in the target geography. Confidential commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CMS Drug Pricing Transparency; EU Transparency Directive 89/105/EEC

attributes.name: list_price_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the gross list price of the product in the target geography (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: patient_support_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a patient support program (copay assistance, patient assistance program, hub services) is included as a component of this access strategy to improve patient access and adherence.
attributes.references: CMS Anti-Kickback Statute Safe Harbors; HIPAA; GDPR

attributes.name: payer_segment
attributes.description: Specific payer segment or channel targeted by this access strategy (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, VA/DoD, Private Insurance, NHS, Statutory Health Insurance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Commercial|Medicare Part D|Medicaid|VA/DoD|NHS|Statutory Health Insurance|Private Insurance|Integrated Delivery Network — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: planned_launch_date
attributes.description: Target date for commercial product launch in the specified geography and payer segment, as defined in the launch sequencing plan. Drives milestone planning and access readiness timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E3; FDA PDUFA; EMA Procedural Guidance

attributes.name: reimbursement_pathway
attributes.description: Regulatory and payer reimbursement pathway pursued for this product: standard (routine formulary review), accelerated (expedited review), managed_entry (conditional coverage), risk_sharing (payer-manufacturer risk agreement), outcomes_based (payment linked to clinical outcomes), named_patient, or compassionate_use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|accelerated|managed_entry|risk_sharing|outcomes_based|named_patient|compassionate_use — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; CMS Coverage Determination; NICE Technology Appraisal

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Description of planned remediation actions to address identified access barriers, including evidence generation plans, payer engagement activities, managed entry agreement negotiations, and patient support program design. Confidential strategic content.

attributes.name: rwe_rwd_plan
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real-World Evidence (RWE) and Real-World Data (RWD) Generation Plan
attributes.description: Description of the Real-World Evidence (RWE) and Real-World Data (RWD) generation plan supporting payer negotiations, HTA submissions, and outcomes-based contracting. Includes study designs, data sources, and timelines. Confidential strategic content.
attributes.references: FDA Real-World Evidence Framework (21st Century Cures Act); EMA RWE Framework; ISPOR

attributes.name: strategy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the access strategy, used in cross-functional communications, HTA submissions, and payer contracting documents. Format: MAS-<ProductCode>-<Year>.

attributes.name: strategy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the market access strategy, typically including the product name, indication, and geography (e.g., 'Oncology Product X — US Formulary Access Strategy 2025').

attributes.name: strategy_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Market Access lead or director accountable for developing and executing this access strategy.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the access strategy by its business purpose: launch (initial market entry), lifecycle (ongoing management), indication_expansion (new indication), line_extension (new formulation/dosage), or biosimilar_defense (protecting market share against biosimilar entry).
attributes.references: ISPOR; ICER; EMA Guideline on Market Access

attributes.name: strategy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the access strategy document following major.minor versioning convention (e.g., 1.0, 2.3). Supports document lifecycle management and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: target_formulary_tier
attributes.description: Desired formulary tier placement targeted by this access strategy for the specified payer segment. Tier 1 represents preferred/lowest cost-share; specialty and non_formulary represent restricted access positions.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Formulary Guidelines; PBAC; NICE

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market access strategy record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: value_proposition
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the clinical, economic, and humanistic value proposition communicated to payers and HTA bodies to justify formulary placement and reimbursement. Confidential strategic content.

products.name: payer_account
products.description: Master record for payer organizations including commercial health plans, government payers (Medicare, Medicaid, NHS, statutory health insurers), pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), and group purchasing organizations (GPOs). Captures payer type, tier, covered lives, formulary influence, contracting authority, and geographic coverage. SSOT for payer identity within the market access domain.

attributes.name: payer_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the payer account record within the market access domain. Serves as the primary key and system-of-record identifier for all downstream joins and references.

attributes.name: account_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal market access account manager or payer relations director responsible for managing the relationship with this payer. Maps to the HR employee master for accountability and CRM ownership.
attributes.references: Veeva CRM Account Owner; Salesforce Health Cloud Account Team; Internal HR Master

attributes.name: parent_payer_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent payer organization in a payer hierarchy (e.g., a regional health plan rolling up to a national parent). Enables hierarchical covered-lives aggregation and enterprise-level contracting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy; Veeva CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: third_party_due_diligence_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Third Party Due Diligence Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.third_party_due_diligence. Business justification: Payer accounts are third parties requiring anti-bribery and corruption (ABAC) due diligence, sanctions screening, and debarment checks before contracting. Linking payers to due diligence records ensur

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payer account record. Drives eligibility for contracting, rebate processing, and formulary negotiations. Active accounts are eligible for all market access activities.
attributes.references: Veeva CRM Account Status; SAP S/4HANA Customer Account Group

attributes.name: cms_payer_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Payer ID
attributes.description: Official CMS-assigned payer identifier used in Medicare and Medicaid claims processing and enrollment data. Enables cross-referencing with CMS plan finder, Part D enrollment, and government reimbursement data.
attributes.references: CMS Payer ID Registry; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS Plan Finder

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of commercial arrangement governing the relationship with this payer. Determines the financial model for gross-to-net deductions and market access obligations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; AMCP Value-Based Contracting Framework

attributes.name: contracting_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer account holds direct contracting authority (True) or operates under a parent/umbrella contract managed by another payer entity. Determines whether a direct rebate or pricing agreement can be executed.

attributes.name: copay_accumulator_policy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer has implemented a copay accumulator adjustment program that prevents manufacturer copay assistance from counting toward patient deductibles and out-of-pocket maximums. Impacts gross-to-net and patient affordability.
attributes.references: CMS Copay Accumulator Policy; PCMA Industry Standards; 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: copay_assistance_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer accepts manufacturer copay assistance cards or patient support programs for its commercially insured members. Government payers (Medicare, Medicaid) are prohibited from accepting copay assistance under Anti-Kickback Statute.
attributes.references: OIG Anti-Kickback Statute; 42 CFR Part 1001; CMS Copay Accumulator Policy

attributes.name: covered_lives
attributes.description: Total number of beneficiaries or members covered under the payer's health plan(s). Key metric for assessing payer reach and prioritizing market access investment. Sourced from CMS enrollment data or payer-reported figures.
attributes.references: CMS Enrollment Data; IQVIA Payer Covered Lives Database

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payer account record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(2); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payer account became active and eligible for market access activities, contracting, and formulary engagement. Marks the start of the formal payer relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Customer Master Valid From; Veeva CRM Account Start Date

attributes.name: formulary_decision_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which the payer's pharmacy and therapeutics (P&T) committee reviews and updates formulary coverage decisions. Critical for planning HTA submission and contracting timelines.
attributes.references: AMCP Formulary Management Guidelines; Internal Market Access Calendar

attributes.name: formulary_influence_score
attributes.description: Proprietary numeric score (0–100) reflecting the payer's ability to drive formulary adoption and steer prescribing behavior across its covered lives. Used in payer prioritization and contracting strategy.
attributes.references: Internal Market Access Scoring Model; IQVIA Payer Influence Analytics

attributes.name: formulary_tier_position
attributes.description: Current formulary tier placement of the company's lead product(s) on this payer's formulary. Reflects the outcome of market access negotiations and directly impacts patient access and copay levels.
attributes.references: AMCP Formulary Management Guidelines; CMS Part D Formulary Requirements

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_scope
attributes.description: Scope of the payer's geographic coverage indicating whether the plan operates nationally, regionally, at state/province level, locally, or across multiple countries. Informs market access strategy and contracting jurisdiction.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Finder; EMA Reimbursement Framework

attributes.name: gpo_membership
attributes.description: Name of the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) to which this payer or its affiliated health system belongs (e.g., Vizient, Premier, HealthTrust). Relevant for hospital and institutional formulary contracting.
attributes.references: HSCA GPO Standards; Internal Market Access Account Mapping

attributes.name: hq_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the payer organization's primary headquarters location (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable regulatory framework, pricing regulations, and reimbursement authority.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: hta_body
attributes.description: Name of the Health Technology Assessment (HTA) body associated with this payer's reimbursement decision-making process (e.g., NICE, HAS, G-BA, AIFA, SMC). Drives value dossier format and HEOR evidence requirements.
attributes.references: EUnetHTA Core Model; NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG Process

attributes.name: last_contract_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal contract or rebate agreement review with this payer. Used to track contracting cycle compliance and trigger renewal workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Market Access Contracting SOP; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management

attributes.name: naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned to licensed insurance entities in the United States. Used for regulatory identification, state insurance filings, and cross-referencing with insurance regulatory databases.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Code Registry; State Insurance Regulatory Filings

attributes.name: payer_account_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the payer organization, used in contracting, SAP SD customer master, and Veeva CRM account records for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Veeva CRM Account Object

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the payer organization as registered with regulatory or governmental authorities (e.g., 'UnitedHealthcare Insurance Company', 'Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services'). Used as the primary identity label for the payer.
attributes.references: CMS Payer Registry; Veeva CRM Account Name; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master

attributes.name: payer_subtype
attributes.description: Further granular classification within the payer type (e.g., Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, Part D Plan Sponsor, NHS England, Statutory Health Insurer, PBM Formulary Manager). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medicare_advantage|medicaid_managed_care|part_d_sponsor|fee_for_service|nhs|statutory_health_insurer|pbm_formulary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Plan Finder; EMA Payer Classification; IQVIA Payer Taxonomy

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payer organization by business model. Drives contracting strategy, rebate structure, and market access approach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial_health_plan|government_payer|pbm|gpo|integrated_delivery_network|managed_care_organization — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IQVIA Payer Taxonomy; CMS Payer Classification

attributes.name: pbm_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) affiliated with or contracted by this payer to manage drug benefit administration, formulary design, and rebate negotiations (e.g., Express Scripts, CVS Caremark, OptumRx).
attributes.references: PCMA PBM Industry Standards; Internal Market Access Account Mapping

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary contact at the payer organization. Used for contracting correspondence, formulary submission notifications, and market access communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA Privacy Rule; Veeva CRM Contact Email

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the payer organization (e.g., Director of Pharmacy, VP of Formulary Management). Used for relationship management and contracting communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA Privacy Rule; Veeva CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary contact at the payer organization. Used for direct payer relations outreach and contracting negotiations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA Privacy Rule; Veeva CRM Contact Phone

attributes.name: primary_therapeutic_focus
attributes.description: The primary therapeutic area(s) or disease categories that the payer's formulary and coverage policies emphasize (e.g., oncology, immunology, rare diseases, cardiovascular). Informs product-specific formulary positioning strategy.
attributes.references: ATC Classification System; Internal Therapeutic Area Taxonomy

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer requires prior authorization (PA) for coverage of the company's products. PA requirements create patient access barriers and are tracked for market access strategy and REMS compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Policy; AMCP Access & Reimbursement Guidelines

attributes.name: pt_committee_meeting_month
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) Committee Meeting Month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which the payer's Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) committee typically convenes for formulary review. Used to time value dossier submissions and contracting negotiations.
attributes.references: AMCP Format for Formulary Submissions; Internal Market Access Planning

attributes.name: rebate_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer account is eligible to participate in pharmaceutical rebate programs. Drives gross-to-net revenue calculations and rebate contract eligibility in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Management; CMS Anti-Kickback Statute Safe Harbors; 42 CFR Part 1001

attributes.name: reimbursement_authority
attributes.description: Name of the governmental or statutory body that holds formal authority over reimbursement listing decisions for this payer (e.g., CMS, NHS England, GKV-Spitzenverband, CNAM). Distinct from HTA body which assesses clinical value.
attributes.references: CMS Reimbursement Policy; NHS England Commissioning Framework; EMA Reimbursement Guidance

attributes.name: rwe_data_sharing_agreement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real-World Evidence (RWE) Data Sharing Agreement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Real-World Evidence (RWE) or Real-World Data (RWD) data sharing agreement is in place with this payer. RWE partnerships support value-based contracting, outcomes-based agreements, and payer negotiations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Data Use Agreement; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA RWE Framework Guidance

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer mandates step therapy (fail-first) protocols before approving coverage of the company's products. Step therapy requirements are key barriers tracked in market access and patient support programs.
attributes.references: CMS Step Therapy Policy; AMCP Step Therapy Guidelines

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payer account was terminated or deactivated. Null for currently active accounts. Used for historical reporting and gross-to-net reconciliation of closed payer relationships.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Customer Master Valid To; Veeva CRM Account End Date

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Strategic tier classification assigned by the market access team reflecting the payer's relative importance based on covered lives, formulary influence, and revenue impact. Tier 1 represents highest-priority national accounts.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this payer account record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(2); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: value_based_contract_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer has the infrastructure and willingness to enter into outcomes-based or value-based contracting arrangements. Drives HEOR evidence generation strategy and RWE data requirements.
attributes.references: AMCP Value-Based Contracting Framework; CMS Innovation Center Models

products.name: market_formulary_position
products.description: Tracks the formulary placement status of a pharmaceutical product within a specific payer formulary at a point in time. Records formulary tier, prior authorization requirements, step therapy requirements, quantity limits, preferred/non-preferred status, and effective dates. Enables gross-to-net revenue modeling and access gap analysis across payer segments.

attributes.name: market_formulary_position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a formulary position record representing the placement status of a pharmaceutical product within a specific payer formulary at a point in time.

attributes.name: coverage_decision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.coverage_decision. Business justification: Formulary positions are determined by coverage decisions. One formulary position results from one coverage decision (1:N from coverage_decision perspective). Column to remove: coverage_decision_date (

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product (drug product or SKU) whose formulary placement is being tracked. Aligns to the commercial product master.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Internal Product Master

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.formulary. Business justification: Market formulary positions track where a drug is placed within a specific formulary. Currently market_formulary_position has payer_account_id but no direct link to the formulary master table. Adding f

attributes.name: formulary_listing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific formulary (drug benefit list) managed by the payer in which this product placement is tracked. A payer may maintain multiple formularies across plan types.
attributes.references: CMS Formulary Reference File; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: market_payer_contract_id

attributes.name: quantity_limit_value

attributes.name: rebate_percentage

Captures submission planning, dossier preparation, submission date, HTA body, therapeutic indication, comparator, clinical evidence package, economic model type, submission status, and the resulting formal decision including recommendation type (positive, negative, restricted, conditional), benefit rating, added therapeutic benefit classification, recommended price range, and reimbursement conditions. Owns both the submission event and the decision outcome as lifecycle stages of a single HTA engagement. Drives downstream payer contracting and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: internal_order_id

attributes.references: Internal HEOR Study Registry; ISPOR Guidelines

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug product (DP) or finished dosage form (FDF) that is the subject of this HTA submission. Links to the master product record.

attributes.name: actual_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the HTA dossier was formally submitted to the HTA body. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp for the submission transaction, used to calculate review timelines and clock-start for statutory deadlines.
attributes.references: NICE Process Guide; G-BA AMNOG §35a SGB V; HAS Transparency Commission Procedures

attributes.name: appeal_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company has filed a formal appeal or clarification request against the HTA body's decision. Triggers the appeal lifecycle tracking and legal review process.
attributes.references: NICE Appeal Procedure; G-BA AMNOG Appeal Process; CADTH Reconsideration Process

attributes.name: appeal_outcome

attributes.references: NICE Appeal Procedure; G-BA AMNOG Appeal Process

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the drug product subject to this HTA submission. Used by HTA bodies to identify the therapeutic class and relevant comparators.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; EMA Product Information

attributes.name: benefit_rating
attributes.description: The HTA body's formal rating of the added therapeutic benefit of the drug compared to the appropriate comparator. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: major|considerable|minor|non_quantifiable|no_added_benefit|asmr_i|asmr_ii|asmr_iii|asmr_iv|asmr_v — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: G-BA AMNOG §35a SGB V; HAS ASMR Classification; NICE Clinical Effectiveness Framework

attributes.name: comparator_description
attributes.description: Description of the comparator treatment(s) used in the clinical evidence package submitted to the HTA body. HTA bodies require comparison against the current standard of care or the most appropriate comparator (e.g., best supportive care, existing first-line therapy). Critical for benefit assessment.
attributes.references: NICE Single Technology Appraisal Guide; G-BA AMNOG Dossier Template; EMA Guideline on Choice of Non-Inferiority Margin

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this HTA submission record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5; ICH E6 GCP

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the HTA body issued its formal recommendation or decision. Used to calculate time-to-decision, trigger downstream payer contracting timelines, and manage reimbursement listing effective dates.

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: The formal recommendation type issued by the HTA body following review of the submission: positive (recommended for reimbursement), negative (not recommended), restricted (recommended for a subset of the indicated population), conditional (recommended subject to managed access or further evidence), deferred (decision postponed), or not recommended.
attributes.references: NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG Benefit Assessment; HAS Transparency Commission; CADTH Recommendations; PBAC Outcomes

attributes.name: dossier_reference
attributes.description: The official dossier or file reference number assigned by the HTA body upon receipt of the submission. Used for all formal correspondence and tracking within the HTA body's system.

attributes.name: economic_model_type
attributes.description: Type of health economic model included in the HTA submission dossier. Cost-utility analysis (CUA) using QALYs is standard for NICE; cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) is used by other bodies. Determines the analytical framework for reimbursement recommendation.
attributes.references: NICE Reference Case; EUnetHTA Methods Guidelines; CADTH Guidelines for Economic Evaluations; PBAC Guidelines

attributes.name: ectd_sequence_number

attributes.name: evidence_package_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary clinical evidence package submitted to the HTA body: randomised controlled trial (RCT), observational study, indirect treatment comparison (ITC), mixed treatment comparison (MTC), single-arm trial, or real-world evidence (RWE). attributes.references: NICE Evidence Standards Framework; EMA Guideline on RWE; CADTH Methods Guidelines

attributes.name: external_agency

attributes.name: hta_body_code

attributes.name: managed_access_scheme

attributes.name: recommended_price_upper

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this version of the value dossier is no longer considered current and should be superseded by a newer version. Nullable for currently active dossiers.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Lifecycle; Internal Market Access Governance Policy

attributes.name: formulary_tier_target
attributes.description: Desired formulary tier placement being sought from the payer or pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) based on the evidence presented in the dossier.
attributes.references: AMCP Format for Formulary Submissions v4.0; CMS Part D Formulary Guidelines

attributes.name: heor_evidence_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Evidence Summary
attributes.description: Summary of the Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) evidence included in the dossier, covering cost-effectiveness analyses, cost-utility analyses, budget impact models, and quality-of-life (QoL) data.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Research Practices for Cost-Effectiveness Analysis; NICE Reference Case; EMA HTA Regulation

attributes.name: hta_body_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific Health Technology Assessment (HTA) body or payer organization to which this dossier is submitted or targeted (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, PBAC, ICER).
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG Process

attributes.name: icd_code
attributes.description: ICD-10 or ICD-11 code corresponding to the target indication, used for standardized disease classification in HTA submissions and payer negotiations.

attributes.name: icur_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the Incremental Cost-Utility Ratio (ICUR) is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: icur_value
attributes.description: Incremental Cost-Utility Ratio (ICUR) expressed as cost per Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY) gained, representing the primary health economic outcome submitted to HTA bodies. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity in payer negotiations.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Research Practices for Cost-Effectiveness Analysis; NICE Reference Case; EMA HTA Regulation

attributes.name: legal_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Legal and Compliance function has reviewed this dossier version for regulatory compliance, IP considerations, and promotional material standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 202; EMA Guideline on Advertising; Internal Legal Review SOP

attributes.name: line_of_therapy
attributes.description: Intended line of therapy for which the product is being positioned in the dossier (e.g., first-line, second-line). Directly impacts formulary tier placement and reimbursement scope.
attributes.references: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines; EMA Summary of Product Characteristics; FDA Label

attributes.name: medical_affairs_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Medical Affairs function has completed a formal scientific review and sign-off of the clinical evidence sections of this dossier version.
attributes.references: Internal Medical Review SOP; ICH E3; ISPOR Good Practices

attributes.name: patient_population_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of eligible patients in the target market who could benefit from the treatment, as used in the budget impact model and payer negotiations.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Research Practices for Budget Impact Analysis; EMA Epidemiology Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_endpoint
attributes.description: Primary efficacy endpoint from the pivotal clinical trial(s) supporting the dossier (e.g., Overall Survival (OS), Progression-Free Survival (PFS), Objective Response Rate (ORR)). Directly informs the clinical value narrative.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: product_inn
attributes.description: WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) featured in the dossier. Used as the universal scientific identifier across regulatory and payer submissions.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; ICH Q6A; FDA Orange Book

attributes.name: qaly_gain
attributes.description: Estimated Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY) gain attributed to the treatment versus the comparator, as reported in the health economic model submitted in the dossier.
attributes.references: NICE Reference Case; ISPOR Good Research Practices; EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282

attributes.name: reimbursement_scope
attributes.description: Scope of reimbursement coverage achieved or sought for the product based on the dossier submission, indicating whether full, restricted, or conditional reimbursement applies.
attributes.references: CMS Coverage Determination Process; NICE Technology Appraisal; G-BA AMNOG

attributes.name: rwe_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether Real-World Evidence (RWE) or Real-World Data (RWD) is included as supporting evidence in this dossier version, in addition to randomized controlled trial data.
attributes.references: FDA Framework for Real-World Evidence; EMA Guidance on RWE; ISPOR RWE Task Force

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the value dossier was formally submitted to the target HTA body, payer, or formulary committee.
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; FDA PDUFA; NICE Process Guide

attributes.name: target_indication
attributes.description: Specific disease or condition for which the product is being positioned in the dossier (e.g., metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis). Should align with the approved or sought label indication.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Guideline on Summary of Product Characteristics; ICD-11

attributes.name: target_payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary payer audience for whom the dossier is tailored. Determines the evidence framing and economic model emphasis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: national_hta|regional_hta|commercial_payer|pbm|gpo|government_formulary|hospital_formulary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMCP Format for Formulary Submissions v4.0; ISPOR HTA Compendium

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Broad disease area or medical specialty the dossier addresses (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Aligns with the company's therapeutic area taxonomy.
attributes.references: WHO International Classification of Diseases (ICD-11); ATC Classification System

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the value dossier, typically including the product name, indication, and target audience (e.g., payer, HTA body).
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Value Dossier Development

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this value dossier record, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: version_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the current version of the dossier was finalized and approved for use.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ISPOR Good Practices

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the dossier (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented with each substantive update to clinical evidence, HEOR data, or comparator landscape.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Management; ICH E3

products.name: market_payer_contract
products.description: Master record for all managed care contracts, rebate agreements, and performance-based contracts negotiated with payers, PBMs (Express Scripts, CVS Caremark, OptumRx), GPOs, and other contracting entities. Captures contract type (base rebate, performance rebate, outcomes-based, value-based, PBM formulary rebate, GPO commitment), contracted product, rebate tiers, performance metrics, administrative fees, data sharing provisions, book-of-business structure, PBM-specific formulary management mechanics, contract term, and payment schedule. Central to gross-to-net revenue management and rebate accrual calculations. Covers all payer types including PBM-specific contract structures.

attributes.name: market_payer_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the payer contract record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this master agreement entity.

attributes.name: access_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.access_strategy. Business justification: Payer contracts are negotiated within the context of market access strategies. One payer contract supports one access strategy (1:N from access_strategy perspective). No columns to remove as payer_con

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Payer contracts generate receivables through administrative fees, upfront payments, and contract settlements. Finance must track AR by contract for reconciliation, payment collection, and revenue reco

attributes.name: disclosure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_disclosure. Business justification: Market payer contracts should link to compliance disclosures for transparency reporting and regulatory compliance. This enables integrated management of payer agreements and associated disclosure obli

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contracted pharmaceutical product (Drug Product / Finished Dosage Form) covered under this payer agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; NDC Registry

attributes.name: exclusivity_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: Contracts reference regulatory exclusivity periods to establish pricing corridors, define renegotiation triggers at LOE, and structure managed entry agreements. Exclusivity timelines are contractual t

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payer, Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM), Group Purchasing Organization (GPO), or managed care organization that is the counterparty to this contract.

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Payer contracts include patent expiry clauses for price protection, rebate adjustment triggers at loss of exclusivity, and contract termination provisions. Patent status directly affects contract term

attributes.name: payer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.payer_account. Business justification: Market payer contracts MUST reference which payer organization the contract is with. This is a fundamental relationship - every managed care contract, rebate agreement, or performance-based contract i

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Payer contracts require compliance program oversight for anti-kickback statute compliance, transparency reporting, and government pricing rules (Medicaid best price, 340B). Every contract must be revi

attributes.name: admin_fee_pct
attributes.description: Administrative fee percentage charged by the PBM or GPO for contract administration, data services, and formulary management, expressed as a percentage of net sales. Deducted in gross-to-net calculations.
attributes.references: PCMA Administrative Fee Disclosure Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Rebate Processing

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews at the end of the effective period unless either party provides notice of termination within the specified notice period.

attributes.name: base_rebate_pct
attributes.description: The unconditional base rebate percentage of Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) or Average Manufacturer Price (AMP) owed to the payer regardless of performance metrics. Core input to gross-to-net revenue accrual calculations.
attributes.references: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (42 CFR Part 447); CMS AMP Reporting; Internal Gross-to-Net Policy

attributes.name: book_of_business_lives
attributes.description: The number of covered lives (plan members) within the payer's book of business that are subject to this contract. Used for rebate volume estimation, market access analytics, and payer segmentation.
attributes.references: PCMA; AMCP; Internal Market Access Analytics Standards

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name of the payer contract (e.g., 'CVS Caremark National Formulary Rebate Agreement FY2025'), used for identification in reporting and gross-to-net management.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this payer contract, used for cross-referencing with the payer, PBM, or GPO and in SAP SD/FI rebate agreement records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: contract_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal Market Access or Managed Care team member responsible for managing and maintaining this payer contract relationship.
attributes.references: Internal Market Access Governance Policy; Salesforce Health Cloud CRM

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payer contract. Governs whether rebate accruals are active, whether the contract is eligible for payment processing, and whether formulary positioning obligations are in effect. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_execution|active|suspended|terminated|expired|under_renegotiation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Agreement Status; Internal Contract Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payer contract by its commercial structure. Determines rebate calculation methodology and accrual treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_rebate|performance_rebate|outcomes_based|value_based|pbm_formulary_rebate|gpo_commitment — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: ASHP; PCMA; Market Access Industry Standards

attributes.name: copay_assistance_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract permits the manufacturer to offer copay assistance or patient support programs to members covered under this payer's plan. Some commercial contracts restrict copay card use.
attributes.references: OIG Copay Assistance Guidance; Internal Patient Access Policy; CMS Anti-Kickback Statute Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payer contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all rebate amounts, fees, and financial obligations under this contract are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_sharing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a data sharing provision requiring the payer or PBM to provide claims data, utilization data, or outcomes data to the manufacturer. Relevant for outcomes-based and value-based contracts.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164); GDPR Article 28; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: data_sharing_scope
attributes.description: Specifies the type of data the payer or PBM is contractually obligated to share with the manufacturer under the data sharing provision. Null if data_sharing_required is False.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164); PCMA Data Sharing Standards; GDPR Article 28

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payer contract expires or is scheduled to terminate. Nullable for evergreen contracts. Used as the upper bound for rebate accrual period calculations and contract renewal tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Agreement; Internal Market Access Policy

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payer contract becomes legally binding and rebate obligations commence. Used as the lower bound for rebate accrual period calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Agreement; ICH E6 GCP (for any outcomes-based contracts referencing clinical data)

attributes.name: estimated_annual_rebate_amount
attributes.description: The estimated total rebate liability for a full contract year based on projected sales volume and contracted rebate rates. Used for gross-to-net accrual budgeting and financial planning. Not a calculated aggregate — represents the contractually agreed estimate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Rebate Accrual; SOX Section 302 Revenue Recognition; ASC 606

attributes.name: exclusivity_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract grants the contracted product exclusive or preferred formulary positioning within its therapeutic class, excluding or restricting competitor products.
attributes.references: FTC Antitrust Guidelines; PCMA Formulary Management Standards; Internal Legal Policy

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was formally signed and executed by all parties. May differ from the effective start date for retroactive agreements.
attributes.references: Internal Legal and Compliance Policy; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: The formulary tier position secured for the contracted product under this payer agreement. Directly impacts patient access, copay levels, and rebate obligations. Central to PBM formulary management mechanics.
attributes.references: PCMA Formulary Management Guidelines; CMS Part D Formulary Requirements (42 CFR Part 423)

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/state code) whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this contract (e.g., US-DE for Delaware, USA).
attributes.references: Internal Legal Policy; GDPR Article 28; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: incremental_rebate_pct
attributes.description: Additional rebate percentage earned above the base rebate upon achievement of performance or formulary tier thresholds. Used in tiered and performance-based contract structures.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Contracting Guidelines; Internal Gross-to-Net Policy

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payer contract record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: most_favored_nation_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract contains a Most Favored Nation (MFN) clause requiring the manufacturer to offer this payer terms no less favorable than those offered to any other payer. Has significant pricing and compliance implications.
attributes.references: FTC Antitrust Guidelines; Internal Legal and Compliance Policy; Inflation Reduction Act MFN Provisions

attributes.name: performance_metric_type
attributes.description: The type of performance metric used to determine eligibility for incremental or performance-based rebates. Applicable for performance rebate, outcomes-based, and value-based contract types.
attributes.references: AMCP Value-Based Contracting Framework; ICER Evidence Standards

attributes.name: performance_threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold that must be achieved on the performance metric to trigger incremental rebate payments (e.g., minimum market share percentage, minimum formulary tier position, minimum adherence rate).
attributes.references: AMCP Value-Based Contracting Framework; Internal Market Access Policy

attributes.name: price_protection_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a price protection provision that triggers additional rebates if the manufacturer raises the list price (WAC) above a specified threshold, typically tied to CPI or a fixed percentage.
attributes.references: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (42 CFR Part 447); Inflation Reduction Act; Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: price_protection_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The maximum allowable annual WAC price increase percentage before price protection rebates are triggered under the contract. Null if price_protection_clause is False.
attributes.references: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (42 CFR Part 447); Inflation Reduction Act; Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: rebate_payment_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed schedule for rebate payment remittance from the manufacturer to the payer or PBM. Drives rebate accrual timing and cash flow planning in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Rebate Settlement; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: rebate_payment_lag_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the close of a rebate period within which the rebate invoice must be paid. Used for cash flow forecasting and accrual true-up calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of days prior to the effective end date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew the contract. Applicable when auto_renewal is True.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Management Policy; Internal Legal Policy

attributes.name: source_system_contract_code
attributes.description: The native contract identifier from the originating system of record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD rebate agreement number, Salesforce Health Cloud contract record ID). Enables traceability back to the operational source system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce Health Cloud; Internal Data Lineage Policy

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Distinct from effective_end_date which represents the scheduled expiry. Null if the contract has not been terminated early.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Lifecycle Policy; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early contract termination. Required for gross-to-net true-up and audit trail purposes when a contract is ended before its scheduled expiry date. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mutual_agreement|breach|regulatory_action|product_withdrawal|formulary_exclusion|renegotiation|expiry — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Market Access Policy; SOX Audit Requirements

attributes.name: utilization_management_restrictions
attributes.description: Specifies the utilization management restrictions applied to the contracted product on the payer's formulary (e.g., prior authorization, step therapy, quantity limits). Impacts patient access and market share performance metrics.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Utilization Management Guidelines; AMCP Formulary Management Standards

products.name: rebate_claim
products.description: Transactional record of rebate claims submitted to or received from payers and PBMs under managed care contracts. Captures claim period, contracted product, eligible units, applicable rebate rate, calculated rebate amount, dispute status, and payment date. Feeds gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting and rebate liability accruals in the finance domain.

attributes.name: rebate_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the rebate claim record. Primary key for the rebate_claim data product in the market domain.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: Rebate claims track actual rebates paid for brand utilization under payer contracts. Financial reconciliation and GTN forecasting process requires linking rebate claims to brands for revenue recogniti

attributes.name: finance_accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Market rebate claims should link to finance accounts receivable for rebate accrual and revenue recognition. This enables accurate gross-to-net calculations and financial reporting for pharmaceutical r

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Rebate claims reference specific lot numbers for Medicaid best price calculations, chargeback validation, and dispute resolution. Lot-level traceability is required for regulatory compliance and finan

attributes.name: market_payer_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the managed care or payer contract under which this rebate claim is generated. Governs the applicable rebate tiers, rates, and eligible products.

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contracted pharmaceutical product (Drug Product/Finished Dosage Form) for which the rebate claim is being processed.

attributes.name: payer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the managed care payer or health plan entity against which this rebate claim is submitted or received. Links to the payer master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce Health Cloud

attributes.name: pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) administering the rebate contract on behalf of the payer. Null when the payer administers rebates directly.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce Health Cloud

attributes.name: accrual_period
attributes.description: Financial reporting quarter (e.g., 2024-Q3) in which the rebate liability or receivable is accrued in the general ledger. Aligns rebate expense recognition with the period of sale per ASC 606 and gross-to-net accounting policies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net adjustments applied to the gross rebate amount, including corrections for prior period true-ups, disputed unit reconciliations, or contractual offsets. Negative values represent reductions; positive values represent additions.

attributes.name: claim_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate claim represents an amount payable by the manufacturer to the payer (outbound rebate) or receivable from a payer/GPO (inbound credit). Drives gross-to-net accounting treatment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the rebate claim. Used in payer correspondence, dispute resolution, and reconciliation. Format: RBC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Gross-to-Net Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: claim_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the measurement period for which eligible units and rebate amounts are being claimed. Together with claim_period_start_date defines the rebate accrual window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

attributes.name: claim_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the measurement period (quarter or month) for which eligible units and rebate amounts are being claimed. Aligns with the contractual reporting period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rebate claim. Tracks progression from initial draft through submission, payer review, approval or dispute, and final payment settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|disputed|paid|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Gross-to-Net Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate claim by the contractual mechanism that generated it. Base rebates are volume-driven; performance rebates are tied to market share or outcomes; formulary rebates are tied to formulary tier placement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_rebate|performance_rebate|market_share_rebate|formulary_rebate|administrative_fee — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center to which the rebate expense is allocated for internal management reporting and P&L attribution by therapeutic area or brand.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which the rebate claim is applicable. Supports multi-country gross-to-net reporting and compliance with country-specific pricing and reimbursement regulations.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this rebate claim are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency gross-to-net reporting.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for the dispute raised on this rebate claim. Used to identify systemic data quality or contracting issues and to prioritize resolution efforts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unit_count_discrepancy|rate_discrepancy|eligibility_dispute|period_mismatch|data_quality|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any dispute raised against this rebate claim by the payer, PBM, or manufacturer. Tracks the dispute lifecycle from initiation through resolution for audit and accrual adjustment purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the portion of the rebate claim currently under dispute. May be less than or equal to net_rebate_amount. Used to calculate the undisputed payable amount and to set dispute reserves.

attributes.name: eligible_units
attributes.description: Total number of units (prescriptions, unit doses, or pack equivalents) dispensed during the claim period that qualify for rebate under the contract terms. Basis for rebate amount calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier at which the product was listed during the claim period. Determines the applicable rebate rate and is used to validate formulary access commitments made in the managed care contract.
attributes.references: Managed Care Contracting Standards; CMS Formulary Guidelines

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code to which the rebate liability or receivable is posted. Ensures correct financial statement classification of gross-to-net revenue deductions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: gross_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Total calculated rebate amount before any adjustments, offsets, or administrative fees. Computed as eligible_units × wac_price × rebate_rate. Primary input to gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; FASB ASC 808

attributes.name: market_share_pct
attributes.description: Product market share within the payer's covered lives during the claim period, expressed as a percentage. Used to validate performance tier achievement and to support market share rebate calculations.
attributes.references: Managed Care Contracting Standards; IQVIA/SYMPHONY Data Standards

attributes.name: medicaid_rebate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim is subject to the CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (MDRP) reporting and payment obligations. Drives separate regulatory reporting workflows and AMP/Best Price calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program; 42 CFR Part 447; 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: National Drug Code (NDC) identifying the specific drug product, labeler, and package size for which the rebate is claimed. Required for payer reconciliation and CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program reporting.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; 21 CFR Part 207; CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program

attributes.name: net_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Final rebate amount after applying all adjustments and administrative fee deductions. Represents the actual liability or receivable recorded in the finance domain for rebate accrual and payment settlement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; FASB ASC 808

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the rebate payment was received from or remitted to the payer. Null until payment is confirmed. Used for cash flow reconciliation and gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractually stipulated date by which the rebate payment must be made or received. Used to calculate days-past-due for outstanding claims and to trigger payment reminders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Bank or ERP payment reference number (e.g., SAP payment document number or wire transfer reference) associated with the settlement of this rebate claim. Used for cash application and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: prior_period_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate claim includes a true-up or correction for a prior reporting period. When true, the adjustment_amount field captures the prior period correction value for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: rebate_rate

products.name: gross_to_net_adjustment
products.description: Records all gross-to-net revenue deduction components applied to a pharmaceutical product's gross sales to arrive at net revenue. Captures adjustment type (base rebate, performance rebate, Medicaid best price, 340B, chargebacks, copay assistance, GPO fees, distribution fees, patient assistance), period, product, channel, and adjustment amount. For copay assistance adjustments, captures individual claim-level detail including dispensing pharmacy, claim date, patient identifier (de-identified), drug product, gross copay amount, assistance amount paid, and remaining patient liability. Enables net revenue reconciliation, deduction category analysis, copay program spend reporting, and patient affordability program financial tracking. SSOT for all GTN deduction records including copay assistance transactions.
