attributes.references: FDA REMS; EMA Managed Access; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient access program becomes operationally active and eligible patients may begin enrolling or receiving benefits. Aligns with commercial launch or pre-approval access window.
attributes.references: FDA REMS; EMA Managed Access; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the patient eligibility criteria for program enrollment, including insurance status requirements, income thresholds, diagnosis requirements, and prior treatment conditions. Sourced from the program design document.
attributes.references: FDA REMS; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which patients or HCPs enroll in the program. Includes hub services, specialty pharmacy, HCP portal, patient portal, phone, and field reimbursement manager (FRM) channels. Drives operational routing and analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Health Cloud; Veeva CRM; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Entity or mechanism funding the patient access program. Manufacturer-funded programs have direct gross-to-net revenue impact; foundation-funded programs may have different OIG compliance implications.
attributes.references: OIG Anti-Kickback Statute; IRS 501(c)(3); SOX; IFRS 15

attributes.name: hub_service_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party hub services organization contracted to administer patient enrollment, benefits verification, prior authorization support, and case management for this program (e.g., Lash Group, ConnectiveRx, Inovalon).
attributes.references: Salesforce Health Cloud; HIPAA BAA requirements

attributes.name: income_threshold_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program requires patients to meet a defined income or financial need threshold as part of eligibility screening. True for patient assistance programs (PAP); typically False for copay assistance programs.

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: Specific disease or condition for which the product is approved or being accessed under this program. Aligns with the label indication or the compassionate use/expanded access authorization.

attributes.name: inn
attributes.description: WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) for the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) covered by this program. Enables cross-country and cross-payer standardization.

attributes.name: insurance_status_requirement
attributes.description: Specifies the insurance coverage status required for patient eligibility. Copay assistance programs typically require commercially insured patients; PAPs typically target uninsured or underinsured populations.
attributes.references: CMS; HIPAA; OIG Anti-Kickback Statute guidance

attributes.name: legal_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program design and terms have been reviewed and approved by the legal department for compliance with anti-kickback statutes, GDPR, HIPAA, and applicable local regulations.
attributes.references: OIG Anti-Kickback Statute; GDPR Article 5; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; SOX

attributes.name: line_of_therapy
attributes.description: Specifies the treatment line for which this program is applicable (e.g., first-line, second-line). Aligns with formulary positioning, HTA evidence requirements, and clinical trial endpoint definitions (e.g., PFS, OS, ORR).
attributes.references: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; NCCN guidelines; ICH E9

attributes.name: patient_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the target patient population for this program, including disease stage, line of therapy, age group, and any biomarker or diagnostic requirements. Informs HTA submissions and payer value dossiers.
attributes.references: ICH E8; EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; FDA guidance on patient-focused drug development

attributes.name: payer_segment
attributes.description: Insurance or payer segment targeted by this program. Copay assistance programs are typically restricted to commercially insured patients; PAPs target uninsured or government-insured populations. Drives OIG compliance and gross-to-net accounting.

attributes.name: program_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special conditions, or exceptions associated with this patient access program. Used by market access and hub operations teams for case-by-case documentation.

attributes.name: program_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal business owner (e.g., Market Access Director, Brand Team Lead) accountable for the design, governance, and performance of this patient access program.
attributes.references: SOX; ICH E6(R2); internal governance framework

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the patient access program. Drives operational eligibility checks, enrollment processing, and reporting to market access leadership.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the program by its access mechanism. Covers copay assistance, free drug programs, patient assistance programs (PAP), named patient programs, compassionate use, expanded access programs (EAP), managed access agreements, hub services, and specialty pharmacy support. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: copay_assistance|free_drug|patient_assistance|named_patient|compassionate_use|expanded_access|managed_access|hub_services|specialty_pharmacy_support — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Expanded Access 21 CFR 312 Subpart I; EMA Compassionate Use Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 Article 83

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this patient access program record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this patient access program record was most recently modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_authorization_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory authorization underpinning this program (e.g., FDA Expanded Access IND number, EMA compassionate use authorization, named patient program reference). Links to the regulatory submission record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 312.310; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 Article 83; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: rems_program_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this patient access program is associated with or operates under an FDA-mandated Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS). REMS programs have additional compliance and reporting obligations.

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether dispensing under this program must occur through a designated specialty pharmacy network. Relevant for REMS programs and high-cost biologics requiring cold-chain or controlled distribution.

attributes.name: supply_terms
attributes.description: Description of the product supply terms under this program, including dispensing quantity, supply duration, dosage form, and whether supply is provided directly by the manufacturer or through a specialty pharmacy or CMO/CDMO partner.
attributes.references: GDP (Good Distribution Practice); SAP S/4HANA MM; ICH Q10

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Clinical therapeutic area for which the program is designed (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Used for portfolio-level market access reporting and HTA alignment.

products.name: pricing_decision
products.description: Master record for formal pricing decisions, approved price corridors, and international reference pricing (IRP) management for pharmaceutical products across markets and channels. Captures list price (WAC/ex-factory), government reference price, IRP constraints, price change type, effective date, approving authority, pricing rationale, and approved price corridors including floor price, target price, ceiling price, IRP basket countries, monitoring frequency, and corridor breach alert thresholds. Serves as the authoritative record of approved prices and price bands, enabling proactive management of cross-country price erosion risk and launch sequencing optimization.

attributes.name: pricing_decision_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each formal pricing decision record in the master pricing decision table.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record

attributes.name: access_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.access_strategy. Business justification: Pricing decisions are made within the context of market access strategies. One pricing decision supports one access strategy (1:N from access_strategy perspective). No columns to remove as pricing_dec

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Pricing decisions require country-specific regulatory constraints, international reference pricing baskets, reimbursement frameworks, and market access tier classifications for compliant pricing strat

attributes.name: exclusivity_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: Pricing decisions incorporate regulatory exclusivity timelines to set launch prices, plan price erosion at LOE, and structure international reference pricing strategies. Exclusivity periods directly a

attributes.name: hta_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.hta_submission. Business justification: Pricing decisions are often informed by HTA outcomes, especially in markets with formal HTA-based pricing. One pricing decision may reference one HTA submission (1:N from hta_submission perspective).

attributes.name: market_country_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic market or country for which this pricing decision is applicable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Organization

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product (Drug Product/Drug Substance) for which this pricing decision applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module — Material Master

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Pricing strategies must account for patent protection duration to optimize lifecycle revenue, manage LOE transitions, and plan price erosion timelines. Patent expiry dates are mandatory inputs to pric

attributes.name: payer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payer, government authority, or channel entity for which this pricing decision is scoped. Nullable for list price decisions applicable to all payers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Health Cloud / Veeva CRM — Account

attributes.name: preceding_decision_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately prior pricing decision that this record supersedes or amends. Enables full price history chain reconstruction for audit and IRP analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record History; ICH Q10 Change Control

attributes.name: transfer_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.transfer_price. Business justification: Intercompany pricing decisions must align with approved transfer pricing policies for tax compliance and arm's length requirements. Market access teams need visibility to transfer price constraints wh

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pricing decision received formal internal governance approval from the approving authority. Distinct from effective_date (when it takes market effect).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Release Date; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or designation of the internal governance body or individual (e.g., Global Pricing Committee, Regional Pricing Board, CFO, VP Market Access) that formally approved this pricing decision.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Management Certification; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the product at the 5th level (chemical substance level), used for cross-market pricing benchmarking and formulary positioning analysis.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; EMA Product Information

attributes.name: ceiling_price
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceiling Price — Approved Price Corridor Maximum
attributes.description: Maximum approved price within the authorized price corridor above which the product must not be priced in this market. Prevents excessive pricing relative to IRP basket and regulatory constraints. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Maximum Price Condition; EMA IRP Framework; PMDA Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution or sales channel to which this pricing decision applies, such as retail pharmacy, hospital formulary, government procurement, tender, specialty pharmacy, or direct-to-payer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Distribution Channel

attributes.name: corridor_breach_threshold_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Price Corridor Breach Alert Threshold Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage deviation from the target price that triggers an automated corridor breach alert for proactive price erosion monitoring. For example, a value of 5.00 means a 5% deviation from target_price triggers an alert.
attributes.references: Market Access Pricing Governance Framework; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Monitoring

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pricing decision record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records and Signatures; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all price values for this decision are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Currency

attributes.name: decision_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this pricing decision, formatted as PD-{country_code}-{year}-{sequence}. Used in cross-functional communications, regulatory submissions, and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record Key; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: decision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing decision. 'draft' = under preparation; 'pending_approval' = submitted for internal governance review; 'approved' = formally approved but not yet effective; 'active' = currently in force; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer decision; 'withdrawn' = cancelled before activation; 'expired' = past effective period. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|superseded|withdrawn|expired — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record Status; ICH Q10

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing decision by the nature of the price change or establishment event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: launch_price|price_increase|price_decrease|price_correction|irp_adjustment|government_mandated|tender_price|access_program_price — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Type; FDA Pricing Transparency; EMA Transparency Directive

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this pricing decision becomes operative and the approved prices take effect in the market. This is the principal business event date for the pricing decision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record Valid From; FDA Drug Pricing Transparency; EMA Transparency Directive

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this pricing decision ceases to be operative. Null indicates an open-ended decision with no scheduled expiry. Superseded decisions will have this populated upon replacement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record Valid To; EMA Transparency Directive

attributes.name: floor_price
attributes.business_glossary_term: Floor Price — Approved Price Corridor Minimum
attributes.description: Minimum approved price within the authorized price corridor below which the product must not be sold in this market. Used for IRP management and cross-country price erosion prevention. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Minimum Price Condition; ICH Q10; EMA IRP Framework

attributes.name: government_reference_price
attributes.description: Officially approved or regulated price set by a government authority (e.g., NHS reference price, ASMR-based French price, German AMNOG price). Applicable in markets with statutory price regulation. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: EMA Transparency Directive 89/105/EEC; PMDA Pricing Guidelines; NMPA Drug Pricing Regulations; NHS England Pricing Framework

attributes.name: gross_to_net_pct
attributes.description: Estimated gross-to-net adjustment percentage representing the aggregate deduction from WAC list price to net realized price, inclusive of all rebates, chargebacks, and mandatory discounts. Used for revenue forecasting and P&L management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module — Revenue Accounting; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Medicaid Drug Rebate Program

attributes.name: irp_basket_countries
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes that constitute the IRP reference basket monitored for this pricing decision (e.g., 'DEU|FRA|GBR|ESP|ITA'). Used to assess cross-country price erosion risk and inform launch sequencing.
attributes.references: EMA IRP Framework; EURIPID Database; WHO Pricing Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: irp_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing decision is constrained by International Reference Pricing (IRP) rules in the target market. True = IRP constraint applies; False = no IRP constraint.

attributes.name: irp_reference_price
attributes.description: The IRP-derived price constraint calculated from the basket countries at the time of this decision. Represents the maximum price permissible under IRP rules for this market. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: EMA IRP Framework; EURIPID Database; PMDA IRP Guidelines

attributes.name: launch_sequence_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank assigned to this market in the global launch sequencing plan, where lower values indicate earlier launch. Used to optimize IRP risk by controlling the order of country launches.
attributes.references: Market Access Launch Sequencing Framework; EMA IRP Framework

attributes.name: list_price_wac
attributes.description: Approved Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) or ex-factory list price per unit for the product in the specified market and channel. This is the gross list price before any rebates, discounts, or government adjustments. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record VK11; US Drug Pricing Transparency Laws; 42 USC 1396r-8 (Medicaid Drug Rebate Program)

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the IRP basket and price corridor compliance are reviewed for this pricing decision. Drives scheduling of automated IRP monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: EMA IRP Framework; Market Access Pricing Governance SOP

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: US National Drug Code (NDC) in 5-4-2 format identifying the specific drug product, dosage form, and package size subject to this pricing decision. Applicable for US market decisions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 207 — National Drug Code; Medicaid Drug Rebate Program

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Approved net price after application of mandatory rebates, statutory discounts, and government-mandated deductions. Represents the effective realized price per unit. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Net Price Condition; Medicaid Drug Rebate Program; EU Transparency Directive

attributes.name: pack_size_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the pack configuration to which this pricing decision applies (e.g., '30 tablets x 10mg', '1 vial x 100mg/10mL'). Ensures unambiguous identification of the priced SKU.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Description; NDC Labeler Code

attributes.name: price_change_pct
attributes.description: Percentage change in list price (WAC) relative to the immediately preceding approved pricing decision for the same product, market, and channel. Positive values indicate a price increase; negative values indicate a price decrease.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Price History; FDA Drug Pricing Transparency Reporting

attributes.name: price_per_unit_type
attributes.description: Defines the unit basis on which all price values in this decision are expressed (e.g., per pack, per tablet, per vial, per mg of active pharmaceutical ingredient, per mL, per dose).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Unit of Measure; WHO INN Pricing Standards

attributes.name: pricing_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative justification for the pricing decision, documenting the strategic, clinical, health-economic, and competitive factors considered. Supports regulatory transparency requirements and internal audit.
attributes.references: EMA Transparency Directive 89/105/EEC; HEOR Value Dossier Standards; ICER Value Assessment Framework

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the regulatory submission (e.g., NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD sequence) associated with this pricing decision. Links pricing to the regulatory approval that enables commercialization.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314 — NDA; EMA MAA Procedure; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: reimbursement_status
attributes.description: Current reimbursement status of the product under this pricing decision in the target market. Determines patient access and payer coverage scope.
attributes.references: EMA Transparency Directive 89/105/EEC; CMS National Coverage Determination; PMDA Reimbursement Guidelines

attributes.name: target_price
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Price — Approved Price Corridor Midpoint
attributes.description: Optimal or target price within the approved price corridor, representing the commercially preferred price point balancing access, revenue, and IRP risk. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record; Market Access Pricing Strategy

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area classification of the product subject to this pricing decision (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Used for portfolio-level pricing analytics and HTA benchmarking.
attributes.references: ATC Classification System (WHO); EMA Therapeutic Area Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this pricing decision record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records and Signatures; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

products.name: market_heor_study
products.description: Master record for Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) evidence assets including studies, models, and real-world data (RWD) datasets used to support market access, payer negotiations, and HTA submissions. Captures study type (budget impact model, cost-effectiveness analysis, cost-utility analysis, retrospective RWD study, PRO study, indirect treatment comparison), therapeutic indication, target payer audience, study status, model version, patient population assumptions, comparator costs, time horizon, model outputs, publication reference, and budget impact model-specific attributes (market share assumptions, treatment cost inputs). Also manages the inventory of RWD/RWE datasets including data source type (claims database, EHR, registry, patient-reported outcomes), data vendor, data vintage, and data use agreements. SSOT for all HEOR evidence assets and RWD/RWE inventory within the market access domain.

attributes.name: market_heor_study_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Study ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the HEOR study or evidence asset record within the market access domain. Primary key.

attributes.name: access_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.access_strategy. Business justification: HEOR studies are commissioned to generate evidence supporting specific market access strategies. One HEOR study supports one access strategy (1:N from access_strategy perspective). This eliminates heo

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: HEOR studies target specific country payer audiences and HTA bodies for evidence generation, requiring regulatory requirements, HTA submission standards, and reimbursement framework context. target_co

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: HEOR studies are project-based activities funded through internal orders, tracking costs for RWE data acquisition, economic modeling, CRO services, and publication fees. Required for budget management

attributes.name: value_dossier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to market.value_dossier. Business justification: HEOR studies (health economics and outcomes research) are evidence assets that feed into value dossiers used for payer negotiations and HTA submissions. A HEOR study is typically conducted to support

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the drug product, used for formulary benchmarking and payer segmentation.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Proprietary brand name of the drug product under study, as approved by the relevant regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, etc.).
attributes.references: FDA Approved Drug Products (Orange Book); EMA Product Information

attributes.name: budget_impact_year1
attributes.description: Projected net budget impact to the payer in Year 1 of the budget impact model, expressed in the currency defined by icur_currency_code. Key output for payer affordability assessments.
attributes.references: ISPOR Budget Impact Analysis Good Practice Guidelines; CMS Coverage Determination Guidelines

attributes.name: budget_impact_year3
attributes.description: Projected net budget impact to the payer in Year 3 of the budget impact model, expressed in the currency defined by icur_currency_code. Represents the standard 3-year horizon used in US payer budget impact analyses.
attributes.references: ISPOR Budget Impact Analysis Good Practice Guidelines; CMS Coverage Determination Guidelines

attributes.name: comparator_description
attributes.description: Description of the comparator treatment(s) used in the economic model or study (e.g., standard of care, active comparator INN, best supportive care), critical for HTA submissions and payer negotiations.
attributes.references: NICE DSU Technical Support Documents; ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the HEOR study record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(2); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cro_vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external Contract Research Organization (CRO) or health economics consultancy engaged to conduct or validate the HEOR study, if applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

attributes.name: data_use_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the Data Use Agreement (DUA) governing the use of the real-world dataset, ensuring compliance with data licensing and privacy obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; FDA Framework for Real-World Evidence Program

attributes.name: hta_body_name
attributes.description: Name of the Health Technology Assessment (HTA) body to which this HEOR evidence is being submitted (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, CADTH, PBAC). Relevant for cost-effectiveness and cost-utility analyses.
attributes.references: EUnetHTA; NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG; CADTH Guidelines

attributes.name: icd_code
attributes.description: ICD-10 diagnosis code corresponding to the target indication, enabling standardized cross-study and cross-payer comparisons.

attributes.name: icur_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the ICUR value (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR), ensuring correct interpretation of the economic model output across geographies.

attributes.name: icur_value
attributes.description: Incremental Cost-Utility Ratio (ICUR) expressed as cost per Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY) gained, the primary output of cost-utility analyses used in HTA submissions. Expressed in the currency defined by icur_currency_code.
attributes.references: NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; EUnetHTA Core Model

attributes.name: line_of_therapy
attributes.description: Treatment line for which the HEOR evidence is generated (e.g., first-line, second-line), a key driver of payer coverage decisions and formulary positioning.
attributes.references: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines; ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: market_share_assumption_pct
attributes.description: Assumed market share percentage for the drug product used as the base case input in the budget impact model, reflecting expected uptake within the eligible patient population.
attributes.references: ISPOR Budget Impact Analysis Good Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the economic model or study protocol, tracking iterative updates submitted to payers or HTA bodies over the product lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: model_version_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current model version was finalized and approved for use in payer submissions or HTA dossiers.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

attributes.name: patient_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the patient population assumptions used in the model, including eligibility criteria, disease stage, line of therapy, and demographic assumptions.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; ICH E9

attributes.name: patient_population_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of eligible patients in the target population used as the base case assumption in the economic model, relevant for budget impact models and market sizing.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; CMS Coverage Determination Guidelines

attributes.name: product_inn
attributes.description: WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) of the drug product that is the subject of the HEOR study, used for global payer and HTA submissions.

attributes.name: publication_reference
attributes.description: Citation or DOI reference for the peer-reviewed publication, congress abstract, or technical report associated with this HEOR study, enabling traceability from payer submissions to published evidence.
attributes.references: ICMJE Recommendations for the Conduct of Scholarly Work; ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

attributes.name: qaly_gain
attributes.description: Estimated incremental Quality-Adjusted Life Years (QALYs) gained with the study treatment versus comparator, the primary effectiveness measure in cost-utility analyses for HTA submissions.
attributes.references: NICE DSU Technical Support Documents; EUnetHTA Core Model; ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

attributes.name: rwd_data_source_type
attributes.description: Type of real-world data source used in the study (e.g., claims database, EHR, registry, patient-reported outcomes). Applicable for retrospective RWD studies and RWE generation. Null for purely modeled studies.
attributes.references: FDA Framework for Real-World Evidence Program (2018); ISPOR RWE Good Practices Task Force

attributes.name: rwd_data_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the external data vendor or data provider supplying the real-world dataset (e.g., IQVIA, Optum, Truven, Flatiron Health). Relevant for data use agreement tracking and data provenance.
attributes.references: FDA Framework for Real-World Evidence Program (2018)

attributes.name: rwd_data_vintage
attributes.description: Date range or vintage period of the real-world dataset used in the study (e.g., '2018-2022'), indicating the temporal coverage of the underlying data and its currency for payer submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Framework for Real-World Evidence Program (2018); ISPOR RWE Good Practices Task Force

attributes.name: rwe_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-world evidence (RWE) is incorporated into this HEOR study or model, a key differentiator for payer submissions and HTA dossiers.
attributes.references: FDA Framework for Real-World Evidence Program (2018); ISPOR RWE Good Practices Task Force

attributes.name: study_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Study Code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the HEOR study or evidence asset, used in payer submissions, HTA dossiers, and cross-functional references.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; ICH E9

attributes.name: study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the HEOR study or model was completed and results were finalized, marking the end of the primary evidence generation phase.
attributes.references: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

attributes.name: study_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the HEOR team member or function responsible for the study, accountable for quality, timelines, and payer submission readiness.

products.name: kol_engagement_plan
products.description: This association product represents the strategic engagement plan between a market access strategy and a Key Opinion Leader (KOL). It captures the specific role, engagement tier, activity targets, and effectiveness metrics for each KOL's participation in a given access strategy. Each record links one access_strategy to one hcp_kol_profile with attributes that exist only in the context of this strategic engagement relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, a single access strategy (e.g., launch strategy for a new oncology drug in Germany) engages multiple KOLs across different roles (advisory board members, HTA expert witnesses, publication authors, congress speakers), and each prominent KOL participates in multiple access strategies across different products, indications, and geographies. The business actively manages these engagements as 'KOL Engagement Plans' with specific roles, activity targets, budgets, and effectiveness tracking for each strategy-KOL combination.

products.name: study_data_sourcing
products.description: This association product represents the data sourcing relationship between HEOR studies and RWE datasets. It captures which real-world evidence datasets are used in which HEOR studies, including the role of the dataset in the study, the specific data vintage used, and the contribution characteristics. Each record links one HEOR study to one RWE dataset with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific data sourcing relationship, enabling tracking of dataset reuse across studies and supporting regulatory compliance requirements for model reproducibility.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, HEOR studies routinely integrate multiple RWE datasets (claims, EMR, registries) to generate comprehensive evidence, and strategic RWE datasets are reused across multiple studies to maximize ROI on expensive data acquisition costs. The business actively manages this relationship as 'Study Data Sourcing' with specific attributes (dataset role, contribution type, vintage used, patient counts) that belong to neither the study nor the dataset alone but to each specific study-dataset pairing. This is an operational relationship that HEOR teams create, track, and query for regulatory compliance and model reproducibility.

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Unified consent, opt-in/opt-out, do-not-contact (DNC), and no-see records governing all permissible and restricted communication with HCPs. Single source of truth for contact permissions and restrictions across all channels. Captures consent grants (promotional, medical, digital, email, phone), consent withdrawals, DNC requests, no-see restrictions, compliance-driven contact restrictions, legal holds, and channel-specific limitations. attributes.description: The date on which CMS published this transfer record to the public Open Payments database. Typically June 30 for prior year data.

attributes.name: cms_reporting_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this sunshine transfer record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delay_publication_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether publication of this transfer has been delayed due to ongoing research, clinical investigation, or product development activities.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the covered recipient has disputed this transfer record with CMS and the current resolution status of the dispute.

attributes.name: form_of_payment

attributes.name: internal_transaction_number
attributes.description: The company's internal transaction or payment reference number from the source financial or CRM system (e.g., SAP document number, Veeva CRM activity ID).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this sunshine transfer record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: nature_of_payment
attributes.description: Detailed description of the context and purpose of the payment, including the specific service provided, event attended, or activity performed. Required for CMS transparency reporting.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the transfer in the transaction currency. Represents the gross amount before any adjustments or taxes.

attributes.name: payment_amount_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Amount in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to US Dollars for CMS reporting purposes. Required for all Open Payments submissions regardless of original currency.

attributes.name: payment_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transfer of value occurred or was provided to the recipient. Used to determine the applicable reporting period.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: The nature of the payment or transfer of value as defined by CMS Open Payments categories. Determines reporting requirements and compliance thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: consulting_fee|speaker_honorarium|meal|travel|lodging|education|research_grant|charitable_contribution|royalty_license|ownership_interest|gift|entertainment|honoraria|current_or_prospective_ownership|compensation_for_services_other_than_consulting|space_rental_or_facility_fees|food_and_beverage — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_indication
attributes.description: The therapeutic indication or disease state for which the associated product is marketed or being discussed in the context of this transfer.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The marketed name of the drug or biological product associated with this transfer of value. Required when payment is related to a specific product.

attributes.name: product_ndc
attributes.description: The 11-digit National Drug Code for the associated drug product in 5-4-2 or 11-digit format. Used for product identification in CMS submissions.

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this transfer is being reported to CMS. Determines the applicable reporting deadline and publication cycle.

attributes.name: recipient_address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the recipient's principal business location. Required for CMS Open Payments reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_city
attributes.description: The city of the recipient's principal business location. Required for CMS Open Payments reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_country
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the recipient's principal business location. Typically USA for domestic Open Payments reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_first_name
attributes.description: The first name of the individual healthcare professional who received the transfer of value. Required for CMS Open Payments reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_last_name
attributes.description: The last name of the individual healthcare professional who received the transfer of value. Required for CMS Open Payments reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier for the recipient healthcare professional or organization. Primary identifier for CMS reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_postal_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code of the recipient's principal business location in 5-digit or ZIP+4 format. Required for CMS Open Payments reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_specialty
attributes.description: The primary medical specialty of the recipient healthcare professional (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Internal Medicine). Used for CMS reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: recipient_state
attributes.description: The two-letter US state or territory code of the recipient's principal business location. Required for CMS Open Payments reporting.

attributes.name: recipient_state_license_number
attributes.description: The state medical license number of the recipient healthcare professional. Used for identity verification in Open Payments submissions.

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment recipient as defined by CMS: physician (MD/DO), non-physician practitioner (PA, NP, etc.), or teaching hospital.

attributes.name: research_information_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer is related to research activities and may qualify for delayed publication under CMS rules.

attributes.name: third_party_payment_recipient_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment was made to a third party on behalf of the covered recipient (e.g., payment to a charity designated by the HCP).

attributes.name: third_party_recipient_name
attributes.description: The name of the third-party entity that received the payment on behalf of the covered recipient. Populated when third_party_payment_recipient_indicator is true.

attributes.name: market_share_percent

attributes.name: prescribing_channel

attributes.name: prescribing_rank_national
attributes.description: National ranking of the HCP based on total prescriptions for the product, with 1 being the highest prescriber.

attributes.name: prescribing_rank_regional
attributes.description: Regional ranking of the HCP based on total prescriptions for the product within their geographic territory.

attributes.name: prescribing_trend

attributes.name: prior_authorization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of prescriptions that required prior authorization approval from payers.

attributes.name: projection_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate prescribing volumes when complete data is not available (actual count, statistical projection, extrapolation, or predictive model).

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: refill_prescriptions

attributes.description: End date of the time period for which prescribing data is aggregated.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period for which prescribing data is aggregated.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area or disease category for the prescribed product (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases).

attributes.name: total_prescriptions_trx
attributes.description: Total number of prescriptions written by the HCP for the product during the reporting period, including both new and refill prescriptions.

attributes.name: total_units_prescribed
attributes.description: Total quantity of product units (tablets, vials, doses) prescribed by the HCP during the reporting period.

attributes.description: Indicates whether payments or transfers of value to this investigator must be reported under the Physician Payments Sunshine Act (Open Payments).

attributes.name: total_subjects_enrolled
attributes.description: Cumulative number of subjects enrolled by this investigator across all trials. Key performance indicator for investigator productivity.

attributes.name: total_trials_conducted
attributes.description: Total number of clinical trials the investigator has conducted as PI or sub-investigator. Performance metric for investigator selection.

products.name: engagement
products.description: This association product represents the operational relationship between healthcare professionals and pharmaceutical company employees (MSLs, medical directors, clinical scientists) in medical affairs field operations. It captures the ongoing professional engagement relationship including therapeutic area focus, interaction patterns, relationship strength metrics, and territory assignments. Each record links one HCP to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this professional engagement relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical medical affairs operations, multiple employees (MSLs, medical directors, clinical scientists) simultaneously maintain distinct professional engagement relationships with the same HCP across different therapeutic areas, territories, and functional roles. Conversely, each employee manages ongoing relationships with multiple HCPs as part of their territory assignment. The business actively manages these relationships as operational entities with specific attributes (relationship type, therapeutic area focus, engagement frequency, strength scoring, territory assignment, primary contact designation) that belong to neither the HCP nor the employee alone but to the relationship itself.

attributes.name: engagement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for engagement

products.name: speaker_program_presentation
products.description: This association product represents the Event between hcp_speaker_program and medicinal_product. It captures individual speaker program events where an HCP presents on a specific medicinal product. Each record links one speaker program event to one medicinal product with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific presentation: venue details, audience metrics, honorarium paid, materials used, and compliance approvals. Supports Sunshine Act reporting and anti-kickback compliance monitoring.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical speaker bureau operations, HCPs are enrolled to present on multiple medicinal products, and each medicinal product is presented by multiple speakers across different events. The business actively manages individual speaker program presentations as distinct operational entities, tracking venue, audience, honorarium, performance ratings, and MLR-approved materials for each speaker-product-event combination. This is a true operational M:N relationship recognized as 'Speaker Program Presentations' or 'Program Events' in the business.

attributes.name: speaker_program_presentation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this speaker program presentation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: hcp_speaker_program_id

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id

Each approved product becomes a record in the association, eliminating the need for a denormalized list in the speaker program entity.]

attributes.name: audience_size
attributes.description: Number of healthcare professionals who attended this specific product presentation. Used for reach metrics and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: audience_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: event_date

attributes.name: event_end_time

attributes.name: event_format
attributes.description: Format of the speaker program event delivery. Determines logistics, compliance requirements, and audience engagement tracking. [Moved from hcp_speaker_program: Event format (in-person, virtual, hybrid) is specific to each speaker-product presentation.]

attributes.name: event_start_time

attributes.name: honorarium_paid

attributes.name: materials_used

attributes.name: mlr_approval_number

attributes.name: presentation_date

attributes.name: speaker_performance_rating

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: venue
attributes.description: Location or facility where this specific product presentation was delivered. Includes venue name and address details.

attributes.name: venue_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the venue where the speaker program event was held. Required for Sunshine Act geographic reporting. [Moved from hcp_speaker_program: Venue address is specific to each speaker-product presentation event.]

attributes.name: venue_city
