attributes.name: api_manufacturer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DMF holder is the manufacturer of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) covered by this DMF. True for Type II DMFs where the holder manufactures the drug substance. Used to distinguish API manufacturers from intermediates suppliers, excipient suppliers, and packaging material suppliers.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 (API GMP); 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the drug substance covered by this DMF. Used for therapeutic area alignment, market access analysis, and competitive intelligence. Applicable primarily to Type II DMFs covering active pharmaceutical ingredients.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; EMA Product Information; ICH E3

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance covered by the DMF. Used for substance identification in regulatory submissions, safety databases, and supply chain qualification. Applicable primarily to Type II (API/DS) and Type IV (excipient) DMFs.
attributes.references: CAS Registry (American Chemical Society); ICH Q11; FDA Substance Registration System (SRS)

attributes.name: cmc_section_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chemistry Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) Section Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) section of the eCTD submission (Module 3) that this DMF supports. Used to map the DMF to the corresponding regulatory dossier section for NDA/BLA/ANDA/MAA submissions.
attributes.references: ICH M4Q (R1) CTD Module 3; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: confidentiality_commitment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority acknowledged the confidential nature of the DMF content. The FDA treats DMF content as confidential trade secret information. This date records when the confidentiality commitment was formally established, supporting IP protection and trade secret management.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420(c); FDA Trade Secret Policy; GDPR Article 9; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DMF record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cross_reference_count
attributes.description: Number of active regulatory applications (NDA, BLA, ANDA, IND, MAA) that currently cross-reference this DMF. Indicates the commercial and regulatory criticality of the DMF; a high count signals high supply chain dependency and elevated risk if the DMF is withdrawn or goes inactive.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: dmf_number
attributes.description: Official DMF number assigned by the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA) upon receipt of the DMF submission. Serves as the primary external identifier used in cross-references within NDA, BLA, ANDA, and IND applications. Format varies by authority (e.g., FDA assigns a numeric DMF number).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: dmf_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DMF with the regulatory authority. 'active' indicates the DMF is in good standing and available for cross-reference; 'inactive' indicates it has not been updated within the required period; 'withdrawn' indicates the holder has formally withdrawn the file; 'under_review' indicates a pending agency review; 'closed' indicates the file has been administratively closed.
attributes.references: FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019); 21 CFR Part 314.420

attributes.name: dmf_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DMF per FDA categorization: Type I (Manufacturing Site, Facilities, Operating Procedures, and Personnel — discontinued by FDA but retained for legacy), Type II (Drug Substance, Drug Substance Intermediate, and Material Used in Their Preparation, or Drug Product), Type III (Packaging Material), Type IV (Excipient, Colorant, Flavor, Essence, or Material Used in Their Preparation), Type V (FDA-Accepted Reference Information). Drives CMC submission strategy and third-party qualification workflows.
attributes.value_regex: Type I|Type II|Type III|Type IV|Type V
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019); ICH Q11

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the drug product or substance covered by the DMF (e.g., tablet, capsule, injectable solution, lyophilized powder, cream, patch). Relevant primarily for Type II (Drug Product) and Type III (Packaging) DMFs. Aligns with FDA/EMA dosage form terminology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|injectable_solution|lyophilized_powder|cream|patch|suspension|gel|suppository|inhalation_powder — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Dosage Form Terminology; EMA EDQM Standard Terms; ICH M4Q CMC Guidance

attributes.name: ectd_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Four-digit eCTD sequence number assigned to the DMF submission or amendment within the eCTD lifecycle. Used to track the submission history and version control of the DMF in the regulatory authority's electronic submission gateway.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Guidance; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DMF became effective and available for cross-reference by applicants in regulatory submissions (NDA, BLA, ANDA, IND). May differ from submission date if the authority requires a review period before the file is deemed active.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: fda_establishment_identifier
attributes.description: FDA Establishment Identifier (FEI) number assigned to the manufacturing facility by the FDA. Used to link the DMF to the FDA's establishment registration database, enabling GMP inspection history lookup and import alert monitoring.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207; FDA Establishment Registration and Drug Listing; FDA FEI Database

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certificate Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the current GMP certificate for the manufacturing site associated with this DMF. Triggers renewal workflows and supplier qualification reviews. An expired GMP certificate may block use of the DMF in new regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210/211; ICH Q7; PIC/S GMP Guide; EMA GMP Certificate Database

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number of the current GMP certificate issued by a recognized regulatory authority or inspection body (e.g., FDA, EMA, PIC/S member authority) for the manufacturing site associated with this DMF. Used for supplier qualification and regulatory compliance verification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210/211; ICH Q7; PIC/S GMP Guide; EMA GMP Certificate Database

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or annual update submitted to the regulatory authority for this DMF. FDA requires annual updates to maintain active status. Tracks currency of the file and triggers compliance alerts when updates are overdue.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: letter_of_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DMF holder issued the Letter of Authorization (LOA) permitting the company to cross-reference this DMF in its regulatory submissions. Relevant when the company is the applicant referencing a third-party DMF.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420(d); FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: letter_of_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Letter of Authorization (LOA) from the DMF holder is required before an applicant can cross-reference this DMF in their regulatory submission. True for most Type II and Type IV DMFs where the holder controls access to confidential manufacturing information.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420(d); FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the manufacturing site is located. Used for import/export compliance, country-of-origin tracking, supply chain risk management, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; 21 CFR Parts 210/211; ICH Q7; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: next_annual_update_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: DMF Next Annual Update Due Date
attributes.description: Calculated due date for the next mandatory annual update submission to maintain active DMF status with the regulatory authority. Derived from the last amendment date plus 12 months. Used for compliance monitoring and proactive submission planning.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional regulatory, operational, or strategic notes related to this DMF. May include information about pending amendments, agency correspondence, supplier negotiations, or lifecycle management decisions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: proprietary_holder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company itself (Pharmaceuticals) is the holder of this DMF (True) or whether it is a third-party supplier DMF that the company cross-references (False). Drives different workflows: internal DMFs require internal maintenance; third-party DMFs require supplier management and LOA tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority to which the DMF was submitted (e.g., FDA for US, EMA for EU, PMDA for Japan, MHRA for UK, NMPA for China). Determines applicable regulatory requirements, format standards (e.g., eCTD vs. paper), and review timelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA|NMPA|WHO|Health Canada|TGA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.420; EMA CMDh Guidance; ICH M4 eCTD; PIC/S

attributes.name: rims_tracking_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regulatory Information Management System (RIMS) Tracking Number
attributes.description: Internal tracking number assigned to this DMF record within the company's Regulatory Information Management System (RIMS), such as Veeva Vault RIM. Used for internal workflow management, submission tracking, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ICH M4 eCTD; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: Intended route of administration for the drug substance or product covered by the DMF (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, topical, inhalation). Applicable for Type II DMFs. Aligns with FDA/EMA route of administration terminology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|intravenous|subcutaneous|intramuscular|topical|inhalation|transdermal|intrathecal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Route of Administration Terminology; EMA EDQM Standard Terms; ICH M4Q

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DMF was first submitted to the regulatory authority. Establishes the official filing date and is used to calculate review timelines, annual update obligations, and IP/exclusivity period calculations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

attributes.name: submission_format
attributes.description: Format in which the DMF was submitted to the regulatory authority: 'eCTD' (Electronic Common Technical Document — mandatory for FDA since 2017 for most submissions), 'paper' (legacy paper-based submission), or 'NeeS' (Non-eCTD Electronic Submission — used in some jurisdictions). Determines document management and archival requirements.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Guidance; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; 21 CFR Part 314.420

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area or disease indication associated with the drug substance covered by this DMF (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular, Neurology). Used for portfolio management, lifecycle planning, and IP strategy alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neurology|infectious_diseases|metabolic|respiratory|dermatology|hematology — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E3; FDA Therapeutic Area Guidance; EMA Therapeutic Area Classification

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official descriptive title of the DMF as submitted to the regulatory authority. Typically includes the substance or material name, manufacturer name, and scope of the file (e.g., 'Drug Substance DMF for [INN] manufactured at [Site]').
attributes.references: FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019); 21 CFR Part 314.420

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DMF record was most recently updated in the enterprise data platform. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data freshness monitoring in compliance with 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault RIM (Regulatory Information Management) system where the DMF submission package and associated correspondence are stored. Enables traceability between the enterprise data platform record and the source regulatory document management system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); FDA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DMF holder formally withdrew the DMF from the regulatory authority. Populated only when dmf_status is 'withdrawn'. Triggers downstream impact assessment for any NDA/BLA/ANDA applications that cross-reference this DMF.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314.420; FDA DMF Guidance for Industry (2019)

Captures agreement type, parties, licensed assets, territory, field of use, exclusivity scope, royalty structure, milestone events (regulatory filing, IND submission, phase completion, NDA approval, first commercial sale, sales thresholds), milestone descriptions, trigger events, milestone due dates, achieved dates, milestone payment amounts, currency, payment status, responsible party, sublicensing rights, and termination conditions. Supports deal management, milestone tracking, revenue recognition (ASC 606), royalty accounting, and partner relationship management.

attributes.name: licensing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the licensing agreement record in the intellectual property portfolio system.

attributes.name: internal_deal_owner_employee_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pharmaceutical business development requires employee ownership of licensing agreements for milestone tracking, diligence monitoring, and contract administration. Replaces text field internal_deal_own

attributes.name: licensor_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Licensing agreements require tracking licensor legal entity for contract management, revenue recognition, and intercompany royalty accounting in pharmaceutical partnerships.

attributes.name: licensor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: In-licensing agreements often involve API/technology suppliers as licensors. Linking enables supplier qualification, audit tracking, and contract management integration. Licensor_name is denormalized;

attributes.name: masterdata_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: License agreements generate costs/revenues allocated to cost centers; required for P&L reporting, royalty expense tracking, and business unit accountability.

attributes.name: masterdata_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: License agreements are assigned to business segments; required for revenue recognition, segment P&L reporting, and royalty income allocation.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Licensing agreements are governed by compliance programs (anti-bribery, transfer pricing, IP compliance, conflict of interest). Program oversight ensures regulatory adherence and third-party due dilig

attributes.name: territory_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: License territories define geographic scope; essential for revenue allocation, royalty calculation, and compliance with territorial restrictions in pharmaceutical licensing.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the licensing agreement, used in correspondence with counterparties, legal counsel, and regulatory filings. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the licensing agreement. Draft: under negotiation. Active: fully executed and in force. Suspended: temporarily paused by mutual consent or breach notice. Terminated: ended before natural expiry. Expired: reached end of term without renewal. Drives deal management workflows and financial reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the licensing agreement by deal structure. In-licensing: rights acquired from a third party. Out-licensing: rights granted to a third party. Cross-licensing: mutual exchange of IP rights. Co-development: joint development with shared IP. Collaboration: broad research or commercialization partnership. Drives revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606.

attributes.name: change_of_control_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a change-of-control clause that grants termination or renegotiation rights upon acquisition or merger of either party. True = change-of-control provision exists; False = no such provision. Critical for M&A due diligence and IP portfolio valuation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K; ICH Q10

attributes.name: commercial_milestone_value
attributes.description: Aggregate value of all commercial milestone payments (e.g., first commercial sale, annual net sales thresholds) defined in the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Supports commercial launch planning and ASC 606 variable consideration estimation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the licensing agreement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED audit trail required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all financial obligations under the agreement (upfront payments, milestones, royalties) are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP). Required for multi-currency royalty accounting and foreign exchange hedging.

attributes.name: development_milestone_value
attributes.description: Aggregate value of all development-stage milestone payments (e.g., IND submission, Phase I/II/III completion) defined in the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Supports clinical development budget planning and ASC 606 variable consideration estimation.
attributes.references: ASC 606; IFRS 15; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: diligence_obligations
attributes.description: Narrative description of the commercially reasonable efforts or best efforts diligence obligations imposed on the licensee to develop and commercialize the licensed product. Failure to meet diligence obligations may trigger termination rights. Used for partner relationship management and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes between the parties. Arbitration: binding arbitration under specified rules (e.g., ICC, AAA). Litigation: resolution through courts of the governing jurisdiction. Mediation: non-binding mediation before escalation. Expert-determination: technical disputes resolved by independent expert.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 314; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the licensing agreement becomes legally binding and operative. Marks the start of the agreement term for royalty accrual, exclusivity period calculation, and milestone tracking. Corresponds to EFFECTIVE_FROM for the MASTER_AGREEMENT role.

attributes.name: exclusivity_type
attributes.description: Scope of exclusivity granted under the license. Exclusive: licensee is the sole permitted user in the territory/field. Non-exclusive: licensor may grant same rights to others. Co-exclusive: limited number of licensees permitted. Semi-exclusive: licensor retains right to practice but not to license others. Critical for generic/biosimilar entry defense strategy.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Rules; 21 CFR Part 314; ICH Q10

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the licensing agreement was formally signed and executed by all parties. May differ from the effective date if the agreement has a retroactive or future effective date. Used for legal record-keeping and audit trails.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the licensing agreement naturally expires at the end of its agreed term. Nullable for perpetual or open-ended agreements. Drives lifecycle management alerts, renewal negotiations, and IP exclusivity planning. Corresponds to EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for the MASTER_AGREEMENT role.

attributes.name: field_of_use
attributes.description: Specific therapeutic area, indication, or application domain within which the licensee is permitted to use the licensed IP. Examples: 'oncology', 'rare diseases', 'human therapeutics only', 'diagnostic use'. Restricts the scope of the license and is critical for exclusivity analysis and sublicensing rights management.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; ICH E6(R2); USPTO Patent Rules

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the agreement. Determines applicable contract law, dispute resolution procedures, and regulatory compliance obligations.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the licensing agreement record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED audit trail required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and change control tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: legal_counsel_reference
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal or external legal counsel responsible for drafting, negotiating, and maintaining the agreement. Used for coordination on patent litigation, IP enforcement, and contract amendments.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; USPTO Patent Rules; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: licensed_asset_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the intellectual property assets covered by the license, including compound names (INN/USAN), patent numbers, know-how, trade secrets, trademarks, or biological sequences. Supports IP portfolio management and freedom-to-operate analysis.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; ICH Q10; USPTO Patent Rules

attributes.name: licensed_asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary intellectual property asset type covered by the agreement. Patent: granted patent rights. Know-how: proprietary technical knowledge. Trademark: brand or trade name rights. Data-package: regulatory data exclusivity or clinical data. Biological-sequence: gene or protein sequence rights. Trade-secret: confidential proprietary information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: patent|know-how|trademark|data-package|biological-sequence|trade-secret|formulation|process — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Rules; 21 CFR Part 314; ICH Q10

attributes.name: licensee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party receiving the license (the licensee). For in-licensing agreements, this is typically the company itself. For out-licensing, this is the external counterparty receiving rights. Used in legal documentation, royalty accounting, and partner relationship management.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; ICH Q10; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: milestone_count
attributes.description: Total number of contractually defined milestone events (development, regulatory, and commercial) specified in the agreement. Used for milestone tracking dashboards, deal management reporting, and ASC 606 performance obligation identification.

attributes.name: regulatory_milestone_value
attributes.description: Aggregate value of all regulatory milestone payments (e.g., NDA/BLA/MAA submission, FDA/EMA approval) defined in the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Supports regulatory affairs planning and ASC 606 variable consideration estimation.
attributes.references: ASC 606; IFRS 15; 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party bears primary responsibility for conducting development activities (clinical trials, regulatory submissions, manufacturing scale-up) under the agreement. Licensor: licensor retains development responsibility. Licensee: licensee assumes development responsibility. Joint: shared responsibility as defined in the agreement.

attributes.name: right_of_first_negotiation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement grants either party a right of first negotiation (ROFN) for additional territories, indications, or follow-on compounds. True = ROFN exists; False = no ROFN. Relevant for lifecycle management and business development strategy.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Rules; ICH Q10; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: royalty_base
attributes.description: The contractual basis on which royalties are calculated. Net-sales: royalties applied to net sales after standard deductions. Gross-sales: royalties applied to gross sales before deductions. Net-revenue: royalties applied to net revenue. Units-sold: royalties calculated per unit sold. Determines the royalty accounting methodology.

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: Contractual royalty rate expressed as a decimal fraction of net sales (e.g., 0.050000 = 5.0%) payable by the licensee to the licensor. Used for royalty accrual calculations, revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15, and P&L forecasting. Null if the agreement uses a tiered royalty structure captured in a separate milestone/royalty schedule.

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number assigned in SAP S/4HANA (SD or FI module) for financial processing of royalty payments, milestone invoicing, and upfront fee recognition. Enables reconciliation between the IP portfolio system and the ERP for royalty accounting and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI; ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sublicensing_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the licensee has the contractual right to sublicense the licensed IP to third parties (e.g., CMOs, CDMOs, or sub-distributors). True = sublicensing permitted; False = sublicensing prohibited. Impacts CMO/CDMO engagement and supply chain structuring.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314; ICH Q10; USPTO Patent Rules

attributes.name: termination_conditions
attributes.description: Summary of the contractual conditions under which either party may terminate the agreement, including material breach cure periods, insolvency triggers, regulatory failure events, and convenience termination rights. Used by legal counsel for contract management and risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 314; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the licensing agreement was terminated prior to its natural expiry, whether by mutual consent, breach, or exercise of termination rights. Null if the agreement has not been terminated. Used for financial close-out and IP rights reversion tracking.

attributes.name: total_deal_value
attributes.description: Total potential deal value including upfront payments, all milestone payments, and estimated royalties over the agreement term, expressed in the agreement currency. Used for deal valuation, P&L forecasting, and investor disclosure. Represents the gross deal value before probability-weighting.
attributes.references: ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: total_milestone_value
attributes.description: Sum of all contractually defined milestone payment amounts across all milestone events in the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Represents the maximum milestone-based consideration achievable under the agreement. Used for deal valuation and revenue recognition planning.

attributes.name: upfront_payment_amount
attributes.description: One-time upfront license fee or signing payment due at execution of the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Recognized as revenue or capitalized as an intangible asset depending on the nature of the license under ASC 606/IFRS 15. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this MASTER_AGREEMENT.

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the fully executed agreement document stored in Veeva Vault (RIM or QualityDocs module). Enables direct navigation from the data product record to the source legal document for audit, due diligence, and regulatory inspection purposes. Aligns with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault RIM; SOX Section 302

products.name: royalty_payment
products.description: Transactional record of royalty payments made or received under licensing agreements. Captures payment date, payment direction (inbound/outbound), royalty basis (net sales, units sold), royalty rate applied, calculation period, gross sales, net sales, deductions, royalty amount, currency, payment status, and reconciliation status. Supports financial reporting, royalty audits, and compliance with licensing agreement terms.

attributes.name: royalty_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each royalty payment transaction record within the intellectual property portfolio management system.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Every royalty payment (in or out) generates a GL posting for revenue/expense recognition. Finance links royalty payments to journal entries for reconciliation, audit trail, SOX compliance, and revenue

attributes.name: licensing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensing agreement under which this royalty payment is made or received. Links the payment to the governing contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ICH Q10

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Royalty payments calculated on product-specific net sales. Essential for financial reporting, deal reconciliation, and product-level P&L attribution. Removes denormalized licensed_product_name.

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patent or intellectual property asset (NCE, NBE, formulation, or process patent) that is the subject of the royalty-bearing license.

attributes.name: primary_royalty_business_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party granting the license (the entity receiving royalty payments in an outbound scenario or paying in an inbound scenario).

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pharmaceutical finance assigns employees to reconcile royalty payments for calculation validation, dispute resolution, and treasury coordination. Critical for revenue recognition, audit trail, and SOX

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustments applied to the calculated royalty amount, such as corrections from prior period reconciliations, audit findings, or contractual true-ups. Positive values increase the payment; negative values reduce it.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty payment record has been flagged for formal royalty audit review, typically triggered by discrepancies between reported sales and expected royalty amounts or by contractual audit rights.

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank-issued transaction reference number or wire transfer confirmation number associated with the royalty payment. Used for bank reconciliation and payment verification.

attributes.name: calculation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the royalty calculation period for which net sales or units sold are being reported and royalties computed. Together with start date defines the reporting window per the licensing agreement.

attributes.name: calculation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the royalty calculation period (e.g., quarter or year) for which net sales or units sold are being reported and royalties computed. Aligns with licensing agreement reporting obligations.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which the royalty payment expense or income is allocated for internal management accounting and P&L reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP/IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty payment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the royalty payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Determines the denomination of all monetary amounts in this record.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: deductions_amount
attributes.description: Total allowable deductions applied to gross sales to arrive at net sales, as defined in the licensing agreement. Typically includes chargebacks, rebates, returns, freight, and applicable taxes.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for disputing the royalty payment amount, applicable when payment_status is 'disputed'. Documents the basis for disagreement between licensor and licensee for legal and audit purposes.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the royalty payment must be made as specified in the licensing agreement. Used to track overdue payments and trigger escalation workflows.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency to the company's functional reporting currency at the time of payment. Required for multi-currency licensing agreements and consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP/IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Total payment amount converted to the company's functional reporting currency using the applicable exchange rate. Used for consolidated P&L reporting and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger account code to which this royalty payment is posted for financial reporting purposes. Distinguishes royalty income (inbound) from royalty expense (outbound) in the P&L.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP/IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: gross_sales_amount
attributes.description: Total gross sales revenue generated from the licensed product during the calculation period, before any deductions. Used as the starting point for net sales calculation per the licensing agreement definition.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX

attributes.name: licensed_territory
attributes.description: Geographic territory or market for which the royalty payment applies, as defined in the licensing agreement. May be a country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), region, or 'GLOBAL'. Supports territory-level royalty analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Licensing Agreement Terms; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: minimum_royalty_amount
attributes.description: Contractual minimum royalty amount guaranteed per period as specified in the licensing agreement, regardless of actual sales performance. Applicable when the calculated royalty falls below this floor.

attributes.name: net_sales_amount
attributes.description: Net sales revenue for the licensed product during the calculation period, calculated as gross sales minus allowable deductions per the licensing agreement definition. Forms the royalty basis for net-sales-based agreements.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the royalty payment was executed (funds transferred or received). Represents the principal real-world business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: payment_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the royalty payment is inbound (received by the company as licensor) or outbound (paid by the company as licensee). Critical for P&L classification and financial reporting.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the royalty payment (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check, offset against receivables, or netting against other obligations).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this royalty payment transaction, typically matching the SAP FI document number or bank remittance reference used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the royalty payment transaction. Tracks progression from draft calculation through approval, payment execution, and final settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending|approved|paid|disputed|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the royalty payment reconciliation process, indicating whether the payment has been matched against the licensee's royalty report and confirmed as accurate. Supports royalty audit workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: royalty_amount
attributes.description: Calculated royalty amount due for the calculation period, derived by applying the royalty rate to the applicable royalty basis (net sales, gross sales, or units sold). This is the principal monetary fact of the transaction.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX

attributes.name: royalty_basis
attributes.description: The contractual basis upon which the royalty is calculated, as defined in the licensing agreement. Common bases include net sales, gross sales, units sold, milestone achievements, or sublicense revenue.

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: The contractual royalty rate applied to the royalty basis (expressed as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.05 for 5%). May be tiered based on sales thresholds as defined in the licensing agreement. Classified confidential as it reflects proprietary deal terms.

attributes.name: royalty_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the royalty statement or sales report submitted by the licensee that forms the basis for this royalty payment calculation. Links the payment to the supporting documentation.

attributes.name: royalty_tier_label
attributes.description: Label identifying the applicable royalty tier when the licensing agreement specifies tiered rates based on cumulative net sales thresholds (e.g., 'Tier 1: 0-$100M', 'Tier 2: $100M-$500M'). Null if the agreement uses a flat rate.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area classification of the licensed drug product (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Supports portfolio-level royalty analytics and strategic lifecycle management decisions.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: Final net royalty payment amount after applying the royalty rate to the basis, enforcing any minimum royalty floor, and incorporating adjustments. This is the amount actually paid or received.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Number of units of the licensed product sold during the calculation period. Used as the royalty basis for unit-based royalty agreements. Expressed as DECIMAL to accommodate partial units or volume-based measures.
attributes.references: Licensing Agreement Terms; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty payment record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the royalty payment at source, as required by applicable tax treaties between the licensor and licensee jurisdictions. Relevant for cross-border licensing arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; OECD Tax Treaties; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: Applicable withholding tax rate (expressed as a decimal fraction) applied to the royalty payment based on the tax treaty between the relevant jurisdictions. Used to validate withholding tax amount calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; OECD Tax Treaties

products.name: fto_analysis
products.description: Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) analysis and competitive IP watch records. Covers FTO assessments determining whether a product, process, or technology can be commercialized without infringing third-party IP rights, plus ongoing monitoring of competitor IP activities (patent filings, ANDA/505(b)(2) submissions, biosimilar applications, patent challenges). Captures analysis title, scope, requestor, conducting attorney or firm, analysis date, product or technology assessed, jurisdictions covered, identified blocking patents, risk level, recommended actions, final opinion, watch type, competitor identity, filing dates, reference numbers, technology area, affected products, and threat assessment. Supports go/no-go decisions for product development, commercial launch, and proactive IP defense strategy.

attributes.name: fto_analysis_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) analysis or competitive IP watch record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: FTO analyses are jurisdiction-specific; critical for market entry risk assessment, product launch planning, and patent landscape analysis in target markets.

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: FTO opinions are product-specific for launch risk assessment, design-around strategy, and IP clearance. Essential for R&D and commercial decision-making. Removes denormalized product identifiers.

attributes.name: ip_watch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.ip_watch. Business justification: Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) analyses are often triggered by IP watch alerts (e.g., competitor patent grant, Paragraph IV notice). Linking fto_analysis to ip_watch tracks which competitive intelligence ev

attributes.name: masterdata_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: FTO analyses are charged to requesting business units; required for cost allocation, chargeback processing, and legal spend tracking in pharmaceutical IP.

attributes.name: requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pharmaceutical R&D requires tracking which employee requested FTO analysis for project prioritization, budget allocation, and regulatory inspection readiness. Replaces text field requestor_name with s

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_risk_register. Business justification: FTO analyses identify IP infringement risks that populate compliance risk registers. Blocking patents create regulatory and commercial compliance risks requiring risk treatment plans and board reporti

attributes.name: affected_product_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of proprietary product names or INNs that are commercially affected by the FTO analysis findings or the competitor IP watch activity. Supports portfolio-level impact assessment and lifecycle management decisions.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FTO analysis was formally conducted or the opinion was rendered by the responsible attorney or firm. Represents the principal business event date for this record.

attributes.name: analysis_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the FTO analysis or IP watch record, used for tracking across legal, regulatory, and business functions. Format: FTO-YYYY-NNNNN.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: analysis_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the FTO analysis record: draft (initiated, not yet reviewed), in_review (under attorney or committee review), completed (final opinion issued), superseded (replaced by a newer analysis), or cancelled.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10

attributes.name: analysis_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the Freedom-to-Operate analysis or competitive IP watch record, summarizing the product, technology, or process under assessment.

attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the analysis record: FTO assessment (go/no-go commercialization opinion), IP watch (ongoing competitor monitoring), patent landscape (broad mapping), clearance opinion (legal freedom-to-use), or freedom-to-use. Drives workflow and reporting.

attributes.name: competitor_filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the competitor filed the patent application, ANDA, biosimilar application, or other regulatory/IP submission being monitored. Critical for calculating response timelines and exclusivity defense windows.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; Hatch-Waxman Act; BPCIA

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor company whose IP activities are being monitored in this watch record (e.g., generic manufacturer filing an ANDA, biosimilar applicant, or third-party patent filer). Central to competitive intelligence.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book

attributes.name: competitor_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number of the competitor's filing being monitored, such as an ANDA application number, biosimilar BLA number, patent publication number, or IPR petition number. Enables direct lookup in regulatory and patent databases.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; FDA; USPTO; EPO; WIPO

attributes.name: conducting_attorney
attributes.description: Name of the internal patent attorney or external legal counsel responsible for conducting and signing off on the FTO analysis. Critical for attorney-client privilege tracking and legal accountability.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to the FTO analysis record, governing access controls and information sharing: restricted (attorney-client privilege, highly sensitive), confidential (internal legal/IP team only), internal (general internal use), or public. Aligns with enterprise data governance policy.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5; HIPAA; Veeva Vault RIM; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FTO analysis record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.

attributes.name: design_around_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FTO analysis concluded that a design-around strategy is required to avoid infringement of identified blocking patents before commercialization can proceed.

attributes.name: dmf_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Drug Master File (DMF) associated with the drug substance or manufacturing process under FTO assessment, if applicable. Links the IP analysis to the CMC regulatory submission package.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.420; Veeva Vault RIM; ICH Q10

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the relevant regulatory exclusivity period (orphan drug, data exclusivity, pediatric, NCE, etc.) expires for the assessed product. Determines the earliest date a competitor could receive approval for a generic or biosimilar.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; Hatch-Waxman Act; BPCIA; EMA; Orphan Drug Act

attributes.name: exclusivity_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory exclusivity relevant to the FTO analysis or IP watch record: orphan_drug, data_exclusivity, pediatric, new_chemical_entity (NCE), biological, or market exclusivity. Informs the window of protection against generic or biosimilar entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: orphan_drug|data_exclusivity|pediatric|new_chemical_entity|biological|market — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; Orphan Drug Act; BPCIA; Hatch-Waxman Act; EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000

attributes.name: final_opinion
attributes.description: The formal legal opinion rendered by the conducting attorney: clear (free to operate without infringement risk), conditional_clear (free to operate subject to design-arounds or licensing), blocked (cannot commercialize without infringing), inconclusive (insufficient information), or pending (opinion not yet issued).
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10

attributes.name: law_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the external law firm or patent agency engaged to conduct the FTO analysis, if applicable. Supports vendor management, cost tracking, and attorney-client privilege documentation.

attributes.name: licensing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FTO analysis concluded that a license must be obtained from a third-party patent holder before the assessed product or technology can be commercialized.

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FTO analysis or IP watch record is associated with active or anticipated patent litigation (e.g., Paragraph IV ANDA challenge, IPR petition, patent infringement suit). Triggers escalation to senior legal counsel.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; Hatch-Waxman Act; 35 USC; 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: patent_expiry_relevance_date
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among the blocking patents identified in the FTO analysis, representing the date after which the primary IP barrier may no longer apply. Critical for lifecycle management and generic/biosimilar entry defense planning.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; USPTO; EPO; 35 USC; ICH Q10

attributes.name: recommended_actions
attributes.description: Narrative description of recommended next steps arising from the FTO analysis, such as design-around strategies, licensing negotiations, patent challenge (IPR/PGR), freedom-to-use licensing, or further legal investigation. Drives IP strategy execution.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ICH Q10; 35 USC (US Patent Act)

attributes.name: requestor_department
attributes.description: Business department or function that initiated the FTO analysis request (e.g., R&D, Commercial, Regulatory Affairs, Legal). Used for workload tracking and cross-functional reporting.

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the FTO analysis or IP watch record must be reviewed and updated to reflect changes in the patent landscape, competitor activities, or product development status. Supports proactive IP portfolio management.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall IP infringement risk level assigned by the conducting attorney following the FTO analysis: high (significant blocking IP identified, commercialization at risk), medium (some risk, mitigation possible), low (minor risk, manageable), or negligible (no material blocking IP found).
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: risk_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative explanation supporting the assigned risk level, summarizing the key blocking patents, claim analysis findings, and legal reasoning that led to the risk determination. Supports legal review and business decision-making.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scope of the FTO analysis, including the specific product features, process steps, formulation parameters, or technology elements assessed for potential third-party IP infringement.

attributes.name: technology_area
attributes.description: Broad technology or therapeutic area classification of the subject matter under FTO assessment (e.g., oncology, immunology, rare diseases, formulation, manufacturing process, delivery device). Supports portfolio-level IP analytics.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ATC Classification; ICH Q10

attributes.name: threat_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the competitive threat posed by the monitored competitor activity: critical (immediate commercial impact expected), high (significant risk to market exclusivity), medium (moderate risk requiring active response), low (limited near-term impact), or monitoring (no immediate action required).
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; ICH Q10; Hatch-Waxman Act; BPCIA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this FTO analysis record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail, version control, and change management per 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the FTO analysis document (e.g., 1.0, 2.1), tracking revisions and updates to the analysis over time. Supports document control and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault RIM; ICH Q10

attributes.name: watch_type
attributes.description: For competitive IP watch records, classifies the type of competitor activity being monitored: patent_filing (new patent applications), anda_submission (Abbreviated New Drug Application), biosimilar_application (biosimilar filing), patent_challenge (IPR/PGR/opposition), regulatory_filing, or trademark. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: patent_filing|anda_submission|biosimilar_application|patent_challenge|regulatory_filing|trademark — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; Hatch-Waxman Act; BPCIA

products.name: patent_litigation
products.description: Tracks active and historical patent litigation cases including Paragraph IV ANDA challenges, inter partes review (IPR) petitions, post-grant review (PGR), patent infringement suits, and declaratory judgment actions. Captures case number, court or tribunal, case type, filing date, parties (plaintiff, defendant), asserted patents, accused products, litigation status, key milestones, outside counsel, estimated liability, and outcome. Critical for generic/biosimilar entry defense strategy and legal budget management.
products.reference: Hatch-Waxman Paragraph IV / BPCIA Patent Dance

attributes.name: patent_litigation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each patent litigation case record in the intellectual property portfolio management system.

attributes.name: budget_id

attributes.name: country_id

attributes.name: defendant_vendor_id
