products.name: patent_license
products.description: This association product represents the licensing relationship between a patent and a licensing agreement. It captures the specific terms, scope, and financial arrangements under which each patent is licensed within a broader agreement. Each record links one patent to one licensing agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific patent-agreement pairing, such as territory-specific exclusivity, field-of-use restrictions, and patent-specific royalty rates that may differ from the agreement-level defaults.. Existence Justification: Patent licensing in pharmaceuticals is operationally many-to-many. A single patent (e.g., a composition-of-matter patent covering a blockbuster compound) is routinely licensed through multiple agreements—an exclusive license to Partner A for oncology indications in North America, a co-exclusive license to Partner B for autoimmune indications in Europe, and a non-exclusive license to Partner C for diagnostic use globally. Conversely, a single licensing agreement typically bundles multiple patents—composition patents, formulation patents, method-of-use patents, and process patents—to provide comprehensive IP coverage for a product or platform. Business development teams actively manage these patent-agreement pairings, negotiating patent-specific terms (territory, exclusivity, royalty rates, field-of-use restrictions) that vary within the same agreement.

attributes.name: patent_license_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each patent-licensing agreement pairing. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: licensing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the licensing agreement under which this patent is licensed

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the patent being licensed under this agreement

attributes.name: diligence_obligations
attributes.description: Narrative description of commercially reasonable efforts or best efforts diligence obligations specific to this patent (e.g., 'Licensee must file IND for Patent A compound within 18 months'). May differ from agreement-level diligence if certain patents have accelerated or deferred development timelines.

attributes.name: enforcement_rights
attributes.description: Identifies which party has the right to enforce this patent against third-party infringers during the license term. Licensor: licensor retains enforcement rights. Licensee: licensee has enforcement rights (common in exclusive licenses). Joint: both parties must agree. Licensee-First-Right: licensee has first right to enforce; licensor may enforce if licensee declines. May vary by patent within the same agreement.

attributes.name: exclusion_date
attributes.description: Date on which this patent was removed from the licensing agreement, if applicable. May occur due to patent expiry, invalidation, amendment, or strategic decision to narrow the licensed portfolio. Null if the patent remains actively licensed.

attributes.name: exclusivity_type
attributes.description: Scope of exclusivity granted for this specific patent within the agreement. Exclusive: licensee is the sole licensee globally or in the specified territory. Co-Exclusive: licensor may grant rights to a limited number of additional licensees. Non-Exclusive: licensor retains the right to license to others. Sole: licensee is the only licensee, but licensor retains rights to practice the patent. May vary by patent within the same agreement.

attributes.name: field_of_use
attributes.description: Specific therapeutic area, indication, or application domain within which this patent is licensed under the agreement. May be narrower than the agreement-level field_of_use if certain patents are restricted to specific indications (e.g., Patent A for oncology only, Patent B for all indications). Stored as free text or controlled vocabulary (e.g., 'Oncology - NSCLC', 'Immunology - Rheumatoid Arthritis').

attributes.name: inclusion_date
attributes.description: Date on which this patent was added to the licensing agreement. May be the agreement effective_date for patents included at execution, or a later date if patents were added via amendment or automatic inclusion clauses (e.g., all patents filed during the term are automatically included).

attributes.name: license_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of rights granted for this specific patent within the agreement. Full grants all rights; Limited restricts to specific claims or applications; Research-Only excludes commercial use; Commercial-Only excludes research use; Diagnostic-Only restricts to diagnostic applications. Scope may vary by patent within the same agreement.

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current status of the license for this specific patent within the agreement. Active: license is in force. Suspended: temporarily paused due to breach, non-payment, or force majeure. Terminated: license ended prior to agreement expiry. Expired: license ended due to patent expiry or agreement expiry. Status may vary by patent within the same agreement.

attributes.name: maintenance_fee_responsibility
attributes.description: Identifies which party is responsible for paying patent maintenance fees (annuities) for this specific patent during the license term. Licensor: licensor pays. Licensee: licensee reimburses or pays directly. Shared: costs split per agreement terms. May vary by patent within the same agreement.

attributes.name: patent_specific_milestone_value
attributes.description: Aggregate value of milestone payments specifically tied to this patent (e.g., regulatory approval milestone triggered only if this patent covers the approved product). Null if no patent-specific milestones exist. Complements agreement-level milestone tracking.

attributes.name: patent_specific_upfront_payment
attributes.description: One-time upfront payment allocated to this specific patent, if the agreement structure assigns value to individual patents (common in patent portfolio acquisitions or carve-out deals). Null if upfront payment is agreement-level only.

attributes.name: prosecution_control
attributes.description: Identifies which party controls patent prosecution (filing, amendments, responses to office actions) for this specific patent during the license term. Licensor: licensor retains control. Licensee: licensee assumes control (common in exclusive licenses). Joint: both parties must agree. May vary by patent within the same agreement.

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: Patent-specific royalty rate expressed as a decimal fraction of net sales (e.g., 0.035 for 3.5%). May differ from the agreement-level royalty_rate when certain patents command premium rates (e.g., composition-of-matter patents vs. formulation patents) or when royalty stacking applies. Null if this patent does not trigger royalty obligations.

attributes.name: sublicensing_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the licensee has the contractual right to sublicense this specific patent to third parties. May differ from the agreement-level sublicensing_permitted if certain high-value patents (e.g., composition-of-matter) are excluded from sublicensing rights while others are permitted.

attributes.name: territory
attributes.description: Geographic territory or jurisdiction(s) in which this specific patent is licensed under the agreement. May be narrower than the agreement-level territory if certain patents are restricted to specific regions (e.g., US-only for composition patents, EU for formulation patents). Stored as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region codes (e.g., 'USA', 'EU', 'APAC', 'Global').

products.name: blocking_patent_assessment
products.description: This association product represents the evaluation of third-party patents that may block commercialization of company products or technologies. Each record links one third-party patent to one FTO analysis, capturing the IP counsel's assessment of infringement risk, claim mapping, design-around strategies, and licensing recommendations specific to that patent-analysis combination. This is a core operational entity in pharmaceutical IP risk management, actively created and maintained by patent attorneys during FTO assessments.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical IP risk management, FTO analyses routinely evaluate multiple third-party patents that may block commercialization, and each third-party patent may be assessed across multiple FTO analyses for different products or technologies. IP counsel creates blocking patent assessment records that capture patent-specific risk levels, claim mappings, design-around strategies, and licensing recommendations that exist only in the context of a specific patent-analysis combination. This is a recognized operational entity actively managed by patent attorneys.

attributes.name: blocking_patent_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each blocking patent assessment record.

attributes.name: fto_analysis_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blocking Patent Assessment - Fto Analysis Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the FTO analysis in which this patent was identified and assessed.

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the third-party patent being assessed as a potential blocking patent in this FTO analysis.

attributes.name: assessing_attorney
attributes.description: Name of the patent attorney or IP counsel who conducted the assessment of this specific patent within the FTO analysis. May differ from the overall conducting attorney if multiple attorneys divided the patent review workload.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which this specific patent was assessed within the FTO analysis. May differ from the overall FTO analysis date if patents were evaluated in phases or if the assessment was updated.

attributes.name: blocking_patent_count
attributes.description: Total number of third-party patents identified during the FTO analysis as potentially blocking or relevant to the commercialization of the assessed product or technology. Key metric for risk quantification. [Moved from fto_analysis: This is an aggregate count that should be derived from the blocking_patent_assessment association table via COUNT() rather than stored redundantly in fto_analysis. Moving it eliminates data synchronization risk.]

attributes.name: blocking_patent_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of patent publication or grant numbers (e.g., US10123456B2, EP3456789A1) identified as potentially blocking in the FTO analysis. Enables direct cross-referencing with patent databases and IP watch systems. [Moved from fto_analysis: This comma-separated list is a denormalized representation of the M:N relationship. The patent numbers should be retrieved via JOIN to the blocking_patent_assessment association and then to the patent table, eliminating redundancy and ensuring data consistency.]
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM; USPTO; EPO; WIPO PCT

attributes.name: claim_mapping
attributes.description: Detailed mapping of specific patent claims (e.g., claims 1, 3, 7-12) to the company's product features, formulation elements, or process steps that may infringe. This is relationship-specific because it describes how THIS patent's claims read on THIS product/technology under analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this blocking patent assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: design_around_strategy
attributes.description: Narrative description of the proposed design-around approach to avoid infringement of this specific patent, such as alternative formulation, different synthesis route, modified dosing regimen, or alternative excipients. This is relationship-specific because the design-around is tailored to both the patent claims and the product under analysis.

attributes.name: invalidity_assessment
attributes.description: IP counsel's assessment of potential grounds for challenging the validity of this patent (e.g., prior art references, obviousness arguments, enablement deficiencies). This is relationship-specific because invalidity strategy is developed in the context of the specific FTO analysis and product development timeline.

attributes.name: licensing_recommendation
attributes.description: IP counsel's recommendation on whether a license should be pursued for this patent in the context of this FTO analysis. Values: required (license necessary to proceed), recommended (license advisable to mitigate risk), optional (license could reduce risk but not essential), not_required (no license needed). This is relationship-specific because licensing need depends on both the patent scope and the specific product/technology.

attributes.name: non_infringement_rationale
attributes.description: Legal rationale explaining why the company's product or technology does not infringe this patent, citing specific claim limitations, product specifications, or process differences. This is relationship-specific because the non-infringement argument is tailored to both the patent claims and the product under analysis.

attributes.name: risk_level_per_patent
attributes.description: IP infringement risk level assigned specifically to this patent within the context of this FTO analysis. Values: critical (immediate blocking threat), high (significant infringement risk), medium (moderate risk requiring monitoring), low (minimal risk), negligible (no material risk). This is relationship-specific because the same patent may pose different risk levels to different products or technologies.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this blocking patent assessment record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Owns enterprise financial data including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cost accounting, budgeting, R&D capitalization, COGS by product, royalty accounting, and SOX-compliant financial reporting. Integrates with SAP FI/CO modules. Supports P&L by therapeutic area, brand, and geography, return on investment (ROI) for R&D programs, and capital expenditure tracking.

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: Central repository for all financial accounting entries across the enterprise, representing the authoritative chart of accounts, account balances, and period-end ledger positions. Captures account master data (account number, account type, account group, currency), period balances (opening, debit totals, credit totals, closing balance by period), company code, profit center allocations, cost center references, and currency translations as sourced from SAP FI module. Serves as SSOT for trial balance, balance sheet, income statement, and SOX-compliant period-end close processes across all legal entities in the pharmaceutical group. Supports consolidation eliminations, multi-GAAP reporting (US GAAP and IFRS), and financial close status tracking. Does NOT own individual postings (owned by journal_entry) — owns aggregate balances and account structure.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each general ledger account balance record in the Silver layer. Serves as the primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1/GLT0

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: SAP ledger identifier distinguishing between parallel ledgers (e.g., '0L' for leading ledger, 'N1' for IFRS non-leading ledger, 'U1' for US GAAP ledger). Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements across the pharmaceutical group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Parallel Ledger; IFRS; US GAAP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: Account group code that controls the number range and field selection for the GL account (e.g., 'OPEX', 'CAPX', 'COGS', 'RDEX'). Used to segment accounts by business function such as R&D expense, COGS, or capital expenditure in pharmaceutical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table T077S; US GAAP ASC 730 (R&D); IFRS IAS 38

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account master record: active (postings allowed), blocked (postings temporarily prevented), or marked_for_deletion (pending archival). Supports SOX-compliant account master data governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP account type classification: A=Assets, D=Customers (Accounts Receivable), K=Vendors (Accounts Payable), M=Materials, S=General Ledger. Determines posting rules and balance sheet/income statement classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1 field KTOKS; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: balance_sheet_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GL account is a balance sheet account (True) or a profit and loss (P&L) income statement account (False). Balance sheet accounts carry forward balances; P&L accounts are reset at year-end. Critical for financial statement classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1 field XBILK; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code used for internal segment reporting across legal entities. Supports cross-company-code P&L and balance sheet reporting by business division (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Consumer Health, Vaccines).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table TGSB; IFRS 8; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: Identifier for the chart of accounts framework applied to this GL account (e.g., 'INT1' for international, 'USGP' for US GAAP). Supports multi-GAAP reporting across the pharmaceutical group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table T004; US GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: The GL account balance at the end of the fiscal period in transaction currency, calculated as opening balance plus debits minus credits (or vice versa depending on account type). Authoritative balance for trial balance, balance sheet, and income statement reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: closing_balance_gc
attributes.description: The GL account closing balance translated into the group consolidation currency. Used for consolidated financial statements, group P&L reporting, and multi-entity consolidation eliminations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; IFRS 10; US GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: closing_balance_lc
attributes.description: The GL account closing balance translated into the company code local currency. Used for statutory reporting and local GAAP compliance in each legal entity's jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit for which the ledger balance is recorded. Aligns with the legal entity structure of the pharmaceutical group for statutory and consolidated reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table T001; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: company_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local (company code) currency in which balances are reported for statutory purposes. Distinct from transaction currency to support currency translation and consolidation eliminations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21 Foreign Currency Transactions

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center code identifying the organizational unit responsible for the costs recorded in this GL account balance (e.g., a manufacturing plant, clinical operations department, or R&D lab). Supports cost accounting and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Module; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Total credit postings to the GL account during the fiscal period in transaction currency. Sourced from aggregated journal entry postings in SAP FI. Used in trial balance and double-entry bookkeeping validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the GL balance amounts are originally recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP). Required for multi-currency pharmaceutical operations across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: Total debit postings to the GL account during the fiscal period in transaction currency. Sourced from aggregated journal entry postings in SAP FI. Used in trial balance and double-entry bookkeeping validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number (1–16, where periods 13–16 are special closing periods) within the fiscal year for which the balance is recorded. Supports period-end close, monthly P&L reporting, and SOX-compliant financial close tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) for which the GL account balance is recorded. Aligns with the company's fiscal year variant as configured in SAP. Used for annual financial close, SOX compliance, and year-over-year comparisons.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP ASC 270; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: fs_item
attributes.description: Financial statement item code mapping the GL account to a specific line in the balance sheet or income statement (e.g., P&L by therapeutic area, balance sheet line). Supports multi-GAAP consolidation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGL_SEGM; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area code classifying the GL account balance by business function (e.g., 'MFGC' for manufacturing/COGS, 'RDEX' for R&D expense, 'SELL' for selling expense, 'GADM' for general and administrative). Supports cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) and P&L by function reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MFGC|RDEX|SELL|GADM|CLIN|REGL|PROC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Module; US GAAP ASC 730 (R&D); IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: gaap_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which this ledger balance is reported (US_GAAP, IFRS, LOCAL_GAAP, or IFRS_AND_US_GAAP for dual-reporting ledgers). Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements for the pharmaceutical group's global legal entities.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation; US GAAP FASB; SAP S/4HANA Parallel Ledger; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gl_account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account as defined in the chart of accounts (e.g., 'Research and Development Expense', 'API Inventory', 'Accrued Clinical Trial Costs'). Used in financial reports and trial balance outputs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: The chart-of-accounts account number uniquely identifying the GL account within the company code. Used as the primary business identifier for account lookup, trial balance, and financial statement mapping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the group (consolidation) currency used in consolidated financial statements (e.g., USD for a US-headquartered pharmaceutical group). Supports group-level P&L and balance sheet consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Consolidation; IFRS 10; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account balance contains intercompany transactions (True) that require elimination during group consolidation. Supports consolidation eliminations for the pharmaceutical group's multi-entity structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Intercompany; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: last_posted_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which a journal entry posting was made to this GL account within the fiscal period. Used for account activity monitoring, dormant account identification, and period-end close validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The GL account balance at the start of the fiscal period in transaction currency. Represents the carried-forward closing balance from the prior period. Used in trial balance preparation and period-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table FAGLFLEXT; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: period_close_status
attributes.description: Current status of the financial period close process for this GL account balance: open (period active), in_progress (close activities underway), closed (period-end close completed), or locked (period locked against further postings). Supports SOX-compliant financial close tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — OB52 Period Control; SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP ASC 855

attributes.name: posting_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account are currently blocked (True) at the company code level. A blocked account prevents new journal entries, used during period-end close or account restructuring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1 field XSPEB; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP profit center code representing the business unit or therapeutic area (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases) to which the GL balance is allocated. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, and geography.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Module; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: rd_capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GL account balance is subject to R&D capitalization rules under IFRS IAS 38 (True) or expensed as incurred under US GAAP ASC 730 (False). Critical for pharmaceutical companies managing the boundary between R&D expense and intangible asset capitalization.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 38 Intangible Assets; US GAAP ASC 730 Research and Development; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: recon_account_type
attributes.description: Indicates if this GL account is a reconciliation account and its type: D=Accounts Receivable (Customers), K=Accounts Payable (Vendors), A=Assets, or empty for non-reconciliation accounts. Reconciliation accounts aggregate subledger balances into the GL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Table SKB1 field MITKZ; US GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GL account balance record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX-compliant record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GL account balance record was last modified in the Silver layer data product. Supports incremental data loading, change tracking, and SOX-compliant audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Segment identifier for IFRS 8 / ASC 280 segment reporting (e.g., 'Oncology', 'Immunology', 'Rare Disease', 'Consumer Health'). Enables disaggregated P&L and asset reporting by operating segment for external financial disclosures.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; US GAAP ASC 280; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Segment

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is in scope for SOX Section 302/404 internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR). SOX-relevant accounts require documented controls, testing, and sign-off during the annual audit cycle.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code associated with the GL account for VAT/GST and withholding tax determination. Relevant for pharmaceutical entities operating across multiple tax jurisdictions. Supports indirect tax reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module; IFRS IAS 12 Income Taxes; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner for balances involving intercompany transactions. Used to identify and eliminate intercompany balances during group consolidation. Populated only when intercompany_flag is True.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Intercompany — Table FAGLFLEXT field RASSC; IFRS 10; US GAAP ASC 810

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Individual accounting transactions posted to the general ledger with full header and line-item detail, including tax-specific postings. Header captures posting date, document type, reference number, fiscal year/period, currency, and posting user. Line items capture GL account, cost center, profit center, debit/credit amounts in transaction and local currency, tax code, tax jurisdiction, taxable base amount, tax amount, withholding tax, assignment field, and line item text. Encompasses all subledger postings (AP, AR, asset, tax) and manual adjustments. Tax postings carry additional attributes: tax jurisdiction, tax return reference, VAT/sales tax/deferred tax classification, and indirect tax reporting period for multi-jurisdiction compliance. Supports audit trails required under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11, financial close processes, and granular P&L analysis by therapeutic area, brand, and geography.
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry / Accounting Document

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the general ledger. Primary key for the journal_entry data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: Journal entries generated by AP postings should reference the source AP document. This is a nullable FK since not all journal entries are AP-related. Strengthens accounts_payable connections to journa

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Journal entries require audit trail linking posting_user to employee master for SOX compliance, segregation of duties controls, and financial audit requirements. Existing posting_user is username stri

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Journal entries related to fixed asset transactions (acquisition, depreciation, disposal, impairment) should reference the specific asset. This is a nullable FK since not all journal entries are asset

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Journal entries post to specific GL accounts. Each JE line item must reference the GL account it impacts. The existing gl_account field is a STRING code; adding general_ledger_id establishes the prope

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: Journal entries for inventory receipts and accruals link to goods receipts for inventory accounting audit trail and period-end accrual validation. Essential for pharmaceutical inventory accounting, en

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Journal entries that charge costs to internal orders should reference the internal order. This is a nullable FK since not all journal entries are internal-order-related. Connects internal_order to jou

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_invoice. Business justification: Journal entries for invoice accruals and postings need vendor invoice traceability for audit trail and invoice-to-GL reconciliation. Critical for pharmaceutical financial close processes, SOX complian

attributes.name: amount_group_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the journal entry translated into the corporate group reporting currency (typically USD or EUR) for consolidated P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, and geography.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS 10; IAS 21; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the journal entry translated into the company code's local (functional) currency using the applicable exchange rate. Used for statutory financial reporting and local tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 21; IFRS; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount of the journal entry in the original transaction currency. For debit entries this is positive; for credit entries this is negative (SAP sign convention). Core monetary fact for the posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 21; IFRS 15; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: SAP assignment field (ZUONR) used for sorting and matching open items in accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliation. Typically populated with invoice number, payment reference, or contract number for automated clearing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing an organizational unit for which an internal balance sheet and P&L can be drawn up. Used for segment reporting across geographies and therapeutic areas.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS 8; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code identifying the legal entity for which the journal entry is posted. Enables P&L reporting by legal entity and supports multi-entity consolidation across the pharmaceutical group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center to which the expense or revenue is assigned. Enables cost allocation by department, therapeutic area, or function (e.g., R&D, Manufacturing, Commercial). Supports internal P&L and ROI analysis for drug programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS; US GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: SAP indicator specifying whether the line item is a debit (S=Soll/Debit) or credit (H=Haben/Credit) posting. Fundamental double-entry bookkeeping attribute required for GL balance validation and trial balance generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS; US GAAP; Double-Entry Bookkeeping Principles

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice date, payment date, contract date) that triggered the journal entry. May differ from posting_date; used for aging analysis and vendor/customer terms calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 1; IFRS 15

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: SAP-assigned unique accounting document number within the company code and fiscal year. Serves as the externally-known business identifier for the journal entry, used in audit trails and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code classifying the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AA=Asset Posting, ZP=Payment Clearing, ML=Material Ledger). Drives posting rules and account determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|AA|ZP|ML|AB|KZ|DZ|WA|WE|RE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the journal entry record was created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to translate the transaction currency amount to local currency at the time of posting. Sourced from SAP exchange rate tables per the applicable rate type (e.g., M=standard, B=bank buying rate).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 21; ECB exchange rate guidelines

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month 01–12, plus special periods 13–16 for year-end adjustments) within the fiscal year. Drives period-end close processes, P&L reporting by period, and financial close calendar management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which the journal entry belongs, as defined in the SAP fiscal year variant. Used for annual financial reporting, R&D capitalization tracking, and SOX compliance period assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area classifying the business function of the posting (e.g., R&D, Manufacturing, Sales & Distribution, General & Administrative). Supports cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) analysis and functional P&L reporting per IFRS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: R&D|Manufacturing|Sales|Marketing|G&A|Regulatory|Medical Affairs|Supply Chain — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS; US GAAP ASC 730; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: SAP GL account number to which the journal entry line is posted. Determines the financial statement line item (P&L or balance sheet). Supports COGS by product, R&D capitalization, and therapeutic area P&L analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; US GAAP ASC 730 (R&D); IFRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry header level explaining the business purpose of the posting (e.g., 'Q3 R&D accrual – Oncology Phase III', 'API procurement – CMO settlement'). Supports audit review and financial close documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry is itself a reversal of a prior posting (True) or an original entry (False). Used to filter reversals from net financial reporting and to identify accrual reversal patterns in period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry was last modified or reversed. Supports change audit trail requirements under SOX Section 404 and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records integrity.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the journal entry document (e.g., 001, 002). Uniquely identifies each debit/credit line within the document for reconciliation, audit, and subledger matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the individual line item level providing context for the specific debit or credit posting (e.g., 'API batch #XYZ123 – COGS', 'Phase III trial accrual – CRO milestone'). Supports granular audit review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local (functional) currency. Used for statutory reporting in the country of the legal entity.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 21; IFRS

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period and year to which the transaction is assigned. Critical for period-end close and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the journal entry in the general ledger lifecycle. 'posted' = fully committed to GL; 'parked' = saved but not posted; 'held' = incomplete draft; 'reversed' = offset entry created; 'cleared' = matched against open items; 'blocked' = pending approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; IFRS

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center representing the business unit or product line responsible for the financial result. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, rare diseases), brand, and geography.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, contract reference, or regulatory submission reference). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversing journal entry if this posting has been reversed. Populated only for reversed entries; null otherwise. Supports audit trail completeness and period-end close validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11; IFRS

attributes.name: subledger_type
attributes.description: Identifies the subledger from which the journal entry originates: AP (Accounts Payable), AR (Accounts Receivable), asset accounting, tax accounting, material ledger, or none (direct GL posting). Enables subledger-to-GL reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS; US GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount (VAT, GST, sales tax) in local currency for the journal entry line. Supports indirect tax return filing, tax provision calculations, and multi-jurisdiction tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; US IRC; OECD BEPS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_base_amount
attributes.description: The taxable base amount in local currency on which the tax is calculated. Required for indirect tax return preparation and multi-jurisdiction VAT/GST compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; OECD BEPS; US IRC

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code identifying the applicable tax rate and type (e.g., VAT, sales tax, withholding tax) for the posting. Drives automatic tax calculation and links to tax jurisdiction for multi-jurisdiction indirect tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; 21 CFR Part 11; OECD BEPS

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, county, city) applicable to the transaction for multi-jurisdiction indirect tax reporting. Required for US sales tax (Vertex/Avalara integration) and international VAT compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; US IRC; EU VAT Directive; OECD BEPS; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: tax_return_period
attributes.description: The reporting period (YYYY-MM) to which this tax posting belongs for indirect tax return filing purposes. May differ from the accounting fiscal period; used for VAT/GST return preparation across multiple tax jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; HMRC VAT regulations; OECD BEPS

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the original transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP). The currency in which the business transaction was originally denominated, before conversion to local or group currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: vat_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the tax posting type for indirect tax reporting: input VAT (recoverable on purchases), output VAT (collected on sales), deferred VAT (timing difference), exempt, zero-rated, or not applicable. Supports multi-jurisdiction VAT compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; HMRC; OECD BEPS

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax (WHT) deducted at source for cross-border payments to vendors, royalty recipients, or service providers. Relevant for pharmaceutical royalty accounting, CRO/CMO payments, and international tax treaty compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; OECD Model Tax Convention; US IRC Section 1441; BEPS Action 6

products.name: internal_order
products.description: SAP CO internal order used to collect, monitor, and settle costs for specific projects, R&D programs, clinical trials, or capital expenditure initiatives. Captures order type (R&D, capex, overhead), settlement rule, budget profile, actual costs, commitment values, responsible cost center, project/WBS reference, and order lifecycle status. References milestone_payment records for contractual obligations but does NOT own milestone payment terms or trigger events. Supports R&D capitalization tracking, ROI analysis for drug development programs, and CAPEX lifecycle governance.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SAP CO internal order record in the Databricks Silver layer. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Object

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: R&D internal orders track initiating employee for approval workflows, budget accountability, and audit trails. Existing created_by_user is username string; FK enables proper authorization controls, Gx

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility associated with this internal order. Relevant for CAPEX orders tied to facility investments or manufacturing overhead orders. Corresponds to WERKS in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP MM/PP AUFK Table — WERKS Field; cGMP 21 CFR Parts 210/211; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_internal_responsible_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center organizationally responsible for managing and monitoring this internal order. Corresponds to KOSTV in SAP AUFK. Used for P&L reporting by therapeutic area and organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — KOSTV Field; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this internal order, enabling P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, or geography. Supports management accounting and ROI analysis for drug development programs.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: R&D and clinical trial internal orders frequently reference master supply agreements for CMO/CRO services and materials procurement. Essential for cost tracking against contracted rates, budget vs. ac

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element linked to this internal order. Used when the internal order is subordinate to a larger capital or R&D project structure. Corresponds to PSPNR in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP PS AUFK Table — PSPNR Field; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual costs posted to this internal order to date in the controlling area currency. Sourced from SAP CO actual cost line items (COEP table). Used for budget vs. actual reporting, R&D spend tracking, and CAPEX lifecycle governance.
attributes.references: SAP CO COEP Table; SOX Section 404; IAS 38; ASC 730

attributes.name: actual_finish_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the internal order activity was completed (technically completed or closed). Used for variance analysis between planned and actual project duration and for R&D capitalization period determination.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table; IAS 38; ASC 730; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to this internal order in the controlling area currency. Represents the authorized spending limit for the R&D program, capital project, or overhead activity. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and availability control.
attributes.references: SAP CO IM (Investment Management); SOX Section 404; IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: budget_profile
attributes.description: SAP CO budget profile code assigned to this internal order, defining the budgeting rules, availability control tolerance levels, and fiscal year distribution method. Corresponds to PROFL in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — PROFL Field; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: capitalization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs accumulated on this internal order are eligible for capitalization as an intangible asset under IAS 38 or ASC 350. Typically set to True for Phase 3 clinical development orders meeting the six IAS 38 criteria. Drives R&D capitalization tracking and CAPEX lifecycle governance.
attributes.references: IAS 38 Intangible Assets; ASC 350 Intangibles; ASC 730 R&D Costs; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: commitment_amount
attributes.description: Total open commitment value (purchase orders, contracts, and reservations) posted against this internal order but not yet invoiced. Represents future obligated spend. Sourced from SAP CO commitment management (COOI table). Critical for total exposure reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO COOI Table — Commitment Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code representing the legal entity under which this internal order is managed. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and statutory reporting. Corresponds to BUKRS in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP FI AUFK Table — BUKRS Field; IFRS; US GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area code that defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. Determines the currency and fiscal year variant applicable to this internal order. Corresponds to KOKRS in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — KOKRS Field

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the internal order record was first created in SAP CO. Corresponds to ERDAT and ERZET fields in SAP AUFK. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — ERDAT/ERZET Fields; SOX Section 302; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the controlling area currency in which budget, actual, commitment, and plan amounts are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Corresponds to WAERS in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP CO AUFK Table — WAERS Field; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order has been flagged for deletion in SAP CO. Deletion-flagged orders are excluded from active reporting but retained for audit trail purposes. Corresponds to LOEKZ in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — LOEKZ Field; SOX Section 302; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal year and period structure applicable to this internal order (e.g., K4 for calendar year, V3 for April–March). Determines period-end processing and budget distribution. Corresponds to PERIV in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP FI AUFK Table — PERIV Field; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area classifying the business function of the internal order (e.g., Research and Development, Manufacturing, Sales and Marketing, General and Administrative). Supports P&L by function and R&D capitalization under ASC 730 / IAS 38. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RD|MFG|SGA|MKTG|CLIN|REG|QA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — FKBER Field; ASC 730; IAS 38; IFRS

attributes.name: investment_measure_type
attributes.description: Classifies the internal order as a capital expenditure (CAPEX), operating expense (OPEX), R&D expense (RD_EXPENSE), or capitalizable R&D (RD_CAPITAL) measure. Drives balance sheet vs. P&L treatment and supports CAPEX lifecycle governance and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: IAS 16; IAS 38; ASC 730; ASC 360; SOX Section 404; IFRS

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to this internal order record in SAP CO. Corresponds to AEDAT and AEZET fields in SAP AUFK. Used for change tracking and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — AEDAT/AEZET Fields; SOX Section 302; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the internal order providing full business context, scope, and objectives. Supports R&D capitalization documentation and audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: SAP CO; SOX Section 302; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: order_category
attributes.description: SAP internal order category code distinguishing overhead orders (01), investment orders (04), accrual orders (02), and statistical orders (10/20). Drives settlement and budget management behavior in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — AUTYP Field

attributes.name: order_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short description of the internal order, typically identifying the R&D program, clinical trial phase, capital project, or overhead activity being tracked. Corresponds to KTEXT in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — KTEXT Field

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: SAP-assigned alphanumeric identifier for the internal order, used as the externally-known business key across finance, R&D, and project management systems. Corresponds to the AUFNR field in SAP CO table AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — AUFNR Field; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current system status of the internal order in SAP CO. CRTD=Created, REL=Released (costs can be posted), TECO=Technically Completed (no further postings), CLSD=Closed (settled and locked), DLT=Deletion Flagged, LKD=Locked. Governs cost posting eligibility and settlement processing.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — OBJNR/Status Profile; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: SAP order type code classifying the purpose of the internal order (e.g., R&D expense, capital expenditure, overhead, clinical trial cost collection, manufacturing overhead). Corresponds to AUART in SAP AUFK. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RD01|CAPEX|OVHD|CLIN|MFG|MKTG — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — AUART Field; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: overhead_key
attributes.description: SAP CO overhead key assigned to this internal order, determining the overhead surcharge rates applied during overhead calculation (costing sheet). Used for allocating indirect manufacturing or R&D overhead costs to the order. Corresponds to ZUONR in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO Overhead Calculation — AUFK Table; cGMP Cost Accounting; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: plan_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total planned cost amount for this internal order in the controlling area currency, as entered in SAP CO planning. Supports budget vs. plan vs. actual three-way variance analysis for R&D program financial governance.
attributes.references: SAP CO COSS/COSP Tables; SOX Section 404; IFRS

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for the activity or project represented by this internal order. Used for R&D program milestone tracking, CAPEX project scheduling, and budget period governance. Corresponds to PLSEZ in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — PLSEZ Field; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the activity or project represented by this internal order. Used for timeline planning of R&D programs, clinical trials, and capital projects. Corresponds to PLFAZ in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — PLFAZ Field; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: program_phase
attributes.description: Drug development lifecycle phase associated with this internal order. Drives R&D capitalization eligibility (costs may be capitalized from Phase 3 under IAS 38 criteria), ROI analysis, and budget governance. Aligns with ICH M4 eCTD structure.
attributes.references: IAS 38 Intangible Assets; ASC 730 R&D Costs; ICH M4; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the internal order was released in SAP CO (status changed to REL), enabling cost postings to begin. Marks the start of the active cost collection period. Corresponds to IDAT2 in SAP AUFK.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_type
attributes.description: Category of the primary settlement receiver for this internal order. CTR=Cost Center, AUC=Asset Under Construction, WBS=WBS Element, PSG=Profitability Segment, GL=G/L Account, ORD=Internal Order. Determines the accounting treatment of settled costs.
attributes.references: SAP CO COBRA Table — EMPFG Field; IAS 16; IAS 38; ASC 360

attributes.name: settlement_rule_type
attributes.description: Defines how costs accumulated on this internal order are settled to receivers (cost centers, G/L accounts, assets, WBS elements, profitability segments). FUL=Full settlement, PER=Periodic settlement, MAN=Manual settlement. Governs period-end cost allocation and R&D capitalization postings.
attributes.references: SAP CO Settlement — COBRA Table; IAS 38; ASC 730; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: statistical_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order is a statistical order (costs posted in parallel for reporting purposes only, without affecting the primary cost object). Statistical orders are used for management reporting overlays such as therapeutic area P&L without impacting actual cost flows.
attributes.references: SAP CO AUFK Table — STOKZ Field; IFRS Management Reporting

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical therapeutic area classification associated with this internal order (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Neuroscience, Cardiovascular). Enables P&L and ROI reporting by therapeutic area as required for management reporting and investor disclosures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ONCOLOGY|IMMUNOLOGY|RARE_DISEASE|NEUROSCIENCE|CARDIOVASCULAR|INFECTIOUS_DISEASE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATC Classification; ICH E6(R2); FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: accounts_payable
products.description: Vendor invoice, payment obligation, and payment execution records managed within SAP FI-AP module. Captures vendor invoice details (invoice number, date, due date, payment terms, gross amount, tax amount, withholding tax, payment block status), payment execution (payment document, payment date, payment method including ACH/wire/check, bank account, clearing document, payment run ID), and settlement status. Covers payables to CROs, CMOs, CDMOs, raw material suppliers, licensors (royalty and milestone payments), and service providers in the pharmaceutical supply chain.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accounts payable record in the SAP FI-AP module, representing a single vendor invoice or payment obligation. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Module; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the vendor bank account used for payment execution, referencing the SAP FI-AP bank details record. Sensitive financial data subject to PCI and SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP LFBK Table; PCI DSS; SOX; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal cost center (e.g., R&D, Manufacturing, Clinical Operations) to which the payable is allocated for P&L reporting by therapeutic area or function.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: AP transactions post to GL accounts (liability accounts, expense accounts). The existing gl_account_code is a STRING; adding general_ledger_id FK links AP to the GL account master record. This further

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: The SAP automatic payment program run identifier (F110 run ID) that generated the payment for this invoice. Enables batch payment reconciliation and audit trail for automated payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP F110 Transaction; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order against which this invoice was raised, enabling three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) per SAP MM-FI integration.

attributes.name: royalty_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_agreement. Business justification: AP invoices for royalty payments (when company is licensee) should reference the governing royalty agreement for compliance, audit, and accrual tracking. Cardinality: Many AP invoices can reference on

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: AP invoices reference master supply contracts for pricing validation, payment terms verification, and contract compliance auditing. Critical for three-way match validation (PO-GR-Invoice) and ensuring

attributes.name: updated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: AP modification tracking for audit trail, SOX compliance, and payment controls. Enables validation that changes were made by authorized personnel, supports segregation of duties analysis, and provides

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier, CRO, CMO, CDMO, licensor, or service provider) who issued the invoice. Links to the vendor master record.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Vendor Master; ICH Q10; GMP

attributes.name: vendor_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_site. Business justification: AP needs to track which specific vendor site invoiced (manufacturing site vs. warehouse vs. R&D facility) for site-specific payment routing, tax jurisdiction determination, and GMP compliance document

attributes.name: warehouse_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse_receipt. Business justification: Three-way match (PO/GR/Invoice) is mandatory in pharma procure-to-pay. AP invoices are verified against goods receipts for quantity/quality confirmation before payment approval. Regulatory and SOX con

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI clearing document number (AUGBL) that offsets the open payable item upon payment or credit memo application. Used for open item management and reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI company code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity within the pharmaceutical group that is the obligor for this payable. Supports intercompany reconciliation and legal entity P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI BKPF.BUKRS; GAAP/IFRS; SOX; IFRS 10

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the accounts payable record was first created in the SAP FI-AP system, used for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.CPUDT/CPUTM; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the vendor invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Supports multi-currency payables for global pharmaceutical supply chain and cross-border licensing transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP FI-AP BKPF.WAERS; GAAP/IFRS; IFRS 9

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount captured if payment is made within the discount period defined in the payment terms (e.g., 2% discount for payment within 10 days). Supports working capital optimization analytics.

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The last date by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount defined in the payment terms. Used by treasury for dynamic discounting and supply chain finance decisions.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to satisfy the invoice obligation and avoid late payment penalties. Derived from invoice date and payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (MONAT, 1–16 including special periods) within the fiscal year in which the invoice is posted in SAP FI, used for monthly close and accrual management.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (GJAHR) in which the invoice is posted in SAP FI, used for period-end close, annual financial reporting, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI general ledger account (HKONT) to which the invoice line is posted, determining the expense or liability classification in the chart of accounts (e.g., R&D expense, COGS, API raw material).
attributes.references: SAP FI BSEG.HKONT; GAAP/IFRS; SOX; IFRS 15

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The SAP MM goods receipt document number (MBLNR) confirming receipt of goods or services against the purchase order. Required for three-way match (PO-GR-Invoice) in GMP-compliant pharmaceutical procurement.
attributes.references: SAP MM MKPF.MBLNR; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q10; SOX

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the vendor invoice before deduction of discounts, withholding tax, or other adjustments, as stated on the invoice document. Represents the full obligation amount.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.WRBTR; GAAP/IFRS; SOX; IFRS 9

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor invoice document (BLDAT in SAP), representing the principal business event date for the payable obligation. Used for aging analysis and payment term calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services invoiced, as provided by the vendor or entered during invoice processing in SAP FI-AP. Supports spend categorization and audit review.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.SGTXT; SOX; GMP Procurement Records

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number provided by the vendor on the invoice document. Used for three-way match and duplicate invoice detection in SAP FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP RBKP Table; SOX; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor invoice by business nature. Milestone and royalty types are specific to pharmaceutical licensing and CRO/CMO contracts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|credit_memo|debit_memo|milestone|royalty|advance|recurring — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BLART; GAAP/IFRS; ICH Q10

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payable is an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the pharmaceutical group, requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements per IFRS 10.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BVTYP; IFRS 10; SOX; GAAP

attributes.name: is_rd_capitalized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the expenditure represented by this payable has been capitalized as an intangible asset under IAS 38 (development phase costs meeting capitalization criteria), as opposed to expensed immediately as R&D.
attributes.references: IAS 38; GAAP ASC 730; SOX; SAP CO Asset Accounting

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the vendor after deducting withholding tax and applicable discounts from the gross invoice amount. Represents the actual cash outflow obligation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.DMBTR; GAAP/IFRS; SOX; IFRS 9

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: SAP payment block key (ZLSPR) indicating whether the invoice is blocked from automatic payment processing. Common values: R=Manual review required, B=Blocked by purchasing, A=Blocked for audit, V=Verified/released, blank=Not blocked.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.ZLSPR; SOX; GMP Procurement Controls

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was executed and the invoice was cleared in SAP FI-AP. Used for cash flow reporting, days payable outstanding (DPO) calculation, and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number of the outgoing payment transaction that cleared this invoice (AUGBL). Populated upon payment execution; null for open/blocked invoices.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to settle the vendor invoice (e.g., ACH for domestic US transfers, SWIFT/wire for international payments, SEPA for EU transactions, check for legacy vendors).
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.ZLSCH; NACHA ACH Rules; SWIFT; SEPA Regulation

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accounts payable record indicating whether the invoice obligation is open, partially settled, fully paid, blocked for payment, cancelled, or under dispute. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|partially_paid|paid|blocked|cancelled|disputed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The SAP payment terms key (ZTERM) defining the agreed payment schedule, discount conditions, and due date calculation rules (e.g., NT30 = Net 30 days, 2/10NT30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days).
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP T052 Table; GAAP/IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was posted to the SAP general ledger (BUDAT), determining the accounting period for financial reporting and period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BUDAT; GAAP/IFRS; SOX; IFRS 9

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The internal SAP FI document number (BELNR) assigned upon posting of the vendor invoice in the general ledger. Serves as the primary system-of-record identifier within SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF/BSEG Tables; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The value-added tax (VAT) or sales tax amount included in the vendor invoice, as calculated by SAP FI tax determination. Used for tax reporting and input tax recovery.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.WMWST; GAAP/IFRS; SOX; EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical therapeutic area (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Neuroscience) to which the payable is attributed, enabling P&L reporting and R&D spend analysis by therapeutic area as required by finance leadership.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center; GAAP/IFRS; ATC Classification (WHO)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the accounts payable record in SAP FI-AP, supporting audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Change Documents; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: vendor_category
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical industry classification of the vendor type. Enables spend analytics by vendor category (e.g., CRO spend for clinical operations, CMO/CDMO spend for outsourced manufacturing, licensor for royalty and milestone obligations). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRO|CMO|CDMO|raw_material_supplier|licensor|service_provider|logistics|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Vendor Master; ICH Q10; GMP; GDP

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax (WHT) deducted from the vendor payment, applicable to royalty payments, milestone payments to licensors, and cross-border service fees per local tax regulations.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.QBSHB; OECD Model Tax Convention; SOX; GAAP/IFRS

products.name: accounts_receivable

Covers receivables from wholesalers, distributors, hospital networks, and government payers. Supports ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition compliance for pharmaceutical product sales.

attributes.name: business_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (wholesaler, distributor, hospital network, or government payer) associated with this receivable record. Maps to the SAP FI-AR customer master (debtor account).

attributes.name: delivery_order_id

attributes.description: Reference to the originating customer invoice document that generated this receivable. Links to the billing document in SAP SD/FI.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SAP SD Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15
