attributes.name: ar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the receivable. 'open' = outstanding balance; 'partially_cleared' = partial payment received; 'cleared' = fully paid or offset; 'disputed' = customer dispute raised; 'written_off' = bad debt write-off applied; 'in_dunning' = active dunning process initiated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|partially_cleared|cleared|disputed|written_off|in_dunning — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer invoice was issued (billing document date). Used as the principal business event date for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. Corresponds to SAP BLDAT.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Total chargeback deductions claimed by wholesalers or distributors against this invoice, representing the difference between the contract price and the wholesale acquisition cost (WAC). Critical for pharmaceutical gross-to-net revenue calculations.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this AR item was fully cleared (settled) in SAP FI-AR. Corresponds to SAP AUGDT. Null for open or partially cleared items. Used for DSO and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP document number of the clearing transaction (payment, credit memo, or offset) that fully or partially settled this AR item. Corresponds to SAP AUGBL field in BSAD. Null for open items.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP company code identifying the legal entity (pharmaceutical subsidiary or affiliate) that owns this AR document. Drives legal entity P&L reporting and SOX compliance segregation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AR record was first created in the SAP FI-AR system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for audit trail and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the AR document (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Represents the transaction currency in which the invoice was issued to the customer. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the customer for this receivable. Supports P&L analysis by channel and revenue recognition reporting under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wholesaler|distributor|hospital_network|government_payer|retail_pharmacy|specialty_pharmacy — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this AR item is past its due date as of the last refresh date. Calculated as (refresh_date - due_date) for open items. Used for aging bucket classification and credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally visible SAP FI-AR accounting document number uniquely identifying this receivable transaction within the general ledger. Corresponds to BELNR in SAP BSID/BSAD tables.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the AR document: customer invoice, credit memo (e.g., chargebacks, rebates), debit memo, down payment request, incoming payment receipt, or revenue accrual entry. Maps to SAP document type (BLART). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_invoice|credit_memo|debit_memo|down_payment|payment_receipt|accrual — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the customer is contractually required to remit payment per the agreed payment terms. Calculated from billing date and payment terms. Used for dunning and aging analysis.

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dunning notice was issued to the customer for this overdue AR item. Corresponds to SAP MAHND. Used to track collections activity and avoid duplicate dunning.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level (0–4) assigned to this AR item by the SAP dunning program. Level 0 = no dunning; higher levels indicate increasing overdue severity. Drives collections escalation for wholesalers and distributors.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied at posting date to translate the document currency amount to local currency. Sourced from SAP exchange rate table (TCURR). Required for multi-currency pharmaceutical operations.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this AR document was posted in SAP FI-AR. Used for period-end close, SOX financial reporting, and P&L by therapeutic area and geography.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SOX; ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account number to which this AR document is posted (e.g., trade receivables account, accrued revenue account). Enables reconciliation between the AR subledger and the GL for SOX financial close.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SAP CO Module; SOX

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount of the AR document before tax deductions, chargebacks, or rebate adjustments. Represents the face value of the customer invoice in the document currency. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AR record in the SAP FI-AR system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking and SOX audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Net invoice amount translated into the company code local currency (e.g., USD for US entity) using the SAP exchange rate at posting date. Required for consolidated P&L reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SOX; IFRS 15; ASC 606

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company code local currency used for translation of the AR document amount (e.g., USD for US legal entity).

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net receivable amount after deducting tax from the gross amount. Represents the revenue-recognized value for ASC 606 / IFRS 15 reporting. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: open_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this AR document at the time of last update. Equals gross_amount minus all clearing payments and credit memos applied. Used for aging reports and collections management.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the customer remitted payment (e.g., bank transfer, ACH, wire transfer, check). Maps to SAP payment method key (ZLSCH). Used for cash application and treasury reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the incoming customer payment was received and applied against this AR document. Null if no payment has been received. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10NET30) defining the discount period, discount percentage, and net due date for this receivable. Drives due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the AR document was posted to the general ledger in SAP FI. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting. Corresponds to SAP BUDAT.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SOX; ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (01–12 for regular months, 13–16 for special closing periods) within the fiscal year in which this AR document was posted. Aligns with SAP FI period control.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SOX; ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: product_ndc
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code (NDC) for the pharmaceutical product billed on this invoice. Uniquely identifies the drug product, labeler, and package configuration. Required for government payer reporting and Medicaid rebate calculations.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; 21 CFR Part 207; SAP MM Module

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center associated with this AR document, representing the internal organizational unit (brand, therapeutic area, or geography) responsible for the revenue. Supports P&L reporting by brand and therapeutic area.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; SAP FI-AR Module; SOX

attributes.name: rebate_amount
attributes.description: Contractual rebate amount accrued or applied against this AR document for government payers (Medicaid, Medicare) or commercial payer contracts. Part of gross-to-net revenue deductions under ASC 606.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15; Medicaid Drug Rebate Program

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue was or is scheduled to be recognized in the income statement per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 performance obligation criteria. May differ from billing date for deferred or accrued revenue entries.
attributes.references: ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX; SAP FI-AR Module

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue treatment for this AR record under ASC 606 / IFRS 15: 'recognized' = revenue fully recognized at point of sale; 'deferred' = revenue deferred pending performance obligation fulfillment; 'accrued' = period-end accrual entry; 'reversed' = accrual reversal.
attributes.references: ASC 606; IFRS 15; SOX; SAP FI-AR Module

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which a period-end revenue accrual entry is scheduled to be automatically reversed in SAP FI. Applicable only to accrual-type AR documents. Null for standard invoices and payments.

attributes.name: sales_territory
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational sales territory associated with this receivable. Used for P&L reporting by geography and market access analysis. Sourced from SAP SD sales area configuration.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SAP SD Module

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax component of the invoice (VAT, GST, or applicable sales tax) calculated on the gross invoice amount. Corresponds to SAP tax line items in FI-AR. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; IFRS 15; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical therapeutic area (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases) associated with the product sold on this invoice. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area as required by finance domain.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Module; SAP CO Module; ATC Classification

products.name: budget
products.description: Annual and multi-year financial budget plans with granular line-item detail by cost center, profit center, GL account, cost element, and internal order. Captures budget version (original, revised, forecast), fiscal year, budget type (opex, capex, R&D), line-item breakdowns with planned amounts by period, currency, budget category, approval workflow status, and variance tracking. Supports P&L planning by therapeutic area, R&D program investment planning, clinical trial budget management, and detailed variance analysis between planned and actual spend for drug development, manufacturing, and commercial operations.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the budget record in the enterprise data lakehouse. Primary key for the budget data product.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Budget approvals require employee link for authorization controls, approval workflow validation, and audit trail. Existing approved_by is name string; FK enables proper approval hierarchy validation,

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account to which this budget line is posted, enabling financial reporting and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational cost center responsible for this budget line. Aligns with SAP CO cost center master data.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP internal order used for tracking R&D program spend, clinical trial costs, or capital projects at a granular level.

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Pharmaceutical budgets are allocated by medicinal product for R&D investment, commercialization spend, and lifecycle management. Product-level budget tracking is fundamental to portfolio financial pla

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this budget, enabling P&L planning by therapeutic area, brand, or geography.

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Budgets for contracted services and materials reference master supply agreements for committed spend tracking and budget vs. contract variance analysis. Essential for pharmaceutical operations to moni

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Pharmaceutical companies budget by therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, rare diseases) as primary financial planning dimension. This enables portfolio investment decisions, resource allocation, and

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure posted against this budget line item to date, sourced from SAP FI actuals. Used to compute budget variance (planned minus actual) for management reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget was formally approved by the authorized budget owner or finance committee. Required for SOX compliance audit trails and budget governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level functional category of the budget line item within the pharmaceutical value chain. Enables cross-functional spend analysis and allocation reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clinical_trials|manufacturing|commercial|medical_affairs|regulatory|rd_discovery|general_admin|supply_chain — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the budget plan (e.g., 'FY2025 Oncology R&D Operating Budget', 'Phase III Clinical Trial Budget - Program X'). Used in reporting and stakeholder communications.

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the budget plan, used in financial reporting, approval workflows, and cross-system references. Follows the enterprise budget numbering convention (e.g., BUD-2025-ONCOL001).

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the budget record within the approval workflow. Transitions from draft through submission, review, and approval to locked (frozen for actuals comparison) or closed (period end). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|locked|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by expenditure category: opex (operating expenditure), capex (capital expenditure), rd (research and development), headcount, contingency, or other. Drives P&L treatment and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: opex|capex|rd|headcount|contingency|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS IAS 38 (R&D Capitalization); US GAAP ASC 730

attributes.name: capitalization_stage
attributes.description: Indicates the R&D stage for capitalization accounting purposes: research (expensed under IFRS IAS 38), development (potentially capitalizable once technical feasibility is established), or not_applicable. Drives correct accounting treatment for pharmaceutical R&D spend.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 38; US GAAP ASC 730; ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The amount encumbered by open purchase orders, contracts, or obligations not yet invoiced. Represents funds committed but not yet expensed. Supports available budget calculation (planned minus actual minus committed).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or subsidiary responsible for this budget. Enables consolidation across global pharmaceutical entities and legal entity-level financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS 10 (Consolidated Financial Statements); SOX

attributes.name: cost_element_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element code that categorizes the nature of the expenditure (e.g., personnel costs, material costs, external services, depreciation). Provides granular cost classification for management accounting and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Provides the audit trail creation event required for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency of this budget line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Supports multi-currency pharmaceutical operations across global markets.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the period covered by this budget plan. For annual budgets, typically the last day of the fiscal year. Nullable for open-ended multi-year plans.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month 1–12 or 1–13 for 4-4-5 calendars) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Enables period-level variance analysis and phased budget tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget applies (e.g., 2025). Supports annual and multi-year budget planning cycles aligned with the enterprise financial calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: geography_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code indicating the geographic scope of this budget (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, JPN). Supports P&L planning by geography and market access financial analysis.

attributes.name: is_capitalized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line relates to R&D expenditure that is subject to capitalization under IFRS IAS 38 or US GAAP ASC 730 (True = capitalized; False = expensed). Critical for R&D capitalization accounting in pharmaceutical development programs.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 38 (Intangible Assets); US GAAP ASC 730 (Research and Development); SOX

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Tracks the latest change event for audit trail, SOX compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for budget planners to document assumptions, justifications, revision rationale, or commentary associated with this budget line. Supports audit trail documentation and budget review discussions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the business owner accountable for managing and reporting against this budget. Typically the cost center manager or program lead responsible for spend governance.

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: The total planned budget amount for this line item in the transaction currency. Represents the approved or forecasted spend for the associated cost center, GL account, and period. Core field for variance analysis against actuals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS; US GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: Indicates the time horizon covered by this budget plan: annual (single fiscal year), multi_year (2–5 year strategic plan), quarterly (quarterly rolling forecast), or rolling_12m (12-month rolling forecast). Supports both short-term operational and long-term R&D investment planning.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the R&D drug development program or commercial brand to which this budget is allocated (e.g., a compound code, IND number reference, or brand identifier). Supports R&D investment planning and program-level ROI tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FDA IND Regulations (21 CFR Part 312)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system from which this budget record was sourced (e.g., SAP_S4HANA for CO/FI module extracts, EXCEL_UPLOAD for offline planning submissions, PLANNING_TOOL for integrated planning applications). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the period covered by this budget plan. For annual budgets, typically the first day of the fiscal year. For multi-year plans, the start of the planning horizon.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between planned amount and actual amount (planned minus actual) for this budget line. A positive value indicates underspend; negative indicates overspend. Stored as a pre-computed field from SAP CO variance reports to support management reporting without recalculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX; IFRS

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The budget variance expressed as a percentage of the planned amount ((planned minus actual) / planned × 100). Sourced from SAP CO variance reporting. Supports threshold-based exception reporting and management dashboards.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Indicates the iteration of the budget plan: original (initial approved plan), revised (formally amended plan), forecast (rolling in-year estimate), reforecast (mid-year replan), or final (year-end close). Supports variance analysis between versions.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Enterprise fixed asset register with complete lifecycle transaction history managed in SAP FI-AA module, covering manufacturing equipment, laboratory instruments, IT infrastructure, and leasehold improvements. Captures asset master data (asset class, acquisition date, acquisition cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value, depreciation key, useful life, location, cost center assignment) and all lifecycle transactions (acquisitions, retirements, transfers, write-ups, impairments, and periodic depreciation postings with transaction type, posting date, amount, document reference, asset value date, and depreciation area). Supports CAPEX tracking, R&D equipment capitalization, and compliance with IAS 16 / US GAAP ASC 360.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fixed asset record in the enterprise fixed asset register. Primary key for the fixed_asset data product.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Asset creation tracking for SOX controls, capitalization audit trail, and GMP equipment accountability. Enables validation that assets were capitalized by authorized finance personnel, supports asset

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Fixed assets acquired or constructed through capital projects are funded via SAP CO internal orders. The internal order collects all costs (materials, labor, overhead) during the asset construction/ac

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Fixed assets are physically located at manufacturing/R&D plants. Required for GMP equipment tracking, physical asset verification audits, site-level depreciation reporting, and regulatory inspection r

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Fixed asset acquisitions (GMP equipment, manufacturing facilities, lab instruments) originate from purchase orders. Essential for capitalization validation, asset acquisition cost tracking, and audit

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Fixed assets track supplying vendor for warranty management, maintenance contracts, equipment qualification documentation, and GMP compliance. Critical for pharmaceutical operations to maintain vendor

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation charged against the asset from the capitalization date to the current reporting period. Expressed as a negative value in SAP FI-AA. Used to calculate net book value and supports IAS 16 / ASC 360 balance sheet disclosures.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original historical cost of the fixed asset at the time of acquisition, including purchase price, import duties, installation costs, and directly attributable costs to bring the asset to its intended use. Expressed in the company code currency. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA 'Acquisition and Production Costs (APC)'.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 16.16; ASC 360-10-30; SOX; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was acquired or placed in service. Used as the start date for depreciation calculations and CAPEX reporting. Corresponds to the 'Asset Value Date' in SAP FI-AA for the initial acquisition posting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 16.73(b); ASC 360; 21 CFR Part 211 (equipment qualification date)

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset class code that categorizes the asset for depreciation, accounting, and reporting purposes (e.g., manufacturing equipment, laboratory instruments, IT infrastructure, leasehold improvements, vehicles, furniture). Drives default depreciation key and useful life.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class; IAS 16; ASC 360; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: asset_class_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the SAP FI-AA asset class (e.g., 'Manufacturing Equipment', 'Laboratory Instruments', 'IT Infrastructure', 'Leasehold Improvements', 'Right-of-Use Assets'). Supports reporting and analytics without requiring a join to a reference table.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Class; IAS 16; ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fixed asset as recorded in the SAP FI-AA asset master (e.g., 'HPLC Analytical Instrument - QC Lab Building 4', 'Bioreactor 2000L - API Manufacturing'). Used for identification and reporting.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset number assigned in SAP FI-AA (Asset Master record number). Used as the primary business identifier for the asset across finance, operations, and audit processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; IAS 16; ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset within the enterprise asset register. Drives inclusion in depreciation runs, CAPEX reporting, and balance sheet presentation. 'under_construction' maps to Assets Under Construction (AuC) in SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA sub-number used to track components or additions to a main asset (e.g., a capital improvement to a piece of manufacturing equipment). Enables component-level tracking under a parent asset number.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; IAS 16 Component Accounting

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical asset tag or barcode number affixed to the asset for inventory tracking and physical verification purposes. Used during annual physical asset counts and GMP equipment identification audits.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Inventory Number; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP; SOX

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI business area code used to segment the asset for internal financial reporting by therapeutic area, product line, or business division (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Consumer Health). Supports P&L reporting by therapeutic area.
attributes.references: SAP FI Business Area; IAS 16; SOX

attributes.name: capex_project_number
attributes.description: Capital expenditure (CAPEX) project or appropriation request number under which the asset was approved and funded. Links the asset to the approved capital budget and supports CAPEX tracking and variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS/CO; IAS 16; ASC 360; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was formally capitalized and transferred from Assets Under Construction (AuC) to a productive asset class in SAP FI-AA. Marks the start of the depreciation period. May differ from acquisition_date for self-constructed assets.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code representing the legal entity that owns the fixed asset. Determines the applicable accounting standards (IFRS or US GAAP), currency, and regulatory reporting requirements for the asset.
attributes.references: SAP FI Company Code; IAS 16; ASC 360; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center to which the fixed asset is assigned for internal cost accounting and P&L reporting. Enables allocation of depreciation charges to the responsible business unit (e.g., manufacturing, R&D, quality control, commercial). Supports P&L by therapeutic area and geography.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; IAS 16; ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset master record was first created in the SAP FI-AA system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this asset record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Supports multi-currency reporting across global pharmaceutical operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP FI-AA; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was retired, disposed of, or deactivated in the SAP FI-AA asset register. Marks the end of the asset's productive life and triggers the retirement posting to remove the asset from the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Retirement; IAS 16.67-72; ASC 360-10-40; SOX

attributes.name: depreciation_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area identifier that specifies the valuation basis for the asset (e.g., '01' for book depreciation per local GAAP, '15' for IFRS, '20' for tax depreciation, '30' for cost accounting). Supports parallel accounting under IAS 16 and US GAAP ASC 360.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area; IAS 16; ASC 360; IFRS 16

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation key that defines the depreciation method and calculation rules for the asset (e.g., LINR for straight-line, DGRV for declining balance, MANU for manual). Determines how periodic depreciation amounts are computed.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Key; IAS 16.62; ASC 360-10-35-4

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP FI General Ledger (GL) account code to which the asset's acquisition cost and depreciation are posted (e.g., asset balance sheet account, accumulated depreciation account). Ensures correct financial statement classification.
attributes.references: SAP FI GL; IAS 16; ASC 360; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number under which the fixed asset is covered. Required for insurance valuation, claims processing, and risk management reporting. Particularly relevant for high-value manufacturing equipment and laboratory instruments.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Insurance Data; IAS 16; ISPE Baseline Guide

attributes.name: insured_value
attributes.description: Replacement or insured value of the fixed asset as declared to the insurer. May differ from net book value and is used for insurance premium calculation and claims settlement. Stored in SAP FI-AA insurance data fields.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Insurance Data; IAS 16; ISPE Baseline Guide

attributes.name: is_gmp_critical
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Critical Equipment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is classified as GMP-critical equipment subject to qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), periodic requalification, and regulatory inspection under 21 CFR Part 211, EU GMP, or PIC/S guidelines. True = GMP-critical; False = non-GMP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11; PIC/S; ISPE GAMP 5; cGMP

attributes.name: is_rd_equipment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is classified as R&D equipment for the purpose of R&D capitalization analysis, tax credit eligibility, and ASC 730 / IAS 38 accounting treatment. True = R&D equipment; False = non-R&D.
attributes.references: ASC 730 Research and Development; IAS 38 Intangible Assets; 21 CFR Part 312; SOX

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the fixed asset master record in SAP FI-AA. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and SOX internal controls over financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: last_physical_verification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or asset verification exercise confirming the asset's existence and location. Required for SOX compliance and GMP equipment audit readiness. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA 'Last Inventory Date'.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Inventory; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Specific physical location code within the plant or facility where the asset is installed or stored (e.g., building, room, floor, warehouse location). Used for physical asset verification, GMP equipment mapping, and insurance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Location; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP; ISPE Baseline Guide

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for the fixed asset. Used for equipment qualification, spare parts identification, and procurement of replacement units in GMP-regulated manufacturing and laboratory environments.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying amount of the fixed asset, calculated as acquisition cost less accumulated depreciation and any accumulated impairment losses. Represents the asset's value on the balance sheet as of the last depreciation posting period. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA 'Book Value'.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Remaining useful economic life of the asset in years as of the last review date. Calculated as useful_life_years minus elapsed depreciation periods. Used for impairment testing and residual value assessments under IAS 36 and ASC 360.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; IAS 16.51; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; ASC 360-10-35

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: Estimated amount the enterprise would currently obtain from disposal of the asset at the end of its useful life, after deducting estimated disposal costs. Used in the depreciable amount calculation. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA 'Scrap Value'.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's serial number of the fixed asset. Critical for GMP equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), maintenance tracking, warranty management, and regulatory inspection readiness. Stored in SAP FI-AA 'Serial Number' field.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11; ISPE GAMP 5; CSV

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful economic life of the asset in years, as defined in the SAP FI-AA asset master. Used to calculate the annual depreciation charge under straight-line method. Must be reviewed periodically per IAS 16.51 and ASC 360-10-35-21.

products.name: rd_capitalization
products.description: Tracks the capitalization of R&D expenditures in accordance with IAS 38 and ASC 730, capturing the transition from expensed research costs to capitalized development costs upon meeting regulatory and technical feasibility criteria. Records drug program, milestone trigger (e.g., Phase III initiation, NDA filing), capitalized amount, amortization start date, useful life, and impairment assessments.

attributes.name: rd_capitalization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each R&D capitalization record in the finance domain. Primary key for the rd_capitalization data product.
attributes.references: IAS 38 Intangible Assets; ASC 730 Research and Development

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: R&D capitalization approvals require employee link for authorization controls and audit trail. Existing approved_by is name string; FK enables proper approval hierarchy validation for milestone-trigge

attributes.name: compound_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.compound. Business justification: R&D capitalization decisions are compound-specific; linking capitalized costs to the specific compound enables asset tracking, impairment testing by compound, and capitalization audit trails required

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Capitalized R&D creates an intangible fixed asset record in the asset register. The rd_capitalization currently has sap_asset_number (STRING) which should be replaced with a proper FK to fixed_asset.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: R&D capitalization records post to GL accounts (gl_account_code is STRING). Adding general_ledger_id FK establishes the relationship to the GL account master for capitalized R&D assets. This connects

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: R&D capitalization records should reference the internal order that collected the costs being capitalized. This provides the audit trail from cost collection to capitalization decision. Cardinality: O

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: R&D capitalization events generate journal entries to record the capitalized amount as an intangible asset. Each capitalization record should reference the journal entry that posted it. Population eve

attributes.name: medicinal_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: R&D capitalization decisions occur at medicinal product level when development milestones are achieved (Phase III completion, regulatory approval). This link enables proper asset recognition, amortiza

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.discovery_project. Business justification: R&D capitalization is project-based; linking to discovery projects enables milestone-based capitalization triggers, phase-specific amortization, and project-level asset valuation required for financia

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Capitalized R&D costs often tied to CMO/CRO contracts for development services, clinical trials, and manufacturing scale-up. Essential for capitalization policy compliance, cost allocation validation,

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: R&D capitalization tracking by therapeutic area is essential for segment reporting under IFRS/GAAP, impairment testing by cash-generating unit, and strategic portfolio valuation. Enables CFO to assess

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard framework under which the R&D capitalization is recognized and reported. IAS 38 (IFRS) permits capitalization of development costs meeting specific criteria; ASC 730 (US GAAP) generally requires expensing except for certain software and acquired IPR&D.
attributes.references: IAS 38 Intangible Assets; ASC 730 Research and Development; IFRS Foundation; FASB

attributes.name: accumulated_amortization
attributes.description: The total amortization charged against the capitalized R&D asset from the amortization start date to the current reporting period. Used to calculate the net book value of the intangible asset.
attributes.references: IAS 38 paragraph 118; ASC 350-30-50; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: The accounting method applied to systematically allocate the capitalized R&D cost over the asset's useful life. Straight-line is most common for pharmaceutical intangibles; units-of-production may apply for royalty-bearing assets.

attributes.name: amortization_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which systematic amortization of the capitalized R&D intangible asset commences, typically aligned with the date the asset is available for use (e.g., regulatory approval date or commercial launch date).

attributes.name: annual_amortization_amount
attributes.description: The annual amortization expense recognized in the income statement for this capitalized R&D asset, calculated based on the capitalized amount, useful life, and amortization method.
attributes.references: IAS 38 paragraph 97; ASC 350-40-35; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the capitalization decision was formally approved by the authorized finance controller or CFO delegate, as required by SOX internal controls.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset class code categorizing the type of intangible asset for fixed asset accounting purposes (e.g., internally generated intangibles, acquired IPR&D, licensed technology).

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the R&D expenditure was formally recognized as a capitalized intangible asset on the balance sheet, coinciding with or following the qualifying milestone trigger date.
attributes.references: IAS 38 paragraph 57; ASC 730-10-25; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: capitalization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the capitalization record, used in SAP FI/CO asset accounting and financial reporting. Follows the format CAP-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Asset Accounting; IAS 38

attributes.name: capitalization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the R&D capitalization record. Tracks progression from initial recognition through active amortization, impairment, full amortization, or write-off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|impaired|fully_amortized|written_off|under_review — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: capitalization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the capitalized R&D asset. Distinguishes between internally developed assets, acquired in-process R&D (IPR&D), licensed technology, milestone-triggered payments, and software development costs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal_development|acquired_iprd|licensed_technology|milestone_payment|software_development — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: capitalized_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount of R&D expenditure recognized as an intangible asset on the balance sheet at the point of initial capitalization, expressed in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this R&D capitalization record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the capitalized amount and all related monetary fields (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Supports multi-currency reporting across FDA, EMA, MHRA, and PMDA jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: development_phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase of the drug program at the time of capitalization or as of the current reporting date. Used to assess technical feasibility criteria under IAS 38 and for R&D pipeline reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preclinical|phase_i|phase_ii|phase_iii|nda_bla_filing|approved|post_approval — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAS 38 paragraph 57; ICH E8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The capitalized R&D amount translated into the entity's functional currency for consolidated financial reporting, applying the exchange rate at the capitalization date per IAS 21.
attributes.references: IAS 21; IAS 38; ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: geography_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary jurisdiction where the capitalized R&D asset is recognized and reported. Supports P&L reporting by geography and multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP FI general ledger account code under which the capitalized R&D intangible asset is recorded on the balance sheet (e.g., intangible assets — development costs account).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IAS 38; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: impairment_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent formal impairment assessment was performed for this capitalized R&D asset, as required by IAS 36 or ASC 350 at each reporting period end.

attributes.name: impairment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether an impairment trigger event has been identified for this capitalized R&D asset (e.g., clinical trial failure, regulatory rejection, competitive obsolescence). Triggers a formal impairment assessment per IAS 36.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; ASC 350-30-35-18; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount by which the carrying value of the capitalized R&D asset exceeds its recoverable amount, recognized as an impairment loss in the income statement. Null if no impairment has been recognized.

attributes.name: impairment_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for impairment recognition, such as clinical trial failure, regulatory rejection (FDA Complete Response Letter, EMA refusal), patent invalidation, or market withdrawal.
attributes.references: IAS 36 paragraph 130; ASC 350-30-50; FDA 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: milestone_date
attributes.description: The date on which the qualifying milestone trigger event occurred, establishing the point at which R&D expenditures meet the IAS 38 or ASC 730 criteria for capitalization.

attributes.name: milestone_trigger
attributes.description: The specific regulatory or technical feasibility milestone that triggered the transition from expensed research costs to capitalized development costs (e.g., Phase III initiation, NDA filing, BLA submission, EMA MAA submission, IND clearance, proof-of-concept). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ind_clearance|phase_iii_initiation|nda_filing|bla_submission|maa_submission|proof_of_concept|regulatory_approval — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAS 38 paragraph 57; ASC 730; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E8

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The carrying amount of the capitalized R&D intangible asset on the balance sheet, calculated as capitalized amount less accumulated amortization and any accumulated impairment losses. Key metric for financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, qualifications, or disclosures related to the capitalization record, such as assumptions used in useful life estimation, basis for impairment assessment, or regulatory developments affecting the asset.

attributes.name: reporting_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity or company code within the pharmaceutical group that owns and reports the capitalized R&D asset, supporting multi-entity consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code; IAS 27 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The financial reporting period end date (e.g., quarter-end or year-end) as of which this capitalization record's carrying value, amortization, and impairment status were last reviewed and confirmed.
attributes.references: IAS 38 paragraph 118; IAS 36; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS Foundation

attributes.name: sox_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the SOX internal control identifier governing the R&D capitalization process, used for audit trail and financial reporting compliance documentation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this R&D capitalization record was most recently modified, supporting change tracking, audit trail, and SOX internal control documentation.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated useful economic life of the capitalized R&D intangible asset in years, used to calculate the annual amortization charge. Reflects patent life, market exclusivity period, or expected product lifecycle.

products.name: cogs_entry
products.description: Cost of Goods Sold records by drug product, SKU, and manufacturing batch, capturing standard cost, actual cost, cost variance, material cost, labor cost, overhead absorption, and period. Sourced from SAP CO-PC (Product Costing) and PP modules. Enables COGS analysis by product, brand, therapeutic area, and geography to support gross margin reporting and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: cogs_entry_id

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each COGS entry record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific manufacturing batch from which this COGS entry originates. Enables batch-level cost traceability and variance analysis per cGMP requirements.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which this COGS entry is posted. Determines the financial statement line item classification for external and internal reporting.

attributes.name: cmo_vendor_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center responsible for incurring the manufacturing costs captured in this entry. Supports cost allocation and P&L reporting by organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: costing_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SAP CO-PC costing run that generated the standard cost estimate for this entry. Enables traceability of cost roll-up calculations and standard cost updates.

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished drug product (DP) or finished dosage form (FDF) for which this COGS entry is recorded. Enables COGS analysis by product, brand, and therapeutic area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System)

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: COGS entries post to GL accounts for financial reporting. The existing gl_account_code is a STRING; adding general_ledger_id FK establishes the relationship to the GL account master. This connects cog

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.goods_issue. Business justification: Goods issues trigger COGS recognition in pharmaceutical accounting. Direct link required for inventory valuation, P&L accuracy, and audit trail from physical movement to financial posting. Standard ER

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: COGS postings triggered by goods receipts need direct linkage for inventory valuation and perpetual inventory accounting. Critical for FIFO/weighted average cost calculation, period-end inventory valu

attributes.name: inventory_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: COGS recognition in pharma requires tracing to specific inventory lots for actual cost determination (FIFO/FEFO). Core inventory valuation and P&L process. New FK needed to link financial postings to

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: COGS entries generate journal entries to record the cost of goods sold and inventory relief. The cogs_entry currently has sap_costing_doc_number (STRING) which should be replaced with a proper FK to j

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility where the drug product batch was produced. Supports COGS analysis by geography and manufacturing site.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; 21 CFR Parts 210/211 (cGMP)

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO profit center associated with this COGS entry. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, or business unit as required for management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: COGS entries for purchased materials and CMO manufacturing services require PO traceability for cost reconciliation. Essential for standard cost vs. actual PO price variance analysis, transfer pricing

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) representing the packaged, market-ready form of the drug product. Enables COGS granularity at the sellable unit level for gross margin and pricing analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: The actual cost incurred for the drug product batch or SKU as recorded in SAP CO-PC actual costing. Reflects real material consumption, labor hours, and overhead absorption during production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Module; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The commercial brand name of the drug product associated with this COGS entry. Supports COGS and gross margin reporting at the brand level for commercial P&L analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; FDA Drug Labeling; EMA Product Information

attributes.name: capitalization_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this COGS entry is eligible for R&D capitalization under applicable accounting standards (e.g., IFRS IAS 38 development phase costs). Supports the finance domain's R&D capitalization tracking process.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 38 (Intangible Assets); US GAAP ASC 730 (R&D Costs); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cmo_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this COGS entry relates to drug product manufactured by a Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) or Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) rather than internal manufacturing. Supports make-vs-buy cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Parts 210/211

attributes.name: cost_component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost component captured in this COGS entry. Enables granular COGS decomposition into material (API/excipients), labor, overhead absorption, depreciation, and royalty components for margin analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: material|labor|overhead|depreciation|royalty|contract_manufacturing|quality_control|packaging|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Cost Component Structure; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The calculated cost per unit of drug product (standard or actual, per costing_type) derived from total cost divided by quantity produced. Used for pricing decisions, gross margin analysis, and transfer pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Unit Cost; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between actual cost and standard cost (actual minus standard) for this COGS entry. Positive variance indicates cost overrun; negative indicates favorable performance. Critical for manufacturing efficiency analysis and pricing decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Variance Analysis; US GAAP ASC 330; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: costing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the costing methodology applied to this entry. Standard costing uses pre-set rates; actual costing uses real incurred costs. Determines how variances are calculated and reported.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Module; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this COGS entry record was first captured in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking per SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this COGS entry are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency COGS reporting across global manufacturing sites.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the COGS entry within the financial posting workflow. Controls whether the entry is included in period-close reporting and gross margin calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month 1–12 or 1–16 depending on fiscal year variant) within the fiscal year to which this COGS entry is attributed. Supports monthly gross margin reporting and period-close reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; US GAAP; IFRS; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this COGS entry belongs, as defined in the SAP FI fiscal year variant. Used for annual P&L reporting, budget vs. actual comparisons, and SOX period-close controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; US GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: The cost attributable to direct and indirect labor (production operators, QC analysts, supervisors) involved in manufacturing the batch. Sourced from SAP CO-PC labor cost component and PP work center confirmations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Labor Cost Component; PP Work Center; US GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: market_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market/geography for which this COGS entry is recorded. Enables COGS analysis by geography to support regional P&L reporting and transfer pricing compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: material_cost_amount
attributes.description: The cost attributable to raw materials, active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), excipients, and packaging materials consumed in producing the batch. Sourced from SAP CO-PC material cost component.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Material Cost Component; ICH Q7 (API GMP); US GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned National Drug Code (NDC) for the drug product SKU. Enables linkage of COGS data to regulatory product registrations and commercial sales data for gross margin analysis.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; 21 CFR Part 207 (Drug Registration and Listing)

attributes.name: overhead_absorbed_amount
attributes.description: The manufacturing overhead costs (facility, utilities, equipment depreciation, indirect costs) absorbed into the product cost using overhead rates defined in SAP CO. Represents the overhead absorption component of COGS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Overhead Cost Component; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world financial event date on which the COGS entry was posted to the general ledger in SAP FI/CO. Determines the fiscal period to which the cost is attributed for P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 2 (Inventories); US GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: quantity_produced
attributes.description: The quantity of drug product units (tablets, vials, doses, kg) produced in the manufacturing batch to which this COGS entry relates. Used to calculate per-unit cost and yield-adjusted COGS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Order; 21 CFR Parts 210/211; ICH Q7

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity produced field (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, TAB for tablets, VIAL for vials). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|MG|ML|TAB|VIAL|DOSE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: reversal_doc_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number of the reversal posting if this COGS entry has been reversed. Populated only when entry_status is 'reversed'. Supports audit trail and period-close reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Posting; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this COGS entry was sourced (e.g., SAP CO-PC for product costing, SAP PP for production orders, MES for manufacturing execution, or MANUAL for manual journal entries). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); SOX Section 404; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: The pre-determined standard cost for the drug product batch or SKU as calculated by the SAP CO-PC costing run. Represents the expected cost under normal operating conditions and is the baseline for variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Module; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area classification of the drug product (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Enables P&L and COGS analysis by therapeutic area as required for management reporting and R&D investment decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neuroscience|infectious_disease|metabolic|respiratory|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATC (Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical) Classification; WHO ATC Index; ICH E3

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this COGS entry record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, incremental loads, and SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: variance_category
attributes.description: Classification of the primary driver of cost variance for this entry.
