attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Variance Categories; US GAAP ASC 330; Management Accounting Standards

products.name: royalty_agreement
products.description: Master record and periodic accrual lifecycle for royalty and licensing agreements with external partners, universities, and IP licensors. Captures agreement terms (licensor/licensee, licensed compound, royalty rate structure including tiered rates, territory, effective dates, minimum payments, sublicensing rights, audit rights) and periodic accrual calculations (calculation period, net sales base, applicable rate tier, accrued royalty amount, currency, payment due date, settlement status). Serves as SSOT for royalty accounting obligations, IP cost tracking for in-licensed compounds, and royalty payment reconciliation across the pharmaceutical portfolio.

attributes.name: royalty_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the royalty and licensing agreement record in the enterprise data platform (Silver Layer). Primary key for this master agreement entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Royalty agreement creation tracking for contract management audit trail and licensing governance. Enables validation that agreements were entered by authorized business development or legal personnel,

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Royalty agreements specify GL accounts for accrual and payment posting (gl_account_code is STRING). Adding general_ledger_id FK links the royalty agreement to the GL account master. This connects roya

attributes.name: licensed_compound_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific compound, drug substance (DS), or active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) that is the subject of the royalty agreement. Links to the compound master record in the discovery domain for IP cost tracking of in-licensed compounds.
attributes.references: ICH Q11; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: licensing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent licensing agreement in the intellectual property domain that governs the broader IP relationship, of which this royalty agreement may be a financial component or schedule. Links to intellectual.licensing_agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ICH Q10

attributes.name: licensor_business_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.business_partner. Business justification: Licensor is a business_partner (bp_role='Licensor'). Essential for royalty payment processing, withholding tax calculation, audit rights enforcement, and vendor master data integration. Role-prefixed

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Royalty agreements with licensors who are also vendors (common in pharma for licensed compounds, APIs, or technology). Essential for consolidated vendor spend reporting, payment coordination, and inte

attributes.name: agreement_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the royalty agreement summarizing the key commercial terms, licensed rights, and strategic context. Used for business user reference and reporting narratives. Not a substitute for the legal agreement document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable agreement reference number assigned at execution (e.g., RA-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reconciliation with SAP FI/CO contract management and legal document repositories. Maps to the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the royalty agreement. Draft indicates the agreement is under negotiation; active indicates it is fully executed and binding; suspended indicates temporarily paused due to dispute or regulatory hold; terminated indicates early termination by either party; expired indicates the agreement reached its natural end date. Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty agreement by direction and structure of the licensing relationship. In-license covers compounds or IP acquired from external parties; out-license covers IP granted to third parties; cross-license covers mutual IP sharing; sublicense covers rights granted by a licensee to a third party; co-development covers joint R&D arrangements with shared royalty obligations. Maps to CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; IP Licensing Best Practices; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: audit_frequency_years
attributes.description: Maximum frequency (in years) at which the licensor may exercise audit rights under the agreement (e.g., once every 2 years). Null when audit_rights_flag is False. Used to schedule and track audit obligations.

attributes.name: audit_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the licensor has the contractual right to audit the licensee's books and records to verify royalty calculations and net sales reporting. True if audit rights are granted; False otherwise. Relevant for SOX compliance and royalty audit defense.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 808; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: base_royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: The primary or base royalty rate expressed as a percentage of net sales applicable to the first tier or flat rate structure. For tiered agreements, this represents the lowest tier rate. Stored with five decimal places to accommodate fractional rates common in pharmaceutical licensing (e.g., 3.50000%). Used as the default rate in accrual calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code to which royalty costs are allocated for internal management reporting. Supports P&L analysis by therapeutic area, brand, or R&D program and ROI calculation for in-licensed compounds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty agreement record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which royalty obligations, net sales, and payments are denominated under this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). All monetary fields in this record are expressed in this currency. Used for multi-currency royalty accounting and FX translation in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the royalty agreement becomes legally binding and royalty obligations commence. Used to determine the start of royalty accrual periods and minimum payment schedules. Maps to EFFECTIVE_FROM category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ICH Q10; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the royalty agreement was formally signed and executed by all parties. May differ from the effective date when agreements are backdated or have a future commencement clause. Critical for SOX audit trail and legal enforceability.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the royalty agreement is scheduled to expire and royalty obligations cease. Nullable for perpetual or open-ended agreements. Used for accrual cutoff and renewal planning. Maps to EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ICH Q10; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code to which royalty expense or income is posted for this agreement. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, and geography. Aligns with the chart of accounts in SAP FI/CO for royalty accounting obligations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the royalty agreement (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Relevant for dispute resolution, tax treaty application, and withholding tax obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty agreement record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: licensee_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity receiving the license rights (licensee). For in-license agreements, this is typically the pharmaceutical company itself or a subsidiary. For out-license agreements, this is the external partner receiving rights.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Customer Master; GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: minimum_annual_royalty_amount
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum royalty payment due to the licensor per calendar or contract year, regardless of actual net sales. If actual royalties calculated on net sales fall below this floor, the minimum amount is payable. Critical for accrual adequacy assessment and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: net_sales_definition
attributes.description: Contractual definition of net sales as the royalty base, specifying which deductions are permitted (e.g., trade discounts, chargebacks, returns, freight, taxes, gross-to-net adjustments). Critical for accurate royalty calculation and audit defense. Stored as free text capturing the contractual language or a standardized reference code.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 808; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Section 302; FDA Guidance on Gross-to-Net

attributes.name: payment_due_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the close of each reporting period within which the royalty payment must be remitted to the licensor (e.g., 45 days after quarter end). Used to calculate payment due dates for each accrual period and to assess timeliness of settlements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/AP Module; FASB ASC 808

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Contractual frequency at which royalty payments must be remitted to the licensor. Drives the accrual period schedule and payment due date calculation in SAP FI accounts payable. Quarterly is the most common frequency in pharmaceutical licensing agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/AP Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: royalty_rate_type
attributes.description: Structure of the royalty rate calculation methodology. Flat applies a single fixed percentage to all net sales; tiered applies different rates to different net sales bands; stepped changes the rate at defined cumulative thresholds; running is a continuous percentage; milestone_based triggers payments upon achievement of defined development or commercial milestones.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 808

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: Source system contract or purchase order number from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO module that corresponds to this royalty agreement. Used for financial reconciliation, accounts payable matching, and audit trail between the data lakehouse and the ERP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sublicense_royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Royalty rate percentage applicable to sublicense revenues received by the licensee, payable to the original licensor. Applicable only when sublicensing_rights_flag is True. May differ from the standard net sales royalty rate. Null when sublicensing is not permitted.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sublicensing_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the licensee has the contractual right to grant sublicenses to third parties under this agreement. True if sublicensing is permitted; False if rights are non-sublicensable. Impacts royalty flow-through obligations and sublicense revenue sharing calculations.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; IP Licensing Best Practices; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate the agreement for convenience or material breach. Used for contract lifecycle management and accrual wind-down planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: territory
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the royalty agreement defining the countries or regions where the licensee has rights to commercialize the licensed compound. Expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (comma-separated for multi-country) or a named region (e.g., WORLDWIDE, EU, USA). Drives territory-specific royalty rate application and net sales calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area classification of the licensed compound (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular, Neuroscience). Used for P&L reporting by therapeutic area and portfolio-level royalty cost analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neuroscience|infectious_diseases|metabolic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATC Classification; FDA Therapeutic Area Designations; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: tier1_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Net sales threshold amount (in the agreement currency) at which the royalty rate transitions from the base rate to the tier 2 rate. For tiered agreements, net sales up to this amount are subject to base_royalty_rate_pct. Null for flat-rate agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: tier2_royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Royalty rate percentage applicable to the second net sales tier for tiered or stepped royalty structures. Null for flat-rate agreements. Applied when cumulative or annual net sales exceed the tier 1 threshold defined in tier1_threshold_amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: tier2_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Net sales threshold amount (in the agreement currency) at which the royalty rate transitions from tier 2 to tier 3 rate. Null if the agreement has only two tiers or is flat-rate. Supports up to three-tier royalty structures common in pharmaceutical licensing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: tier3_royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Royalty rate percentage applicable to net sales exceeding the tier 2 threshold for three-tier royalty structures. Null for flat-rate or two-tier agreements. Typically the highest rate in escalating structures or lowest in de-escalating structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: upfront_license_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time non-refundable upfront payment made to the licensor upon execution of the agreement, separate from ongoing running royalties. Relevant for R&D capitalization assessment under FASB ASC 730 and IP cost tracking for in-licensed compounds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 730; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Applicable withholding tax rate percentage on royalty payments as determined by the governing tax treaty between the licensor and licensee jurisdictions. Used for net payment calculation and tax reporting. Zero if no withholding tax applies under a treaty exemption.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention; FASB ASC 740; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Module; SOX Section 302

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Records of financial transactions between legal entities within the pharmaceutical group, including intercompany loans, transfer pricing charges, management fee allocations, and intercompany product sales. Captures sending entity, receiving entity, transaction type, amount, currency, transfer price basis, and elimination status for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each intercompany transaction record within the pharmaceutical group's consolidated financial system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Intercompany transaction creation tracking for transfer pricing audit trail and SOX compliance. Enables validation that transactions were created by authorized finance personnel, supports transfer pri

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product (drug substance, drug product, or finished dosage form) involved in an intercompany product sale or transfer pricing transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; IFRS 15; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Intercompany transactions post to GL accounts (gl_account_code is STRING). Adding general_ledger_id FK links intercompany transactions to the GL account master. This further integrates general_ledger

attributes.name: intercompany_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master intercompany agreement or service level agreement that governs the terms, pricing, and conditions of this transaction between the two legal entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IAS 24; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Intercompany transactions generate journal entries in both the sending and receiving entities. Each intercompany transaction should reference the journal entry that posted it (typically the sending en

attributes.name: original_transaction_intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original intercompany transaction that this record reverses or amends. Null for original transactions; populated only for reversal or adjustment entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IAS 8; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity within the pharmaceutical group that initiates and books the intercompany charge, sale, or loan as the originating party.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code; IFRS 10; IAS 24

attributes.name: receiving_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity within the pharmaceutical group that receives the intercompany charge, product, or service and records the corresponding payable or expense.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code; IFRS 10; IAS 24

attributes.name: royalty_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_agreement. Business justification: Intercompany royalty payments between legal entities within the pharmaceutical group should reference the governing royalty agreement. This is essential for transfer pricing compliance and audit trail

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Cross-border shipments between affiliates create intercompany transactions for transfer pricing. Links physical movement to financial settlement, customs valuation, and withholding tax calculation. Re

attributes.name: stock_transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.stock_transfer_order. Business justification: Intercompany stock transfers between legal entities generate IC transactions at transfer prices. Required for legal entity P&L, transfer pricing documentation, and tax compliance. Core pharma supply c

attributes.name: transfer_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.transfer_price. Business justification: Intercompany transactions for product transfers must reference the applicable transfer pricing record for tax compliance and audit. This is a core transfer pricing requirement. Cardinality: Many IC tr

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary adjustments applied to the gross amount, including withholding tax, discounts, or transfer pricing true-up adjustments. Negative values represent reductions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IAS 12 Income Taxes

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center to which the intercompany management fee, cost allocation, or service charge is attributed on the receiving entity's books, enabling P&L reporting by therapeutic area or function.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IAS 1; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2); SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the originating source document number (e.g., SAP FI document number, invoice number, loan agreement reference, or intercompany billing document) that triggered this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Management; 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: elimination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was eliminated in the group consolidation process. Null if elimination has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction has been eliminated in the consolidated financial statements to avoid double-counting of intra-group revenues and expenses per IFRS 10.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Group Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to translate the transaction currency amount into the group reporting currency. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables per IAS 21 requirements.
attributes.references: IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate Configuration; ECB/Federal Reserve reference rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–12 or 1–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which the transaction is recorded in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction is recognized for financial reporting purposes, aligned with the pharmaceutical group's fiscal calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements; SOX

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA general ledger account code to which the intercompany transaction is posted on the sending entity's books. Determines P&L or balance sheet classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Chart of Accounts; IAS 1; IFRS 10; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the intercompany transaction before any adjustments, discounts, or withholding taxes, expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 15; IAS 21; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net transaction amount translated into the pharmaceutical group's reporting currency (e.g., USD) using the applicable exchange rate for consolidation and P&L reporting by therapeutic area.
attributes.references: IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; SOX

attributes.name: loan_interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applicable to intercompany loan transactions, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.035000 = 3.5%). Must comply with arm's-length interest rate requirements under OECD BEPS guidelines.
attributes.references: OECD BEPS Action 4; IAS 39/IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; 26 CFR §1.482-2; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary value of the intercompany transaction after all adjustments (gross_amount + adjustment_amount). This is the amount recorded in the general ledger and used for consolidation elimination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany payment was actually settled between the legal entities. Used to calculate days outstanding and assess compliance with intercompany payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the receiving entity must settle the intercompany payable. Used for cash flow forecasting and intercompany aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms; IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows; IFRS 9

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI. May differ from transaction_date due to period-end close timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IAS 10 Events After the Reporting Period; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center associated with the intercompany transaction, enabling P&L reporting by brand, therapeutic area (e.g., oncology, immunology), or geography.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; SOX

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA four-character company code identifying the receiving legal entity. Used for automated intercompany matching and elimination in the consolidation system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration; IFRS 10

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction. True for correcting entries or period-end accrual reversals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Reversal Posting; IAS 8 Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors; SOX

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA four-character company code identifying the sending legal entity. Used for automated intercompany matching and elimination in the consolidation system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration; IFRS 10

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction is subject to SOX internal control testing and documentation requirements. True for transactions above materiality thresholds or in scope of SOX key controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SEC Rules 13a-15 and 15d-15

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical therapeutic area associated with the intercompany transaction (e.g., product sale of an oncology drug substance). Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area as required by segment reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_disease|neuroscience|cardiovascular|infectious_disease|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; ICH E8; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: tp_documentation_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the transfer pricing documentation file (e.g., master file, local file, or country-by-country report) supporting the arm's-length nature of this transaction per OECD BEPS Action 13.
attributes.references: OECD BEPS Action 13; 26 CFR §1.6038A; EU Code of Conduct on Transfer Pricing Documentation; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the intercompany transaction is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Drives foreign currency translation for consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the intercompany transaction was executed or the service/product was delivered between legal entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; IFRS 15

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number assigned to the intercompany transaction, used for cross-entity reconciliation and audit trail. Format: ICT-{YYYY}-{8-digit sequence}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the intercompany transaction within the financial close and consolidation workflow. 'Eliminated' indicates the transaction has been removed in consolidated reporting per IFRS 10.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction by its business nature. Drives accounting treatment, transfer pricing documentation requirements, and elimination logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: intercompany_loan|transfer_pricing_charge|management_fee|product_sale|royalty|cost_allocation|dividend — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS 10; IAS 24 Related Party Disclosures

attributes.name: transfer_price_basis
attributes.description: The OECD-approved transfer pricing methodology used to determine the arm's-length price for this intercompany transaction. CUP=Comparable Uncontrolled Price, RPM=Resale Price Method, CPM=Cost Plus Method, TNMM=Transactional Net Margin Method, PSM=Profit Split Method. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUP|CUT|RPM|CPM|TNMM|PSM|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises; BEPS Action Plans 8-10; IAS 24; 26 CFR §1.482

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was last modified, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2); SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of withholding tax deducted from the intercompany payment, calculated as gross_amount × withholding_tax_rate. Relevant for royalty payments and intercompany loans.
attributes.references: IAS 12; OECD Model Tax Convention; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Withholding Tax

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The withholding tax rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.1500 = 15%) applicable to this intercompany transaction under the relevant bilateral tax treaty or domestic tax law.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention; IAS 12 Income Taxes; 26 CFR §1.1441; EU Interest and Royalties Directive

products.name: tax_posting
products.description: Tax-related financial postings including VAT, sales tax, withholding tax, and deferred tax entries managed in SAP FI-TX. Captures tax code, tax jurisdiction, taxable base amount, tax amount, tax account, reporting period, and tax return reference. Supports indirect tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions where pharmaceutical products are sold or manufactured.

attributes.name: tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax-related financial posting record in the SAP FI-TX module. Serves as the primary key for the tax_posting data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: Tax postings generated from AP transactions (withholding tax, VAT on purchases) should reference the source AP document. This is a nullable FK since not all tax postings are AP-related. Strengthens ac

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Tax postings generated from AR transactions should reference the source AR document. This is a nullable FK since not all tax postings are AR-related (some are AP, payroll, etc.). Provides additional i

attributes.name: business_partner_id
attributes.description: The SAP vendor (LIFNR) or customer (KUNNR) account number associated with the originating transaction. Identifies the counterparty (e.g., CRO, CMO, CDMO, distributor, wholesaler, or hospital) for the taxable transaction, supporting withholding tax reporting and VAT reclaim processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI LIFNR/KUNNR; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center (KOSTL) to which the tax posting is allocated. Enables tax cost attribution by therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, rare diseases), manufacturing site, or R&D program for internal P&L reporting and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO KOSTL; IFRS IAS 12; SOX

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tax posting creation tracking for tax compliance audit trail and SOX controls. Enables validation that tax entries were created by authorized tax personnel with proper training, supports tax authority

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Tax postings record to GL accounts (tax_account field is STRING). Adding general_ledger_id FK establishes the relationship to the GL account master. This connects tax_posting to general_ledger. Not re

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.intercompany_transaction. Business justification: Tax postings (withholding tax, VAT, deferred tax) related to intercompany transactions should reference the source IC transaction for audit trail and tax compliance. Cardinality: Many tax postings can

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Tax postings are specialized journal entries in SAP FI. Every tax posting generates or is associated with a journal entry that records the tax transaction in the general ledger. This is a standard par

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO profit center (PRCTR) associated with the tax posting. Supports P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, or geography and enables segment-level tax analysis for management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO PRCTR; IFRS IAS 12; SOX

attributes.name: royalty_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_agreement. Business justification: Tax postings (especially withholding tax) on royalty payments should reference the governing royalty agreement for compliance reporting and treaty benefit tracking. Cardinality: Many tax postings can

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP document number of the clearing entry that settles this tax posting against a tax payment, refund, or offset, if applicable. Populated when posting_status is 'cleared'. Supports tax account reconciliation and cash flow reporting for tax payments.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The four-character SAP company code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity or subsidiary within the pharmaceutical enterprise for which the tax posting is recorded. Supports P&L reporting by legal entity and multi-jurisdictional tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI BUKRS; IFRS IAS 12; SOX

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the tax jurisdiction where the tax liability arises. Used to determine applicable tax authority (FDA/IRS for USA, EMA/national authorities for EU member states, MHRA for GBR, PMDA for JPN, NMPA for CHN) and applicable tax treaty.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OECD Model Tax Convention; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the tax posting record was first created in the source SAP FI-TX system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 404 and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures in pharmaceutical financial systems.
attributes.references: SAP FI; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the originating transaction document (WAERS in SAP). Identifies the transaction currency for cross-border pharmaceutical sales, royalty payments, and intercompany transfers subject to withholding tax.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP FI WAERS; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: deductible_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of input tax that is recoverable when a pharmaceutical entity makes both taxable and exempt supplies (partial exemption / pro-rata recovery). Calculated per the applicable tax authority's partial exemption method and applied to determine the recoverable portion of input VAT.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC Article 173; HMRC VAT Notice 706

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating business document (BLDAT) such as an invoice, credit memo, or customs declaration that triggered the tax posting. May differ from posting_date and is used for tax point determination under VAT rules.
attributes.references: SAP FI BLDAT; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; HMRC VAT Notice 700

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI accounting document number (BELNR) that uniquely identifies the financial document containing this tax posting within a company code and fiscal year. Used for cross-referencing with the general ledger and accounts payable/receivable.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The SAP document type code (BLART) classifying the originating financial document (e.g., KR=vendor invoice, DR=customer invoice, KZ=vendor payment, SA=general ledger posting). Determines the number range and posting rules for the tax entry.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal posting period (MONAT, 1–16 in SAP) within the fiscal year in which the tax entry is recorded. Supports monthly and quarterly indirect tax reporting and VAT return filing cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (GJAHR) in which the tax posting is recorded in SAP FI. Used for period-end tax reporting, annual tax return preparation, and SOX-compliant financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI GJAHR; IFRS IAS 12; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: is_deductible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the input tax amount on this posting is fully deductible (recoverable) from the tax authority. Non-deductible input tax arises on purchases used for exempt pharmaceutical activities (e.g., certain clinical trial services or exempt healthcare supplies). Drives VAT recovery calculations.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC Article 168; HMRC VAT Notice 700

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the tax posting record in the source SAP FI-TX system. Used for incremental data loading into the Databricks Silver Layer and for change audit trail compliance under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: SAP FI; SOX; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code local currency (HWAER in SAP). Used for statutory tax reporting and local tax authority submissions in the jurisdiction of the legal entity.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP FI HWAER; IFRS IAS 21; SOX

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The SAP plant code (WERKS) identifying the manufacturing or distribution facility associated with the taxable transaction. Relevant for excise tax, customs duty, and VAT on pharmaceutical manufacturing activities subject to cGMP and GDP regulations.
attributes.references: SAP MM WERKS; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; 21 CFR Parts 210/211

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date (BUDAT) on which the tax posting is recorded in the SAP general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date used for tax period reporting and VAT return preparation.
attributes.references: SAP FI BUDAT; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax posting in SAP FI. 'Posted' indicates a confirmed accounting entry; 'reversed' indicates the posting has been cancelled via a reversal document; 'cleared' indicates the tax account has been cleared against a tax payment or refund; 'parked' indicates a preliminary entry pending approval; 'blocked' indicates the posting is held for review.

attributes.name: posting_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax posting represents output tax (collected on pharmaceutical product sales), input tax (recoverable on purchases of raw materials, API, or services), withholding tax on royalties or intercompany payments, or deferred tax asset/liability per IFRS IAS 12.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number (XBLNR in SAP) from the originating business document such as a vendor invoice number, customer purchase order, customs entry number, or intercompany billing document. Used to trace the tax posting back to the source transaction for audit and tax return reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI XBLNR; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; SOX

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reversal document was posted in SAP FI, if this tax posting has been reversed. Used for period-end reconciliation and to ensure reversed postings are excluded from tax return submissions.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP document number of the reversal entry that cancels this tax posting, if applicable. Populated when posting_status is 'reversed'. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records integrity.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this tax posting was sourced (e.g., SAP FI-TX, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and enables multi-system reconciliation during ERP migrations or parallel-run periods.

attributes.name: tax_account
attributes.description: The SAP general ledger account number (HKONT) to which the tax amount is posted. Identifies the specific tax liability or tax receivable account in the chart of accounts, enabling tax account reconciliation and balance sheet reporting under IFRS IAS 12.
attributes.references: SAP FI HKONT; IFRS IAS 12; SOX

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount (HWSTE in SAP) in the company code local currency. Represents the actual tax liability or recoverable input tax for this posting. Used for VAT return preparation, tax account reconciliation, and indirect tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX HWSTE; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; SOX

attributes.name: tax_amount_doc_currency
attributes.description: The tax amount expressed in the original transaction document currency (FWSTE in SAP). Relevant for cross-border pharmaceutical transactions where the invoice currency differs from the company code local currency, supporting foreign currency tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX FWSTE; IFRS IAS 21; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: tax_base_amount
attributes.description: The net taxable base amount (HWBAS in SAP, in local currency) upon which the tax is calculated. Represents the value of the pharmaceutical product sale, service, or intercompany transaction subject to tax before the tax amount is applied.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX HWBAS; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; SOX

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The SAP tax code (MWSKZ) that identifies the applicable tax rate, tax type, and tax procedure for the posting. Encodes the combination of tax category (input/output), jurisdiction, and rate applicable to the pharmaceutical product or service transaction.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX MWSKZ; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The SAP tax jurisdiction code (TXJCD) identifying the specific geographic tax authority (federal, state/province, county, city) to which the tax is owed. Critical for multi-jurisdictional pharmaceutical sales and manufacturing operations across FDA, EMA, MHRA, and PMDA regulated markets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX TXJCD; US IRC; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; OECD BEPS

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 20.0000 for 20% VAT) used to calculate the tax amount from the taxable base. Derived from the tax code configuration in SAP FI-TX and varies by jurisdiction, product classification, and applicable tax treaty.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: The tax registration number of the counterparty (vendor or customer) involved in the taxable transaction, such as a VAT registration number (EU), Employer Identification Number (US), or equivalent. Required for EC Sales List reporting, Intrastat, and cross-border VAT compliance in pharmaceutical distribution.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; US IRC §6109; OECD BEPS Action 13

attributes.name: tax_reporting_period
attributes.description: The calendar year and month (YYYY-MM format) of the tax reporting period to which this posting belongs for indirect tax return purposes. May differ from the SAP fiscal period when the company uses a non-calendar fiscal year. Used for VAT return filing, Intrastat reporting, and withholding tax declarations.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; HMRC VAT Notice 700; US IRC §6011; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: tax_return_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of the periodic tax return (VAT return, sales tax return, or withholding tax declaration) to which this posting has been assigned. Enables reconciliation between individual tax postings and filed tax returns submitted to FDA-regulated markets, EU member states, HMRC, PMDA, or other tax authorities.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; HMRC VAT Notice 700; US IRC; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax category applicable to this posting. Distinguishes between Value Added Tax (VAT), sales tax, withholding tax on royalties or intercompany payments, deferred tax, customs duty on API imports, and excise tax on pharmaceutical products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VAT|sales_tax|withholding_tax|deferred_tax|customs_duty|excise_tax — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX; IFRS IAS 12; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical therapeutic area associated with the product or program that generated the taxable transaction. Enables tax cost allocation and P&L reporting by therapeutic area (e.g., oncology, immunology, rare diseases) as required for management reporting and R&D capitalization analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|neuroscience|cardiovascular|infectious_diseases|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Finance Taxonomy; IFRS IAS 12; SOX

products.name: milestone_payment
products.description: Tracks contractual milestone-based payment obligations and receipts triggered by development, regulatory, or commercial events in pharmaceutical partnerships. Captures milestone type (e.g., IND filing, Phase II completion, NDA approval, first commercial sale, sales thresholds), triggering event date, contractual payment amount, currency, counterparty, associated internal order, payment status, and accounting treatment. Distinct from internal_order (which collects all costs for a program) — milestone_payment owns the individual contractual obligation record and its trigger-based lifecycle. Critical for R&D partnership financial management and contingent liability disclosure.

attributes.name: milestone_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each milestone payment obligation or receipt record. Primary key for the milestone_payment data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Internal Document Number

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Milestone payment approvals require employee link for authorization controls and audit trail. Existing approved_by is name string; FK enables proper approval hierarchy validation for licensing milesto

attributes.name: business_partner_id
attributes.description: System identifier for the external counterparty (vendor or customer) in the SAP master data. Links to the vendor/customer master record for the partner organization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Vendor Master (LFA1) / Customer Master (KNA1)

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger account to which this milestone payment is posted in SAP FI. Determines the financial statement line item for the payment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — G/L Account (SKA1); IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost center responsible for this milestone payment obligation. Used for departmental cost allocation and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center (CSKS)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Each milestone payment triggers a journal entry for the financial posting. The milestone_payment currently has sap_document_number (STRING) which should be replaced with a proper FK to journal_entry.

attributes.name: licensing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent licensing, collaboration, or partnership agreement under which this milestone payment obligation was established.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Contract Reference

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP profit center for P&L reporting of this milestone payment by business unit, brand, or therapeutic area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Profit Center (CEPC)

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.discovery_project. Business justification: Milestone payments (in/out-licensing) are project-specific; linking enables accrual tracking, contingent liability management, portfolio valuation, and cash flow forecasting essential to pharmaceutica

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Milestone payments to CRO/CMO vendors for development and manufacturing milestones require vendor linkage for payment processing, vendor performance tracking, and consolidated spend reporting. Critica

attributes.name: accounting_treatment
attributes.description: Accounting classification applied to this milestone payment per applicable accounting standards: rd_expense (expensed as R&D), capitalize (capitalized as intangible asset), cogs (recognized as cost of goods sold), deferred_revenue (deferred until performance obligation met), contingent_liability (disclosed as contingent liability until triggered).
attributes.references: IFRS 15; IFRS 38; ASC 730 — Research and Development; ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the milestone payment was formally approved by the authorized approver. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial disbursements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for the milestone payment. Tracks whether the payment has been reviewed and authorized by the appropriate financial and legal stakeholders before processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Approval Workflow; SOX Section 302/404 — Internal Controls

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP company code identifying the legal entity responsible for this milestone payment. Determines the applicable accounting standards, currency, and regulatory jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Company Code (T001); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: contractual_amount
attributes.description: The gross payment amount as specified in the partnership or licensing agreement for this milestone, in the contract currency. This is the base obligation before any adjustments, withholding taxes, or FX conversion.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Transaction Price; ASC 808; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone payment record was first created in the system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for SOX-compliant financial records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contractual milestone payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP). Defines the denomination of the contractual_amount field.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: development_stage
attributes.description: Development stage of the associated drug program at the time the milestone is triggered (e.g., preclinical, Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, NDA/BLA Filed). Used for R&D capitalization assessment and program tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discovery|preclinical|phase_1|phase_2|phase_3|nda_bla_filed|approved|commercial — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); ICH E8; IFRS 38 — Intangible Assets (R&D Capitalization)

attributes.name: expected_trigger_date
attributes.description: Projected date by which the triggering event is expected to occur, based on current program timelines. Used for contingent liability forecasting and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: IFRS 37 — Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets; ASC 450 — Contingencies

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Milestone payment amount converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the applicable exchange rate at the time of recognition or payment. Used for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company's functional currency used in the functional_currency_amount field (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the contractual_amount from contract currency to functional currency at the time of recognition or payment. Sourced from SAP FI treasury rates.
attributes.references: IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI Treasury

attributes.name: is_capitalized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone payment has been capitalized as an intangible asset on the balance sheet rather than expensed. Applicable when the payment relates to a product that has received regulatory approval and meets capitalization criteria.
attributes.references: IFRS 38 — Intangible Assets; ASC 350 — Intangibles; SAP S/4HANA FI Asset Accounting

attributes.name: is_contingent_liability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone payment represents a contingent liability that must be disclosed in financial statements prior to the triggering event occurring. True if the payment obligation is contingent on a future uncertain event.
attributes.references: IFRS 37 — Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets; ASC 450 — Contingencies; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this milestone payment record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the milestone payment as defined in the contractual agreement (e.g., 'Phase II Completion Payment', 'NDA Approval Milestone', 'First Commercial Sale Milestone').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) — Good Clinical Practice; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: milestone_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this milestone payment, typically referenced in the partnership agreement schedule. Format: MS-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Reference Number

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the milestone by the nature of the triggering event: development (e.g., IND filing, Phase completion), regulatory (e.g., NDA/BLA/MAA approval), commercial (e.g., first commercial sale), sales_threshold (e.g., net sales exceeding a defined threshold), or technical (e.g., target validation, candidate nomination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: development|regulatory|commercial|sales_threshold|technical|preclinical — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH M4 eCTD; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Licensing Agreements

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual net amount paid or received after deducting withholding taxes and any other contractual adjustments from the contractual_amount. Represents the cash flow impact.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, legal commentary, dispute details, or operational notes related to this milestone payment record.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the milestone payment was settled (funds transferred or received). Null if payment has not yet been made.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Clearing Date; IFRS 15

attributes.name: payment_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone payment is an obligation owed by the company to a counterparty (payable) or a receipt due from a counterparty (receivable). Critical for balance sheet classification and contingent liability disclosure.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 808 — Collaborative Arrangements; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractually defined date by which the milestone payment must be made or received following the triggering event. Typically calculated as triggering event date plus contractual payment terms (e.g., net 30/60 days).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Due Date; IFRS 15

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the milestone payment obligation. Pending: milestone not yet achieved; Triggered: triggering event has occurred and payment is due; Approved: payment approved for processing; Paid: payment has been settled; Waived: contractually waived; Disputed: under dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Status; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this milestone payment record originated (e.g., SAP_FI for SAP Finance, VEEVA_VAULT for contract management, MANUAL for manually entered records).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; SAP S/4HANA Data Lineage

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Therapeutic area classification of the drug program associated with this milestone (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Neuroscience). Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area.
attributes.references: ATC Classification System (WHO); SAP S/4HANA CO — Profit Center

attributes.name: triggering_event
attributes.description: Description of the specific contractual event that triggers this milestone payment (e.g., 'IND Filing Accepted by FDA', 'Phase II Primary Endpoint Met', 'NDA Approval Received', 'First Commercial Sale in US', 'Annual Net Sales Exceed $500M').
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); FDA 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); ICH E8 — General Considerations for Clinical Studies

attributes.name: triggering_event_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the contractual triggering event occurred, confirming the milestone has been achieved and the payment obligation is activated. Null if the milestone has not yet been triggered.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue Recognition; ASC 808; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the milestone payment as required by applicable tax treaties or local tax regulations. Reduces the net payment amount received or paid.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention; IRS Publication 515; SAP S/4HANA FI — Withholding Tax

products.name: transfer_price
products.description: Transfer pricing master records governing the prices at which pharmaceutical products, APIs, and services are transacted between related legal entities across jurisdictions. Captures product or service, sending entity, receiving entity, transfer price method (CUP, cost-plus, TNMM), approved price, currency, effective date, and regulatory documentation reference. Supports OECD transfer pricing compliance and tax authority documentation.

attributes.name: transfer_price_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the transfer pricing master record governing intercompany transactions between related legal entities.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Transfer price approvals require employee link for authorization controls and audit trail. Existing approved_by is name string; FK enables proper approval hierarchy validation for arm's length pricing

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost center responsible for the intercompany transfer pricing arrangement. Used for internal P&L allocation and management reporting by therapeutic area or geography.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: drug_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product, drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), or finished dosage form (FDF) subject to this transfer price.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ICH Q10

attributes.name: primary_transfer_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity that is the seller or supplier in the intercompany transaction (the entity transferring the product, API, or service).
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code

attributes.name: prior_version_transfer_price_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding version of this transfer price record (self-referential). Enables reconstruction of the full price history chain for audit and tax authority documentation purposes.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP profit center associated with the intercompany transaction. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, or geography in SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supply_contract. Business justification: Intercompany supply contracts reference transfer pricing policies for arm's length validation and transfer pricing compliance. Essential for pharmaceutical companies with global manufacturing networks

attributes.name: apa_reference
attributes.description: Reference to an Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) or bilateral APA (BAPA) concluded with one or more tax authorities that pre-approves the transfer pricing methodology and price range for this transaction. Null if no APA is in place.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; 26 CFR §1.482; Rev. Proc. 2015-41

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transfer price was formally approved by the authorized approver (e.g., Head of Tax, CFO, or Transfer Pricing Committee) in accordance with SOX-compliant approval workflows.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow

attributes.name: approved_price
attributes.description: The arm's-length intercompany price approved for the transfer of the product or service per unit, expressed in the transaction currency. This is the operative price used in intercompany invoicing.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Record

attributes.name: arm_length_range_max
attributes.description: The upper bound of the arm's-length price range (interquartile range) established through benchmarking analysis. The approved transfer price must fall within this range to satisfy OECD and local tax authority requirements.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter III; 26 CFR §1.482

attributes.name: arm_length_range_min
attributes.description: The lower bound of the arm's-length price range (interquartile range) established through benchmarking analysis. The approved transfer price must fall within this range to satisfy OECD and local tax authority requirements.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter III; 26 CFR §1.482

attributes.name: benchmarking_study_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the economic benchmarking study (comparables analysis) that supports the arm's-length determination for this transfer price. Links to the transfer pricing documentation file.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter III; OECD BEPS Action 13

attributes.name: cost_base_amount
attributes.description: The total cost base (direct manufacturing cost, overhead, and allocated R&D) used as the starting point for cost-plus or TNMM pricing method calculations. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter II; SAP S/4HANA CO Product Costing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this transfer price record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports SOX audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the approved transfer price is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this transfer price record becomes binding and operative for intercompany invoicing between the sending and receiving legal entities.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this transfer price record ceases to be operative. Null indicates an open-ended record with no defined expiry. Superseded records will have this date set to the day before the successor record's effective date.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this transfer price record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports SOX audit trail and change management tracking.

attributes.name: markup_pct
attributes.description: The arm's-length markup percentage applied to the cost base to arrive at the approved transfer price under cost-plus or TNMM methodology. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.0000 = 15%).
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter II; 26 CFR §1.482-3

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next periodic review of this transfer price must be completed to maintain arm's-length compliance and update the supporting documentation.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; OECD BEPS Action 13

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, rationale, or context regarding the transfer price determination, including any deviations from standard methodology or special circumstances noted by the transfer pricing team.

attributes.name: price_per_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure to which the approved transfer price applies (e.g., per kg of API, per vial of drug product, per batch). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA base unit of measure on the material master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|mg|L|mL|unit|vial|tablet|capsule|batch — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ICH Q7

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: OECD-recognized transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arm's-length price. CUP = Comparable Uncontrolled Price; TNMM = Transactional Net Margin Method; RPM = Resale Price Method; PSM = Profit Split Method; cost_plus = Cost-Plus Method.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter II; 26 CFR §1.482

attributes.name: product_lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: The commercial lifecycle stage of the pharmaceutical product at the time this transfer price is established. Influences the pricing methodology and markup applied (e.g., pre-launch products may use cost-plus; commercial products may use CUP).
attributes.references: ICH Q10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the item or service subject to the transfer price. Distinguishes between active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), drug substance (DS), finished drug product (DP), finished dosage form (FDF), contract manufacturing services, or intellectual property royalty arrangements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: API|drug_substance|drug_product|FDF|service|CMO_service|IP_royalty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q7; ICH Q10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: receiving_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the receiving legal entity is domiciled. Used for bilateral tax treaty analysis and OECD country-by-country reporting.

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the transfer pricing record, used in intercompany agreements, tax authority documentation, and OECD compliance filings. Format: TP-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transfer pricing record. Active records govern live intercompany transactions; superseded records have been replaced by a newer version. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|superseded|expired|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: regulatory_doc_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the formal transfer pricing documentation package (local file, master file, or country-by-country report) filed with tax authorities in accordance with OECD BEPS Action 13 requirements. May reference a Veeva Vault document ID or SAP document number.
attributes.references: OECD BEPS Action 13; 26 CFR §1.6038A; EU ATAD

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled frequency at which this transfer price is reviewed and potentially revised to ensure continued arm's-length compliance. Annual review is the OECD standard minimum.

attributes.name: sending_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the sending legal entity is domiciled. Used for bilateral tax treaty analysis and OECD country-by-country reporting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this transfer price record originates (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, manual entry via spreadsheet, or a Regulatory Information Management System). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: tax_ruling_ref
attributes.description: Reference to any binding tax ruling, private letter ruling, or competent authority agreement issued by a tax authority that specifically governs or validates this transfer pricing arrangement.
attributes.references: OECD BEPS Action 5; 26 CFR §1.482; EU ATAD

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area classification of the pharmaceutical product subject to the transfer price (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Supports P&L reporting by therapeutic area and R&D ROI analysis.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Nature of the intercompany transaction governed by this transfer price: tangible goods (products/APIs), services (manufacturing, R&D, distribution), IP licensing, cost-sharing arrangements, or intercompany loans.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter VI; 26 CFR §1.482

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the transfer price record for a given product-entity pair. Incremented each time the price is revised. Enables audit trail and historical price reconstruction for tax authority inquiries.
attributes.references: OECD BEPS Action 13; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: withholding_tax_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether withholding tax applies to the intercompany transaction governed by this transfer price (e.g., royalty payments or service fees may be subject to withholding tax under bilateral tax treaties).
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention; 26 CFR §1.1441; EU Interest and Royalties Directive

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: The applicable withholding tax rate (as a decimal percentage) on the intercompany payment, as determined by the bilateral tax treaty between the sending and receiving entity jurisdictions. Null if withholding_tax_applicable is False.
