attributes.description: Reference to the material being delivered under this schedule. May represent Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), excipient, packaging material, or laboratory supply.

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line_item. Business justification: Delivery schedules in SAP MM are maintained at the line item level, not the header level. While delivery_schedule already has FK to purchase_order, adding FK to po_line_item provides the correct granu

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order or blanket purchase order under which this delivery schedule is created. Links to the procurement purchase order entity.

attributes.name: receiving_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Delivery schedules specify receiving plant for inbound logistics planning and goods receipt preparation. Plant master provides receiving hours and dock capacity for pharmaceutical supply chain executi

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.storage_location. Business justification: Delivery schedules specify storage location for inbound logistics and goods receipt posting. Storage location master provides capacity and temperature control for pharmaceutical delivery planning.

attributes.name: scheduling_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduling agreement with the vendor that governs this delivery schedule. Used for long-term procurement arrangements with scheduled releases.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Delivery schedule quantity UOM for ASN confirmation and goods receipt matching. UOM master provides conversion for pharmaceutical inbound logistics and inventory posting.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor responsible for delivering the materials under this schedule. Links to the vendor master data.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the material was received at the destination. Populated upon goods receipt posting. Used for schedule adherence analysis and vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Advanced Shipping Notice document received from the vendor. Used to correlate shipment notification with goods receipt.

attributes.name: asn_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Advanced Shipping Notice was received from the vendor. Used to measure vendor compliance with ASN lead time requirements.

attributes.name: asn_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) has been received from the vendor for this delivery schedule line. ASN provides advance notification of shipment details and enables proactive receiving preparation.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the logistics carrier or freight forwarder responsible for transporting the material from the vendor to the receiving location.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the vendor in response to the scheduled delivery date. May differ from the scheduled date if the vendor cannot meet the original request. Used for supply planning and risk assessment.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material confirmed by the vendor for delivery. May differ from the scheduled quantity if the vendor cannot fulfill the full request. Used for supply planning adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material received and posted in the goods receipt. Used for invoice verification and schedule adherence tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_delay_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days by which the actual delivery date exceeded the confirmed delivery date. Positive values indicate late delivery; negative values indicate early delivery. Used for vendor performance scoring.

attributes.name: delivery_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: The acceptable percentage variance (over or under) from the scheduled quantity that the buyer will accept without requiring approval. Used for automated goods receipt processing and tolerance checking.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the goods receipt document created when the material was physically received and posted into inventory. Links the delivery schedule to the actual receipt transaction.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The Incoterms code that defines the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and seller for this delivery. Examples include EXW (Ex Works), FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid).

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the quality inspection lot created for this goods receipt. Used to track sampling, testing, and release decisions in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery schedule record was most recently updated. Tracks the latest change to any field in the record for change management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: overdelivery_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable percentage by which the vendor may exceed the scheduled quantity. Separate from underdelivery tolerance to provide asymmetric control.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material must undergo quality inspection before being released for use. Typically true for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) materials including APIs, excipients, and packaging components.

attributes.name: quantity_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage difference between the delivered quantity and the confirmed quantity. Calculated as ((delivered_quantity - confirmed_quantity) / confirmed_quantity) * 100. Used for vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: required_temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments. Excursions beyond this threshold may compromise material quality and require investigation.

attributes.name: required_temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments. Used for cold chain validation and compliance verification.

attributes.name: schedule_adherence_status
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery performance relative to the confirmed delivery date and quantity. On-time indicates delivery within tolerance; early and late indicate timing deviations; partial indicates quantity shortfall; cancelled indicates the schedule line was not fulfilled.

attributes.name: schedule_change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the delivery schedule was modified after initial creation. Captures business context for date or quantity changes, cancellations, or expedited deliveries.

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the purchase order or scheduling agreement that uniquely identifies this delivery schedule entry. Used for ordering and referencing specific schedule lines.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery schedule line. Tracks progression from initial planning through vendor confirmation, shipment, and final delivery or cancellation.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery schedule indicating the commitment level and planning horizon. Forecast schedules are non-binding planning signals; firm schedules are committed deliveries; just-in-time schedules support lean manufacturing; blanket and contract releases are call-offs from long-term agreements.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date on which the material is expected to be delivered to the receiving location. This is the buyer's requested delivery date communicated to the vendor.

attributes.name: scheduled_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material originally scheduled for delivery on the scheduled delivery date. Expressed in the material's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: shipping_point
attributes.description: The vendor's facility or location from which the material is being shipped. Used for logistics planning and transit time calculation.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery requires temperature-controlled transportation to maintain material stability and quality. Critical for biologics, vaccines, and temperature-sensitive Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs).

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-provided tracking number for the shipment. Enables real-time visibility of in-transit materials and proactive exception management.

attributes.name: underdelivery_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable percentage by which the vendor may fall short of the scheduled quantity without triggering a deviation or requiring approval.

products.name: approved_vendor_material
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory approval and quality agreement between a vendor and a specific material they are authorized to supply. It captures vendor-material-specific approval status, quality agreements, DMF references, audit history, and risk classifications that exist only in the context of this specific supply relationship. Each record links one vendor to one material with regulatory and quality attributes that govern the supply of that specific material by that specific vendor.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical operations, a vendor can be approved to supply multiple materials (APIs, excipients, packaging materials), and a material can be sourced from multiple approved vendors to ensure supply continuity and competitive pricing. The approval relationship is actively managed by procurement and quality teams through vendor qualification, audits, quality agreements, and regulatory filings (DMF references). Each vendor-material combination has its own approval status, quality agreement, pricing terms, lead times, and audit history that cannot be stored on either the vendor or material master alone.

attributes.name: approved_vendor_material_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this vendor-material approval record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Vendor Material - Masterdata Material Master Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the material master record. Identifies which material this vendor is approved to supply.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor master record. Identifies which vendor is approved for this material.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor was approved to supply this specific material following successful qualification, audit, and quality agreement execution.

attributes.name: approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the approval for this vendor-material combination expires and requires requalification or renewal. Typically aligned with quality agreement term or audit cycle.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory and quality approval status for this vendor to supply this specific material. Approved: fully qualified. Conditional: approved with restrictions. Suspended: temporarily not allowed. Revoked: approval withdrawn. Under Review: qualification in progress.

attributes.name: conditional_approval_conditions
attributes.description: Text description of specific conditions, restrictions, or requirements that apply when approval_status is Conditional. Examples: additional testing required, batch-by-batch release, restricted to specific manufacturing site.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor-material approval record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dmf_reference_number
attributes.description: FDA Drug Master File (DMF) reference number or equivalent regulatory filing reference (e.g., CEP, ASMF) specific to this vendor's manufacturing process for this material. Critical for APIs and excipients.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent vendor audit specifically covering this material's manufacturing, testing, and release processes. Material-specific audits may occur separately from general vendor audits.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor-material approval record was last modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from purchase order placement to goods receipt for this material from this vendor. Vendor-material specific based on manufacturing cycle and logistics.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by this vendor for this material, expressed in the material's base unit of measure. Vendor-material specific based on manufacturing batch sizes.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next audit of this vendor's capability to supply this specific material. Audit frequency is risk-based per the risk_classification.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the preferred or primary source for this specific material based on quality performance, pricing, lead time, and strategic relationship. Used for sourcing prioritization.

attributes.name: pricing_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit_price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF).

attributes.name: quality_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the material-specific quality agreement or addendum governing the supply of this material by this vendor. May reference a master quality agreement with material-specific annexes.

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Risk-based classification of this specific vendor-material supply relationship based on material criticality, vendor performance, regulatory complexity, and supply chain risk. Determines audit frequency and oversight level.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Current negotiated unit price for this material from this vendor, expressed in the pricing currency. Price is vendor-material specific and may vary based on volume tiers.

products.name: vendor_gxp_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification and compliance relationship between a vendor and a specific GxP regulatory obligation. It captures the vendor's qualification status, audit history, and compliance evidence for each applicable GxP requirement (GMP, GDP, GCP, GLP, GPvP). Each record links one vendor to one GxP obligation with attributes that exist only in the context of this vendor-obligation qualification pair. Essential for supplier oversight, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance tracking.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical operations, vendors must be qualified against multiple specific GxP obligations depending on the materials or services they supply (e.g., an API supplier must meet GMP requirements, a distributor must meet GDP requirements, a CRO must meet GCP requirements). Conversely, each GxP obligation applies to multiple vendors across the supply chain. The business actively manages this as a 'Vendor GxP Qualification Matrix' with obligation-specific qualification statuses, audit schedules, and compliance evidence that cannot reside on either the vendor master record or the obligation master record alone.

attributes.name: vendor_gxp_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this vendor-GxP obligation qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gxp_obligation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Gxp Qualification - Gxp Obligation Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the GxP regulatory obligation record in the compliance domain

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor master record in the procurement domain

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required audit frequency in months for this vendor-obligation pair. Frequency is risk-based and varies by obligation criticality and vendor risk profile. Typical values: 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), 36 (triennial).

attributes.name: audit_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent audit for this vendor-obligation pair. Approved: no critical findings. Approved with Observations: minor findings documented. Conditional Approval: major findings require corrective action. Not Approved: critical findings prevent qualification. Pending: audit completed but outcome under review.

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the CAPA record(s) associated with this vendor-obligation qualification. Null if no CAPA required.

attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) is required for this vendor-obligation qualification based on audit findings or compliance gaps.

attributes.name: compliance_evidence_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document path to the compliance evidence package supporting this vendor's qualification for this obligation. May include audit reports, certificates, test results, quality agreements, and correspondence with regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor-GxP obligation qualification record was created in the system.

attributes.name: gmp_certification_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or certification body that issued the GMP certification (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, WHO PQ). [Moved from vendor: Similar to above - this is vendor-level general GMP certification metadata. The association tracks obligation-specific qualification, not general certifications. This should remain on vendor. Removing this entry.]

attributes.name: gmp_certification_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date when the current GMP certification expires. Vendors must renew certification before this date to maintain qualified supplier status. [Moved from vendor: This is the vendor's general GMP certificate expiry. The association has qualification_expiry_date which is obligation-specific and may differ. Both are needed. Removing this entry.]

attributes.name: gmp_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds current GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) certification from a recognized regulatory authority. Critical for API, excipient, and CMO/CDMO suppliers. [Moved from vendor: This is a general GMP certification flag at the vendor level, but GMP is just one of many GxP obligations. The qualification_status in the association captures whether the vendor is qualified for each specific GxP obligation (GMP, GDP, GCP, GLP, GPvP). However, upon reflection, this attribute should REMAIN on vendor as it represents the vendor's general GMP certification status, while the association tracks obligation-specific qualification. Removing this entry.]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211, EMA GMP Guidelines, ICH Q7

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent audit conducted specifically for this vendor-obligation combination. Distinct from the vendor's general last_audit_date as audits may be obligation-specific.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor-GxP obligation qualification record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next audit of this vendor for this specific GxP obligation. Calculated based on last_audit_date plus audit_frequency_months.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was qualified for this specific GxP obligation. Represents successful completion of qualification assessment including documentation review, audit, and approval.

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's qualification for this specific GxP obligation expires and requires renewal. Expiry dates are obligation-specific and may differ from the vendor's general GMP certification expiry.

attributes.name: qualification_owner
attributes.description: The role, department, or individual responsible for managing this specific vendor-obligation qualification. May differ from the general obligation owner based on vendor category or material type.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the vendor for this specific GxP obligation. Qualified: vendor meets all requirements. Conditionally Qualified: vendor meets requirements with minor observations. Not Qualified: vendor does not meet requirements. Under Review: qualification assessment in progress. Suspended: qualification temporarily revoked. Expired: qualification period has lapsed.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this qualification record.

products.name: service_entry_sheet
products.description: Master reference table for service_entry_sheet. Referenced by service_entry_sheet_id.

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_id
attributes.description: Primary key for service_entry_sheet

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master service contract or supplier quality agreement under which this service was procured.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which the service costs are allocated for financial accounting and management reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created the service entry sheet record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who performed the service acceptance, typically a quality assurance or receiving department representative.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified the service entry sheet record.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant, research facility, or site where the service was performed or for which the service was procured.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which services were rendered and recorded.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or service provider who performed the services documented in this entry sheet.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the service was formally accepted by the receiving department or quality assurance, applicable when acceptance is required.

attributes.name: acceptance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal acceptance or quality approval is required before the service entry can be posted and invoiced.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service entry sheet record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this service entry sheet.

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service entry sheet record has been marked for deletion or logical archival, typically used for error correction or cancellation scenarios.

attributes.name: entry_sheet_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service entry sheet in the approval and posting workflow.

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number provided by the vendor or service provider, such as their delivery note, timesheet reference, or service report number.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the service entry value is posted for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total value of services before taxes and adjustments, calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price.

attributes.name: invoice_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the invoice verification process for this service entry, indicating whether the vendor invoice has been matched and approved for payment.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service entry sheet record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total payable amount including taxes and all adjustments.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: Date when the service entry sheet was posted to financial accounting, triggering accounts payable liability recognition.

attributes.name: purchase_order_item_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the purchase order for which this service entry is recorded.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal quality inspection or audit of the service deliverables is required per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) or supplier quality agreement requirements.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the quality inspection or audit performed on the service deliverables, critical for GMP compliance and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of service units rendered, measured according to the unit of measure specified in the purchase order (e.g., hours, days, tests, batches).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the service entry, including any deviations or exceptions.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the services performed, including scope, deliverables, and any deviations from the original purchase order specification.

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the service performance period ended.

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the service entry sheet, externally visible and used for tracking and reference in procurement and accounts payable processes.

attributes.name: service_performer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization unit that performed the service, may differ from the contracting vendor in subcontracting scenarios.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the service performance period began.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of service rendered, aligned with pharmaceutical procurement categories including Contract Research Organization (CRO), Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO), and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the service entry, including VAT, GST, or other jurisdiction-specific taxes.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the service quantity is measured, aligned with pharmaceutical service measurement standards.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of service as agreed in the purchase order or contract.

attributes.name: reversed_service_entry_sheet_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on service_entry_sheet (reversed_service_entry_sheet_id)

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Manages human resources data including employee master data, organizational structure, talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, benefits, payroll, and training. Tracks GCP, GMP, and GLP training records for regulated personnel, certifications, competencies, and role-based access for quality-critical functions. Supports workforce planning and audit readiness for FDA/EMA inspections.
domains.references: 21 CFR Part 211.68 / ICH Q10 / GDPR (employee data) / Labor Regulations

products.name: employee
products.description: Master record for all personnel at Pharmaceuticals including full-time, part-time, contract, and CRO-seconded staff. Captures personal details, employment status, job classification, department assignment, site location, hire date, termination date, employment type, regulatory role flags (GCP/GMP/GLP-qualified), manager reference, HR system identifiers, and complete lifecycle movement history (promotions, transfers, site relocations, secondments, role changes, organizational restructuring events with effective dates, reason codes, and approver audit trail). Serves as the SSOT for workforce identity and career history across all domains and the anchor entity for training compliance, access control, and regulatory inspection queries.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee record. Primary key for the employee master data product. Serves as the single source of truth for workforce identity across all domains including clinical trials, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory functions.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created this employee record. Required for complete audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11 and GDPR accountability principle.

attributes.name: employing_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Employment contracts are with specific legal entities - required for tax reporting, statutory compliance, labor law jurisdiction, and corporate structure reporting. Creates new FK as no existing colum

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Record Last Modified By User Identifier
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that last modified this employee record. Part of the complete audit trail for regulatory compliance and data governance.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the direct manager or supervisor. Establishes reporting hierarchy for approval workflows, performance management, and training assignment escalation.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary physical site or facility where the employee is based. Critical for site-specific GMP training, emergency response planning, and regulatory inspection readiness. Links to manufacturing plants, R&D labs, clinical sites, or corporate offices.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 - Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent background check completion. Used to determine when periodic re-screening is due per company policy and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of pre-employment or periodic background screening. Cleared status is required for roles with access to controlled substances, financial systems (SOX), or patient data (HIPAA). Failed status prevents hiring or triggers termination.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, HIPAA Security Rule, US DEA regulations

attributes.name: citizenship_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the employee's citizenship. Used for work authorization verification, export control compliance (ITAR, EAR), and visa/immigration tracking for international assignments.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code for charging employee compensation and expenses. Used for P&L reporting, project costing, and SOX financial controls. Sourced from SAP FI Controlling module.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and SOX internal controls.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Employee's date of birth. Used for age verification, benefits eligibility, retirement planning, and identity verification in electronic signature workflows. Highly sensitive personal data requiring restricted access.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary corporate email address for business communications, system access notifications, training assignments, and electronic signature workflows. Serves as unique identifier in many enterprise systems.

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier assigned to the employee by HR systems. Used for payroll, timekeeping, and external reporting. Typically sourced from SAP HR Personnel Number field.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the employee within the organization. Active employees have full system access and training obligations. Inactive or terminated employees trigger access revocation workflows per SOX and GxP requirements.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment arrangement. CRO-seconded staff are Contract Research Organization personnel working on-site who require GCP training and system access but remain employed by the CRO. Critical for determining training requirements, access levels, and regulatory accountability.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name (given name) of the employee as recorded in official identity documents. Required for regulatory submissions, audit trails, and GCP/GMP/GLP training records.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the employee officially started employment with the organization. Used to calculate tenure, benefits eligibility, and training recertification cycles. Critical for audit trail and employment verification.

attributes.name: is_gcp_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is currently qualified to perform GCP-regulated clinical trial activities per ICH E6(R2) guidelines. True if all required GCP training is current and documented. Used to control access to clinical trial systems (CTMS, EDC, eTMF) and determine eligibility for clinical roles.
attributes.references: ICH GCP E6(R2), FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_glp_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is currently qualified to perform GLP-regulated nonclinical laboratory studies per FDA 21 CFR Part 58 and OECD GLP principles. True if all required GLP training is current. Used to determine eligibility for preclinical study roles and LIMS access.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 58, OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: is_gmp_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is currently qualified to perform GMP-regulated manufacturing and quality activities per 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and EU GMP Annex 11. True if all required cGMP training is current. Controls access to manufacturing execution systems (MES), batch records, and quality systems.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, EU GMP Annex 11, ICH Q10

attributes.name: is_people_manager
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has direct reports and managerial responsibilities. True if the employee manages one or more subordinates. Used to determine eligibility for management training programs and approval authority levels.

attributes.name: is_quality_critical_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a quality-critical function requiring enhanced training documentation, competency assessment, and audit readiness per ICH Q10 and ISO 9001. Includes QA/QC personnel, Qualified Persons, and individuals with batch release authority.
attributes.references: ICH Q10, ISO 9001, EU GMP Chapter 2

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job classification code from HR system. Maps to compensation bands, competency frameworks, and training matrices. Typically sourced from SAP Organizational Management job catalog.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping similar roles (e.g., Research & Development, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Operations, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs). Used for workforce planning and skills gap analysis.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title assigned to the employee. Used for organizational charts, role-based access control (RBAC), and determining applicable GxP training curricula.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this employee record. Used to track data currency and support change control processes required for GxP systems.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (family name or surname) of the employee. Critical for identity verification, regulatory audit trails, and electronic signature validation per 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the employee's most recent formal performance review. Used to schedule upcoming reviews and ensure compliance with performance management cycles.

attributes.name: last_promotion_date
attributes.description: Date of the employee's most recent promotion or job grade increase. Used for career progression analytics, retention risk modeling, and compensation planning.

attributes.name: last_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date of the employee's most recent lateral transfer to a different department, site, or role. Used to track internal mobility and trigger site-specific training reassessments.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the employee. Optional field used for complete legal name representation in regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: mobile_phone_number
attributes.description: Personal or corporate mobile phone number. Used for emergency notifications, on-call schedules, and multi-factor authentication for system access.

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in US, National Insurance Number in UK). Used for tax reporting, benefits administration, and background checks. Highly restricted access per data privacy regulations.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent annual performance appraisal rating. Used for compensation decisions, promotion eligibility, and identifying training needs. Confidential data with restricted access per HR policy.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the employee prefers to be called in day-to-day business interactions. Used for internal communications, badges, and non-regulatory systems.

attributes.name: regulatory_role_flag
attributes.description: Identifies employees holding specific regulatory-defined roles with legal accountability. Qualified Person (EU) and Authorized Person (US) have batch release authority. Study Director oversees GLP studies. Principal Investigator leads clinical trials. Used for regulatory submissions and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: EU Directive 2001/83/EC, FDA 21 CFR Part 58, ICH GCP E6(R2)

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: Highest level of security clearance granted to the employee for access to classified or highly sensitive information. Relevant for employees working on government contracts, controlled substances (DEA schedules), or proprietary research with national security implications.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's employment ended. Triggers immediate system access revocation per 21 CFR Part 11 and SOX requirements. Null for active employees. Used for retention period calculations and audit history.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for employment termination. Used for workforce analytics, turnover reporting, and compliance with labor regulations. Null for active employees.

attributes.name: work_authorization_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's work authorization (visa, permit) expires. Null for citizens and permanent residents. Used to trigger renewal workflows and prevent unauthorized work.

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employee's legal authorization to work in the work country. Critical for compliance with immigration laws and export control regulations. Expired status triggers HR review and potential access suspension.
attributes.references: US Immigration and Nationality Act, EU Blue Card Directive

attributes.name: work_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the employee primarily works. Determines applicable labor laws, tax jurisdictions, and regulatory training requirements (FDA vs EMA vs PMDA). Used for global workforce reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: work_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the employee. Used for internal directory, emergency contact during business hours, and audit communication.

products.name: department
products.description: Organizational unit hierarchy master representing departments, divisions, cost centers, and functional groups within Pharmaceuticals. Captures unit name, unit type (department, division, function, site), parent unit, cost center code, site location, therapeutic area alignment, and effective dates. Supports organizational reporting and workforce planning. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA organizational management.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the department. Primary key.

attributes.name: head_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is the head or manager of the department. Supports organizational hierarchy and reporting structure.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Departments map to organizational units for enterprise structure alignment, cross-functional reporting, and consolidation hierarchies. Creates new FK to link workforce departments to masterdata organi

attributes.name: parent_department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent department in the organizational hierarchy. Enables multi-level organizational structure representation.

attributes.name: budget_amount_annual
attributes.description: Total annual operating budget allocated to the department in the company's reporting currency. Includes personnel, operational, and capital expenses.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the department's budget amount.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity to which the department belongs. Supports multi-entity financial consolidation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code associated with the department for budgeting, expense tracking, and financial reporting. Aligns with SAP Controlling (CO) module.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the department is primarily located. Supports geographic reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the department record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: csv_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department uses computerized systems that require validation under 21 CFR Part 11 and CSV guidelines. Drives system qualification and audit requirements.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the department within the organizational structure. Used for reporting and system integration.

attributes.name: department_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the department's purpose, responsibilities, and scope of work. Provides business context for organizational understanding.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the department, division, or functional unit.

attributes.name: department_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the department. Tracks lifecycle from planning through active operation to closure.

attributes.name: department_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit type. Distinguishes between departments, divisions, functional groups, sites, cost centers, and business units.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the department ceased or will cease operations. Null for currently active departments. Supports organizational history tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the department became or will become operational. Supports time-based organizational reporting and historical analysis.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Primary business function or domain that the department supports. Aligns with core pharmaceutical business processes.

attributes.name: gmp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department performs GMP-critical manufacturing or quality control functions subject to regulatory inspection and validation requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210, 211; ICH Q7; PIC/S GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: gxp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department performs GxP-regulated activities requiring compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), or Good Laboratory Practice (GLP). Drives training, audit, and qualification requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210, 211, 312; ICH Guidelines; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: headcount_actual
attributes.description: Current actual number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees assigned to the department. Updated as employees join or leave.

attributes.name: headcount_planned
attributes.description: Planned or budgeted number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees for the department. Used for workforce planning and budget allocation.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center code for departments that are treated as independent profit-generating units. Used for Profit and Loss (P&L) reporting.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for the department. Supports regional organizational structures and reporting (e.g., NORAM, EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name of the department for display in reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: site_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical site or facility where the department is located. Supports multi-site organizational structures.

attributes.name: sox_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department is in scope for Sarbanes-Oxley Act compliance and internal controls over financial reporting. Drives audit and control testing requirements.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area alignment for departments involved in research, clinical development, or commercial operations. Supports portfolio and pipeline management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the department record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized position master and job profile catalog defining all approved roles, headcount slots, and standardized role requirements within the organizational structure. Captures position title, job family, job level, grade band, FTE allocation, reporting line, site, department, GMP/GCP/GLP qualification requirement flags, regulated role indicator, position status (filled, vacant, frozen), required competencies, mandatory training curricula, applicable SOPs, and job profile reference data including competency expectations, required qualifications, and regulatory role classifications. Serves as the single template for recruitment requisitions, training compliance determination, performance evaluation criteria, and organizational design. Distinct from employee — a position can be vacant or shared.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the authorized position. Primary key. This represents a headcount slot in the organizational structure, distinct from the employee who may fill it.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically senior management or HR leadership) who approved the creation or modification of this position. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: Positions are budgeted to specific cost centers for financial planning, headcount cost allocation, and budget variance analysis. Creates new FK to replace denormalized cost_center_code with proper ref

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department or organizational unit to which this position is assigned. Links to organizational hierarchy for reporting structure and cost center allocation.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: Position should reference its job profile definition. Position currently has job_profile_reference as a STRING, but this should be a proper FK for referential integrity. This is a core normalization o

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Positions exist within organizational units for organizational design, reporting structure definition, and workforce planning. Creates new FK to establish org unit context for position management.

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisory position to which this position reports. Defines the reporting line in the organizational hierarchy. Nullable for top-level executive positions.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical site, facility, or location where the position is based. Critical for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) site-specific training and access control requirements.

attributes.name: applicable_sop_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document numbers or identifiers applicable to the position. Defines the controlled procedures the position holder must be trained on and follow. Critical for quality-critical and regulated roles subject to audit.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was formally approved by management and budget authority. Used for audit trail and organizational governance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the position record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the position is scheduled to be closed or eliminated. Nullable for ongoing positions. Used for temporary positions, project-based roles, or organizational restructuring planning.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the position becomes active and available for assignment or recruitment. Used for organizational planning and budget cycle alignment.

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation for the position. 1.00 represents full-time; 0.50 represents half-time. Used for headcount planning and budget calculations. Supports fractional positions and job-sharing arrangements.

attributes.name: grade_band
attributes.description: Compensation grade or pay band assigned to the position, determining salary range and benefits eligibility. Business-confidential classification used for compensation planning and budgeting.

attributes.name: is_gcp_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position performs Good Clinical Practice (GCP)-regulated activities requiring International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) GCP training and compliance per ICH E6(R2). True for clinical research, clinical operations, and medical affairs roles.

attributes.name: is_glp_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position performs Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)-regulated activities requiring GLP training and compliance per 21 CFR Part 58. True for preclinical research and toxicology roles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 58 - Good Laboratory Practice for Nonclinical Laboratory Studies

attributes.name: is_gmp_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position performs GMP-regulated activities requiring Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) training, qualification, and audit trail documentation per 21 CFR Part 211. True for manufacturing, quality control, and quality assurance roles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice for Finished Pharmaceuticals

attributes.name: is_quality_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is designated as quality-critical, requiring enhanced qualification, training documentation, and role-based access controls per Quality Management System (QMS) requirements. Subject to stricter audit scrutiny by Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and European Medicines Agency (EMA).

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping similar roles (e.g., Research and Development, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing Operations, Clinical Development). Used for workforce planning and career pathing.

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level or seniority tier within the organization (e.g., Entry, Mid, Senior, Principal, Director, Vice President, Executive). Determines scope of responsibility and decision-making authority.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or username of the person who last modified the position record. Used for audit trail and accountability per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the position record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail. Critical for maintaining compliance documentation history for FDA/EMA inspections.

attributes.name: mandatory_training_curricula
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory training course codes or curricula identifiers required for the position. Includes GMP, GCP, GLP, safety, compliance, and role-specific technical training. Used to auto-assign training upon position assignment and track compliance for FDA/EMA inspections.

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the position, used in requisitions, organizational charts, and Human Resources Information System (HRIS) integrations. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by HR.
attributes.references: SAP HCM OM - Organizational Management Position Object

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the position's purpose, key responsibilities, and scope of work. Used for recruitment job postings, performance management, and organizational documentation.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the position. Active indicates the position is approved and available; vacant means unfilled; filled means occupied by an employee; frozen means temporarily unavailable for hiring; closed means permanently eliminated; pending_approval means awaiting budget or organizational approval.

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the position by employment arrangement. Permanent indicates regular full-time or part-time employment; temporary indicates fixed-term employment; contract indicates external contractor; intern indicates trainee or student; consultant indicates professional services engagement.

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of professional certifications, licenses, or credentials required for the position (e.g., Certified Quality Auditor, Project Management Professional, Registered Pharmacist, Clinical Research Associate certification). Used for compliance verification and recruitment screening.

attributes.name: required_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of competency codes or descriptors defining the skills, knowledge, and behaviors required for successful performance in the position. Used for talent assessment, development planning, and succession planning.

attributes.name: required_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational qualification required for the position. Used for recruitment screening and competency verification. Critical for roles requiring scientific or technical expertise in pharmaceutical development and manufacturing.

attributes.name: required_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for the position. Used for recruitment qualification and career progression planning.

attributes.name: requires_csv_training
attributes.business_glossary_term: Computer System Validation (CSV) Training Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires Computer System Validation (CSV) training per 21 CFR Part 11 for roles that create, modify, or approve electronic records in validated systems. True for IT, quality, and regulated system users.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

attributes.name: requires_data_integrity_training
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires data integrity training covering ALCOA+ principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available) per FDA and EMA data integrity guidance. Critical for laboratory, manufacturing, and quality roles.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance - Data Integrity and Compliance with Drug CGMP

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: Required security clearance or access level for the position. Defines physical access rights, system access privileges, and data classification access. Critical for roles handling Intellectual Property (IP), controlled substances per Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) regulations, or confidential clinical data.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official job title for the position as it appears in organizational charts, job postings, and employee records. Human-readable label for the role.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Expected percentage of work time requiring business travel. Used for recruitment transparency and workforce planning. Common for clinical research, sales, and regulatory affairs roles.

attributes.name: work_schedule
attributes.description: Standard work schedule pattern for the position. Standard indicates regular business hours; shift indicates rotating or fixed shift work (common in manufacturing); flexible indicates flexible hours; remote indicates fully remote work; hybrid indicates combination of on-site and remote.

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Reference catalog of standardized job profiles defining role requirements, competency expectations, required qualifications, GCP/GMP/GLP training mandates, and regulatory role classifications. Each job profile maps to a job family, job level, and applicable SOPs. Used as the template for position creation and performance evaluation. Distinct from position (which is a headcount slot) and employee (who fills it).

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job profile. Primary key. This is the standardized template defining role requirements, competencies, and regulatory training mandates. Distinct from position (headcount slot) and employee (person filling it).

attributes.name: competency_framework_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competency framework defining the skills, behaviors, and knowledge areas required for this role. Used in performance evaluation, training needs analysis, and talent development.

attributes.name: job_family_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job family grouping that this profile belongs to (e.g., Research & Development, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Operations, Clinical Development). Used for workforce planning and career pathing.

attributes.name: primary_job_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (typically HR Director or Quality Head) who approved this job profile. Required for audit trail and accountability per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH Q10.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile was formally approved by HR leadership and quality assurance (for GxP roles). Required for audit trail and change control compliance per ICH Q10.

attributes.name: compensation_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade or band assigned to this role, defining the salary range and bonus eligibility. Used in budgeting, offer generation, and pay equity analysis. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail required for regulatory compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile version was superseded or retired. Null for currently active profiles. Used for historical analysis and regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile version became effective and available for use in position creation and workforce planning. Supports temporal tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the U.S. Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the role is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements. Drives payroll processing and labor cost planning.

attributes.name: gcp_training_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Training Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role requires mandatory Good Clinical Practice training per ICH E6 guidelines. True for clinical trial personnel (CRAs, clinical monitors, data managers). Drives training assignment and audit readiness.

attributes.name: glp_training_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) Training Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role requires mandatory Good Laboratory Practice training per FDA GLP regulations. True for preclinical research and toxicology study personnel. Drives GLP curriculum assignment and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gmp_training_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Training Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role requires mandatory Good Manufacturing Practice training per 21 CFR Part 211. True for manufacturing, quality control, and quality assurance personnel. Drives cGMP curriculum assignment and FDA inspection readiness.

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the role within the organization, used for compensation banding, career progression, and span-of-control analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entry|intermediate|senior|lead|principal|director|executive — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was last updated. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH Q10.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and regulatory compliance. Used to trigger periodic review cycles (typically annual for GxP roles) and ensure alignment with evolving business needs.

attributes.name: minimum_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum formal education credential required for this role (e.g., Bachelor of Science in Chemistry for QC Analyst, Doctorate in Pharmacy for Medical Affairs). Used in candidate screening and qualification verification.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for this role. Used in candidate screening, internal mobility decisions, and compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this job profile. Drives proactive review workflows and ensures continuous alignment with regulatory requirements and business strategy.

attributes.name: physical_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical demands and working conditions for this role (e.g., standing for extended periods, lifting up to 50 lbs, cleanroom environment, laboratory safety protocols). Used for ADA compliance and workplace safety planning.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), OSHA regulations

attributes.name: preferred_education_field
attributes.description: Preferred academic discipline or field of study for this role (e.g., Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Life Sciences, Engineering). Used in talent acquisition and succession planning.

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this job profile across HR systems, used in position requisitions, performance evaluations, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: profile_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive narrative describing the purpose, scope, and key responsibilities of the role. Includes regulatory context for GxP-critical roles and quality-critical functions.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile. Active profiles are used for position creation and hiring. Inactive or obsolete profiles are retained for historical reference and audit trail. Draft profiles are under development.

attributes.name: profile_title
attributes.description: Official title of the job profile as it appears in organizational charts, position postings, and regulatory documentation (e.g., Senior Quality Control Analyst, Clinical Research Associate II, Manufacturing Technician III).

attributes.name: quality_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role performs quality-critical activities that directly impact product quality, patient safety, or data integrity. True for roles requiring heightened qualification, training documentation, and audit scrutiny per ICH Q10.

attributes.name: regulatory_role_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the role performs GxP-critical activities (GCP, GMP, GLP), quality-critical functions requiring heightened training and qualification, or non-regulated administrative functions. Drives training curriculum and audit scope.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 (cGMP), ICH E6 (GCP), FDA GLP regulations

attributes.name: remote_work_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role is eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements. False for roles requiring on-site presence (manufacturing, laboratory, clinical site personnel). Used in workforce flexibility planning and talent attraction.

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory professional certifications or licenses required for this role (e.g., Certified Quality Auditor, Registered Pharmacist, Project Management Professional). Drives qualification tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: role_based_access_level
attributes.description: Default system access level assigned to this role for regulated systems (LIMS, MES, QMS, CTMS). Drives 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records and signatures, and supports least-privilege access control.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures

attributes.name: safety_training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role requires mandatory occupational health and safety training (e.g., hazardous materials handling, biosafety, radiation safety, ergonomics). True for laboratory, manufacturing, and clinical roles. Drives OSHA compliance.

attributes.name: sop_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SOP identifiers that personnel in this role must be trained on and qualified to execute. Critical for GxP roles and quality-critical functions. Drives training curriculum and audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: succession_planning_tier
attributes.description: Priority tier for succession planning and talent pipeline development. Critical for roles with high business impact, specialized expertise, or regulatory accountability (e.g., Qualified Person, Head of Quality). Used in talent review and development planning.

attributes.name: supervisory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this role has direct supervisory or managerial responsibilities over other employees. Used in organizational structure modeling, span-of-control analysis, and leadership development planning.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Expected percentage of work time requiring business travel (0-100). Used in candidate screening, expense budgeting, and work-life balance planning. High for field-based roles (CRAs, sales reps, auditors).

attributes.name: typical_span_of_control
attributes.description: Typical number of direct reports for supervisory roles. Used in organizational design, workforce planning, and management capacity analysis. Null for non-supervisory roles.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this job profile. Incremented with each approved revision. Supports change control, audit trail, and regulatory compliance per ICH Q10 and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: employment_contract
products.description: Transactional record of employment agreements between Pharmaceuticals and individual employees. Captures contract type (permanent, fixed-term, CRO secondment), start date, end date, notice period, probation period, working hours, salary grade, contract status, governing jurisdiction, and amendment history reference. Supports HR compliance, audit readiness, and regulatory inspection documentation.

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employment contract record. Primary key for the employment contract entity.

attributes.name: contracting_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Contracts are executed by specific legal entities - essential for legal validity, governing jurisdiction determination, and contract enforceability. Creates new FK to establish which legal entity is t

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is party to this employment contract. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Employment contracts are typically written for a specific authorized position slot. The contract currently has job_title and job_family as strings, but these should reference the position master for c

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of amendments or modifications made to the original employment contract. Incremented each time a contract amendment is executed. Used for audit readiness and contract version control.

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: Annual base salary amount in the contract currency. Excludes bonuses, allowances, and benefits. Used for payroll processing, compensation analysis, and financial planning.

attributes.name: confidentiality_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employment contract includes a confidentiality or non-disclosure agreement (NDA) clause. True if confidentiality obligations are contractually binding; False otherwise. Critical for intellectual property (IP) protection and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the signed employment contract document stored in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault, SharePoint). Used for audit readiness, regulatory inspections, and legal documentation retrieval.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the employment contract. Used for audit trails, regulatory inspections, and HR documentation.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the employment contract. Draft indicates pending approval; active is in force; suspended is temporarily paused; terminated is ended by either party; expired indicates natural end of fixed-term; amended indicates contract has been modified.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment contract. Permanent indicates indefinite employment; fixed-term has a defined end date; temporary is short-term; CRO (Contract Research Organization) secondment indicates assignment from external research partner; consultant and intern are specialized arrangements.
attributes.references: ILO - International Labour Organization Employment Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the employment contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employment contract terminates. Nullable for permanent contracts. Mandatory for fixed-term, temporary, and CRO secondment contracts. Used for workforce planning and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: fte
attributes.description: Full-time equivalency ratio representing the proportion of a full-time workload. 1.000 indicates full-time; 0.500 indicates half-time. Used for headcount reporting, budget planning, and resource allocation.

attributes.name: governing_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the legal jurisdiction under which the employment contract is governed. Determines applicable labor laws, tax regulations, and dispute resolution mechanisms. Examples: USA, GBR, DEU, JPN, CHE.

attributes.name: gxp_role_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a quality-critical role requiring Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), or Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) training and certification. True for roles subject to FDA/EMA inspection and audit requirements.
attributes.references: ICH - International Council for Harmonisation, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: gxp_training_required
attributes.description: Specifies which Good Practice training certifications are mandatory for this role. GCP (Good Clinical Practice) for clinical trial personnel; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) for manufacturing and quality personnel; GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) for laboratory and preclinical personnel.
