attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the qualification assignment. Links to the employee master record for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: qualification_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who holds this qualification. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.training_course. Business justification: Qualifications are often earned through completion of training courses. The qualification record should link to the course that granted it (when applicable). This enables traceability from qualificati

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Level of access or permission granted within the system. Read-only allows viewing; read-write allows data entry; approve allows electronic signature and approval; admin allows configuration; super-user allows full control.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification assignment or system access was formally approved by the authorized approver.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager, quality assurance representative, or authorized personnel who approved the qualification assignment or system access grant.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: assessment_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the qualification assessment or examination. Pass indicates successful completion; fail indicates unsuccessful attempt; conditional_pass indicates pass with remediation required; not_assessed indicates no formal assessment was conducted.

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numerical score or grade achieved by the employee on the qualification assessment or examination. Null if no formal assessment was required.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification was formally assigned or recorded in the system for the employee. May differ from issue_date if there is a delay in administrative recording.

attributes.name: audit_trail_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification record is subject to electronic audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11. True if audit trail is required; false otherwise.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the qualification or system access is required for the employee's role. Supports audit trails and access review processes for SOX and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number issued by the certifying body. Enables verification of authenticity with the issuing organization.

attributes.name: competency_area
attributes.description: Functional or technical area of competency covered by this qualification (e.g., 'Aseptic Processing', 'Clinical Monitoring', 'Analytical Chemistry', 'Quality Auditing', 'Controlled Substance Handling'). Supports skills matrix and workforce planning.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, ICH Q10 - Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this qualification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the qualification becomes valid and the employee is authorized to perform the associated activities or access systems.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification expires and must be renewed or re-qualified. Null if the qualification does not expire (e.g., permanent certifications).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH Q10 - Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification, certification, or authorization was originally issued or granted to the employee.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization, regulatory authority, or internal department that issued or granted the qualification. Examples: 'FDA', 'EMA', 'Internal Quality Assurance', 'Society of Clinical Research Associates', 'DEA'.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 17024 - Conformity Assessment

attributes.name: last_access_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic access review for system access qualifications. Supports SOX compliance and segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, ISO/IEC 27001 - Access Control

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this qualification record was last modified or updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or assessment of the qualification. Supports proactive compliance management and audit readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice, SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or contextual information related to the qualification. Supports documentation of exceptions, remediation plans, or audit observations.

attributes.name: qualification_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code or identifier for the qualification used in internal systems and training records. Enables quick lookup and reporting.

attributes.name: qualification_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the qualification, certification, or authorization. Examples: 'GMP Aseptic Processing Qualification', 'ICH-GCP Clinical Monitor Certification', 'HPLC Method Qualification for Product X'.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the qualification. Active indicates the employee is currently qualified; expired indicates renewal is required; suspended indicates temporary hold; pending_renewal indicates renewal process is underway; revoked indicates permanent withdrawal; under_review indicates periodic assessment in progress.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO/IEC 27001 - Access Control

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Category of qualification held by the employee. Distinguishes between regulatory competencies (GMP, GCP, GLP), technical qualifications (analytical method), audit certifications, and controlled substance authorizations (DEA handler).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH E6 - Good Clinical Practice

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is mandated by regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA, DEA) or industry standards (GMP, GCP, GLP). True if regulatory-required; false if voluntary or internal.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH E6 - Good Clinical Practice

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification was last renewed or re-certified. Tracks the most recent renewal event for qualifications requiring periodic revalidation.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification or system access was revoked or withdrawn. Null if the qualification has never been revoked.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO/IEC 27001 - Access Control

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the qualification or system access was revoked (e.g., 'Employee termination', 'Role change', 'Compliance violation', 'Failed re-certification'). Supports audit trails and access control reviews.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the supporting documentation for this qualification (e.g., certificate scan, training transcript, approval memo). Enables retrieval of evidence for audits and inspections.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: system_name
attributes.description: Name of the IT system or application for which access authorization is granted (e.g., 'SAP QM', 'LIMS LabWare', 'Veeva Vault QualityDocs', 'Medidata Rave', 'MES'). Applicable only for system access qualifications; null for professional certifications.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, GAMP 5 - Good Automated Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: system_role_name
attributes.description: Name of the role or permission set assigned to the employee within the system (e.g., 'QC Analyst', 'Manufacturing Operator', 'Clinical Data Manager', 'Quality Reviewer'). Defines the scope of system access.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO/IEC 27001 - Access Control

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee completed the required training associated with this qualification. Supports GMP, GCP, and GLP training record requirements for FDA/EMA inspections.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH E6 - Good Clinical Practice

attributes.name: training_hours
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed by the employee to achieve this qualification. Tracks continuing education and professional development requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, ICH Q10 - Pharmaceutical Quality System

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Transactional record of formal employee performance evaluations conducted on annual or mid-year cycles. Captures review period, overall rating, competency ratings, individual and team goal definitions with weights and achievement scores, development feedback, reviewer identity, calibration status, and final approval date. Includes cascaded goal-setting from corporate strategy to individual contributors. Supports talent management, promotion decisions, compensation planning, and succession readiness assessment.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance review record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the performance review (typically HR Business Partner or senior manager).

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Performance reviews should be tied to the position the employee held during the review period. This enables: (1) evaluating performance against position-specific competency requirements and expectatio

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee being reviewed. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee conducting the review (typically the direct manager or supervisor).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review was formally approved by the appropriate authority (e.g., HR, senior management).

attributes.name: calibration_session_date
attributes.description: Date when the review was discussed and calibrated in a management calibration session to ensure consistency across the organization.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Status of the calibration process for this review (not required, pending, completed, rating adjusted, or rating confirmed).

attributes.name: compensation_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this review will impact compensation decisions such as merit increases or bonuses (True/False).

attributes.name: competency_collaboration_rating
attributes.description: Rating for teamwork, cross-functional collaboration, and communication competencies.

attributes.name: competency_compliance_rating
attributes.description: Rating for adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), and other regulatory compliance standards.
attributes.references: ICH GCP, FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: competency_leadership_rating
attributes.description: Rating for leadership and people management competencies.

attributes.name: competency_technical_rating
attributes.description: Rating for technical competencies specific to the employee's role (e.g., GMP knowledge, laboratory techniques, regulatory expertise).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: development_areas_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of areas where the employee needs improvement or further development.

attributes.name: development_plan
attributes.description: Detailed development plan outlining specific actions, training, or experiences to support the employee's growth and address development areas.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee acknowledged the performance review.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has acknowledged receipt and review of their performance evaluation (True/False).

attributes.name: employee_self_assessment
attributes.description: Employee's self-assessment narrative reflecting on their own performance, achievements, and development needs.

attributes.name: goal_achievement_score
attributes.description: Weighted average score of all individual and team goals achieved during the review period (typically 0-100 or 0-5 scale).

attributes.name: gxp_training_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee maintained compliance with required Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) training during the review period (True/False). Critical for FDA and EMA audit readiness.
attributes.references: ICH GCP E6(R2), FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: individual_goals_count
attributes.description: Number of individual goals defined for the employee during the review period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was last modified.

attributes.name: merit_increase_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for a merit-based salary increase based on this review (True/False).

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The overall performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exceeds_expectations|meets_expectations|needs_improvement|unsatisfactory|outstanding|developing|not_rated — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the overall performance rating (e.g., 1.0 to 5.0 scale). Used for quantitative analysis and compensation planning.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has been placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) as a result of this review (True/False).

attributes.name: promotion_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is considered ready for promotion based on this review (True/False).

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review process was fully completed, including all approvals and employee acknowledgement.

attributes.name: review_cycle_type
attributes.description: The type of review cycle (annual, mid-year, probationary, project-based, quarterly, or ad-hoc).

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the performance period being evaluated (e.g., December 31 for annual review).

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the performance period being evaluated (e.g., January 1 for annual review).

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance review (draft, submitted, in calibration, calibrated, approved, completed, or cancelled). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|in_calibration|calibrated|approved|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reviewer_comments
attributes.description: Detailed comments and feedback provided by the reviewer regarding the employee's performance.

attributes.name: strengths_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the employee's key strengths and positive contributions during the review period.

attributes.name: succession_candidate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is identified as a succession candidate for critical roles (True/False).

attributes.name: team_goals_count
attributes.description: Number of team or departmental goals assigned to the employee during the review period.

products.name: compensation_plan
products.description: Master and transactional record defining total rewards structures and tracking employee benefit enrollments at Pharmaceuticals. Covers base salary bands, bonus targets, long-term incentive (LTI) eligibility, merit increase parameters by grade band, and comprehensive benefit program enrollments (health, dental, vision, life insurance, pension/401k, FSA, employee assistance programs). Captures plan definitions, geographic market differentials, individual employee enrollment records including coverage tier, effective dates, dependent count, employee/employer contribution amounts, enrollment status, and open enrollment lifecycle. Supports workforce cost planning, annual compensation cycles, open enrollment, pay equity analysis, and benefits administration in SAP SuccessFactors.

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compensation plan record. Primary key for the compensation plan entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee enrolled in this compensation plan. Links to employee master data for individual enrollment tracking.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: Compensation plans are designed for job profiles/families, not individual positions. The compensation_plan currently has job_grade_band as a STRING, but should also link to job_profile for systematic

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Compensation structures vary by legal entity for local labor law compliance, tax optimization, and benefit regulations. Creates new FK to link plans to governing legal entities for compliance manageme

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the compensation plan. Plans must be approved before activation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or compensation committee member who approved this compensation plan.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the compensation plan was formally approved by the compensation committee or authorized executive.

attributes.name: base_salary_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum base salary amount for the applicable job grade band within this compensation plan. Defines upper limit for salary progression.

attributes.name: base_salary_midpoint
attributes.description: Target or midpoint base salary amount for the applicable job grade band. Represents market-competitive pay level.

attributes.name: base_salary_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum base salary amount for the applicable job grade band within this compensation plan. Used for pay equity analysis and salary range management.

attributes.name: benefit_package_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the standard benefit package associated with this compensation plan (e.g., health, dental, vision, life insurance, pension/401k, FSA, EAP).

attributes.name: bonus_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target annual bonus as a percentage of base salary for employees enrolled in this plan. Used for total compensation calculations.

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance review for this compensation plan. Required for audit readiness.

attributes.name: compliance_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation plan has undergone compliance review for pay equity, regulatory requirements, and internal policy adherence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compensation plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for monetary amounts in this compensation plan (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP').

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the compensation plan expires or is no longer available for new enrollments. Nullable for open-ended plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the compensation plan becomes active and available for employee participation. Aligns with annual compensation cycle or plan year start.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules defining which employees qualify for this compensation plan (e.g., job grade, tenure, performance rating, geographic location).

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee enrolled in this compensation plan. Used for eligibility and vesting calculations.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the employee in this compensation plan. Tracks individual participation lifecycle.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic applicability of the compensation plan using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region identifiers (e.g., 'USA', 'EUR', 'Global'). Supports market-based pay differentiation.

attributes.name: health_insurance_employer_contribution
attributes.description: Standard employer contribution amount toward health insurance premiums for employees enrolled in this plan. May vary by coverage tier.

attributes.name: job_grade_band
attributes.description: Job grade or band range applicable to this compensation plan (e.g., 'Grade 10-12', 'Executive Band'). Links to organizational job architecture.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified the compensation plan record. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX, 21 CFR Part 11, SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compensation plan record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: lti_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees in this compensation plan are eligible for long-term incentive programs (e.g., stock options, restricted stock units, performance shares).

attributes.name: lti_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target long-term incentive award as a percentage of base salary. Applicable only when LTI eligibility flag is true.

attributes.name: merit_increase_budget_percentage
attributes.description: Annual merit increase budget as a percentage of current base salary for this compensation plan. Used during annual compensation review cycles.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the annual open enrollment period. Benefit elections must be completed by this date.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the annual open enrollment period when employees can enroll or modify their benefit elections for this compensation plan.

attributes.name: pay_equity_analysis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation plan has been analyzed for pay equity across gender, ethnicity, and other protected classes.

attributes.name: plan_administrator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the plan administrator for employee inquiries and escalations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Management

attributes.name: plan_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the HR or compensation team member responsible for administering this compensation plan. Used for audit and governance purposes.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the compensation plan. Used for cross-system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the compensation plan including eligibility criteria, calculation methodology, and key terms. Used for employee communication and HR reference.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the compensation plan (e.g., 'Executive Long-Term Incentive Plan 2024', 'Global Base Salary Structure').

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compensation plan. Active plans are available for employee enrollment and payroll processing.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compensation plan by reward category. Determines the structure and rules applied.

attributes.name: retirement_plan_employer_match_percentage
attributes.description: Employer matching contribution percentage for retirement plans (401k, pension) associated with this compensation plan.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the compensation plan. Incremented with each amendment or update to maintain audit trail.

products.name: payroll_run
products.description: Transactional record of payroll processing cycles and individual employee payslips for Pharmaceuticals. Captures payroll period, run date, payroll area (country/entity), run status (simulated, posted, reversed), total gross/net pay aggregates, and individual employee-level pay details (payslips) including base salary, overtime, bonuses, allowances, tax deductions, social security, pension contributions, net pay, and payment method. Supports financial reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA FI module, employee self-service pay statements, statutory reporting, and payroll audit per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payroll processing cycle. Primary key for the payroll run entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Payroll is processed per legal entity for tax withholding, statutory reporting, and financial consolidation. Creates new FK as payroll runs must be segregated by legal entity for compliance and accoun

attributes.name: payroll_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.payroll_period. Business justification: Payroll runs occur within defined payroll periods. Currently payroll_run has period dates as attributes but no FK to the payroll_period master table. The start and end dates can be derived from payrol

attributes.name: primary_payroll_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the payroll specialist or HR administrator who executed this payroll run. Used for audit trail and accountability per SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period to which this payroll run is posted in SAP FI (format: YYYY-MM, e.g., 2024-01). Used for general ledger reconciliation and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll run was approved for posting. Part of the audit trail for financial controls and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character code representing the legal entity for financial reporting and consolidation in SAP S/4HANA FI module. Links payroll costs to the general ledger.

attributes.name: cost_center_default
attributes.description: Default cost center for payroll cost allocation when employee-specific cost centers are not provided. Used for SAP CO (Controlling) module integration and departmental expense tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll run (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, JPY). Ensures consistent financial reporting and multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number generated when payroll costs are posted to the general ledger. Provides audit trail linking payroll transactions to financial statements. Ten-digit numeric identifier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Document Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll administrators to document special circumstances, processing exceptions, or other relevant information about this payroll run (e.g., holiday adjustments, system issues, manual corrections).

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when net pay is disbursed to employees via bank transfer, check, or other payment method. Critical for cash flow planning and employee communication.

attributes.name: payroll_area
attributes.description: Organizational unit representing the country, legal entity, or payroll processing group (e.g., US01, UK01, DE01). Determines payroll calendar, payment frequency, and regulatory jurisdiction. Maps to SAP Payroll Area configuration.

attributes.name: payroll_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of payroll processing for this run (monthly, semi-monthly, bi-weekly, weekly, quarterly, annual). Determines the cadence of payroll cycles and employee payment schedules.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) - US Department of Labor

attributes.name: payroll_run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the payroll run, typically formatted as a human-readable code used in SAP S/4HANA HCM Payroll module for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: payroll_schema
attributes.description: Technical identifier for the payroll calculation logic and rules applied in this run (e.g., US01, UK01). Defines wage types, tax rules, and deduction sequences per jurisdiction in SAP HCM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Payroll Schema Documentation

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when payroll costs were posted to the general ledger in SAP FI. May differ from payment date due to accounting cutoff rules. Critical for period-end close and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Document Posting

attributes.name: profit_center_default
attributes.description: Default profit center for payroll cost allocation when employee-specific profit centers are not provided. Used for SAP CO profitability analysis and segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why this payroll run was reversed or cancelled. Required for audit documentation and root cause analysis of payroll errors. Null if run was not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll run was reversed. Null if run was not reversed. Used for audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payroll run. Draft = initial creation; Simulated = test run for validation; Released = approved for processing; Posted = finalized and integrated to FI; Reversed = corrected/voided; Cancelled = aborted before completion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Payroll Control Record

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run purpose. Regular = standard periodic payroll; Off-cycle = unscheduled payment (e.g., new hire, termination); Correction = adjustment to prior run; Bonus = incentive/commission payment; Final = termination settlement; Advance = early payment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Payroll Schema Configuration

attributes.name: sox_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run is within the scope of SOX financial controls and audit requirements. True for payroll runs affecting publicly reported financial statements.

attributes.name: total_employees_processed
attributes.description: Count of employees included in this payroll run. Used for reconciliation and audit purposes to ensure all eligible employees received payslips.

attributes.name: total_gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate gross pay across all employees in this run before any deductions (base salary + overtime + bonuses + allowances). Used for financial reconciliation with SAP FI Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and Profit and Loss (P&L) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: total_net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate net pay across all employees in this run after all deductions (gross pay - taxes - social security - pension - other deductions). Represents the total cash disbursement required for this payroll cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Cash Management

attributes.name: total_other_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate of all other deductions not classified as tax, social security, or pension (e.g., health insurance premiums, union dues, garnishments, loan repayments). Used for detailed payroll reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_pension_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate retirement plan contributions (employee + employer portions) for this run. Includes 401(k), pension schemes, or equivalent per jurisdiction. Must be remitted to pension administrators.
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) - US; Pensions Regulator - UK

attributes.name: total_social_security_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate social security contributions (employee + employer portions) for this run. Includes FICA (US), National Insurance (UK), or equivalent per jurisdiction. Must be remitted to government agencies.
attributes.references: Social Security Administration (SSA) - US; HMRC National Insurance - UK

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate income tax withheld from all employees in this run (federal, state, local). Must be remitted to tax authorities per statutory deadlines. Critical for compliance with IRS, HMRC, and other tax agencies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E) - Employer's Tax Guide; HMRC PAYE Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures

products.name: payslip
products.description: Transactional record of individual employee payslips generated per payroll cycle. Captures employee reference, payroll period, gross pay, net pay, base salary, overtime pay, bonus payment, allowances, tax deductions, social security contributions, pension contributions, and payment method. Supports employee self-service, payroll audit, and statutory compliance reporting per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: payslip_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payslip record. Primary key for the payslip entity.

attributes.name: finance_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Workforce payslips should link to finance journal entries for payroll accounting and financial reporting. This enables integrated payroll processing with proper financial controls and GL posting.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll period for which this payslip was generated. Links to the payroll period master data.

attributes.name: payslip_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the payroll administrator or manager who approved this payslip for payment. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: payslip_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who received this payslip. Links to the employee master data record.

attributes.name: allowances
attributes.description: Sum of all allowances paid in this period, including housing, transportation, meal, shift, and other statutory or contractual allowances.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payslip was approved for payment. Part of the payroll approval workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The masked or tokenized bank account number to which net pay was transferred. Full account number is stored in secure vault per PCI DSS requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the employee bank account is held, used for payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: base_salary
attributes.description: The regular base salary amount for the payroll period, excluding overtime, bonuses, and allowances.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Wage Type - Basic Pay

attributes.name: bonus_payment
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus payments included in this payslip, such as annual bonuses, spot awards, or incentive payments.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code under which this payslip was processed. Used for multi-entity payroll consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which this employees payroll costs are allocated for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction under which this payslip was processed. Determines applicable tax and labor laws.

attributes.name: generated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payslip record was generated by the payroll system. Represents the payroll calculation event timestamp.

attributes.name: gross_pay
attributes.description: Total gross earnings before any deductions. Sum of base salary, overtime, bonuses, and allowances.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Payroll Result - Gross Pay

attributes.name: health_insurance_deduction
attributes.description: Employee portion of health insurance premiums deducted from gross pay for medical, dental, and vision coverage.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Wage Type - Health Insurance

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of regular hours worked during the payroll period, excluding overtime hours. Used for hourly wage calculations.

attributes.name: leave_balance
attributes.description: Remaining leave balance available to the employee as of the end of this payroll period, expressed in days.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Time Management - Leave Quota

attributes.name: leave_days_taken
attributes.description: Number of paid leave days taken during the payroll period, including vacation, sick leave, and other paid time off.

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: Final take-home pay amount after all deductions. Calculated as gross pay minus total deductions. This is the amount disbursed to the employee.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Payroll Result - Net Pay

attributes.name: other_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all other deductions not categorized above, including union dues, garnishments, loan repayments, and voluntary deductions.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Wage Type - Other Deductions

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked during the payroll period, including regular overtime and premium overtime.

attributes.name: overtime_pay
attributes.description: Total overtime compensation for the payroll period, including regular overtime and premium overtime rates.

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this payslip (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net pay was disbursed to the employee. Represents the actual payment event date.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which net pay was disbursed to the employee. Supports multiple payment instruments per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: payroll_area
attributes.description: Payroll processing area or grouping that defines the payroll frequency and processing schedule (e.g., monthly salaried, bi-weekly hourly).

attributes.name: payslip_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique payslip document number assigned by the payroll system. Used for employee self-service and audit trail.

attributes.name: payslip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payslip record. Tracks progression from draft through approval, payment, and any subsequent corrections or voids.

attributes.name: pension_contribution
attributes.description: Employee pension or retirement plan contributions deducted from gross pay, including mandatory and voluntary contributions.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the payroll period covered by this payslip.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the payroll period covered by this payslip.

attributes.name: social_security_contribution
attributes.description: Employee portion of social security or national insurance contributions deducted from gross pay, as required by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Wage Type - Social Security

attributes.name: tax_deduction
attributes.description: Total income tax withheld from gross pay for the payroll period, including federal, state, and local taxes as applicable by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Wage Type - Tax Deduction

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions from gross pay, including tax, social security, pension, health insurance, and other deductions.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Payroll Result - Total Deductions

attributes.name: year_to_date_gross
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this payroll period. Used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: year_to_date_net
attributes.description: Cumulative net pay from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this payroll period.

attributes.name: year_to_date_tax
attributes.description: Cumulative income tax withheld from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this payroll period. Used for tax reporting and W-2/T4 preparation.

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record of employee enrollment in benefit programs including health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, pension/401k, employee assistance programs, and flexible spending accounts. Captures benefit plan type, coverage tier, enrollment date, effective date, dependent count, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, and enrollment status. Sourced from SAP HCM Benefits module.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrollment record. Primary key for the benefit enrollment transaction.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the benefit plan in which the employee is enrolling. References the benefit plan master data.

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.compensation_plan. Business justification: Benefit enrollments are part of compensation plans. Currently benefit_enrollment has plan_type as string but no FK to the authoritative compensation plan that defines the benefit structure. The plan_t

attributes.name: primary_benefit_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee enrolling in the benefit program. Links to the employee master record in SAP HCM.

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: Total annual amount elected by employee for FSA, HSA, or 401k contributions. Used for payroll deduction calculation and IRS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125, IRS Section 223, IRS Section 401(k)

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of HR or benefits administrator approval for this enrollment. Certain enrollments (life events, COBRA) require manual review before activation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the enrollment was approved by HR or benefits administrator. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation
attributes.description: Name(s) of designated beneficiaries for life insurance or pension benefits. Confidential information used for claims processing. Nullable for non-applicable benefit types.

attributes.name: carrier_member_number
attributes.description: Unique member identifier assigned by the insurance carrier to the employee. Used on insurance cards and for claims processing. Restricted PII.

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance carrier's policy or certificate number assigned to this enrollment. Used for claims processing and carrier reconciliation.

attributes.name: cobra_continuation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Continuation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is a COBRA continuation coverage following termination of employment. True for COBRA enrollments, False for active employee enrollments.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code in SAP S/4HANA to which this enrollment belongs. Used for multi-entity financial and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: contribution_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for employee and employer contribution amounts. Supports multi-country payroll operations.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted or paid: weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly, monthly, or annual.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the employee is enrolled. Supports multi-country benefit plan administration and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected by the employee: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or full family coverage. Determines premium rates and contribution amounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: csv_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment record is within the scope of computer system validation per 21 CFR Part 11. True for GxP-regulated personnel benefit records requiring validation.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this enrollment. Used for premium calculation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit coverage ends. Nullable for open-ended enrollments. Populated upon termination, cancellation, or plan year end.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit coverage becomes active and the employee is eligible to use the benefit. May differ from enrollment date due to waiting periods or plan year start dates.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount deducted from employee paycheck per pay period for this benefit. Represents the employee's share of the premium or contribution.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount contributed by the employer per pay period for this benefit. Represents the employer's share of the premium or contribution for financial and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the benefit enrollment election. Represents the business event timestamp of the enrollment transaction.

attributes.name: enrollment_event_type
attributes.description: Type of qualifying event that triggered the enrollment: new hire enrollment, annual open enrollment period, qualifying life event (marriage, birth, etc.), COBRA continuation, or rehire enrollment.

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the employee completed the enrollment: online self-service portal, paper form, phone enrollment, HR-assisted enrollment, or automatic enrollment.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing enrollment confirmation number provided to the employee. Used for tracking and reference in HR communications.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. Tracks whether the enrollment is pending approval, active, suspended due to leave, terminated, cancelled by employee, or waived.

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_date
attributes.description: Date of the qualifying life event (marriage, birth, adoption, divorce, etc.) that allowed mid-year enrollment change. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this enrollment record originated: SAP HCM Benefits module, Workday, Oracle HCM, ADP, or manual entry.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of benefit coverage: employment termination, voluntary cancellation, plan discontinuation, loss of eligibility, etc. Nullable if enrollment is active.

attributes.name: termination_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the benefit enrollment was terminated in the system. Nullable if enrollment is active.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this enrollment record was last modified in the system. Audit trail field for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee actively waived this benefit coverage. True if waived, False if enrolled.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by employee if they waived coverage. Common reasons include coverage through spouse, Medicare, or other insurance. Nullable if not waived.

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Transactional record of employee leave requests and absences including annual leave, sick leave, parental leave, study leave, and unpaid leave. Captures leave type, requested start date, end date, duration in days, approval status, approver identity, reason code, and balance impact. Supports workforce availability planning, payroll deductions, and compliance with local labor regulations across Pharmaceuticals global sites.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave request transaction. Primary key for the leave request record.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or authorized person who approved or rejected the leave request. Links to the employee master record. Null if request is not yet processed.

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who last modified the leave request record. Used for audit trail and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments provided by the approver during the approval or rejection decision. May include conditions, alternative arrangements, or reasons for rejection.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the leave request was approved or rejected by the authorized approver. Null if request is still pending or in draft status.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents attached to the leave request (e.g., medical certificates, travel itineraries, legal notices). Used for compliance verification and audit readiness.

attributes.name: balance_after
attributes.description: Employee leave balance in days for the applicable leave type after this request was approved and deducted. Calculated as balance_before minus duration_days. Used for entitlement tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: balance_before
attributes.description: Employee leave balance in days for the applicable leave type immediately before this request was approved. Snapshot value for audit trail and balance reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the legal entity or company within the Pharmaceuticals corporate structure where the employee is employed. Used for multi-entity reporting and compliance with local labor regulations.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the employee is employed. Determines applicable labor law, leave entitlement rules, and regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the leave request record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of working days requested for leave, excluding weekends and public holidays. Supports fractional days for partial-day absences (e.g., 0.5 for half-day leave). Used for leave balance deduction and workforce capacity planning.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of working hours requested for leave. Calculated based on employee work schedule and used for hourly leave tracking and payroll deduction calculations.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employees emergency contact was notified about the leave (True) or not (False). Typically True for extended medical or emergency leave situations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the requested leave period. Employee is expected to return to work the following business day.

attributes.name: gxp_critical_role_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a GxP-critical role (GMP, GCP, GLP) requiring special absence management and substitute qualification verification (True) or not (False). Used for regulatory compliance and audit readiness for FDA/EMA inspections.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Guidelines; ICH GCP

attributes.name: half_day_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave request is for a half-day absence (True) or full-day absence (False). Used for precise leave balance calculation and workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: half_day_period
attributes.description: Specifies which half of the day is requested for leave when half_day_flag is True. AM=morning absence, PM=afternoon absence. Null for full-day leave requests.

attributes.name: handover_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has completed the work handover process to the substitute or team before starting leave (True) or not (False). Used for operational readiness tracking in GxP-regulated functions.

attributes.name: leave_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the leave request type. Determines entitlement rules, approval workflows, and payroll treatment. ANNUAL=paid annual vacation, SICK=illness absence, PARENTAL=family care leave, MATERNITY=maternity leave, PATERNITY=paternity leave, STUDY=educational leave, BEREAVEMENT=compassionate leave, UNPAID=unpaid time off, SABBATICAL=extended career break, JURY_DUTY=civic duty, MILITARY=military service. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ANNUAL|SICK|PARENTAL|MATERNITY|PATERNITY|STUDY|BEREAVEMENT|UNPAID|SABBATICAL|JURY_DUTY|MILITARY — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Local Labor Law; SAP HCM Absence Types

attributes.name: medical_certificate_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certificate has been received and verified (True) or is still outstanding (False). Null if medical certificate is not required for this request.

attributes.name: medical_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical certificate or doctors note is required for this leave request (True) or not (False). Typically True for sick leave exceeding a threshold duration as per company policy or local labor law.
attributes.references: Local Labor Law; Company HR Policy

attributes.name: paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave period is paid (True) or unpaid (False). Determines payroll treatment and salary deduction requirements. Derived from leave type and employee entitlement rules.

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: Payroll period (YYYY-MM format) in which the leave impact was processed for salary calculation. Used for payroll reconciliation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave request has been processed in the payroll system for salary adjustment or deduction (True) or is pending payroll processing (False). Used for payroll reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason category for the leave request. Used for workforce analytics, absence pattern analysis, and compliance reporting. VACATION=planned time off, ILLNESS=health-related absence, FAMILY_CARE=dependent care, MEDICAL_APPOINTMENT=healthcare visit, PERSONAL=personal matters, EMERGENCY=unplanned urgent situation, TRAINING=educational activity, OTHER=miscellaneous. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VACATION|ILLNESS|FAMILY_CARE|MEDICAL_APPOINTMENT|PERSONAL|EMERGENCY|TRAINING|OTHER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the employee describing the reason for the leave request. Optional field for additional context beyond the standardized reason code.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the leave request. Represents the business event timestamp for the transaction initiation.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the leave request, typically system-generated in format LR-YYYYNNNN for external reference and employee communication.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the leave request. DRAFT=saved but not submitted, SUBMITTED=awaiting manager review, PENDING_APPROVAL=in approval workflow, APPROVED=authorized and confirmed, REJECTED=denied by approver, WITHDRAWN=retracted by employee before approval, CANCELLED=revoked after approval. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|SUBMITTED|PENDING_APPROVAL|APPROVED|REJECTED|WITHDRAWN|CANCELLED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: return_to_work_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employees return to work has been confirmed by the manager or HR (True) or is pending confirmation (False). Used for attendance tracking and workforce availability updates.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the employee returned to work after the leave period. May differ from the planned end_date if leave was extended or curtailed. Used for attendance reconciliation and workforce planning accuracy.

attributes.name: site_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical site or facility where the employee is based. Used for site-level workforce availability planning and local labor law compliance.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the requested leave period. Employee is expected to be absent starting from this date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the leave request record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

products.name: recruitment_requisition
products.description: Transactional record of approved headcount requisitions initiating the talent acquisition process. Captures requisition number, position reference, hiring manager, department, site, job profile, required qualifications, GxP role flag, target start date, requisition status (draft, approved, open, filled, cancelled), sourcing channel, and budget approval reference. Supports workforce planning and talent pipeline management.

attributes.name: recruitment_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the recruitment requisition record. Primary key for the recruitment requisition entity.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department organizational unit where the position will be assigned. Links to department master data for cost center, functional area, and GxP scope.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized job profile defining role responsibilities, required competencies, qualifications, and career level for this requisition.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position master record that defines the job profile, organizational assignment, and role specifications for this requisition.

attributes.name: primary_recruitment_hiring_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the hiring manager responsible for the requisition approval, candidate selection, and final hiring decision.

attributes.name: quaternary_recruitment_recruiter_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the talent acquisition specialist or recruiter assigned to manage the recruitment process for this requisition.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical site or facility location where the hired employee will be based. Critical for GMP, GLP, and GCP site-specific training and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: tertiary_recruitment_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the approver who authorized the requisition (typically HR Director, Finance Controller, or senior executive with budget authority).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition received final approval and was authorized to proceed with recruitment activities.

attributes.name: approved_salary_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum approved annual salary or hourly rate for the position, as authorized by compensation and budget approval process.

attributes.name: approved_salary_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum approved annual salary or hourly rate for the position, as authorized by compensation and budget approval process.

attributes.name: budget_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the budget approval document or internal order authorizing the headcount and associated compensation costs.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the requisition was cancelled or withdrawn (e.g., budget cuts, organizational restructuring, position eliminated, internal fill).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or context relevant to the requisition that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that will employ the hired candidate. Critical for payroll, tax, and legal compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which the hired employee salary and benefits costs will be charged. Used for financial planning and budget tracking.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the work location country. Determines applicable labor laws, tax regulations, and employment standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the recruitment requisition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process timeline tracking.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Type of employment relationship being recruited for: full-time permanent, part-time, fixed-term temporary, contractor, or internship.

attributes.name: gmp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is GMP-critical, requiring specific cGMP training, qualification, and audit trail documentation per FDA 21 CFR Part 211 and EMA GMP guidelines.

attributes.name: gxp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires GxP (GMP, GLP, GCP) compliance training and certification. True for roles in regulated manufacturing, laboratory, or clinical operations subject to FDA, EMA, or ICH requirements.

attributes.name: headcount_quantity
attributes.description: Number of positions to be filled under this requisition. Typically 1 for individual roles, may be greater for bulk hiring initiatives.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the role responsibilities, key accountabilities, reporting relationships, and success criteria. Used in job postings and candidate communications.

attributes.name: job_posting_title
attributes.description: External-facing job title used in job postings and advertisements. May differ from internal position title for market competitiveness and candidate attraction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to the recruitment requisition record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for the position.

attributes.name: preferred_qualifications
attributes.description: Desired but not mandatory qualifications, skills, and experience that would make a candidate more competitive (e.g., experience with Veeva Vault, knowledge of ICH guidelines).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the requisition indicating urgency of fill: critical (business-critical role, immediate need), high (important role, fill within 30 days), medium (standard priority), low (opportunistic hire).

attributes.name: required_qualifications
attributes.description: Detailed description of mandatory educational qualifications, certifications, licenses, and professional credentials required for the position (e.g., PhD in Chemistry, PharmD license, CQA certification).

attributes.name: requisition_close_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition was closed, either due to successful fill, cancellation, or other closure reason.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the recruitment requisition, externally visible and used for tracking and reference in talent acquisition workflows.

attributes.name: requisition_open_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition was approved and opened for active recruitment, marking the start of the talent acquisition process.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recruitment requisition: draft (being prepared), pending approval (awaiting budget/manager approval), approved (ready to post), open (actively recruiting), in progress (candidates in pipeline), filled (position accepted), cancelled (requisition withdrawn), or on hold (temporarily paused). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|open|in_progress|filled|cancelled|on_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition purpose: new headcount creation, replacement for departed employee, temporary coverage, contractor engagement, or internship program.

attributes.name: salary_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the approved salary range (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: Primary recruitment sourcing strategy for this requisition: internal mobility, external job boards, employee referral program, recruitment agency, campus recruiting, LinkedIn, or other job posting platforms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal|external|referral|agency|campus|linkedin|job_board — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_start_date
attributes.description: Desired date by which the hired candidate should commence employment. Used for workforce planning and recruitment timeline management.

products.name: candidate
products.description: Master record for job applicants in the talent acquisition pipeline, including their complete application history to specific requisitions. Captures candidate identity, contact details, source channel, qualifications, therapeutic area expertise, GxP experience flag, visa/work authorization, and per-application transactional details including application date, application source, screening status, interview stage, assessment scores, offer status, rejection reason, background check status, pre-employment medical clearance for GxP roles, and hiring decision. Supports end-to-end recruitment tracking from sourcing through offer acceptance across multiple requisitions.

attributes.name: candidate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the candidate record in the talent acquisition system. Primary key.

attributes.name: candidate_recruiter_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the internal recruiter or talent acquisition specialist assigned to manage this candidate.

attributes.name: candidate_referral_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the internal employee who referred this candidate, if applicable.

attributes.name: background_check_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the candidates background check was completed.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Current status of the candidates pre-employment background verification process.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), GDPR Article 22

attributes.name: candidate_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the candidate, typically system-generated and used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: candidate_status
attributes.description: Current overall status of the candidate in the talent acquisition pipeline across all applications.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the candidates current residence.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the candidates current country of residence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the candidate record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_employer
attributes.description: Name of the candidates current employer organization, if disclosed.

attributes.name: current_job_title
attributes.description: Candidates current job title or role at their present employer.

attributes.name: degree_field
attributes.description: Primary field of study or major for the candidates highest degree (e.g., Chemistry, Pharmacology, Biochemistry, Engineering).
attributes.references: ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013

attributes.name: diversity_self_identification

products.name: headcount_plan
products.description: Master record of strategic workforce planning, headcount management, and succession planning for Pharmaceuticals. Captures planning period, org unit, approved FTE count, current FTE count, open positions, attrition assumptions, hiring plans, budget envelopes, plan status, and scenario modeling for clinical/manufacturing/commercial scale-up. Also captures detailed succession plans for critical and regulated roles (Qualified Person, Responsible Pharmacist) including target position, incumbent, successor candidates with readiness levels (ready now, 1-2 years, 3-5 years), development gap assessments, retention risk ratings, GxP qualification readiness, therapeutic area criticality, and plan review dates. Supports annual workforce planning cycles, business continuity for regulated roles, and regulatory continuity planning.

attributes.name: headcount_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for headcount_plan

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or unit for which this headcount plan applies. Links to the department master data.

attributes.description: Reference to the job profile or role for which headcount is being planned. Used for role-specific workforce planning and succession planning.

attributes.description: Reference to the current employee holding the target position for succession planning. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: quaternary_headcount_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who created this headcount plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
