attributes.description: Reference to the employee who most recently modified this headcount plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: tertiary_headcount_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this headcount plan. Typically a senior leader or HR executive with workforce planning authority.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this headcount plan was formally approved and authorized for execution.

attributes.name: approved_fte_count
attributes.description: Authorized full-time equivalent headcount for the planning period. Represents the approved workforce capacity including full-time and part-time employees normalized to FTE basis.

attributes.name: attrition_assumption_rate
attributes.description: Assumed attrition rate (as percentage) used in workforce planning calculations. Represents expected voluntary and involuntary turnover during the planning period.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget envelope allocated for workforce costs during the planning period, including salaries, benefits, and related expenses.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: business_continuity_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for business continuity planning: critical (role essential for regulatory compliance or patient safety), high (significant business impact if vacant), medium (moderate impact), low (minimal immediate impact).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments, notes, or additional context regarding the headcount plan, succession strategy, or planning assumptions. Used for qualitative information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this headcount plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_fte_count
attributes.description: Current actual full-time equivalent headcount as of the plan snapshot date. Used to calculate the gap between current state and approved target.

attributes.name: development_gap_assessment
attributes.description: Detailed assessment of competency gaps and development needs for the successor candidate to be fully prepared for the target position. Includes technical skills, leadership capabilities, and regulatory qualifications.

attributes.name: expected_attrition_count
attributes.description: Projected number of employee departures during the planning period based on attrition assumptions. Used to calculate replacement hiring needs.

attributes.name: gxp_qualification_readiness
attributes.description: Status of GxP (GMP/GLP/GCP) qualification readiness for the successor candidate: qualified (meets all regulatory requirements), in_progress (undergoing qualification training), not_started (qualification not yet initiated), not_applicable (role does not require GxP qualification).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this headcount plan record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory review of this headcount or succession plan. Ensures regular updates to workforce planning assumptions and succession readiness.

attributes.name: open_positions_count

attributes.name: plan_name

attributes.name: retention_risk_rating

attributes.name: successor_readiness_level

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_criticality
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area for which this succession plan is critical, reflecting specialized expertise requirements in pharmaceutical development and commercialization.

attributes.name: training_requalification_required_flag

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.25, EMA GMP Annex 11

products.name: succession_plan
products.description: Master record of succession planning for critical and regulated roles at Pharmaceuticals. Captures target position, incumbent employee, successor candidates (multiple per position), readiness level (ready now, 1-2 years, 3-5 years), development gap assessment, retention risk rating, GxP qualification readiness, therapeutic area criticality, and plan review date. Supports talent pipeline management, business continuity for Qualified Person and Responsible Pharmacist roles, and regulatory continuity planning.

attributes.name: succession_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the succession plan record. Primary key for the succession plan entity.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department to which the target position belongs. Links to department master data. Used for organizational succession planning analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee responsible for maintaining and executing this succession plan. Typically the hiring manager, department head, or HR business partner. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: primary_succession_incumbent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the current employee holding the target position. May be null if position is vacant. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: quaternary_succession_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who created this succession plan record. Links to employee master data. Used for audit trails and accountability.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 - Metadata Registries, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: quinary_succession_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who last modified this succession plan record. Links to employee master data. Used for audit trails and accountability.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 - Metadata Registries, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the site or facility where the target position is located. Links to site master data. Used for multi-site succession planning and regulatory reporting by location.

attributes.name: target_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the critical position for which succession planning is being performed. Links to the position master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_succession_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this succession plan. Typically senior leadership or executive responsible for talent management. Links to employee master data. Null if plan not yet approved.

attributes.name: actual_transition_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the successor assumed the target position. Null if transition has not yet occurred. Used to measure succession planning effectiveness and close out completed plans.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan was formally approved. Null if plan is still in draft status. Used for audit trails and governance reporting.

attributes.name: business_continuity_priority
attributes.description: Priority tier assigned to this succession plan based on the target positions criticality to business operations and regulatory compliance. Tier 1 indicates highest priority requiring immediate succession readiness (e.g., Qualified Person, Responsible Pharmacist); Tier 2 indicates high priority; Tier 3 indicates moderate priority; Tier 4 indicates standard priority.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, context, or special considerations related to the succession plan. May include information about unique circumstances, external factors, or stakeholder feedback.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the succession plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking. Immutable after initial creation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: development_gap_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the competency, experience, and qualification gaps that must be addressed before the successor is ready to assume the target position. Informs individual development plan creation.

attributes.name: estimated_transition_date
attributes.description: Projected date when the successor is expected to assume the target position. May be based on incumbent retirement date, readiness timeline, or business planning. Null if transition timing is uncertain.

attributes.name: gxp_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the successor achieved full GxP qualification for the target position. Null if qualification is not yet complete. Used for regulatory audit trails and requalification scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: gxp_qualification_status
attributes.description: Status of the successors qualification for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), or Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) requirements applicable to the target position. Qualified indicates all required GxP training and assessments are current; In Progress indicates qualification activities underway; Not Started indicates qualification not yet initiated; Expired indicates requalification required; Waived indicates regulatory exemption granted.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: gxp_requalification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the successor must complete GxP requalification activities to maintain qualification status for the target position. Null if initial qualification not yet achieved or if position does not require periodic requalification.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the succession plan record was last updated. Used for audit trails, change tracking, and data currency assessment. Updated automatically on each modification.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the succession plan must be reviewed and updated. Typically set based on organizational policy (e.g., annual review) or triggered by significant business changes.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the succession plan, formatted as SP-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence number. Used for audit trails and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: plan_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan was last reviewed and updated. Used to ensure succession plans remain current and aligned with business needs and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the succession plan. Draft indicates plan is under development; Active indicates plan is approved and being executed; On Hold indicates temporary suspension; Completed indicates successor has assumed role; Cancelled indicates plan was terminated; Archived indicates historical record retention.

attributes.name: qualified_person_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target position is a Qualified Person role as defined by EU GMP regulations. True if position requires QP designation; False otherwise. QP roles have heightened succession planning requirements due to regulatory mandate for batch release authority.

attributes.name: readiness_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the successor readiness level was last assessed. Used to track currency of succession planning data and trigger periodic reassessments.

attributes.name: readiness_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the successors readiness to assume the target position. Ready Now indicates candidate can assume role immediately; 1-2 Years indicates near-term readiness with minor development; 3-5 Years indicates longer-term development required; Not Ready indicates significant gaps exist.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspection_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this succession plan record is complete and audit-ready for FDA, EMA, or other regulatory authority inspections. True if all required documentation, assessments, and approvals are in place; False if gaps exist that must be addressed before inspection.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EMA GMP Guidelines, ICH Q10

attributes.name: responsible_pharmacist_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target position is a Responsible Pharmacist role as defined by regulatory authorities. True if position requires Responsible Pharmacist designation; False otherwise. These roles have specific succession planning requirements for pharmacy operations continuity.

attributes.name: retention_risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk that the successor candidate may leave the organization before assuming the target role. Low indicates stable retention; Medium indicates some flight risk; High indicates significant retention concerns; Critical indicates imminent departure risk requiring immediate intervention.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_criticality
attributes.description: Assessment of the strategic importance of the target positions therapeutic area to the organizations business continuity and regulatory compliance. Critical indicates essential therapeutic area with high regulatory scrutiny or revenue impact; High indicates important therapeutic area; Medium indicates moderate importance; Low indicates limited business impact.

products.name: time_attendance
products.description: Transactional record of employee time and attendance entries including clock-in/clock-out, shift assignments, overtime hours, break periods, and absence codes for manufacturing, laboratory, and clinical operations staff. Captures date, shift pattern, scheduled hours, actual hours, overtime category, cost center allocation, and approval status. Critical for GMP manufacturing compliance where personnel presence during batch production must be documented, and for labor cost allocation to production orders in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: time_attendance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the time and attendance record. Primary key for the time_attendance product.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved this time and attendance record. Required for audit trails and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: payroll_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll period to which this time and attendance record belongs. Links time records to payroll processing cycles.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Time tracking at plant level enables GMP batch record traceability, labor cost allocation to manufacturing sites, and site-specific attendance compliance. Creates new FK to replace denormalized work_l

attributes.name: primary_time_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee for whom this time and attendance record is captured. Links to the employee master data.

attributes.name: absence_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the type of absence if the employee did not work (e.g., SICK, VAC, PTO, FMLA, UNPAID). Used for leave balance tracking and payroll processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR-PT Time Management, FMLA

attributes.name: absence_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive explanation of the absence reason. Provides additional context for HR and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.description: The actual number of hours the employee worked, calculated from clock-in and clock-out timestamps minus break periods. Used for payroll processing and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR-PT Time Management, FLSA

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the time and attendance record in the workflow. Determines whether the record can be processed for payroll.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time and attendance record was approved. Used for audit trails and payroll cutoff validation.

attributes.name: attendance_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the employee's time and attendance was recorded. Principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: attendance_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this time and attendance record, used for audit trails and payroll reconciliation.

attributes.name: attendance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the attendance record indicating whether the employee was present, absent, or partially present. Used for attendance tracking and performance management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: present|absent|partial|late|early_departure|no_show|excused|unexcused — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the pharmaceutical product being manufactured during this shift. Critical for GMP traceability and batch record documentation.

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of break periods taken during the shift, measured in minutes. Deducted from gross time to calculate actual hours worked.

attributes.name: clock_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the employee clocked in or started their shift. Critical for GMP batch production documentation where personnel presence must be timestamped.

attributes.name: clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the employee clocked out or ended their shift. Used to calculate actual hours worked and for GMP compliance documentation.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes related to this time and attendance record, such as explanations for late arrivals, early departures, or overtime justifications.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the labor hours and costs for this attendance record are allocated. Used for financial reporting and production order costing in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time and attendance record was first created in the system. Required for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: early_departure_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes the employee left early compared to their scheduled end time. Used for attendance policy enforcement and performance tracking.

attributes.name: gmp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time record is for GMP-critical manufacturing operations where personnel presence must be documented for regulatory compliance and FDA/EMA inspections.

attributes.name: gxp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time record is for GxP-regulated activities (GMP, GCP, GLP) requiring documented personnel presence for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time and attendance record was last updated. Required for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: late_arrival_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes the employee arrived late compared to their scheduled start time. Used for attendance policy enforcement and performance tracking.

attributes.name: overtime_category
attributes.description: Classification of overtime hours by compensation rate (e.g., time and half, double time, holiday premium). Determines the overtime multiplier for payroll. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|time_and_half|double_time|holiday|weekend|night_differential|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours worked beyond the standard work schedule that qualify for overtime compensation. Critical for labor cost management and compliance with labor laws.

attributes.name: paid_break_minutes
attributes.description: The portion of break time that is compensated according to company policy or labor agreements. Included in payroll calculations.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time and attendance record has been processed in a payroll run. Prevents duplicate processing and supports reconciliation.

attributes.name: production_order_number
attributes.description: Production order number to which the employee's time is allocated for GMP batch manufacturing. Links labor hours to specific batch production for cost accounting and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning, 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: The portion of actual hours worked that are classified as regular hours (non-overtime). Used for standard payroll calculations.

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the employee was scheduled to work on this date according to their shift assignment. Used for variance analysis and labor planning.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shift pattern assigned to the employee for this attendance record (e.g., DAY, NIGHT, SWING, ROTATING). Used for shift differential calculations and manufacturing scheduling.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the shift pattern (e.g., Morning Shift 6AM-2PM, Night Shift 10PM-6AM). Provides human-readable context for the shift assignment.

attributes.name: time_clock_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical time clock or biometric device used to capture the attendance record. Used for device audit trails and validation.

attributes.name: time_entry_method
attributes.description: Method by which the time and attendance data was captured (e.g., biometric scanner, badge swipe, manual entry). Important for audit trails and data quality assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: biometric|badge_swipe|manual|mobile_app|web_portal|supervisor_entry|system_generated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR-PT Time Management, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: unpaid_break_minutes
attributes.description: The portion of break time that is not compensated (e.g., meal breaks). Excluded from payroll calculations.

attributes.name: adjusted_time_attendance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on time_attendance (adjusted_time_attendance_id)

attributes.name: compensation_grade_max

attributes.name: remote_work_eligibility

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: succession_planning_priority

attributes.name: typical_experience_years_max

attributes.name: union_eligibility

attributes.name: workforce_planning_category

attributes.name: predecessor_framework_id

attributes.name: applicable_regions

attributes.name: applicable_sites

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approval_required

attributes.name: assessment_method

attributes.name: audit_trail_required

attributes.name: business_justification

attributes.name: certification_required

attributes.name: competency_count

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: job_family

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Primary language of the framework documentation using ISO 639-1 two-letter code, optionally followed by ISO 3166-1 country code (e.g., en, en-US, de-DE).

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: linked_training_programs

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: owning_department

products.name: legal_entity
products.description: Master record for all legal entities within the pharmaceutical enterprise including subsidiaries, affiliates, joint ventures, and holding companies. Captures legal name, registration number, jurisdiction of incorporation, entity type (operating company, holding, JV), tax identification numbers, registered address, functional currency, consolidation group, and SAP company code mapping. Serves as the organizational backbone for financial consolidation, regulatory submissions, and cross-system entity resolution.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the legal entity record. Primary key for the legal entity master data product.
attributes.references: ISO 17442 (Legal Entity Identifier), SAP S/4HANA Company Code Master

attributes.name: parent_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent legal entity in the organizational hierarchy. Null for top-level holding companies. Used to construct the legal entity hierarchy for consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure, IFRS 10 (Consolidated Financial Statements)

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ultimate parent legal entity at the top of the organizational hierarchy. Used for global consolidation and group-level reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure, IFRS 10 (Consolidated Financial Statements)

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: The consolidation group or reporting unit to which this legal entity belongs for financial consolidation purposes. Used to aggregate financial results across multiple legal entities.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 (Consolidated Financial Statements), SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated score representing the completeness and accuracy of this legal entity master data record, typically ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Used for data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: DAMA-DMBOK (Data Management Body of Knowledge), Internal Data Quality Framework

attributes.name: data_steward_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or role responsible for maintaining the accuracy and completeness of this legal entity master data record. Part of the MDM governance framework.
attributes.references: DAMA-DMBOK (Data Management Body of Knowledge), Internal MDM Governance Policy

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially dissolved or terminated. Null for active entities.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for global business identification and credit reporting.

attributes.name: ema_organization_code
attributes.description: The organization identifier assigned by the European Medicines Agency for entities involved in pharmaceutical activities in the European Union. Used in regulatory submissions and correspondence.

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: The current operational and legal status of the entity. Active entities are currently operating, inactive entities are dormant but legally registered, dissolved entities have been legally terminated, merged entities have been combined with another entity, acquired entities have been purchased by another organization, and pending formation entities are in the process of incorporation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Configuration, Local Company Registry Standards

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity based on its operational and ownership structure. Operating companies conduct business operations, holding companies own other entities, joint ventures are shared ownership arrangements, subsidiaries are majority-owned entities, branches are extensions of parent entities, and partnerships are shared ownership structures.
attributes.references: ISO 20275 (Entity Legal Forms), SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure

attributes.name: fda_establishment_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Establishment Identifier (FEI)
attributes.description: The FDA Establishment Identifier assigned to facilities that manufacture, repack, relabel, or salvage drugs, biologics, or devices for commercial distribution in the United States. Required for regulatory submissions and inspections.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207 (FDA Establishment Registration), FDA Data Standards Council

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_month
attributes.description: The month in which the legal entity's fiscal year ends, represented as an integer from 1 (January) to 12 (December). Used for financial reporting and tax purposes.
attributes.references: IAS 1 (Presentation of Financial Statements), SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_currency
attributes.description: The primary currency in which the legal entity conducts its business and maintains its books of account, represented as a 3-letter ISO currency code.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 (Currency Codes), IAS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates)

attributes.name: gmp_certification_status
attributes.description: The current status of GMP certification for this legal entity. GMP certification is required for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and demonstrates compliance with quality standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 (cGMP), ICH Q7 (GMP for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), PIC/S GMP Guide

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially incorporated or registered in its jurisdiction.

attributes.name: industry_classification_code
attributes.description: The standard industry classification code for the legal entity's primary business activity. May use NAICS, SIC, or ISIC classification systems.
attributes.references: NAICS (North American Industry Classification System), ISIC Rev.4

attributes.name: iso_certification_status
attributes.description: The current ISO quality management system certifications held by this legal entity (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 13485). Multiple certifications may be listed.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 (Quality Management Systems), ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality Management)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_of_incorporation
attributes.description: The country or jurisdiction where the legal entity is incorporated or registered, represented as a 3-letter ISO country code.

attributes.name: legal_form
attributes.description: The legal form or structure of the entity as defined by the jurisdiction of incorporation (e.g., Corporation, Limited Liability Company, Public Limited Company, Private Limited Company, Partnership). Uses ISO 20275 Entity Legal Forms codes where applicable.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the entity as recorded in the jurisdiction of incorporation. This is the name that appears on all regulatory filings, contracts, and official documents.
attributes.references: ISO 20275 (Entity Legal Forms), FDA Establishment Registration

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: The 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier code used for global entity identification in financial transactions and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: primary_business_activity
attributes.description: Description of the primary business activity or operations conducted by this legal entity (e.g., pharmaceutical manufacturing, research and development, distribution, holding company).
attributes.references: ISIC Rev.4 (International Standard Industrial Classification), NAICS (North American Industry Classification System)

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity master data record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 (Date and Time Format), Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity master data record was last modified.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 (Date and Time Format), Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the official registered address of the legal entity as recorded with the jurisdiction of incorporation.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the official registered address of the legal entity, typically containing suite, floor, or building information.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: The country of the registered address, represented as a 3-letter ISO country code.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region of the registered address.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The official registration or incorporation number assigned by the jurisdiction of incorporation. This may be a company registration number, certificate of incorporation number, or equivalent identifier.

attributes.name: reporting_currency
attributes.description: The currency used for external financial reporting and consolidation, represented as a 3-letter ISO currency code. May differ from functional currency for subsidiaries.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 (Currency Codes), IAS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates)

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: The 4-character SAP S/4HANA company code assigned to this legal entity. Company codes are the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for external reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the legal entity used in internal systems and reporting.

attributes.name: stock_exchange_listing
attributes.description: The stock exchange(s) on which the legal entity's securities are listed, if publicly traded. Uses ISO 10383 Market Identifier Codes (MIC) where applicable.
attributes.references: ISO 10383 (Market Identifier Codes), SEC EDGAR System

attributes.name: stock_ticker_symbol
attributes.description: The ticker symbol or trading symbol for the legal entity's publicly traded securities, if applicable.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The primary tax identification number assigned by the tax authority in the jurisdiction of incorporation. In the US this is the Employer Identification Number (EIN), in other jurisdictions it may be a VAT number, corporate tax number, or equivalent.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635 (EIN), OECD Tax Identification Standards

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: The VAT registration number assigned by the tax authority for entities registered for VAT purposes. Applicable primarily in jurisdictions with VAT systems.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive, Local VAT Registration Standards

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Master record for organizational units within the enterprise hierarchy including business units, divisions, departments, and functional groups. Captures unit name, unit type (business unit, division, department, function, team), parent unit reference for hierarchy traversal, effective dates, responsible manager, geographic location, headcount, and SAP organizational element mapping. Supports HR organizational structure, operational reporting hierarchies, and management accountability across SAP S/4HANA, Veeva, and LIMS.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Primary key for org_unit

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Org units located in countries. New FK country_id → country.country_id. Existing country_code (STRING) remains for code-level reference.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Organizational units belong to legal entities. New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the enterprise hierarchy. Enables hierarchical traversal and roll-up reporting across business units, divisions, departments, and teams. Null for top-level units.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: Org units roll up to profit centers for P&L reporting. New FK profit_center_id → profit_center.masterdata_profit_center_id. Remove profit_center_code as redundant.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the organizational unit location. Used for correspondence, regulatory submissions, and facility audits.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or floor information. Optional field for additional location detail.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit in the reporting currency. Used for financial planning, variance analysis, and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amount. Used for multi-currency reporting and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) business area code for cross-company code reporting. Used for segment reporting and consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the organizational unit is located. Used for geographic reporting and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) cost center code associated with this organizational unit. Used for financial planning, budgeting, and expense allocation. Aligns with SAP CO module cost center master data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the master data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the organizational unit ceased or will cease operations. Null for currently active units. Used for historical reporting and organizational change tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the organizational unit became or will become operational. Used for time-based hierarchy queries and historical organizational structure analysis.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary contact email address for the organizational unit. Used for official correspondence and system notifications.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Broad functional classification of the organizational unit such as Research and Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, Human Resources, or Information Technology. Supports cross-functional analysis and resource allocation.

attributes.name: gcp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates under GCP (Good Clinical Practice) regulations. True for clinical development, medical affairs, and pharmacovigilance units conducting or supporting clinical trials.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market where this organizational unit operates (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America). Used for regional performance analysis and market segmentation.

attributes.name: glp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates under GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) regulations. True for preclinical research and toxicology laboratories conducting non-clinical safety studies.

attributes.name: gmp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates under GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) or cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) regulations. True for manufacturing, quality control, and quality assurance units handling drug substances or drug products.

attributes.name: headcount_fte
attributes.description: Total full-time equivalent employee count allocated to this organizational unit. Used for workforce planning, budget allocation, and productivity analysis. Includes full-time, part-time, and contractor resources normalized to FTE.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit. Active units are operational and staffed. Inactive units are temporarily suspended. Pending units are approved but not yet operational. Dissolved units have been permanently closed.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the organizational unit. Used for business communication and emergency contact.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the organizational unit address. Used for mail delivery and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: qms_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is within the scope of the enterprise Quality Management System (QMS). True for units subject to ISO 9001 certification and quality audits.

attributes.name: sap_org_unit_code
attributes.description: Native SAP S/4HANA organizational unit identifier from the Organizational Management (OM) module. Used for bidirectional synchronization and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: site_location
attributes.description: Physical site or facility name where the organizational unit is primarily located. Used for facility management, space planning, and operational logistics.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region for the organizational unit location. Used for regional compliance and tax reporting.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area focus for research, clinical, or commercial organizational units (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular, Neuroscience). Null for non-product-focused units.

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code for the organizational unit. Used for cross-system integration and reporting. Typically aligned with SAP S/4HANA organizational element codes (cost center, profit center, business area).

attributes.name: unit_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of the unit in the organizational hierarchy. Level 1 represents top-level enterprise units, with increasing numbers for deeper nesting. Supports hierarchy depth analysis and roll-up aggregation.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the organizational unit as recognized in corporate documentation and reporting systems. Used for display in reports, dashboards, and organizational charts.

attributes.name: unit_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or acronym for the organizational unit. Used in space-constrained displays and informal communication.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit by its role in the enterprise structure. Determines reporting hierarchy level and management accountability scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: business_unit|division|department|function|team|cost_center|profit_center — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for SAP cost centers used in management accounting and financial controlling. Captures cost center code, description, cost center category (production, administration, R&D, sales), responsible person, valid-from and valid-to dates, controlling area, profit center assignment, and functional area classification. Serves as the primary financial dimension for cost allocation across manufacturing, clinical, and R&D operations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cost_center

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Cost centers belong to legal entities (SAP company codes). New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Cost centers belong to organizational units. New FK org_unit_id → org_unit.masterdata_org_unit_id. Remove department_code as org_unit.unit_code provides authoritative reference.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Cost centers in pharmaceutical manufacturing are typically plant-specific (e.g., 'Plant 123 - QC Lab', 'Plant 456 - Packaging Line 2'). The existing 'location_code' STRING attribute should be normaliz

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person responsible for managing and controlling costs within this cost center. Used for accountability and approval workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Personnel Number (PA0000)

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: Cost centers roll up to profit centers for internal P&L reporting. New FK profit_center_id → profit_center.masterdata_profit_center_id. Remove profit_center_code as redundant.

attributes.name: activity_type_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center performs activity-based costing and maintains activity types for internal cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Activity Type (CSLA)

attributes.name: budget_profile
attributes.description: Budget control profile defining budget availability checking rules, tolerance limits, and budget management parameters for this cost center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Budget Profile (FM)

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area assignment for cross-company code reporting and segment analysis, enabling consolidated financial statements by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Business Area (TGSB)

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The controlling area to which this cost center is assigned. Controlling area is the highest organizational unit in management accounting, representing a closed system for cost accounting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Controlling Area (TKA01)

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used for allocating costs from this cost center to other cost objects (e.g., direct allocation, activity-based costing, assessment, distribution). Supports COGS calculation and transfer pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Allocation Methods

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by functional area. Production includes manufacturing and API production; R&D includes drug discovery, preclinical, and clinical development; Quality Control includes QC labs and QA functions; Regulatory Affairs includes submission and compliance activities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Category (KOSAR)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric business identifier for the cost center used across SAP S/4HANA and financial reporting systems. This is the externally-known code used in general ledger postings, budget allocations, and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Table (Cost Center Master)

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Extended textual description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities within the organization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKT Table (Cost Center Texts)

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center, providing human-readable identification for reporting and analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Table

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers accept postings; Inactive cost centers are closed; Blocked cost centers exist but cannot receive new postings; Planned cost centers are defined for future use.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Lock Indicator

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Granular classification of the cost center type within its category, enabling detailed cost analysis and allocation logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Type Field

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created this cost center master record in the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost center master record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which cost center transactions are recorded and reported.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting and external financial reporting per IFRS/GAAP requirements. Typical values include manufacturing, R&D, sales, administration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module - Functional Area (FMFINCODE)

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the cost center operates under GMP regulations. GMP-critical cost centers (e.g., API production, sterile manufacturing) require enhanced documentation and validation; GMP-non-critical support GMP operations; Non-GMP cost centers operate outside GMP scope.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: Standard hierarchy assignment for cost center grouping and roll-up reporting in management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Standard Hierarchy (SETHEADER)

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this cost center master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost center master record was last modified.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates which types of postings are locked for this cost center. Unlocked allows all postings; Locked_actual prevents actual cost postings; Locked_plan prevents planning postings; Locked_all prevents all postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Lock Indicator (SPERRK)

attributes.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is the authoritative golden record in the MDM system, used for master data governance and data quality management.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Planning group assignment for cost center planning and budgeting cycles, enabling coordinated planning across related cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Planning Parameters

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source operational system from which this cost center master record originated, supporting multi-system MDM governance.
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) - Source System Registry

attributes.name: sox_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements, typically for cost centers involved in financial reporting processes.

attributes.name: statistical_cost_center_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical cost center used for informational purposes only, without actual cost postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Statistical Indicator

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center master record is valid and can accept cost postings. Part of the time-dependent master data structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Valid From (DATAB)

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center master record is valid. After this date, no new postings are allowed. Nullable for open-ended validity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Valid To (DATBI)

products.name: profit_center
products.description: Master record for SAP profit centers representing autonomous business segments for internal profitability reporting. Captures profit center code, name, hierarchy node, responsible manager, segment classification (therapeutic area, product line, geography), controlling area, and dummy profit center flag. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, rare diseases) and product portfolio.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for profit_center

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Profit centers belong to legal entities for consolidation. New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

attributes.name: analysis_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period for which this profit center configuration is effective, in YYYYMM format. Supports period-specific profit center assignments and reorganizations.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area for cross-company code reporting. Represents a business segment that spans multiple legal entities, used for consolidated management reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The controlling area to which this profit center is assigned. Controlling area is the organizational unit in SAP CO that represents a closed system for cost accounting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Controlling Area

attributes.name: cost_center_group
attributes.description: The cost center group or range associated with this profit center. Links profit center to underlying cost centers for cost allocation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this profit center master record was created in the system. Supports audit trail and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11, SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The functional currency in which this profit center's P&L is reported. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The department or organizational unit code associated with this profit center. Links profit center to the organizational hierarchy for reporting and governance.

attributes.name: dummy_profit_center_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a dummy or placeholder profit center used for technical postings, system balancing, or temporary allocations. True if dummy, False if operational.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: The functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting. Represents business functions such as R&D, manufacturing, sales, marketing, or administration.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The primary geographic region or market that this profit center serves. Used for regional P&L reporting and market access strategy.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node
attributes.description: The node identifier in the profit center standard hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting and aggregation of P&L across organizational structures (e.g., by therapeutic area, geography, or product line).

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The primary language code for profit center descriptions and reporting. Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., EN, DE, FR).

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the profit center is locked for posting. When True, no new transactions can be posted to this profit center. Used during period-end close or when deactivating a profit center.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this profit center master record. Used for change tracking and data stewardship accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this profit center master record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11, SOX

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The product line or portfolio grouping associated with this profit center. May represent a brand family, drug class, or commercial franchise.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The business identifier code for the profit center as defined in SAP Controlling. Typically alphanumeric, 4-10 characters. Used across financial reporting, P&L statements, and management accounting.

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: The full business name or description of the profit center. Human-readable label used in financial reports and management dashboards.

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the profit center. Active profit centers are operational and accept postings. Planned profit centers are set up but not yet operational. Closed profit centers are historical and no longer accept postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Master Data Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: The classification type of the profit center indicating its primary business function. Operating profit centers generate revenue; support and corporate profit centers provide shared services.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: The segment classification for external segment reporting per IFRS 8 and US GAAP. Typically represents therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, rare diseases), product line, or geographic market.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments, SAP S/4HANA Segment Reporting

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or short text for the profit center, used in condensed reports and user interfaces where space is limited.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The primary therapeutic area or disease category that this profit center focuses on. Used for portfolio analysis, R&D allocation, and commercial strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neuroscience|infectious_diseases|vaccines|consumer_health|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this profit center master record is valid and can accept financial postings. Supports time-dependent master data changes.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this profit center master record is valid. After this date, no new postings are allowed. Nullable for open-ended validity.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created this profit center master record in the system. Used for audit trail and data governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master record defining all general ledger account codes used across the pharmaceutical enterprise. Captures GL account number, description, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account group, P&L vs balance sheet classification, tax category, reconciliation account indicator, IFRS/US-GAAP mapping, R&D capitalization eligibility flag, and controlling integration settings. Governs financial reporting consistency across all company codes, enabling compliant reporting under multiple accounting standards and supporting pharma-specific accounting requirements (R&D expense vs capitalization, milestone revenue recognition, royalty accruals).

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account record. Primary key for the chart of accounts master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the company code (legal entity) for which this GL account is defined. Chart of accounts can be shared across multiple company codes, but account properties may vary by company code.

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: The hierarchical grouping code that organizes GL accounts into logical categories for reporting and analysis (e.g., 'RDEXP' for R&D expenses, 'COGS' for cost of goods sold).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Account Group Configuration

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the GL account, providing clear business context for the account's purpose (e.g., 'Research and Development Expenses - Preclinical Studies').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or label for the GL account used in reports and user interfaces where space is limited.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account. Active accounts are available for posting; inactive accounts are retained for historical reporting only; blocked accounts prevent new postings; pending closure accounts are scheduled for deactivation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Governance

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the GL account, determining its placement in financial statements and its normal balance (debit or credit).
attributes.references: IFRS Framework, US GAAP ASC 210, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: balance_sheet_classification
attributes.description: For balance sheet accounts, specifies whether the account is classified as current or non-current asset/liability, or equity. Not applicable for P&L accounts.

attributes.name: controlling_area_integration
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is integrated with the Controlling module for cost center, internal order, and profitability analysis postings.

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: For accounts that are cost elements, specifies whether it is a primary cost element (posted from FI) or secondary cost element (used for internal allocations). Not applicable if cost_element_indicator is false.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Types

attributes.name: cost_element_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this GL account is also defined as a cost element in Controlling (CO) module, enabling cost center and internal order postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Configuration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account master record was originally created in the system. Required for regulatory audit trails and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Specifies which currency perspective this account primarily operates in: local currency, group currency, hard currency, index-based currency, or global company currency. Supports multi-currency pharmaceutical operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Configuration, IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: financial_statement_category
attributes.description: Indicates which primary financial statement this account appears on: balance sheet (statement of financial position), profit and loss (income statement), cash flow statement, or statement of retained earnings.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1, US GAAP ASC 205, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The business function or department this account is primarily associated with (e.g., 'R&D', 'Manufacturing', 'Commercial', 'Regulatory Affairs'). Used for functional cost analysis in pharmaceutical operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Functional Area, Pharmaceutical Industry Best Practices

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: The unique account code used to identify this GL account across all financial transactions. Typically a 6-10 digit numeric code structured by account type and category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts, IFRS, US GAAP

attributes.name: ifrs_mapping_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Mapping Code
attributes.description: The IFRS financial statement line item code that this account maps to for IFRS-compliant financial reporting. Enables parallel accounting and consolidated reporting under IFRS standards.
attributes.references: IFRS Financial Statement Presentation Standards, SAP S/4HANA Parallel Accounting

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether individual line item details are stored and can be displayed for this account. Essential for accounts requiring detailed transaction audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Display Configuration

attributes.name: milestone_revenue_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this revenue account is used for milestone-based revenue recognition common in pharmaceutical licensing and collaboration agreements (e.g., regulatory approval milestones, sales milestones).
attributes.references: IFRS 15, US GAAP ASC 606, Pharmaceutical Revenue Recognition Guidance

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this GL account master record. Essential for change tracking and compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account master record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and governance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account uses open item management, requiring line items to be explicitly cleared (e.g., for receivables, payables, clearing accounts).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Open Item Management

attributes.name: pl_classification
attributes.description: For income statement accounts, specifies the detailed classification within the P&L structure (operating vs non-operating, revenue vs expense categories). Not applicable for balance sheet accounts.

attributes.name: posting_block_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether direct postings to this account are currently blocked. When true, the account can only receive postings through specific controlled processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Controls

attributes.name: profit_center_update_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether postings to this account automatically update profit center accounting, enabling segment reporting and profitability analysis by therapeutic area or product line.

attributes.name: rd_capitalization_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Research and Development (R&D) Capitalization Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether costs posted to this account are eligible for capitalization as intangible assets under development (e.g., post-IND development costs). Critical for pharmaceutical R&D accounting under IAS 38 and ASC 730.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 38, US GAAP ASC 730, Pharmaceutical R&D Accounting Policies

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that summarizes detailed transactions from subsidiary ledgers such as Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, or Asset Accounting.

attributes.name: royalty_accrual_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is used for royalty expense accruals or royalty revenue recognition, common in pharmaceutical licensing arrangements and patent agreements.
attributes.references: IFRS 15, US GAAP ASC 606, Pharmaceutical Licensing Accounting

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: The default sort key used for organizing and displaying line items within this account (e.g., by posting date, document number, reference). Improves usability for high-volume accounts.

attributes.name: subledger_type
attributes.description: For reconciliation accounts, specifies which subledger this account reconciles (AR, AP, Fixed Assets, MM). Not applicable for non-reconciliation accounts.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax treatment category for this account, determining how transactions posted to this account are handled for tax reporting purposes (e.g., 'VAT_INPUT', 'VAT_OUTPUT', 'NON_TAXABLE', 'EXEMPT').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: us_gaap_mapping_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP) Mapping Code
attributes.description: The US GAAP financial statement line item code that this account maps to for US GAAP-compliant financial reporting. Supports dual reporting requirements for pharmaceutical companies with US operations.
attributes.references: US GAAP Accounting Standards Codification, SAP S/4HANA Parallel Accounting

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account becomes active and available for transaction postings. Supports time-dependent account structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this GL account remains active. Null indicates no planned end date. Used for account lifecycle management and historical cutover scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this GL account master record. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: material
products.description: Central master record for all materials managed within the pharmaceutical enterprise including APIs (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), excipients, drug substances (DS), drug products (DP), finished dosage forms (FDF), packaging materials, laboratory reagents, and raw materials. Captures material number, INN (International Nonproprietary Name), USAN, material type, base unit of measure, material group, gross/net weight, shelf life, storage conditions, hazardous material classification, GMP classification, and cross-system identifiers (SAP material number, LIMS material code). SSOT for material identity across SAP MM, LIMS, and MES.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Primary key for material

attributes.name: atc_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: Pharmaceutical materials classified by WHO ATC system. New FK atc_classification_id → atc_classification.masterdata_atc_classification_id. Remove atc_code as redundant.

attributes.name: inn_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: Materials reference INN registry for active pharmaceutical ingredients. New FK inn_registry_id → inn_registry.masterdata_inn_registry_id. Remove inn_name as redundant.

attributes.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.ndc_code. Business justification: Marketed pharmaceutical products have NDC codes. New FK ndc_code_id → ndc_code.masterdata_ndc_code_id. Remove ndc_code (STRING) as redundant.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Materials measured in standard units of measure. New FK base_uom_id → unit_of_measure.uom_id for base UOM. Remove base_unit_of_measure (STRING) as redundant. Note: weight_unit and volume_unit remain a

attributes.name: batch_managed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires batch-level tracking and management for traceability and quality control purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by CAS to every chemical substance, used for regulatory submissions and scientific documentation.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: DEA schedule classification for controlled substances. Schedule I-V indicate varying levels of control requirements; non-controlled materials are not regulated under DEA.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308 - Schedules of Controlled Substances

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the material is discontinued and no longer available for new orders or production, supporting product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the material master record becomes active and available for use in business transactions.

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating the level of GMP control required for this material. GMP-critical materials require the highest level of quality control and documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice for Finished Pharmaceuticals

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the material including packaging, expressed in the weight unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Weight Fields

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Classification of hazardous materials per GHS (Globally Harmonized System) or DOT hazard classes for transportation and safety management.
attributes.references: UN GHS - Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling

attributes.name: hazardous_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is classified as hazardous per regulatory definitions, requiring special handling and documentation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material master record was last updated, supporting audit trail and change management requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

attributes.name: lims_material_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Material Code
attributes.description: Material identifier used in the LIMS system for laboratory testing, quality control, and certificate of analysis tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's unique part number or catalog number for the material, used for procurement and supplier management.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short textual description of the material for identification and display purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Master Data Standards

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Hierarchical grouping code for materials used for procurement, planning, and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group Hierarchy

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the material across the enterprise. Typically the SAP material number used as the primary external reference code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Master Data Standards

attributes.name: material_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material indicating its availability for use in operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Status Management

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material by its role in pharmaceutical operations. API = Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient, DS = Drug Substance, DP = Drug Product, FDF = Finished Dosage Form. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: API|EXCIPIENT|DRUG_SUBSTANCE|DRUG_PRODUCT|FINISHED_DOSAGE_FORM|PACKAGING_PRIMARY|PACKAGING_SECONDARY|RAW_MATERIAL|REAGENT|REFERENCE_STANDARD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

attributes.name: mes_material_code
attributes.description: Material identifier used in the MES system for production tracking, batch records, and manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
