attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required at goods receipt or before use in production, ensuring adequate time for processing and distribution.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the material excluding packaging, expressed in the weight unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Weight Fields

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is obtained: externally purchased, internally manufactured, or both. Consignment indicates vendor-owned inventory.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Procurement Type Configuration

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether incoming goods or production batches of this material require quality inspection before release for use.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart E - Control of Components and Drug Product Containers

attributes.name: retest_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days after which stored material must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications, applicable to APIs and intermediates.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

attributes.name: serial_number_profile
attributes.description: Configuration profile defining serial number management requirements for the material, used for unit-level traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the material from manufacturing date to expiration, expressed in days. Critical for GMP compliance and inventory management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for material storage including temperature range, humidity, and light protection requirements per stability data.

attributes.name: temperature_sensitive_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires temperature-controlled storage and transportation (cold chain management).
attributes.references: WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 - Temperature Control Guidelines

attributes.name: usan_name
attributes.description: United States Adopted Name for pharmaceutical substances as designated by the USAN Council.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Physical volume of the material, used for storage and transportation planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Volume Fields

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume field.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross and net weight fields.

products.name: plant
products.description: Master record for manufacturing plants, packaging sites, distribution centers, and R&D facilities within the pharmaceutical enterprise. Captures plant code, plant name, plant type (manufacturing, packaging, distribution, R&D, QC laboratory), address, country, GMP certification status, regulatory authority registrations (FDA establishment registration, EMA site number), capacity class, and SAP plant code. Supports manufacturing network planning, regulatory site management, and supply chain operations.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plant facility. Primary key.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Plants located in countries for regulatory compliance (GMP, FDA, EMA). New FK country_id → country.country_id. Existing country_code (STRING) remains for code reference.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Plants owned/operated by legal entities. New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Plants are operational facilities that should be part of the organizational hierarchy. Each plant belongs to an organizational unit (e.g., 'Manufacturing Operations', 'R&D Facilities'). This enables o

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the plant facility including building number and street name.
attributes.references: ISO 3166 Country Codes, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as suite, floor, or building designation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166 Country Codes, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: annual_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum annual production capacity of the plant expressed in standard units (e.g., kilograms of API, millions of dosage units), used for capacity planning and network design.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Production Planning, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: capacity_class
attributes.description: Classification of the plant's production or operational capacity relative to other facilities in the network, used for supply chain planning and network optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Master Data, Supply Chain Planning Standards

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the annual capacity metric (e.g., kg, liters, dosage units, batches) aligned with the plant's primary output type.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, SAP S/4HANA Unit of Measure

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the plant facility is located.
attributes.references: ISO 3166 Country Codes, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the plant facility was officially commissioned and began operational activities.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Primary cost center code assigned to the plant facility for cost accounting and financial controlling purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the plant master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dea_registration_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number for facilities handling controlled substances, required for manufacturing, distribution, or research involving scheduled drugs.

attributes.name: ema_site_number
attributes.description: Unique site identifier assigned by the European Medicines Agency for manufacturing and testing facilities within the European Economic Area.
attributes.references: EMA Manufacturing and Import Authorisation Guidelines

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact address for the plant facility for official communications and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_status
attributes.description: Current status of environmental operating permits required for pharmaceutical manufacturing operations at the plant facility.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Regulations, EU Industrial Emissions Directive

attributes.name: fda_establishment_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Establishment Identifier
attributes.description: Unique registration number assigned by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for facilities engaged in the manufacture, preparation, propagation, compounding, or processing of drug products.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 207 Registration of Producers of Drugs and Listing of Drugs in Commercial Distribution

attributes.name: gmp_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the plant received its current Good Manufacturing Practice certification from the relevant regulatory authority.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 210, 21 CFR Part 211, PIC/S GMP Guide

attributes.name: gmp_certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the plant's Good Manufacturing Practice certification, indicating compliance with pharmaceutical manufacturing quality standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 210, 21 CFR Part 211, EMA GMP Guidelines, PIC/S GMP Guide

attributes.name: gmp_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the plant's current Good Manufacturing Practice certification expires and requires renewal or re-inspection.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 210, 21 CFR Part 211, PIC/S GMP Guide

attributes.name: iso_certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the plant's ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification or other relevant ISO certifications (e.g., ISO 13485 for medical devices).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, ISO 13485 Medical Devices

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection by FDA, EMA, or other competent authority at the plant facility.
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Guidelines, EMA GMP Inspection Programme

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the plant master record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the plant facility in decimal degrees, used for logistics planning and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: lims_system
attributes.description: Name and version of the Laboratory Information Management System used at the plant for sample tracking, testing, and Certificate of Analysis generation.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the plant facility in decimal degrees, used for logistics planning and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: manufacturing_execution_system
attributes.description: Name and version of the Manufacturing Execution System used at the plant for batch execution, electronic batch records, and production tracking.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Anticipated or scheduled date for the next regulatory inspection based on inspection frequency requirements and risk classification.
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Guidelines, EMA GMP Inspection Programme

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the plant facility indicating whether it is actively producing, temporarily offline, or permanently closed.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the plant facility including country and area codes.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the plant facility, typically used in SAP S/4HANA and other operational systems for cross-system reference.

attributes.name: plant_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the plant facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in official documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Establishment Registration, EMA Site Registration

attributes.name: plant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the plant facility based on its primary operational function within the pharmaceutical enterprise.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the plant facility address used for mail delivery and geographic reference.

attributes.name: quality_management_system
attributes.description: Name and version of the Quality Management System software platform used at the plant (e.g., MasterControl, TrackWise, Veeva Vault QualityDocs).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character plant code used in SAP S/4HANA ERP system for materials management, production planning, and financial controlling.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the plant facility is located.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the plant facility location, used for scheduling, shift planning, and cross-site coordination.

products.name: storage_location
products.description: Master record for storage locations within pharmaceutical manufacturing and distribution plants. Covers warehouses, cold rooms (2-8°C, -20°C, -80°C), controlled substance vaults (DEA Schedule II-V), quarantine zones, QC sampling areas, returns processing areas, and hazardous material storage. Captures storage location code, plant assignment, temperature range, humidity control requirements, DEA license number (for controlled substances), GMP zone classification (Grade A-D), GDP compliance status, capacity in storage units, and WMS integration flag. Critical for batch traceability, cold-chain integrity, controlled substance accountability, and regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the storage location within the pharmaceutical manufacturing and distribution network. Primary key for the storage location master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Master Data Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: Storage locations incur operational costs (utilities, climate control, labor, maintenance) that must be allocated to cost centers for management accounting. This is a standard cost allocation relation

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or distribution plant to which this storage location belongs. Links storage location to the organizational hierarchy for GMP compliance and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the physical address for this storage location. Includes building number, street name, and suite/unit if applicable. Required for GDP traceability and regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines PIC/S, SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Master

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the physical address for this storage location. Optional field for additional address details such as building name or department.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines PIC/S, SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Master

attributes.name: capacity_storage_units
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of this location measured in storage units (pallets, bins, cubic meters, or location-specific unit). Used for warehouse space planning and inventory optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the capacity_storage_units field. Standardizes capacity reporting across heterogeneous storage types.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure Master

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where this storage location is physically located. Required for regulatory reporting and distribution planning.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines PIC/S, SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Master

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the storage location. Examples: USA, GBR, DEU, JPN, CHN. Required for multi-country regulatory reporting and GDP compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location master record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: dea_license_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number for storage locations authorized to hold controlled substances (Schedule II-V). Format: 2 letters + 7 digits. Required for controlled substance accountability and regulatory inspections. Null for non-controlled substance storage.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 1301 DEA Registration, DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: dea_schedule_authorized
attributes.description: Highest DEA controlled substance schedule this storage location is authorized to hold. Schedule II requires vault-level security. Not applicable for non-controlled substance storage.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 1301 DEA Registration, 21 CFR Part 1304 Records and Reports

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this storage location was decommissioned or permanently closed. Null for active storage locations. Used for historical reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this storage location became operational and available for goods movements. Marks the beginning of the storage locations lifecycle in the master data system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: gdp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location meets GDP requirements for pharmaceutical distribution. True for qualified distribution centers with temperature mapping, security, and traceability controls. False for non-GDP locations.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines PIC/S, EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

attributes.name: gmp_zone_classification
attributes.description: Cleanroom classification per EU GMP Annex 1 or ISO 14644. Grade A for aseptic processing, Grade D for general manufacturing. Unclassified for non-GMP warehouses. Drives gowning, environmental monitoring, and personnel flow requirements.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 1 Manufacture of Sterile Medicinal Products, ISO 14644 Cleanroom Standards

attributes.name: hazmat_storage_class
attributes.description: Classification of hazardous materials authorized for storage per OSHA and DOT regulations. Determines segregation requirements, fire suppression systems, and emergency response protocols. Non-hazardous for general storage.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 Flammable Liquids, DOT 49 CFR Part 172 Hazardous Materials Table

attributes.name: humidity_max_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage for this storage location. Excursions may impact product stability and require OOT investigation. Null if humidity control is not required.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, 21 CFR Part 211.142 Warehousing Procedures

attributes.name: humidity_min_percent
attributes.description: Minimum allowable relative humidity percentage for this storage location. Required for hygroscopic API and moisture-sensitive drug products. Null if humidity control is not required.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, 21 CFR Part 211.142 Warehousing Procedures

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location master record was last updated. Tracks change history for audit trail and data stewardship.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: last_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent qualification or requalification of this storage location per CSV and GMP requirements. Includes temperature mapping, humidity validation, and security system testing. Drives requalification scheduling.
attributes.references: GAMP 5 CSV Guidelines, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs, 21 CFR Part 211 GMP Requirements

attributes.name: next_qualification_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic requalification of this storage location. Typically annual or biennial based on risk assessment. Overdue qualifications may trigger storage location blocking.
attributes.references: GAMP 5 CSV Guidelines, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for this storage location. Required for logistics planning and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines PIC/S, SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Master

attributes.name: quarantine_zone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated as a quarantine zone for materials pending QC release, under investigation, or rejected. True for quarantine areas, false for released goods storage.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.80 General Requirements for Components, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs

attributes.name: returns_processing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for processing returned goods, including customer returns, expired products, and recalls. True for returns processing areas requiring segregation and disposition workflows.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.204 Returned Drug Products, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

attributes.name: sampling_location_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for QC sampling activities. True for sampling areas where materials are temporarily held for sample collection per sampling plans.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.84 Testing and Approval or Rejection of Components

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Physical security classification for this storage location. High for DEA vaults and high-value products requiring 24/7 surveillance, access control, and intrusion detection. Medium for controlled access areas. Standard for general warehouses.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 1301.71 DEA Security Requirements, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

attributes.name: segregation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials in this storage location must be physically segregated from other materials due to cross-contamination risk, regulatory requirements, or product incompatibility. True for quarantine zones, controlled substances, and hazmat.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.176 Penicillin Contamination, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province where this storage location is physically located. Required for state-level regulatory reporting and DEA registration.
attributes.references: GDP Guidelines PIC/S, 21 CFR Part 1301 DEA Registration

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location. Alphanumeric code used across SAP WM, LIMS, and MES systems for warehouse management and batch traceability. Typically 4-10 characters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: storage_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the storage location. Examples: Cold Room 2-8C Building A, DEA Vault Schedule II, Quarantine Zone QC Lab 3, Hazmat Storage Flammables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: storage_location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Blocked status prevents goods movements pending CAPA resolution or requalification. Under qualification indicates validation in progress per CSV requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master, GAMP 5 CSV Guidelines

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location by functional purpose. Determines applicable GMP, GDP, and DEA controls. Critical for regulatory inspection readiness and batch traceability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warehouse|cold_room|freezer|controlled_substance_vault|quarantine_zone|qc_sampling_area|returns_processing|hazmat_storage|bulk_storage|finished_goods|raw_material|packaging_material|work_in_process — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q7 GMP for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, 21 CFR Part 211 GMP Requirements

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature for this storage location in degrees Celsius. Excursions beyond this threshold trigger deviation investigations and potential batch impact assessments.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature for this storage location in degrees Celsius. Critical for cold-chain integrity and stability compliance. Examples: 2.0 for refrigerated, -25.0 for freezer, -85.0 for ultra-low freezer.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

attributes.name: temperature_monitoring_system
attributes.description: Type of temperature monitoring system deployed at this storage location. Continuous automated systems provide real-time alerts for excursions. Periodic manual monitoring uses data loggers with batch review. Not monitored for ambient storage.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, GDP Guidelines PIC/S, 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: wms_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is integrated with a WMS for automated goods movements, bin management, and real-time inventory tracking. True for WMS-managed locations, false for manual locations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Extended Warehouse Management

products.name: unit_of_measure
products.description: Reference master for units of measure used across pharmaceutical operations including mass (mg, g, kg), volume (mL, L), concentration (mg/mL, %w/v), potency (IU, mcg), packaging (vial, ampoule, blister, tablet, capsule), and analytical units (ppm, ppb, CFU/mL). Captures UOM code, UOM description, UOM category, ISO unit code, SAP internal UOM, conversion factors to SI base units, and applicable regulatory standards. Ensures consistent measurement across SAP, LIMS, and MES.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Unit of Measure (MM) / ISO 80000

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Primary key for unit_of_measure

attributes.name: applicable_material_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SAP material types or substance categories for which this UOM is applicable. Examples: API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient), DS (Drug Substance), DP (Drug Product), FDF (Finished Dosage Form), excipient, raw material, packaging material. Guides UOM selection during material master creation and transaction processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) Material Type Configuration, ICH Q7 API GMP

attributes.name: conversion_group
attributes.description: Logical grouping of UOMs that can be converted among each other. UOMs within the same conversion group share a common dimension and can be mathematically converted (e.g., mass group: mg, g, kg; volume group: mL, L). Used to enforce conversion rules and prevent invalid cross-dimensional conversions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA UOM Conversion Configuration, ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this unit of measure master record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field supporting regulatory compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Computed data quality score (0.00 to 100.00) reflecting completeness, accuracy, consistency, and conformance of this UOM master record to MDM data quality rules. Supports proactive data quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) Data Quality Framework, ISO 8000 Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this UOM master record originates. Examples: SAP S/4HANA MM, LIMS LabWare, MES, Veeva Vault QualityDocs. Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation in the lakehouse architecture.
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) Data Lineage Standards, Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: decimal_precision
attributes.description: Number of decimal places typically used when recording measurements in this unit. Guides data entry validation and reporting formats. Example: 3 for milligrams (0.001), 6 for micrograms (0.000001), 0 for tablets (whole units).
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures, USP General Chapter <1058> Analytical Instrument Qualification

attributes.name: dimension_type
attributes.description: The fundamental physical dimension represented by this unit of measure per dimensional analysis. Aligns with SI base quantities and derived quantities. Used for dimensional consistency validation in formulation calculations and process parameter specifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: length|mass|time|temperature|amount_of_substance|electric_current|luminous_intensity|area|volume|velocity|acceleration|force|pressure|energy|power|frequency|dimensionless — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units - General, BIPM SI Brochure

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this unit of measure is no longer valid for new transactions. Null for currently active UOMs. Supports phase-out of deprecated units while preserving historical data integrity.
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) Temporal Data Standards, Data Retention Policies

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this unit of measure becomes valid and available for use in operational systems. Supports temporal master data management and regulatory change management (e.g., adoption of new pharmacopeial standards).
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) Temporal Data Standards, ICH M4 Common Technical Document

attributes.name: is_base_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Base Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is the base unit for its material or substance in SAP Material Master. Base UOMs serve as the reference for all alternative UOM conversions within a material. True if base UOM, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) Material Master Configuration

attributes.name: is_commercial_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Commercial Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used for commercial transactions, sales orders, and distribution (SAP SD module). Commercial UOMs may differ from manufacturing or laboratory UOMs. True if used in commercial contexts, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) Configuration, GDP Good Distribution Practice

attributes.name: is_laboratory_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Laboratory Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in laboratory testing, quality control, and LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System). Laboratory UOMs support analytical testing, stability studies, and Certificate of Analysis (CoA) reporting. True if used in laboratory contexts, False otherwise.
attributes.references: LIMS Configuration Standards, ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures, USP General Chapters, GLP Good Laboratory Practice

attributes.name: is_manufacturing_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Manufacturing Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in manufacturing operations, batch production, and MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Manufacturing UOMs align with production planning (PP) and shop floor data collection. True if used in manufacturing, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Production Planning (PP) Configuration, cGMP Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH Q7 Good Manufacturing Practice for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API)

attributes.name: iso_unit_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Unit Code
attributes.description: Standardized unit code per ISO 80000 and UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20. Enables interoperability across international regulatory submissions (eCTD) and supply chain systems. Examples: GRM (gram), KGM (kilogram), MLT (milliliter), LTR (liter).
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this unit of measure master record. Supports change control and data stewardship accountability per GxP requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, GAMP 5 Good Automated Manufacturing Practice, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this unit of measure master record was last modified. Updated with each change to support audit trail and change control documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

attributes.name: mdm_approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this unit of measure within the MDM governance process. Draft records are under construction; pending_review records await data steward approval; approved records are released for operational use; rejected records require rework. Enforces data quality gates before UOM activation.
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) Governance Framework, Data Stewardship Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

attributes.name: regulatory_standard
attributes.description: Citation of the regulatory or pharmacopeial standard that defines or governs the use of this unit of measure. Examples: USP <1> Injections, Ph. Eur. 2.9.40 Uniformity of Dosage Units, FDA 21 CFR Part 210 Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH Q6A Specifications. Supports compliance traceability for regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, EMA Guidelines, ICH Quality Guidelines, USP General Chapters, Ph. Eur. Monographs

attributes.name: sap_internal_uom
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA internal unit of measure code used in Material Master (MM), Production Planning (PP), Quality Management (QM), and Warehouse Management (WM) modules. Maps external UOM codes to SAP-specific representations for ERP transaction processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) Configuration Guide

attributes.name: si_conversion_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: International System of Units (SI) Conversion Factor
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier to convert this UOM to its SI base unit. Enables automated unit conversion across systems. Example: for milligram to kilogram, factor is 0.000001; for milliliter to liter, factor is 0.001. Null for dimensionless units.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, NIST Special Publication 811

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit of measure in the master data repository. Active UOMs are available for use in transactions; inactive UOMs are retained for historical data but not selectable for new entries; deprecated UOMs are phased out per regulatory or business changes; pending_approval UOMs await MDM governance review before activation.
attributes.references: Master Data Management (MDM) Governance Framework, Data Stewardship Procedures

attributes.name: uom_category
attributes.description: Classification of the unit of measure by measurement type. Segments UOMs into functional categories for pharmaceutical operations: mass (mg, g, kg), volume (mL, L), concentration (mg/mL, %w/v), potency (IU, mcg), packaging (vial, ampoule, blister, tablet, capsule), analytical (ppm, ppb, CFU/mL), time (hour, day), temperature (Celsius, Fahrenheit), pressure (bar, psi), count (each, piece). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mass|volume|concentration|potency|packaging|analytical|time|temperature|pressure|count — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, ICH Q6A Specifications

attributes.name: uom_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the unit of measure. Used as the business identifier across SAP S/4HANA, LIMS, and MES systems. Examples: MG, G, KG, ML, L, IU, MCG, PPM, PPB, CFU.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, SAP Material Management (MM) UOM Master

attributes.name: uom_description
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the unit of measure. Provides human-readable explanation of the UOM code. Examples: Milligram, Gram, Kilogram, Milliliter, Liter, International Unit, Microgram, Parts Per Million, Parts Per Billion, Colony Forming Unit per Milliliter.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this unit of measure master record. Supports audit trail and data stewardship accountability per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act, GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on unit_of_measure (base_unit_of_measure_id)

products.name: country
products.description: Reference master for countries and territories relevant to pharmaceutical operations, regulatory submissions, and commercial activities. Captures ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, country name, region, sub-region, regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA), ICH region membership, currency code, language, and pharmaceutical market classification (regulated, semi-regulated, unregulated). Supports regulatory submission routing, market access planning, and supply chain geography.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the country or territory record. Primary key for the country master data product.

attributes.name: clinical_trial_registration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country mandates registration of clinical trials in a public registry (e.g., ClinicalTrials.gov, EU Clinical Trials Register, CTRI India) before trial initiation. True if registration required, False otherwise. Impacts CTMS workflows and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E8, FDA 21 CFR Part 312, EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule_system
attributes.description: Name of the controlled substance classification system used in the country (e.g., DEA Schedules I-V for USA, UK Misuse of Drugs Act Classes A/B/C, Japan Narcotics and Psychotropics Control Law). Determines manufacturing, storage, distribution, and prescribing requirements for controlled APIs and drug products. Impacts supply chain security and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308, UN Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Official English name of the country or territory as recognized by the United Nations and used in regulatory submissions, commercial documentation, and reporting (e.g., United States of America, United Kingdom, Japan, China, Germany).

attributes.name: country_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the country for pharmaceutical business activities. Active: normal operations permitted. Inactive: no current operations or market presence. Restricted: limited operations due to regulatory or business constraints. Sanctioned: operations prohibited due to international sanctions or trade restrictions. Impacts supply chain routing, clinical trial site selection, and commercial activities.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this country master data record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance (21 CFR Part 11 electronic records).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the country's official currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY). Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO modules for financial transactions, pricing, revenue recognition, and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: data_privacy_regulation
attributes.description: Name of the primary data privacy and protection regulation applicable in the country (e.g., GDPR for EU, HIPAA for USA, LGPD for Brazil, PDPA for Singapore). Governs handling of patient data in clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, and commercial activities. Critical for EDC system configuration, eTMF management, and data transfer agreements.

attributes.name: distribution_license_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a separate wholesale distribution license or GDP certification is required to distribute pharmaceutical products within the country. True if distribution license required, False otherwise. Impacts supply chain partner qualification and logistics planning.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this country master data record is effective and valid for use in operational systems, regulatory submissions, and commercial transactions. Supports temporal master data management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this country master data record is no longer valid for use. Null if the record is currently active with no planned expiration. Used for managing country code changes, territory splits, or operational discontinuation.

attributes.name: gmp_inspection_authority
attributes.description: Name of the authority responsible for conducting GMP inspections of pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities within the country (may differ from the primary regulatory authority in some jurisdictions). Critical for manufacturing site qualification, PAI scheduling, and quality compliance.

attributes.name: hta_body_name
attributes.description: Name of the national or regional health technology assessment body that evaluates clinical and economic value of new medicines for reimbursement decisions (e.g., NICE for UK, G-BA for Germany, PBAC for Australia, CADTH for Canada, HAS for France). Null if no formal HTA process exists.

attributes.name: ich_region_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Region Membership Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is a member of an ICH region (USA, EU, Japan, Canada, Switzerland). ICH membership determines applicability of harmonized technical requirements for pharmaceutical registration (CTD/eCTD format, stability testing, quality guidelines). True if ICH member, False otherwise.

attributes.name: ich_region_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Region Name
attributes.description: Name of the ICH region to which the country belongs, if applicable. Used to determine which ICH guidelines and harmonized standards apply to regulatory submissions and CMC documentation.

attributes.name: iso_alpha_2_code
attributes.description: Two-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard. Used for regulatory submissions, labeling, and system integrations (e.g., US, GB, JP, CN, DE).

attributes.name: iso_alpha_3_code
attributes.description: Three-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 standard. Used in eCTD submissions, regulatory documents, and SAP S/4HANA master data (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, CHN, DEU).

attributes.name: iso_numeric_code
attributes.description: Three-digit numeric country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 numeric standard. Used in systems requiring numeric-only identifiers (e.g., 840 for USA, 826 for GBR, 392 for JPN).

attributes.name: market_access_tier
attributes.description: Commercial prioritization tier for market access and launch planning. Tier 1: high-value markets with established reimbursement frameworks and large patient populations (e.g., USA, Germany, Japan). Tier 2: significant markets with moderate access complexity. Tier 3: smaller markets or those with challenging reimbursement. Emerging: developing markets with growth potential. Drives commercial strategy, HEOR investment, and launch sequencing.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this country master data record. Supports audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this country master data record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: patent_filing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the national intellectual property office responsible for patent applications and grants (e.g., USPTO, EPO, JPO, CNIPA, UKIPO). Used for tracking patent filings, patent term extensions, and exclusivity periods for NCEs and NBEs.

attributes.name: pharmaceutical_market_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the country's pharmaceutical regulatory maturity and market structure. Regulated markets have stringent GMP, GCP, and pharmacovigilance requirements (e.g., USA, EU, Japan). Semi-Regulated markets have evolving frameworks. Emerging markets have developing regulatory infrastructure. Unregulated markets have minimal oversight. Drives market access strategy, clinical trial site selection, and supply chain compliance requirements.

attributes.name: pharmacovigilance_requirement_level
attributes.description: Classification of the country's pharmacovigilance and adverse event reporting requirements. Stringent: mandatory ICSR reporting, SUSAR expedited reporting, periodic safety update reports (e.g., USA, EU, Japan). Moderate: ICSR reporting required with longer timelines. Basic: minimal AE reporting. None: no formal PV requirements. Drives Argus Safety configuration and safety reporting workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E2A/E2B/E2D/E2E, FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP

attributes.name: pics_member_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S) Member Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country's regulatory authority is a member of PIC/S, enabling mutual recognition of GMP inspections and reducing duplicate inspections for manufacturing sites. True if PIC/S member, False otherwise.

attributes.name: primary_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the country's primary official language (e.g., en, ja, zh, de, fr). Used for labeling requirements, patient information leaflets, regulatory submission language, and Veeva PromoMats localization.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: High-level geographic region classification based on UN M49 standard. Used for regional sales reporting, supply chain planning, and market access strategy segmentation.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or abbreviation for the primary regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA). Used in Veeva Vault RIM, RIMS systems, and regulatory submission workflows.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary national regulatory authority responsible for pharmaceutical product approvals, post-market surveillance, and GMP inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA, Health Canada, TGA, Anvisa). Critical for routing regulatory submissions and managing compliance obligations.

attributes.name: reimbursement_framework_type
attributes.description: Description of the country's pharmaceutical reimbursement and pricing framework (e.g., government-negotiated pricing, health technology assessment (HTA) required, free pricing, reference pricing, value-based agreements). Impacts pricing strategy, market access timelines, and HEOR evidence requirements.

attributes.name: serialization_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country mandates unique serialization and track-and-trace for pharmaceutical products to prevent counterfeiting (e.g., EU FMD, US DSCSA, China NMPA serialization, South Korea PMDA serialization). True if serialization required, False otherwise. Drives packaging line configuration and supply chain system requirements.
attributes.references: EU FMD, US DSCSA, GS1 Standards

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Commonly used short name for the country or territory, used in user interfaces, reports, and operational systems (e.g., United States, UK, Japan, China, Germany).

attributes.name: sub_region
attributes.description: Sub-region classification within the broader region (e.g., Northern America, Western Europe, Eastern Asia, South-Eastern Asia, Southern Asia). Used for granular market segmentation and supply chain optimization.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this country master data record. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.

products.name: atc_classification
products.description: Reference master for the WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system used to classify pharmaceutical substances by organ/system and therapeutic, pharmacological, and chemical properties. Captures ATC code at all five levels (anatomical main group, therapeutic subgroup, pharmacological subgroup, chemical subgroup, chemical substance), ATC level description, DDD (Defined Daily Dose), DDD unit, and administration route. Serves as the global standard for drug classification across regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, and commercial analytics.

attributes.name: atc_classification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for atc_classification

attributes.name: inn_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: ATC level 5 codes reference INN substances. New FK inn_registry_id → inn_registry.masterdata_inn_registry_id. Remove inn_name as redundant.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Defined Daily Dose (DDD) measured in standard units of measure. New FK ddd_uom_id → unit_of_measure.uom_id. Remove ddd_unit (STRING) as redundant.

attributes.name: administration_route
attributes.description: The route by which the drug is administered: O=Oral, P=Parenteral, R=Rectal, V=Vaginal, N=Nasal, Implant=Implant, Inhal=Inhalation, Instill=Instillation, SL=Sublingual/Buccal, TD=Transdermal. Critical for DDD assignment and clinical use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: O|P|R|V|N|Implant|Inhal|Instill|SL|TD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The complete 7-character WHO ATC code representing the full classification hierarchy from anatomical main group to chemical substance level (e.g., A10BA02 for metformin).

attributes.name: atc_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the ATC code: 1=Anatomical main group (1 character), 2=Therapeutic subgroup (3 characters), 3=Pharmacological subgroup (4 characters), 4=Chemical subgroup (5 characters), 5=Chemical substance (7 characters).

attributes.name: atc_level_1_code
attributes.description: First level anatomical main group code (single letter A-V) representing the organ or system on which the drug acts.

attributes.name: atc_level_1_description
attributes.description: Full description of the anatomical main group (e.g., 'Alimentary tract and metabolism', 'Blood and blood forming organs', 'Cardiovascular system').

attributes.name: atc_level_2_code
attributes.description: Second level therapeutic subgroup code (3 characters) representing the therapeutic main group.

attributes.name: atc_level_2_description
attributes.description: Full description of the therapeutic subgroup (e.g., 'Drugs used in diabetes', 'Antithrombotic agents').

attributes.name: atc_level_3_code
attributes.description: Third level pharmacological subgroup code (4 characters) representing the pharmacological or therapeutic subgroup.

attributes.name: atc_level_3_description
attributes.description: Full description of the pharmacological subgroup (e.g., 'Blood glucose lowering drugs, excl. insulins', 'Platelet aggregation inhibitors excl. heparin').

attributes.name: atc_level_4_code
attributes.description: Fourth level chemical subgroup code (5 characters) representing the chemical or therapeutic subgroup.

attributes.name: atc_level_4_description
attributes.description: Full description of the chemical subgroup (e.g., 'Biguanides', 'Adenosine diphosphate (ADP) receptor inhibitors').

attributes.name: atc_level_5_code
attributes.description: Fifth level chemical substance code (7 characters) representing the specific chemical substance or combination.

attributes.name: atc_level_5_description
attributes.description: Full description of the chemical substance, typically the INN (International Nonproprietary Name) or combination name (e.g., 'metformin', 'clopidogrel').
attributes.references: WHO ATC Classification System, WHO INN Programme

attributes.name: atc_note
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to the ATC classification, including usage restrictions, combination product details, or cross-references to related codes.

attributes.name: atc_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ATC code: active=currently in use, inactive=temporarily suspended, withdrawn=permanently removed from WHO ATC index, pending=under review for inclusion, deprecated=superseded by another code.

attributes.name: biosimilar_reference_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this biological substance serves as a reference product for biosimilar development and approval (True) or not (False). Relevant for biologics license applications.
attributes.references: FDA BLA Guidance, EMA Biosimilar Guidelines

attributes.name: combination_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ATC code represents a fixed-dose combination product containing two or more active pharmaceutical ingredients (True) or a single active substance (False).

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.business_glossary_term: DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) Controlled Substance Schedule
attributes.description: The DEA schedule classification for controlled substances: I=High abuse potential no accepted medical use, II=High abuse potential with severe dependence, III=Moderate to low abuse potential, IV=Low abuse potential, V=Lowest abuse potential, Not Controlled=Not a controlled substance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ATC classification record was first created in the master data system.

attributes.name: ddd_value
attributes.description: The assumed average maintenance dose per day for a drug used for its main indication in adults, expressed as a numeric value. Used for drug utilization studies and pharmacoeconomic analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ATC classification record was last updated or modified in the master data system.

attributes.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: MDM (Master Data Management) Golden Record Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is the master golden record (True) or a duplicate/historical version (False) in the enterprise master data management system.

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substance has received orphan drug designation from FDA or EMA for treatment of rare diseases affecting small patient populations (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: FDA Orphan Drug Act, EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this ATC classification record was loaded (e.g., SAP MM, Veeva Vault RIM, external WHO ATC reference feed).

attributes.name: therapeutic_equivalence_group
attributes.description: Grouping code for substances considered therapeutically equivalent or interchangeable for the same indication, used in formulary management and substitution policies.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ATC classification record becomes effective and valid for use in regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance reporting, and commercial analytics.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this ATC classification record remains valid. Null indicates the record is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: who_publication_year
attributes.description: The year this ATC code was officially published or last updated by the WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology.

attributes.name: parent_atc_classification_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on atc_classification (parent_atc_classification_id)

products.name: masterdata_ndc_code
products.description: Reference master for National Drug Codes (NDC) assigned to pharmaceutical products marketed in the United States. Captures NDC number (10-digit or 11-digit format), labeler code, product code, package code, proprietary name, nonproprietary name (INN/USAN), dosage form, route of administration, strength, labeler name, marketing status, application number (NDA/ANDA/BLA), and DEA schedule. Serves as the US product identifier for commercial, supply chain, and pharmacovigilance operations.
products.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory (21 CFR 207)

attributes.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data National Drug Code (NDC) ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NDC code record in the master data system.

attributes.name: atc_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: NDC products classified by ATC system. New FK atc_classification_id → atc_classification.masterdata_atc_classification_id. Remove atc_code as redundant.

attributes.name: inn_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: NDC codes represent marketed pharmaceutical products in the US, which are based on active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) identified by International Nonproprietary Names (INN). The existing 'nonpro

attributes.name: strength_unit_of_measure_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Strength Unit Of Measure Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: NDC codes have a 'strength' STRING attribute (e.g., '500mg', '10mg/mL') that combines a numeric value and a unit of measure. Best practice is to split this into strength_value (DECIMAL) and strength_u

attributes.name: active_ingredient_count
attributes.description: The number of distinct active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in the drug product. Most products have 1; combination products have 2 or more.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: The FDA application number under which the drug product was approved. Format includes application type prefix (NDA for New Drug Application, ANDA for Abbreviated New Drug Application, BLA for Biologics License Application) followed by 6-digit number.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book

attributes.name: biosimilar_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biological product is a biosimilar (highly similar to an FDA-approved reference biological product). True if biosimilar, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this NDC master data record was first created in the MDM system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of the NDC master data record, used for data stewardship prioritization and reporting.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: The controlled substance schedule classification assigned by the DEA if the drug has abuse potential. CI (Schedule I) through CV (Schedule V), or None for non-controlled substances.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form of the drug product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream, patch). Standardized per FDA dosage form terminology.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this NDC master data record ceases to be effective. Null if the record is currently effective with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this NDC master data record is effective and valid for use in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: end_marketing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug product was discontinued from commercial marketing in the United States. Null if the product is still actively marketed.

attributes.name: interchangeable_biosimilar_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biosimilar product has been designated by the FDA as interchangeable with the reference biological product, allowing pharmacy-level substitution. True if interchangeable, False otherwise.

attributes.name: labeler_code
attributes.description: The first segment of the NDC identifying the labeler (manufacturer, repackager, or distributor) assigned by the FDA. Typically 4 or 5 digits.

attributes.name: labeler_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the company responsible for labeling and marketing the drug product (manufacturer, repackager, or distributor).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this NDC master data record was last updated in the MDM system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: listing_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NDC listing expires or was discontinued in the FDA National Drug Code Directory. Products with expired listings are no longer actively marketed.

attributes.name: marketing_status
attributes.description: The current marketing and distribution status of the drug product in the United States. Indicates whether the product is actively marketed as prescription, over-the-counter, or has been discontinued.

attributes.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NDC record is the authoritative golden record in the Master Data Management system, having passed data quality and stewardship validation. True if golden record, False if duplicate or unvalidated.

attributes.name: ndc_number
attributes.description: The 10-digit or 11-digit National Drug Code assigned by the FDA to uniquely identify a drug product marketed in the United States. Format may be 5-4-1, 5-4-2, 5-3-2, or 4-4-2 depending on labeler, product, and package code segments.

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: The third segment of the NDC identifying the package size and type. Typically 1 or 2 digits.

attributes.name: package_description
attributes.description: A textual description of the package configuration, including quantity, container type, and packaging hierarchy (e.g., '100 TABLET in 1 BOTTLE', '10 BLISTER PACK in 1 CARTON').

attributes.name: pharm_class
attributes.description: The pharmacologic class or mechanism of action (MOA) of the active ingredient, describing how the drug works at the molecular or physiological level.
attributes.references: FDA Pharmacologic Class; FDA Structured Product Labeling

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The second segment of the NDC identifying the specific strength, dosage form, and formulation of the drug product. Typically 3 or 4 digits.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The regulatory classification of the drug product type as defined by the FDA (e.g., Human Prescription Drug, Human OTC Drug, Biological Product, Vaccine).
attributes.value_regex: Human Prescription Drug|Human OTC Drug|Biological Product|Vaccine|Plasma Derivative

attributes.name: proprietary_name
attributes.description: The brand or trade name under which the drug product is marketed (e.g., Lipitor, Advil). May be null for generic products marketed under nonproprietary name only.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the NDC master data record in the MDM system. Active records are available for operational use; Inactive records are deprecated; Pending Review records await steward validation; Archived records are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: rems_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug product is subject to a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) program required by the FDA to ensure that benefits outweigh risks. True if REMS required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: repackager_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the labeler is a repackager (repackages bulk drug product into smaller units) rather than the original manufacturer. True if repackager, False if original manufacturer or distributor.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, subcutaneous, inhalation). Standardized per FDA route terminology.

attributes.name: rx_otc_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug product requires a prescription (Rx) or is available over-the-counter (OTC) without a prescription.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the operational system of record from which this NDC master data was sourced (e.g., FDA_NDC for FDA National Drug Code Directory, SAP_MM for SAP Materials Management, VEEVA_RIM for Veeva Regulatory Information Management).

attributes.name: start_marketing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug product was first commercially marketed in the United States under this NDC.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The concentration or potency of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the dosage form, including unit of measure (e.g., 10 mg, 500 mg/5 mL, 0.5%).

attributes.name: therapeutic_equivalence_code
attributes.description: The FDA Orange Book therapeutic equivalence code indicating whether the drug product is therapeutically equivalent to a reference listed drug. Codes starting with 'A' are considered therapeutically equivalent; codes starting with 'B' are not.

products.name: inn_registry
products.description: Reference master for International Nonproprietary Names (INN) as assigned by the WHO for pharmaceutical substances. Captures INN name, USAN (United States Adopted Name), recommended INN status, substance class (small molecule, biologic, vaccine, gene therapy), pharmacological class, CAS registry number, molecular formula, and WHO INN publication reference. Serves as the global nonproprietary naming standard for drug substances across regulatory submissions, labeling, and scientific communications.

attributes.name: inn_registry_id
attributes.description: Primary key for inn_registry

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the data steward or data governance role responsible for maintaining the quality and accuracy of this INN registry record. Supports accountability and data quality management.

attributes.name: active_moiety_inn
attributes.description: The INN of the active moiety (the molecule or ion responsible for physiological or pharmacological action) when the registered substance is a salt, ester, or other derivative. For example, imatinib mesylate (salt) has imatinib as the active moiety.
attributes.references: FDA Active Moiety Definition, ICH M4

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code assigned to the substance. ATC codes classify drugs by organ system, therapeutic use, and chemical structure. Format is one letter followed by two digits, two letters, and two digits (e.g., L01XE01 for imatinib).

attributes.name: biosimilar_reference_inn
attributes.description: For biosimilar substances, the INN of the reference biologic product to which this biosimilar is compared. Null for non-biosimilar substances or originator biologics.
attributes.references: EMA Biosimilar Guidelines, FDA Biosimilar Guidance

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the substance has received breakthrough therapy designation from the FDA, indicating preliminary clinical evidence of substantial improvement over existing therapies for serious conditions.

attributes.name: cas_registry_number
attributes.description: The unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to the chemical substance. CAS numbers are globally recognized identifiers for chemical compounds used in regulatory filings, scientific literature, and supply chain documentation.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification if the substance is subject to controlled substance regulations in the United States. Schedule I through V indicate varying levels of abuse potential and regulatory control; Not Controlled indicates no DEA scheduling.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this INN registry record in the master data system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this INN registry record was first created in the master data system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this INN registry record ceases to be effective. Null indicates the record is currently active. Supports temporal validity, version control, and historical tracking of withdrawn or superseded INNs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this INN registry record is effective and valid for use in regulatory submissions, labeling, and scientific communications. Supports temporal validity and version control.

attributes.name: inn_definition
attributes.description: The official WHO definition or description of the substance associated with the INN, including its chemical nature, biological origin, or therapeutic purpose. Provides context for the INN assignment.

attributes.name: inn_language_variants
attributes.description: Alternative language-specific spellings or transliterations of the INN (e.g., Latin, French, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Chinese). Stored as a delimited list or JSON structure to support multilingual regulatory submissions and labeling.

attributes.name: inn_name
attributes.description: The official International Nonproprietary Name assigned by the World Health Organization (WHO) for the pharmaceutical substance. This is the globally recognized nonproprietary name used across regulatory submissions, scientific literature, and labeling.

attributes.name: inn_status
attributes.description: Current status of the INN designation in the WHO publication lifecycle. Proposed indicates initial submission; Recommended indicates WHO expert committee approval; Published indicates final inclusion in WHO INN list; Withdrawn indicates retraction.

attributes.name: inn_stem
attributes.description: The suffix or stem used in the INN name that indicates the pharmacological or chemical class (e.g., -mab for monoclonal antibodies, -tinib for tyrosine kinase inhibitors, -pril for ACE inhibitors). INN stems provide systematic nomenclature consistency.

attributes.name: iupac_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC) Name
attributes.description: The systematic chemical name of the substance according to IUPAC nomenclature rules. Provides unambiguous chemical structure identification, primarily applicable to small molecules.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that last modified this INN registry record. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements for master data governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this INN registry record was last modified in the master data system. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this record is the authoritative golden record in the MDM system for this INN. True indicates this is the master record; False indicates a duplicate or non-authoritative record.

attributes.name: mechanism_of_action
attributes.description: A description of the biochemical or physiological mechanism by which the substance exerts its therapeutic effect (e.g., inhibits BCR-ABL tyrosine kinase, blocks TNF-alpha receptor). Critical for regulatory submissions and scientific communications.

attributes.name: molecular_formula
attributes.description: The chemical molecular formula representing the elemental composition of the substance (e.g., C20H27N7O for imatinib). Applicable primarily to small molecules; may be null for biologics and complex substances.

attributes.name: molecular_weight
attributes.description: The molecular weight of the substance expressed in Daltons (Da) or grams per mole (g/mol). Critical for dosing calculations, formulation development, and analytical method specifications.

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the substance has received orphan drug designation from FDA, EMA, or other regulatory authorities for treatment of rare diseases. True indicates orphan designation has been granted; False indicates no orphan designation.
attributes.references: FDA Orphan Drug Act, EMA Orphan Regulation

attributes.name: pharmacological_class
attributes.description: The therapeutic or pharmacological classification of the substance based on its mechanism of action or therapeutic use (e.g., kinase inhibitor, monoclonal antibody, beta-lactam antibiotic, ACE inhibitor). Provides insight into the drug's mode of action and therapeutic category.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this master data record. Active indicates the record is current and in use; Inactive indicates the record is no longer in use but retained for historical reference; Deprecated indicates the record has been superseded; Under Review indicates the record is being validated or updated.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The typical or approved route(s) by which the substance is administered to patients (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, inhalation, topical). May contain multiple routes separated by semicolons if the substance has multiple approved formulations.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier of the source system from which this INN registry record was ingested or synchronized (e.g., WHO_INN_DB, USAN_REGISTRY, SAP_MDM). Supports data lineage and master data governance.

attributes.name: substance_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the pharmaceutical substance type. Small molecule refers to chemically synthesized drugs; Biologic refers to protein-based therapeutics; Vaccine refers to immunization products; Gene therapy and Cell therapy refer to advanced therapeutic modalities; Oligonucleotide refers to nucleic acid-based drugs.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The primary therapeutic area or disease category for which the substance is intended (e.g., oncology, immunology, cardiovascular, infectious disease, rare disease). Aligns with pharmaceutical business segmentation.

attributes.name: usan_name
attributes.description: The United States Adopted Name for the pharmaceutical substance as designated by the USAN Council. May differ from INN in some cases but typically aligns with WHO INN nomenclature.

attributes.name: who_inn_list_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: World Health Organization (WHO) International Nonproprietary Name (INN) List Number
attributes.description: The sequential WHO INN list number in which the substance was published. WHO publishes INN lists periodically; this number references the specific publication edition.

attributes.name: who_publication_date
attributes.description: The date on which the INN was officially published by the WHO in the INN list. Represents the formal recognition date of the nonproprietary name.

attributes.name: who_publication_reference
attributes.description: The full citation or reference to the WHO document or publication in which the INN was announced. Typically includes WHO Drug Information volume and issue number.

products.name: system_crosswalk
products.description: Cross-system identifier mapping table maintaining authoritative golden-record mappings between master data entity identifiers across the pharmaceutical technology landscape. Maps materials, business partners, sites, compounds, and organizational units between SAP S/4HANA, Veeva Vault, LIMS, MES, Argus Safety, and Medidata Rave. Captures source system, target system, entity type, source identifier, target identifier, mapping direction, mapping status (active, deprecated, pending validation), effective/expiry dates, confidence score, and last reconciliation timestamp. Enables MDM golden record resolution, system integration reconciliation, merger/acquisition data harmonization, and audit trail for identifier lifecycle.
products.reference: MDM Cross-Reference / SAP S/4HANA ALE IDoc

attributes.name: system_crosswalk_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the system crosswalk mapping record. Primary key for the cross-system identifier mapping table.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the data steward responsible for approving and maintaining this identifier mapping. Used for data governance accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: mapping_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business rule or transformation logic used to establish this identifier mapping. Links to MDM governance documentation and mapping specifications.

attributes.name: merger_acquisition_event_id
