attributes.description: Reference to the specific merger, acquisition, or divestiture event that triggered the creation of this identifier mapping. Null for mappings created during normal operations.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the confidence level in the accuracy of this identifier mapping. Higher scores indicate greater certainty in the mapping relationship. Used for data quality management and reconciliation prioritization.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system process that created this identifier mapping record. Required for audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identifier mapping record was first created in the system. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this identifier mapping is no longer valid. Null indicates the mapping is currently active with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this identifier mapping becomes valid and should be used for cross-system integration and Master Data Management (MDM) golden record resolution.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Type of master data entity being mapped across systems. Indicates whether the mapping is for materials, business partners, sites, compounds, organizational units, or products.

attributes.name: golden_record_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mapping represents the authoritative Master Data Management (MDM) golden record relationship for this entity. True for the primary system-of-record mapping.

attributes.name: gxp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this identifier mapping is subject to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), or Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulatory requirements. True for mappings involving regulated master data.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system process that most recently modified this identifier mapping record. Required for audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identifier mapping record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent reconciliation process that validated this identifier mapping against source and target systems. Used for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: mapping_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mapping is unidirectional (source to target only) or bidirectional (can be used in both directions for identifier resolution).

attributes.name: mapping_method
attributes.description: Method by which the identifier mapping was established. Manual indicates data steward creation; automated indicates system-generated; ML-derived indicates machine learning algorithm output.

attributes.name: mapping_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for data stewards to document special considerations, exceptions, or context about this identifier mapping. Used for knowledge transfer and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: mapping_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the identifier mapping. Active mappings are used for integration; deprecated mappings are retained for historical audit; pending validation mappings await data steward approval.

attributes.name: merger_acquisition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this identifier mapping was created as part of a merger, acquisition, or divestiture data harmonization effort. True for M&A-related mappings requiring special governance.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent reconciliation check. Matched indicates both identifiers exist and are consistent; mismatch indicates data quality issue requiring investigation.

attributes.name: source_entity_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description or name of the entity as it appears in the source system. Aids in manual validation and troubleshooting of identifier mappings.

attributes.name: source_identifier
attributes.description: The identifier value as it exists in the source system. This is the original identifier that needs to be mapped to the target system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which the identifier originates. Examples: SAP_S4, VEEVA_VAULT, LIMS_LABWARE, ARGUS, MEDIDATA, MES, VEEVA_CRM.

attributes.name: source_system_instance
attributes.description: Specific instance or environment of the source system (e.g., production, quality assurance, development). Important for multi-instance SAP S/4HANA or Veeva Vault deployments.

attributes.name: sox_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this identifier mapping is relevant for Sarbanes-Oxley Act financial reporting compliance. True for mappings involving financial master data such as cost centers, profit centers, or general ledger accounts.

attributes.name: target_entity_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description or name of the entity as it appears in the target system. Aids in manual validation and troubleshooting of identifier mappings.

attributes.name: target_identifier
attributes.description: The corresponding identifier value in the target system. This is the mapped identifier that the source identifier resolves to.

attributes.name: target_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the target system to which the identifier is mapped. Examples: SAP_S4, VEEVA_VAULT, LIMS_LABWARE, ARGUS, MEDIDATA, MES, VEEVA_CRM.

attributes.name: target_system_instance
attributes.description: Specific instance or environment of the target system (e.g., production, quality assurance, development). Important for multi-instance SAP S/4HANA or Veeva Vault deployments.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this identifier mapping was last validated or approved by a data steward. Critical for regulatory compliance and data quality assurance.

products.name: address
products.description: Master record for standardized physical and postal addresses used across pharmaceutical operations including manufacturing sites, distribution centers, clinical trial sites, vendor locations, and customer ship-to/bill-to addresses. Captures address line 1-3, city, state/province, postal code, country, address type (registered, operational, shipping, billing), geocoordinates, address validation status, and standardization source (USPS, Royal Mail, Deutsche Post). Serves as the cross-domain address SSOT referenced by vendor, customer, plant, and site entities.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Address / ISO 19160

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Primary key for address

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Address references country for geographic/regulatory context. New FK column country_id will link to country.country_id. Existing country_code (STRING) remains for code-level reference; new FK provides

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the data steward or data owner responsible for maintaining the accuracy and quality of this address record. Used for data governance, accountability, and escalation of data quality issues.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are currently in use, inactive addresses are no longer valid but retained for historical reference, pending addresses are awaiting approval or validation, and archived addresses are historical records retained for compliance.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose within pharmaceutical operations. Registered addresses are used for regulatory filings and legal documentation, operational addresses represent active business locations, shipping addresses are used for logistics and distribution, billing addresses are used for invoicing, clinical site addresses represent trial locations, and manufacturing addresses represent production facilities.
attributes.references: FDA Establishment Registration; EMA Site Registration

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name where the address is located. Used for geographic segmentation, logistics planning, and regulatory reporting by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1; Universal Postal Union S42 Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the master data system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number uniquely identifying the business entity at this address. Used for vendor qualification, supply chain due diligence, and compliance with pharmaceutical procurement standards.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address ceased to be valid or was replaced by a new address. Null for currently active addresses. Used for historical reporting and compliance with Good Documentation Practice (GDP) requirements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became valid and active for business use. Used for temporal tracking of address changes, critical for audit trails and regulatory inspection history.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for the address location. Used for electronic communication, document transmission, and coordination with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMO), Contract Research Organizations (CRO), and regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the address location. Still used in pharmaceutical industry for transmitting regulatory documents, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation where electronic signatures are not yet implemented.

attributes.name: gmp_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator identifying whether the address location holds current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) certification. True indicates the site is certified for pharmaceutical manufacturing under FDA, EMA, or other regulatory authority standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211; EMA GMP Guidelines; ICH Q7

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code indicating the primary language used at this address location. Used for generating localized documentation, labeling, and communication in compliance with regional regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this address record. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and ensuring compliance with Good Documentation Practice (GDP) requirements for maintaining current and accurate master data.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees format. Used for geospatial analytics, supply chain route optimization, clinical trial site mapping, and emergency response planning for manufacturing facilities.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line containing street number, street name, and building identifier. This is the main address component used for physical location identification and postal delivery.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 Standard; ISO 19160-1

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as suite number, floor, building name, department, or unit identifier. Optional field used when address_line_1 is insufficient for precise location identification.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 Standard; ISO 19160-1

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for complex addresses requiring additional location context such as industrial park name, campus identifier, or district information. Rarely used but necessary for large pharmaceutical manufacturing complexes or research campuses.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 Standard; ISO 19160-1

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees format. Used in conjunction with latitude for precise geolocation, distribution center proximity analysis, and cold chain logistics planning.

attributes.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator identifying whether this address is the authoritative golden record in the Master Data Management (MDM) system. True indicates this is the single source of truth (SSOT) for this address across all enterprise systems.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the address location. Used for logistics coordination, emergency contact, and operational communication with manufacturing sites, distribution centers, and clinical trial sites.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for mail delivery and geographic precision. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit ZIP in USA, alphanumeric in Canada and UK). Used for logistics optimization, territory assignment, and distribution planning.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 Standard; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: primary_address_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator identifying whether this is the primary or default address for the associated entity (vendor, customer, plant, site). True indicates this is the main address used for official correspondence and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: regulatory_site_identifier
attributes.description: Official site registration number or establishment identifier assigned by regulatory authorities such as FDA Establishment Identifier (FEI), EMA site number, or PMDA registration number. Required for regulatory submissions and inspection tracking.
attributes.references: FDA Establishment Registration; EMA Site Registration; PMDA Guidelines

attributes.name: sap_address_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA system address number linking this master data address to the corresponding address record in SAP modules (MM, SD, FI). Enables cross-system reconciliation and ensures consistency between lakehouse and operational ERP system.

attributes.name: standardization_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last validated or standardized against postal authority databases. Used to determine when re-validation is required, as addresses may become outdated due to postal code changes or street renaming.

attributes.name: standardization_source
attributes.description: The authoritative postal service or third-party vendor used to validate and standardize the address format. Identifies which national postal authority or address verification service confirmed the address accuracy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USPS|Royal_Mail|Deutsche_Post|Canada_Post|Australia_Post|manual|third_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union; USPS Publication 28; Royal Mail PAF

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, region, or administrative division within the country. Critical for regulatory compliance as pharmaceutical licensing and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certifications are often issued at state or provincial level.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Critical for coordinating global clinical trials, manufacturing schedules, and supply chain operations across multiple time zones.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the address has been verified against authoritative postal databases. Validated addresses have been confirmed by postal authority services (USPS, Royal Mail, Deutsche Post), unvalidated addresses have not been checked, failed addresses could not be verified, pending addresses are queued for validation, and manual override indicates business approval despite validation failure.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; Royal Mail PAF; ISO 19160-1

products.name: business_partner
products.description: Unified master record and Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for ALL external business partners in the pharmaceutical enterprise, following the SAP S/4HANA Business Partner model. Encompasses all vendor/supplier roles (API suppliers, CMOs, CDMOs, CROs, excipient suppliers, packaging suppliers, laboratory reagent vendors) and all customer roles (wholesalers, distributors, hospital networks, pharmacy chains, GPOs, government health agencies) under a single authoritative identity. Captures BP number, BP category (person, organization, group), BP role(s) (supplier, customer, carrier, CMO, CRO, distributor), legal name, tax identification numbers, GMP certification status, qualification status, approved vendor list (AVL) flag, DEA registration number, HIN (Health Industry Number), GLN (Global Location Number), payment terms, credit limits, bank details, sales organization assignment, distribution channel, currency, and cross-system identifiers (SAP BP number, Veeva account ID, LIMS supplier code). Role-specific attributes maintained per role assignment. This is the sole authoritative product for external party identity — no other product in this domain masters vendor or customer identity.

attributes.name: country_id

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Business partners (especially subsidiaries, affiliates) may be linked to legal entities for consolidation and intercompany transactions. New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id.

attributes.name: masterdata_address_id
attributes.description: FK to masterdata.address

attributes.name: avl_flag

attributes.name: bank_account_number

attributes.name: blocking_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the business partner is blocked for specific business functions (sales, purchasing, payment) due to compliance, quality, or financial issues.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Model; ICH Q10

attributes.name: bp_category
attributes.description: Classification of the business partner entity type: person (individual), organization (company/institution), or group (corporate group).

attributes.name: bp_number

attributes.name: bp_role

A single BP may hold multiple roles.

attributes.name: business_partner_status

attributes.name: company_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency_code

attributes.name: dea_registration_number

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.name: email_address

attributes.name: fda_establishment_identifier

attributes.name: gln

attributes.name: gmp_certification_status

attributes.name: legal_name

attributes.name: lims_supplier_code

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

attributes.name: veeva_account_code

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between a business partner (in supplier role) and a material. It captures the Approved Vendor List (AVL) qualification, pricing, lead times, and GMP compliance requirements mandated by pharmaceutical regulations. Each record links one business partner to one material with supplier-specific terms that exist only in the context of this supply relationship. Critical for procurement, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance in pharmaceutical supply chain management.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical supply chain operations, a single material (e.g., an API or excipient) is routinely sourced from multiple qualified suppliers to ensure supply continuity, competitive pricing, and regulatory compliance. Conversely, each supplier provides multiple different materials to the pharmaceutical manufacturer. The Approved Vendor List (AVL) is a regulatory requirement under GMP that mandates qualification and ongoing monitoring of each supplier-material combination, with relationship-specific data including pricing, lead times, qualification dates, audit schedules, and GMP certification status that cannot be stored on either the business partner or material entity alone.

attributes.name: supply_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each supply agreement record between a business partner and a material

attributes.name: business_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the business partner acting in supplier role (API supplier, CMO, CDMO, CRO, excipient supplier, packaging supplier, laboratory reagent vendor)

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supply Agreement - Masterdata Material Master Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the material being supplied (API, excipient, drug substance, drug product, packaging material, laboratory reagent, raw material)

attributes.name: avl_status
attributes.description: Current AVL qualification status for this supplier-material combination. Approved = fully qualified, Conditional = approved with restrictions, Suspended = temporarily not allowed, Disqualified = removed from AVL. GMP regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the legal contract or purchase agreement governing this supply relationship. Links to contract management system for terms and conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply agreement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit price. Required for multi-currency procurement operations.

attributes.name: gmp_certification_status
attributes.description: GMP certification status specific to this suppliers capability to manufacture or supply this material. Material-specific because GMP requirements vary by material type (API vs excipient vs packaging).

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality or GMP compliance audit conducted at this suppliers facility for this material. Supplier-material specific because audit scope varies by material criticality and GMP classification.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this supply agreement record. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from purchase order to delivery for this material from this supplier. Critical for MRP planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum order quantity that this supplier can fulfill for this material in a single order, expressed in the materials base unit of measure. Reflects supplier capacity constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by this supplier for this material, expressed in the materials base unit of measure. Supplier-specific commercial term.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next audit of this supplier for this material. Audit frequency varies by material risk classification and supplier performance history.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the preferred source for this material based on quality, reliability, cost, and strategic relationship. Used in automated source determination during procurement.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this supplier was qualified for this specific material through the supplier qualification process including audits, sample testing, and documentation review. Required for regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: supply_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this supply agreement. Active = currently valid for procurement, Inactive = not available for new orders, Pending = under negotiation, Expired = past valid_to_date.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Negotiated price per base unit of measure for this material from this supplier. Varies by supplier-material combination based on volume commitments, contract terms, and market conditions.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date for this supply agreement. Pricing, lead times, and qualification are valid from this date forward.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Expiration date for this supply agreement. Null indicates an open-ended agreement. Triggers contract renewal workflow when approaching.

products.name: entity_registration
products.description: This association product represents the country-specific registration and regulatory compliance record for a legal entity operating in a particular jurisdiction. It captures registration numbers, tax identifiers, regulatory licenses, and compliance status that exist only in the context of a specific legal entity operating in a specific country. Each record links one legal entity to one country with jurisdiction-specific regulatory and tax attributes.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical operations, a single legal entity (e.g., Pfizer Inc.) operates in multiple countries with country-specific registrations, tax IDs, and regulatory licenses in each jurisdiction. Conversely, each country hosts multiple legal entities from different pharmaceutical companies. The business actively manages these country-specific registrations as distinct compliance records with jurisdiction-specific attributes (registration numbers, tax IDs, regulatory status, license expiry dates) that cannot be stored on either the legal entity or country master alone.

attributes.name: regulatory_status

products.name: material_plant_data
products.description: This association product represents the plant-specific configuration and planning parameters for materials in pharmaceutical manufacturing operations. It captures MRP settings, quality inspection procedures, storage locations, and procurement rules that exist only in the context of a specific material-plant combination. Each record links one material to one plant with operational parameters that govern how that material is managed at that specific facility.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, materials are managed across multiple plant facilities with plant-specific operational parameters, and each plant manages thousands of different materials with unique MRP settings, quality procedures, and storage configurations. Material Plant Data is a foundational SAP MM business concept that captures the intersection of material master data and plant master data, representing how a specific material is procured, planned, stored, and quality-controlled at a specific manufacturing site. This is a textbook many-to-many relationship where the association itself carries rich operational configuration data that belongs to neither the material nor the plant alone.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material plant data record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Plant Data - Masterdata Material Master Id

attributes.name: plant_id

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum inventory quantity that must be maintained at this plant to buffer against demand variability and supply disruptions, expressed in the material base unit of measure.

attributes.name: valid_to_date

products.name: material_storage_location_data
products.description: This association product represents the storage configuration and inventory management parameters for a specific material at a specific storage location within pharmaceutical operations. It captures bin assignments, reorder points, stock limits, handling strategies, and environmental monitoring requirements that exist only in the context of a material being stored at a particular location. Each record links one material to one storage location with operational parameters required for SAP WM/EWM, cold-chain integrity, controlled substance accountability, and GMP compliance.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical operations, a single material (e.g., an API or finished drug product) is routinely stored across multiple storage locations (e.g., main warehouse, cold room, quarantine zone, controlled substance vault) to support manufacturing, quality control, and distribution processes. Conversely, a single storage location houses many different materials. Each material-storage location combination requires specific operational parameters including bin assignments, reorder points, stock limits, putaway strategies, and environmental monitoring requirements that are unique to that combination and cannot be stored on either the material master or storage location master alone.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Annual budget allocated to the compliance program in USD, covering personnel, training, technology, consulting, and audit costs.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount. Typically USD for global pharmaceutical enterprises.

attributes.name: capa_integration

attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance program is integrated with the enterprise CAPA system for tracking and resolving compliance deviations, audit findings, and quality issues.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current external certification or accreditation expires and requires renewal or re-audit.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Status of external certification or accreditation for this compliance program. Examples include ISO 37301 certification, SOX attestation, or industry-specific accreditation.

attributes.name: charter_document
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document management system location for the formal program charter that defines objectives, governance, roles, responsibilities, and success criteria.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance program record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; ALCOA+ Data Integrity

attributes.name: csv_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether systems covered by this compliance program require formal Computer System Validation per 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, or GAMP 5 guidelines.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance program became or will become operationally effective and binding across the defined scope.

attributes.name: escalation_procedure
attributes.description: Description of the escalation path and notification procedures for compliance breaches, audit findings, or regulatory issues identified within this program. Includes roles, timelines, and communication protocols.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance program is scheduled to expire or be retired. Null for ongoing programs without a defined end date.

attributes.name: external_audit_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external audit or consulting firm that provides independent assessment or certification of this compliance program. Applicable for SOX, ISO, or third-party GxP audits.

attributes.name: governance_committee
attributes.description: Name of the cross-functional governance committee or steering group that oversees this compliance program. Examples include Quality Council, Compliance Steering Committee, or Data Integrity Governance Board.

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the programs preparedness for regulatory inspection or external audit. Inspection Ready indicates all documentation, training, and evidence are current and accessible. Audit Verified indicates recent successful inspection or third-party audit.

attributes.name: key_performance_indicators
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of key performance indicators used to measure compliance program effectiveness. Examples include training completion rate, audit finding closure rate, deviation response time, or inspection deficiency count.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection or external audit that assessed this compliance program.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified the compliance program record. Required for audit trail and ALCOA+ attributability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance program record was last updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and data integrity compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; ALCOA+ Data Integrity

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or assessment of the compliance program by the governance committee or internal audit function.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the compliance program across the enterprise. Used in regulatory submissions and audit documentation.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the compliance programs objectives, regulatory obligations, key controls, and business impact. Used in governance materials and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official name of the compliance program as documented in the program charter and governance materials.

attributes.name: program_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the business functions, processes, systems, and geographic regions covered by this compliance program. Defines boundaries and applicability across the enterprise.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance program. Draft indicates program is being designed. Active means program is operational. Under Review indicates periodic assessment or audit in progress. Suspended means program activities are temporarily halted. Remediation indicates program is addressing identified deficiencies. Retired means program has been formally closed.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compliance program by regulatory domain. GxP includes Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) programs. SOX refers to Sarbanes-Oxley internal controls. ABAC is Anti-Bribery and Corruption. HCP Transparency covers Sunshine Act and physician payment disclosure requirements. attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory agency or governing body that enforces the compliance obligations addressed by this program. Examples include FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration), EMA (European Medicines Agency), MHRA (UK), PMDA (Japan), NMPA (China), or DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration).
attributes.references: FDA; EMA; MHRA; PMDA; NMPA; ICH

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework or standard governing this compliance program. Examples include 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records, EU Annex 11 for computerized systems, GDPR for data privacy, ICH Q10 for pharmaceutical quality systems, or SOX Section 404 for internal controls.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EMA Guidelines; ICH; GDPR; SOX; PIC/S

attributes.name: reporting_cadence
attributes.description: Frequency at which program performance metrics, compliance status, and risk indicators are reported to governance committees and executive leadership. attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Enterprise risk classification of the compliance program based on potential regulatory, financial, and reputational impact. Critical tier programs address patient safety, product quality, or financial reporting. High tier programs address significant regulatory obligations. Medium and Low tier programs address operational compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ISO 31000 Risk Management

attributes.name: sop_count
attributes.description: Number of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that define processes and controls for this compliance program. Indicates program maturity and documentation completeness.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP

attributes.name: training_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required refresher training cycles for personnel covered by this compliance program. Typical values are 12 (annual), 24 (biennial), or 36 (triennial) months.

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether personnel working under this compliance program must complete mandatory training and demonstrate competency. Required for all GxP programs per ICH guidelines.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211.25; EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: parent_program_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on program (parent_program_id)

products.name: internal_control
products.description: Master record for internal controls established to satisfy regulatory requirements, SOX obligations, and GxP compliance mandates. Captures control ID, control name, control type (preventive, detective, corrective), control category (IT general control, business process control, entity-level control), control owner, frequency (continuous, daily, monthly, annual), testing method, and SOX applicability flag. Links to regulatory requirements and compliance programs. Serves as the authoritative control inventory for SOX Section 302/404 and GxP compliance assurance.

attributes.name: internal_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the internal control record. Primary key for the internal control master data.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: SOX and GxP controls are assigned to organizational units for execution. Control owners are typically org unit heads. Essential for control testing, deficiency remediation, and audit preparation.

attributes.name: part11_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the IT system or application where this control is executed or documented. Relevant for automated controls and ITGC controls.

attributes.name: process_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the business process taxonomy. Identifies which business process this control operates within (e.g., Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Drug Manufacturing).

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the enterprise risk register. Links this control to the specific risk(s) it is designed to mitigate.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree to which the control is automated. Fully Automated controls execute without human intervention; Semi-Automated controls combine system logic with manual review; Manual controls require complete human execution.

attributes.name: cfr_part_11_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) Part 11 Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control ensures compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for electronic records and electronic signatures in FDA-regulated systems.

attributes.name: compensating_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control serves as a compensating control for another control that has a deficiency or is not operating effectively. Compensating controls provide alternative risk mitigation.

attributes.name: control_activity
attributes.description: Specific action or procedure performed to execute the control (e.g., 'Quality Assurance reviews and approves batch records before release', 'System enforces dual authorization for payments over $50,000').

attributes.name: control_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the control. IT General Controls (ITGC) support IT infrastructure and applications; Business Process Controls operate within specific business processes; Entity-Level Controls operate across the organization; Application Controls are embedded in software; Manual Controls require human execution; Automated Controls execute via system logic.

attributes.name: control_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the control objective, control activities, and how the control mitigates the identified risk. Includes the what, who, when, and how of the control execution.

attributes.name: control_effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Most recent assessment of whether the control is operating effectively. Effective means no deficiencies; Needs Improvement indicates minor deficiencies; Ineffective indicates material weaknesses; Not Tested means no recent testing has been performed.

attributes.name: control_evidence
attributes.description: Description of the documentation or artifacts that demonstrate control execution (e.g., 'Signed batch record with QA approval stamp', 'System audit log showing dual approval', 'Monthly reconciliation report with preparer and reviewer signatures').

attributes.name: control_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is executed or evaluated. Continuous and real-time controls operate automatically; periodic controls execute on a schedule; event-driven controls trigger based on specific business events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|real_time|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|event_driven — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: control_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the internal control (e.g., 'Segregation of Duties for Invoice Approval', 'Batch Record Review and Approval').

attributes.name: control_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the control, typically formatted as domain-category-sequence (e.g., FI-ITGC-0001, QM-BPC-0023). Used in audit documentation and control testing reports.

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: High-level statement of what the control is designed to achieve (e.g., 'Ensure completeness and accuracy of batch production records', 'Prevent unauthorized access to financial systems').

attributes.name: control_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role responsible for the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of the control. Accountable for control effectiveness and remediation of deficiencies.

attributes.name: control_owner_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the control owner for audit notifications, testing requests, and deficiency communications.

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control. Active controls are in operation; Inactive controls are temporarily suspended; Under Review controls are being assessed for design changes; Remediation in Progress controls have identified deficiencies being corrected; Retired controls are no longer in scope.

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control based on its timing relative to the risk event. Preventive controls stop errors before they occur, detective controls identify errors after occurrence, corrective controls remediate identified issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for control inventory management.

attributes.name: data_integrity_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control specifically addresses ALCOA+ principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available). Critical for pharmaceutical data integrity compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance, MHRA GXP Data Integrity Guidance, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of open control deficiencies, exceptions, or findings identified during testing. Includes control design deficiencies and operating effectiveness deficiencies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this control was retired or superseded. Null for active controls. Used for historical analysis and audit trail.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this control became operational and in scope for compliance monitoring. Used for historical tracking and audit period determination.

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control supports GDPR compliance for personal data protection, privacy rights, and data subject rights in EU operations or clinical trials.

attributes.name: gxp_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control supports GxP compliance (GMP, GLP, GCP, GDP). True if the control ensures data integrity, product quality, or patient safety in regulated pharmaceutical operations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH Q10

attributes.name: gxp_regulation
attributes.description: Specific GxP regulation(s) this control supports (e.g., '21 CFR Part 211', 'EU GMP Annex 11', 'ICH Q7'). Multiple regulations may be comma-separated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 21_cfr_part_11|21_cfr_part_210|21_cfr_part_211|21_cfr_part_312|eu_gmp_annex_11|ich_q7|ich_q10|gdp_guidelines — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR, EMA GMP Guidelines, ICH Guidelines

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control supports HIPAA compliance for protected health information (PHI) in US clinical trials, patient support programs, or pharmacovigilance activities.

attributes.name: key_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a key control that directly addresses a significant risk and must be tested annually. Key controls are critical to the overall control environment and receive heightened audit focus.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified this control record. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was most recently updated. Part of audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the control was most recently tested for design and operating effectiveness by internal audit, external audit, or compliance team.

attributes.name: material_weakness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a material weakness has been identified in this control. Material weaknesses are deficiencies that create a reasonable possibility of material misstatement in financial statements and must be disclosed under SOX Section 404.

attributes.name: next_test_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next control testing cycle based on control frequency and risk rating. Used for audit planning and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: significant_deficiency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a significant deficiency has been identified in this control. Significant deficiencies are less severe than material weaknesses but important enough to merit attention by those charged with governance.

attributes.name: sox_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control is in scope for SOX Section 302/404 compliance and must be tested annually for financial reporting integrity. True if the control is a key control over financial reporting.

attributes.name: sox_section
attributes.description: Specific SOX section(s) this control supports. Section 302 relates to management certification of financial statements; Section 404 relates to internal control over financial reporting assessment.

attributes.name: testing_method
attributes.description: Primary audit testing procedure used to evaluate control design and operating effectiveness. Inquiry involves asking control performers; Observation involves watching control execution; Inspection involves examining evidence; Reperformance involves auditor executing the control; Data Analytics involves statistical or automated testing.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created this control record. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirements.

attributes.name: parent_internal_control_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on internal_control (parent_internal_control_id)

products.name: control_assessment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the periodic testing and assessment of internal controls. Covers SOX control testing, GxP compliance assessments, and IT general control (ITGC) evaluations. Captures assessment period, assessor identity, testing approach (walkthrough, sample testing, full population), sample size, test results (effective, ineffective, not tested), deficiency classification (control deficiency, significant deficiency, material weakness), and remediation status. Feeds SOX 404 management assessment and external auditor reliance programs.
products.reference: SOX Control Test / GxP Control Assessment

attributes.name: control_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the control assessment record. Primary key for the control assessment entity.

attributes.name: internal_control_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal control being assessed. Links to the control master record defining the control objective, description, and ownership.

attributes.name: primary_control_assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who performed the control assessment. Must be independent of the control owner per segregation of duties requirements. For external auditor assessments, references the engagement team member.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework, 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: quality_capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal CAPA record created to address identified control deficiencies. Links to quality management system for tracking root cause analysis, corrective actions, preventive actions, and effectiveness verification per 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart J and ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who reviewed and approved the assessment results. Typically a senior compliance officer, quality assurance manager, or internal audit director. Required for SOX management assessment sign-off.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the control assessment was formally approved by the reviewer. Represents management sign-off on assessment conclusions and remediation plans. Required for SOX 404 management assessment certification.

attributes.name: assessment_execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the control assessment testing was performed. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the assessment activity. May differ from period end date for interim or retrospective testing.

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for assessor observations, testing procedures performed, evidence examined, and other relevant assessment details. Supports audit trail and provides context for assessment conclusions and recommendations.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the control assessment. Format: CA-YYYY-NNNNNN where YYYY is fiscal year and NNNNNN is sequential number. Used for external reporting and audit trail references.

attributes.name: assessment_period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the period under assessment. Defines the scope boundary for transaction sampling and control effectiveness evaluation.

attributes.name: assessment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the period under assessment. For SOX testing, typically aligns with fiscal quarter or year start. For GxP assessments, may align with batch production periods or clinical trial phases.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the control assessment. Planned indicates assessment scheduled but not started. In progress indicates active testing underway. Testing complete indicates fieldwork finished, awaiting review. Under review indicates management or audit committee review in progress. Approved indicates assessment concluded with no material findings. Remediation required indicates deficiencies identified requiring Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA).

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control assessment activity. SOX control testing covers Sarbanes-Oxley 404 internal control evaluations. GxP compliance assessment covers Good Practice (GMP, GLP, GCP) regulatory compliance. ITGC evaluation covers IT General Controls. Process walkthrough covers end-to-end process documentation and control identification. Data integrity review covers ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available) principles. Vendor audit covers third-party Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) and Contract Research Organization (CRO) assessments.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, COSO Framework

attributes.name: control_effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of control design and operating effectiveness. Highly effective indicates robust control with no exceptions and strong design. Effective indicates control operates as designed with minor exceptions. Needs improvement indicates control operates but has design weaknesses or recurring exceptions. Ineffective indicates control does not mitigate risk or has material failures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the control assessment record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance and data integrity requirements.

attributes.name: data_integrity_alcoa_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether control assessment verified compliance with ALCOA+ data integrity principles: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Enduring, and Available. Critical for GxP systems validation and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, MHRA GXP Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Severity classification of identified control deficiencies per SOX 404 and PCAOB standards. No deficiency indicates effective control. Control deficiency indicates a weakness that does not rise to significant deficiency. Significant deficiency indicates a deficiency or combination of deficiencies that is less severe than a material weakness yet important enough to merit attention by those charged with governance. Material weakness indicates a deficiency or combination of deficiencies such that there is a reasonable possibility that a material misstatement will not be prevented or detected on a timely basis.

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of identified control deficiencies, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, and specific instances of control failure. Required for significant deficiencies and material weaknesses reported to audit committee and external auditors.

attributes.name: evidence_location
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location of assessment work papers and supporting evidence. May be document management system path, shared drive location, or electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) reference. Required for audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: exceptions_identified_count
attributes.description: Number of control failures or deviations identified during testing. Exceptions indicate instances where the control did not operate as designed or was not performed. Used to calculate control deficiency rate and determine control effectiveness conclusion.

attributes.name: external_auditor_reliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether external auditors can rely on this internal control assessment for their financial statement audit. True indicates assessment meets PCAOB standards for auditor reliance. False indicates external auditors must perform independent testing. Critical for SOX 404(b) external auditor attestation.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter in which the control assessment was performed. Used for quarterly SOX testing cycles and interim control effectiveness monitoring.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the control assessment was performed. Used for SOX 404 annual management assessment reporting and multi-year trend analysis of control effectiveness.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the control assessment record was last updated. Tracks changes to assessment status, test results, or remediation progress. Required for audit trail and change control per 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: Total number of control instances or transactions in the assessment period. Used to calculate sampling rates and extrapolate findings. For automated controls, may represent system-generated control executions. For manual controls, represents documented control performance instances.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether control assessment documentation is inspection-ready for FDA Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI), EMA inspection, or other regulatory authority audits. True indicates assessment package complete with evidence, work papers, and management sign-off per GxP requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Compliance Program 7346.832, EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when corrective action implementation was completed. Used to calculate remediation cycle time and track compliance with remediation commitments made to audit committee and external auditors.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for corrective action implementation. Established based on deficiency severity and risk rating. Material weaknesses typically require remediation within 90 days. Significant deficiencies within 180 days. Monitored for SOX 404 management assessment and external auditor follow-up.

attributes.name: remediation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether corrective action is required to address identified deficiencies. True indicates Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan must be developed and tracked. False indicates no remediation needed.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current state of corrective action implementation. Not required indicates no deficiencies identified. Planned indicates CAPA plan approved but not started. In progress indicates remediation activities underway. Completed indicates remediation actions finished, awaiting verification. Verified indicates remediation effectiveness confirmed through re-testing. Overdue indicates remediation past target completion date.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart J, ISO 9001 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of residual risk exposure given identified control deficiencies. Critical indicates immediate risk of material financial misstatement or regulatory non-compliance. High indicates significant risk requiring prompt remediation. Medium indicates moderate risk with planned remediation. Low indicates minimal risk with monitoring.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of control instances or transactions tested during the assessment. For sample testing, determined by statistical sampling methodology based on population size, expected error rate, and confidence level. For full population testing, equals total population. Null for walkthroughs and inquiry-only assessments.

attributes.name: sox_scoping_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this control is in scope for SOX 404 management assessment and external auditor attestation. True indicates control is key to preventing or detecting material misstatements in financial reporting. Scoping based on materiality, risk assessment, and process-level controls over significant accounts and disclosures.

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Overall conclusion on control operating effectiveness. Effective indicates control operated as designed with no material exceptions. Ineffective indicates control failures that could result in material misstatement or compliance violation. Not tested indicates assessment planned but not executed. Not applicable indicates control not in operation during assessment period.

attributes.name: testing_approach
attributes.description: Methodology used to evaluate control effectiveness. Inquiry involves interviewing control performers. Observation involves watching control execution in real-time. Inspection involves examining documentary evidence. Reperformance involves independently executing the control. Walkthrough involves tracing a single transaction end-to-end. Sample testing involves statistical sampling of control instances. Full population testing involves examining all control instances in the period. products.name: part11_system
products.description: Master record for computerized systems subject to 21 CFR Part 11 (FDA) and EU Annex 11 (EMA) electronic records and electronic signatures regulations. Captures system name, system owner, GxP criticality classification, validation status, audit trail capability, electronic signature implementation, access control configuration, system category (infrastructure, laboratory, manufacturing, clinical), and Part 11/Annex 11 compliance determination. Serves as the authoritative inventory of regulated computerized systems requiring Part 11/Annex 11 compliance management.
products.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11 System Inventory

attributes.name: part11_system_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: 21 CFR (Code of Federal Regulations) Part 11 System ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the computerized system subject to 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 regulations. Primary key.

attributes.name: access_control_implemented
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system has access controls to limit system access to authorized individuals based on role and responsibility.

attributes.name: access_control_method
attributes.description: Type of access control mechanism implemented to enforce authorization policies and restrict system functions.

attributes.name: annex11_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system is subject to EU Annex 11 requirements for computerized systems in GMP environments.

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system has audit trail functionality enabled to capture secure, computer-generated, time-stamped electronic records of user actions.

attributes.name: audit_trail_review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which audit trail records are reviewed by quality assurance or system owners to detect unauthorized access or data manipulation.

attributes.name: backup_recovery_validated

attributes.name: change_control_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether changes to the system require formal change control procedures including impact assessment and revalidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this system record was first created in the compliance inventory.

attributes.name: data_integrity_controls
attributes.description: Level of data integrity controls implemented to ensure data is Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Enduring, and Available.
attributes.references: MHRA GXP Data Integrity Guidance, FDA Data Integrity Guidance, ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_residency_location
attributes.description: Geographic location or jurisdiction where system data is stored, critical for GDPR and data sovereignty compliance.

attributes.name: decommission_date

attributes.name: deployment_environment
attributes.description: Infrastructure deployment model for the system, impacting validation scope and data residency compliance.

attributes.name: electronic_signature_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system supports electronic signatures that are legally binding equivalents to handwritten signatures under Part 11 requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Subpart B, EU Annex 11

attributes.name: electronic_signature_type
attributes.description: Method used for electronic signature implementation, ensuring unique identification and authentication of the signatory.

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system processes personal data of EU residents and is subject to GDPR privacy and data protection requirements.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Date when the system was first deployed into production and made available for business use following validation approval.

attributes.name: gxp_criticality
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the system directly impacts product quality, patient safety, or data integrity under GxP regulations (GMP, GLP, GCP, GDP).

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable

attributes.description: Indicates whether the system processes protected health information (PHI) and is subject to HIPAA privacy and security rules.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: inspection_findings
attributes.description: Classification of findings or observations from the last regulatory inspection related to this system.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.references: FDA Inspection Guidelines, EMA GMP Inspection

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the individual who last modified this system record, ensuring accountability and traceability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this system record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: part11_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: 21 CFR (Code of Federal Regulations) Part 11 Applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system is subject to 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for electronic records and electronic signatures.

attributes.name: part11_system_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the system's business purpose, functional scope, and role in pharmaceutical operations.

attributes.name: record_retention_period_years

attributes.name: revalidation_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for periodic revalidation or validation review to ensure continued system compliance and fitness for use.

attributes.name: sox_controls_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system is subject to SOX internal controls over financial reporting, requiring additional audit and access controls.

attributes.name: system_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the computerized system indicating its primary business domain and operational scope. attributes.name: system_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the system for identification and tracking purposes across compliance documentation.

attributes.name: system_name

attributes.name: system_owner

attributes.name: system_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the system in the enterprise inventory, indicating whether it is in active use or retired.

attributes.name: system_version

attributes.name: validation_date

attributes.name: validation_status

attributes.name: vendor_name

attributes.name: predecessor_part11_system_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on part11_system (predecessor_part11_system_id)

products.name: esignature_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing each electronic signature event executed within GxP-regulated computerized systems subject to 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11. Captures signer identity, signer role, system ID, record being signed, signature meaning (reviewed, approved, authored, verified), timestamp, authentication method (biometric, username/password), and non-repudiation confirmation. Provides the audit trail of electronic signature events required for regulatory compliance and inspection readiness.

attributes.name: esignature_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the electronic signature event. Primary key for the esignature_event product.

attributes.name: part11_system_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the GxP-regulated computerized system in which the electronic signature event occurred.

attributes.name: predecessor_signature_event_esignature_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preceding electronic signature event in a sequential approval chain, if applicable.

attributes.name: primary_esignature_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the individual who executed the electronic signature. Links to the enterprise user or employee master.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user session during which the electronic signature was executed, linking the signature to the broader audit trail.

attributes.name: workflow_step_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific workflow step or approval stage at which the electronic signature was executed.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this electronic signature event to the broader system audit trail or log entry for complete traceability.

attributes.name: authentication_method
attributes.description: Method used to authenticate the signer's identity at the time of signature execution (e.g., username/password, biometric, token-based, multi-factor authentication).

attributes.name: authentication_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the authentication attempt (success, failure, account locked, credentials expired).

attributes.name: biometric_data_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash of biometric data (fingerprint, retina scan) used for authentication, if biometric method was employed. Raw biometric data is not stored.

attributes.name: compliance_validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the electronic signature event was validated for regulatory compliance by the system or quality assurance process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this electronic signature event record was first created in the data lakehouse, recorded in UTC.

attributes.name: delegation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the signature was executed under delegated authority (True) or by the originally assigned individual (False).

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device (workstation, tablet, mobile device) used to execute the electronic signature.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol (IP) address of the device from which the electronic signature was executed, captured for audit trail and security purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this electronic signature event record was last modified in the data lakehouse, recorded in UTC.

attributes.name: non_repudiation_token
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash or token generated at the time of signing to ensure non-repudiation and integrity of the signature event.

attributes.name: record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the business record or document being signed within the source system (e.g., batch record ID, protocol ID, SOP ID).

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Type or category of the business record being signed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: batch_record|protocol|sop|deviation|capa|change_control|specification|validation_report|clinical_trial_document|manufacturing_instruction|quality_record|regulatory_submission|training_record|audit_report|investigation_report|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_version_number
attributes.description: Version number or identifier of the business record at the time the electronic signature was executed, ensuring signature is tied to a specific record state.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the electronic signature event meets all regulatory compliance requirements (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11) at the time of execution.

attributes.name: signature_image_path
attributes.description: File path or URI to the stored graphical representation of the electronic signature, if captured (e.g., stylus signature on tablet).

attributes.name: signature_meaning
attributes.description: The intended meaning or purpose of the electronic signature as defined by the business process (e.g., reviewed, approved, authored, verified). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: authored|reviewed|approved|verified|witnessed|acknowledged|released|rejected — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: signature_reason
attributes.description: Optional free-text reason or comment provided by the signer at the time of signature execution, explaining the basis for their action.

attributes.name: signature_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this signature within a multi-signature workflow or approval chain for the same record.

attributes.name: signature_status
attributes.description: Current status of the electronic signature event in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the electronic signature was executed, recorded in UTC with millisecond precision for audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: signer_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual who executed the electronic signature, captured at the time of signing for non-repudiation.

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Functional role or job title of the signer at the time of signature execution (e.g., QA Manager, Manufacturing Supervisor, Principal Investigator).

attributes.name: signer_username
attributes.description: Username or login ID of the individual who executed the electronic signature at the time of signing.

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the source GxP-regulated system from which the electronic signature event was captured (e.g., Veeva Vault, MasterControl, TrackWise).

attributes.name: workflow_step_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the workflow step at which the electronic signature was executed (e.g., QA Review, Final Approval).
